About this job

Lead strategic and operational direction for Assurant Dealer Services in a defined geographic region. Oversee revenue growth, regional sales team performance, and client satisfaction across a portfolio of automotive accounts.

Good fit if you have 10+ years progressive automotive F&I leadership experience and 15+ years automotive insurance industry experience.

Full job description


Job Description

The Division Vice President (DVP) of Assurant Dealer Services leads the strategic and operational direction of a defined geographic business. This executive is responsible for achieving and exceeding revenue targets, growing market share, budget management, and ensuring exceptional client satisfaction across a portfolio of automotive accounts. The DVP oversees performance of the regional sales team, drives new business development, and builds strong relationships with key clients and stakeholders.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Develop and execute sales strategies aligned with Assurant Dealer Services (ADS) goals based on expertise within the channel, participants, markets, products and competitive landscape (traditional and disruptive).
  • Drive revenue growth, margin performance, and cost management across the division, creating a roadmap for increased profitability and commercial excellence within their division.
  • Research and proposes innovative strategies for ADS sales strategic accounts growth for their division; monitor sales effectiveness in delivering points of difference to increase our position in value creation for AIZ and our partners.
  • Provides leadership in developing best practices for measuring and optimizing strategic activities to drive data-driven decision making and excellence in their division.
  • Proactively analyze segments of customer data to uncover insights and key takeaways that inform strategic planning, increase revenue and drives business value in their division.
  • Synthesize and present data on account performance, identify areas of potential income improvement, and implement strategies to cross-sell products in their division.
  • Ensures any service gaps are addressed quickly and effectively and in situations of conflict with the client, leads the management team(s) to resolution looking to accomplish a win-win situation. Measures client satisfaction and uses findings to identify and address areas of opportunities as well as build upon success stories in their division.
  • Collaborates with risk management team related to current clients to mitigate regulatory risk and manage client compliance and oversight requirements in their division.
  • Lead, mentor, develop and performance manage regional sales managers and support staff. Build a high-performance, results-driven culture.
  • Monitor division sales performance/pipeline metrics and provide coaching.
  • Creating a roadmap for increased profitability and excellence within their division.

Team Leadership:


Direct reports

  • 8 Regional Managers

Number of direct and indirect reports

  • Approx. 20-35


What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Marketing or related field.
  • A minimum of 10 years of progressive leadership experience in retail automotive space with concentration in the F&I arena, with demonstrated experience showing progression and increasing scope of responsibility.
  • 15 or more years in the Automotive Insurance experience and/or training industry.
  • Proven track record of strategic goal setting and personnel oversight, development and managing large, complex accounts.
  • Strong knowledge of the automotive ecosystem—OEMs, tiered suppliers, dealers, or fleet/aftermarket services.
  • Excellent negotiation, presentation, and client relationship management skills.
  • Change Management - Develops workable implementation plans; Communicates changes effectively; Builds commitment and overcomes resistance; Prepares and supports those affected by change; Monitors transition and evaluates results.
  • Business Acumen - Understands business implications of decisions; Displays orientation to profitability; Demonstrates knowledge of market and competition; Aligns work with strategic goals.
  • Organizational Support - Follows policies and procedures; Completes administrative tasks correctly and on time; Supports organization's goals and values.
  • Strategic Thinking - Develops strategies to achieve business goals that support the overall organization's goals; Understands business strengths & weaknesses; Analyzes market and competition; Identifies external threats and opportunities; Adapts strategy to changing conditions.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Master's degree in Business Administration preferred.​

How much should I expect to travel?

  • Up to 70% travel

Strong preference to candidates that reside or are open to relocation to the Dallas, Houston, Phoenix, Los Angeles, or Chicago markets.

About this job

12-week summer internship in Global Finance at Fortune 500 Assurant, offering hands-on experience in accounting, business finance, tax, investments, internal audit, analytics, vendor management, or actuarial work. Program includes mentorship, real-world projects, and a capstone presentation to leadership.

Good fit if you are pursuing a degree in accounting, finance, business, economics, data analytics, or actuarial science with at least one semester remaining after summer 2027.

Full job description

Overview

The Global Finance Internship Program at Assurant is a 12-week immersive experience designed to provide hands-on exposure within Accounting, Business Finance, Tax, Investments, Internal Audit & Analytics, Vendor Management or Actuarial. This program offers students meaningful, real-world experience while building foundational technical and business skills in a Fortune 500 organization.


Interns will contribute to meaningful business initiatives, gain insight into enterprise financial operations, and develop professional capabilities through structured learning and mentorship. This program concludes with a capstone presentation delivered to leadership.


Interns will be placed into one of several functional teams based on interests, coursework, and business need. High-performing interns may be considered for future full-time opportunities within Assurant's Finance organization.


What You'll Do

Responsibilities vary by placement area, but interns can expect to perform one or more of the following tasks:

  • Support financial analysis, reporting, forecasting, and reconciliation activities
  • Participate in month‑end financial close tasks and audit preparation
  • Analyze structured data and develop insights to support business decisions
  • Assist in building dashboards, financial models, and KPI reports
  • Conduct research, synthesize findings, and communicate recommendations
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on ongoing projects and strategic initiatives
  • Present project outcomes and learnings during final capstone

Specialized Finance Tracks

  • Accounting : Gain exposure to corporate and international accounting operations, financial reporting (including SEC and statutory), controllership activities, audit support, and balance sheet reconciliation processes.
  • Finance: Support financial planning, forecasting, expense management, client profitability analysis, and financial modeling across domestic and international business units.
  • Vendor Management: Assist in global vendor risk oversight, regulatory research, and emerging risk analysis to support enterprise compliance and operational resilience.
  • Internal Audit & Analytics : Contribute to risk-based audit activities and leverage data analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Power BI) to enhance audit insights and financial transparency.
  • Tax : Support state and local tax compliance, research, and planning initiatives within a complex regulatory environment.
  • Investments : Assist with portfolio analytics, income forecasting, risk assessment, and strategic asset allocation activities within the enterprise investment function.
  • Actuarial : Support pricing, ratemaking, reserving, forecasting, and financial reporting activities that inform risk and profitability management.

Basic Qualifications

  • You are currently enrolled in a bachelor's degree program in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, Actuarial Science/Mathematics, or related field and will have at least on semester remaining following the summer internship
  • Expected graduation between December 2027 – June 2029
  • Basic Excel skills
  • Willingness to develop advanced Excel & Power BI skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Analytical mindset with curiosity and problem-solving ability
  • Ability to organize and interpret structured data
  • Collaborative, team-oriented approach
  • Interest in accounting, finance, risk, investments, or analytics

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Excel: pivot tables, lookups, data cleaning
  • Power BI: dashboards, KPIs (training provided)
  • SQL and/or other data tools (preferred for some tracks)
  • Understanding of performance metrics and financial statements
  • Automation/AI exposure
  • PowerPoint and executive-level presentation skills
  • Progress towards professional designations (CPA, CFA, ACAS, etc.)

Finance at Assurant

Finance at Assurant is about more than numbers—it's about creating clarity and confidence in a complex world. Our teams operate across global markets and provide analytical insight and financial stewardship that empower the organization to invest smartly, innovate boldly, and deliver long‑term value. This internship will provide exposure to how finance helps strengthen and sustain our business globally.


Hybrid Opportunity: 2 days per week in office

Paid Internship: $25/hour

Start Date: 5/17/2027
End Date: 8/7/2027


Note: You must be work authorized in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to F-1 (student) visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or cannot work now on a full time basis.

About this job

Technical leader responsible for maximizing equipment reliability and uptime in an automated production environment. Diagnoses and repairs robotics, vision systems, conveyors, and PLC-controlled equipment while mentoring team members and driving continuous improvement.

Good fit if you have 4+ years of industrial maintenance experience with robotics, PLCs, and automation systems troubleshooting.

Full job description

The Maintenance Technician is a technical leader and subject matter expert (SME) responsible for maximizing equipment reliability, uptime, and operational performance within a highly automated production environment. This role leads advanced troubleshooting and repair efforts across robotics, vision systems, conveyors, PLC-controlled equipment, and other production technologies. Beyond hands-on maintenance, the Maintenance Technician mentors team members, drives continuous improvement initiatives, champions safety and compliance, and serves as the primary escalation point for complex equipment issues. Working cross-functionally with Operations, Engineering, Quality, and Production teams, this individual helps optimize productivity, enhance equipment performance, and minimize downtime.

This is an onsite role in our Lewisville TX facility, with a schedule of Monday-Thursday 6AM-4:30PM.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair complex mechanical, electrical, robotic, vision, and automation systems, including KUKA robots, Cognex vision systems, shrink tunnels, conveyors, and PLC-controlled equipment
  • Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions to eliminate recurring failures
  • Serve as the primary escalation resource for advanced equipment and automation issues
  • Analyze maintenance data and identify opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency, and equipment performance
  • Recommend equipment upgrades, design enhancements, and process improvements to reduce downtime
  • Mentor and train Maintenance Technicians on troubleshooting, safety, maintenance procedures, and best practices
  • Support onboarding and development of new technicians through structured training and hands-on coaching
  • Lead daily shift meetings to communicate safety updates, maintenance priorities, and operational goals
  • Provide feedback to leadership regarding team performance and development opportunities
  • Coordinate maintenance activities and provide shift leadership when supervisors are unavailable
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records and ensure compliance with CMMS (e.g., eMaint) work order standards
  • Develop and update SOPs, PM procedures, troubleshooting guides, and LOTO documentation
  • Audit preventive maintenance activities to ensure quality and effectiveness
  • Participate in Kaizen, 5S, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance productivity and equipment reliability
  • Champion workplace safety through LOTO compliance, safety audits, and proactive risk identification
  • Assist in developing Job Safety Analyses (JSAs) and support ongoing safety training efforts
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure maintenance activities meet safety, quality, and customer compliance requirements
  • Identify critical spare parts requirements and support inventory optimization efforts
  • Assist with storeroom audits and ensure availability of essential repair components

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • 4+ years of industrial maintenance experience, including experience with automation systems and advanced troubleshooting
  • Strong knowledge of electromechanical systems, robotics, PLCs, vision systems, motors, sensors, and industrial controls
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and equipment documentation
  • Experience using CMMS platforms such as eMaint or similar maintenance management systems
  • Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex equipment issues in a fast-paced manufacturing environment

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Experience leading, mentoring, or training maintenance technicians
  • Hands-on experience with KUKA robotics, Cognex vision systems, Siemens TIA Portal, or similar automation platforms
  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification
  • Experience leading continuous improvement, reliability, or equipment optimization projects

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

The Portfolio Lead serves as the operating partner to the Business Lead and Value Stream Lead for the Claims and Corporate strategic investment portfolios. The role translates business strategy into investment decisions, execution priorities, measurable outcomes, executive reporting, and course corrections across the full portfolio lifecycle—from strategy and prioritization through execution, value realization, and communication.

This role goes beyond portfolio reporting and delivery tracking; it actively questions, shapes, and influences portfolio direction in partnership with business sponsors, Value Stream Leads, Product Owners, Application Delivery, Data & Analytics, AI and COE teams. Key responsibilities include investment planning and prioritization, maintaining delivery roadmaps, managing budgets and risks, defining and tracking business value metrics, and ensuring leadership has the insight needed to make informed decisions and adjust course when outcomes are not on track.

What will you do in this role?

Drive and guide portfolio strategy in collaboration with Business Leaders, Business Sponsors, Product Owners, Value Stream Leads, Release Train Engineers, and delivery partners to ensure investment decisions, execution priorities, outcomes, and reporting remain aligned with business objectives. Specifically, they will execute:

  • Strategy Translation and Portfolio Leadership: Serve as an operating partner to the Business Lead and Value Stream Lead, translating strategy into portfolio priorities, investment choices, delivery roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.

  • Investment Planning, Prioritization, and Governance: Lead portfolio planning and prioritization activities, including quarterly business reviews and planning cadences, to ensure funding, sequencing, capacity, and trade-off decisions are aligned to strategic business priorities.

  • Outcomes and Value Ownership: Establish, track, and communicate business value metrics, benefits realization, Objectives & Key Results (OKRs), and investment outcomes to ensure portfolio investments deliver expected business results; shape course corrections when value delivery is not on track.

  • Proactive Risk, Issue, and Root Cause Management: Identify delivery, funding, dependency, capacity, and value realization challenges early; perform root cause analysis and partner with business and technology leaders to define mitigation plans and course corrections.

  • Executive Reporting and Stakeholder Communication: Create clear, insight-driven executive reporting and communications that inform senior leaders on portfolio health, investment outcomes, risks, decisions required, and recommended actions.

  • Financial and Resource Stewardship: Manage portfolio financials, including budgets, forecasts, actuals, investment trade-offs, and resource allocation decisions, ensuring transparency and alignment between spend, capacity, and expected business value.

  • PI Planning and Quarterly Business Review Cadence: Actively participate in Program Increment (PI) Planning and quarterly business review cadences, identifying cross-Value Stream dependencies, helping set execution priorities, validating progress against business outcomes, and escalating impediments or decisions required.

You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.

About You:

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.

What you need to have:

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration or a related field.

  • Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean Six Sigma certifications, Agile delivery certifications (e.g. SAFe SPC, SAFe Lean Portfolio Management, PMI-ACP) , or other relevant certifications are advantageous.

  • Proven experience in portfolio leadership, strategic planning, investment prioritization, or project/program management, with a track record of shaping and delivering large-scale initiatives in a matrixed business and technology environment.

  • Experience partnering with senior business sponsors, Value Stream Leads, and technology leaders to translate strategy into investment plans, execution priorities, business outcomes, and executive decision-making materials.

  • Proven experience in the insurance industry preferred.

  • Demonstrated financial acumen, including experience with portfolio budgets, forecasts, investment trade-offs, benefits realization, and value-based decision support.

Critical competencies:

  • Ability to think strategically and translate business strategy into portfolio priorities, investment decisions, delivery outcomes, and measurable business value for the Claims and Corporate Divisions.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex delivery, financial, risk, and value information and identify root causes of portfolio challenges.

  • Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to create clear, concise, decision-oriented materials for senior business and technology leaders.

  • Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and manage ambiguity.

  • Keen attention to detail to ensure project plans and deliverables are accurately developed and maintained.

  • Strong collaborative skills to work effectively with various teams and stakeholders.

  • Ability to balance structure and flexibility, with a focus on results and accountability.

  • Strong executive presence and credibility, with experience influencing senior stakeholders, business sponsors, and cross-functional leaders through ambiguity and investment trade-offs.

  • Strong financial acumen, including the ability to connect budget, forecast, capacity, benefits realization, and investment outcome data to portfolio decisions.

  • Effective influencing, negotiating, and decision-making skills.

  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate and manage multiple priorities.

  • Proficiency in using AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, improve analysis, streamline communication, and support effective portfolio management.

  • Proficiency in project management tools and software platforms.

Role Factors:

In this role, you will typically be required to:

  • Embrace the hybrid culture offered at AXIS, you need to be in office 3 days per week.

Much of the work involves using computers for data entry, analysis, and communication. Comfort with prolonged screen time is necessary.

While much of the work may be desk-bound, there might be occasions requiring mobility within the office environment, such as attending meetings or accessing filing systems.

What we offer:

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $137,500 - $229,000. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.

Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is Exempt for FLSA purposes.

About this job

Senior Data Engineer leading end-to-end delivery of AI-ready data products at Lincoln Financial's AI, Data and Analytics organization. You will design and build graph models, implement GraphRAG solutions, and create AWS pipelines that connect business use cases to governed data capabilities.

Good fit if you have 5+ years building production data systems, hands-on experience with Amazon Neptune or graph databases, GraphRAG implementation, advanced Python and SQL, and strong AWS expertise.

Full job description

Alternate Locations: Radnor, PA (Pennsylvania); Charlotte, NC (North Carolina); Fort Wayne, IN (Indiana); Greensboro, NC (North Carolina)

Work Arrangement:

Hybrid : Employee will work 3 days a week in a Lincoln office

Relocation assistance: is not available for this opportunity.

Requisition #: 76678

The Role at a Glance

Lincoln Financial's AI, Data and Analytics (AIDA) organization is building the capabilities required for an AI-enabled business. Within AIDA, Data Strategy & Governance turns priority insurance and retirement use cases into governed, reusable data products and services. We work backward from the decisions and actions AI agents and applications must support, then build the common meaning, quality, metadata, lineage, and secure access needed to trust the result. We deliver with AIDA's infrastructure, platform, engineering, MLOps, and AI-native platform teams, with governance built into the product.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you wil lead the end-to-end technical direction and delivery of complex AI-ready data products. You will connect priority business and AI use cases to the data capabilities beneath them, including shared meaning, rules, quality, lineage, secure access, and reusable services. You will also lead hands-on graph and GraphRAG delivery where relationships and unstructured knowledge matter, while choosing simpler relational, search, or rules-based patterns when they fit better.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead discovery with business and product owners, domain experts, stewards, source owners, and partner AIDA pillars to define the questions, actions, outcomes, product boundaries, and accountable owners.
  • Design the product's canonical and consumer models, ontology and semantic layer, business rules, contracts, interfaces, quality controls, metadata, lineage, provenance, and secure access.
  • Design and build graph models in Amazon Neptune or comparable technology, including entities, relationships, effective dates, rules, provenance, SPARQL queries, and performance tuning.
  • Implement GraphRAG and hybrid graph-vector retrieval, including ingestion, entity and relationship extraction, embeddings, graph enrichment, filtering, retrieval, reranking, grounding, and citations.
  • Design and build AWS source-to-product pipelines and agent-facing APIs or Model Context Protocol interfaces using fit-for-purpose lakehouse, orchestration, transformation, and infrastructure-as-code patterns.
  • Evaluate graph, relational, vector, search, and rules-based approaches against representative questions, expected evidence, answer quality, latency, security, operational complexity, and cost.
  • Lead a blended delivery pod through production readiness, code and design review, incident prevention, partner knowledge transfer, and reusable patterns that avoid unnecessary complexity and lock-in.

What we're looking for

Must Haves:

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience, plus typically 5 or more years of relevant experience with ownership of complex production data systems or products.
  • Substantial hands-on experience building and operating graph solutions with Amazon Neptune or comparable technology, including graph modeling, SPARQL, query analysis, and performance tuning.
  • Hands-on implementation of GraphRAG or comparable hybrid graph-vector retrieval, including ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, grounding, and citations.
  • Advanced Python and SQL, plus strong AWS data-platform experience, orchestration, data modeling, distributed processing, automated testing, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
  • Proven ability to translate a business capability into semantics, rules, contracts, controls, interfaces, and measurable evaluations, and to lead architecture decisions through influence while contributing hands-on.
  • Ownership of quality, lineage, privacy, access, observability, recovery, and production operations for sensitive or regulated data.

Nice to Haves:

  • Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, OpenSearch, Bedrock AgentCore, SageMaker, MLflow, or comparable production AI and retrieval services.
  • Model Context Protocol design, authorization propagation, agent evaluation and observability, ontologies, entity resolution, feature stores, or knowledge-graph governance.
  • Deep insurance or financial-services experience and technical leadership across employees, contractors, consultants, or managed-service teams.

Application Deadline

Applications for this position will be accepted through 1/24/27 subject to earlier closure due to applicant volume.

Working alongside dedicated and talented colleagues, we build fulfilling careers and stronger communities through a company that values our unique perspectives, insights and contributions and invests in programs that empower each of us to take charge of our own future.

What you'll be doing

• Assisting in the planning & management of facilities modifications and projects from inception of design concepts through design and implementation.
• Coordinating team to manage moves, adds, relocations, and change processes.
• Developing cost estimates related to space planning, relocation activities, and other projects.
• Maintaining drawings and operational effectiveness of internal team.
• Acting as a resource for clients & planning team to identify equipment requirements and coordinate support for furniture needs.
• Reconciling invoices & purchase orders, submitting invoices for payment, tracking trends in spending.

• Inspecting construction/installation progress to ensure conformance to drawings, specifications, and schedule.
• Creating and monitoring scorecards & dashboards of more complex metrics such as headcount projections, capacity, occupancy/vacancy ratios, space allocations & workplace conditions.
• Identifying key metrics to monitor project progress and ensure success; communicating effectively to keep team & internal/external stakeholders informed of progress.
• Promoting execution with a strong sense of urgency and focus on results; influencing team & external contractors to achieve defined objectives.
• Evaluating effectiveness of facilities services, recommending & implementing process changes and participating in the development of best practices, new tools, & other approaches for operational efficiency.

What we're looking for

• 4 Year/Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of Bachelor's) (Minimum Required)

The Role at a Glance

We are creating a new AI/ML Ops pillar to own the reliability, safety, and cost-effectiveness of every model, pipeline, and agent we run in production. This is fundamentally an operations leadership role: someone who has built monitoring, escalation, and change management discipline from the ground up during a technology or business transformation, and who can apply that same rigor to AI/ML systems. This leader will build and run the function that closes the gap between "built" and "running well at scale." They will report to the Chief Data & AI Engineering Officer and sit alongside the leaders of AI/Data Infrastructure, Data Strategy & Governance, Data & Delivery Platform, AI/ML/Agentic Engineering, and AI Native Intelligence Platform.

What you'll be doing

Operating Foundation & Change Management

  • Define the operating model for how AI/ML systems move from build to production: intake, change approval, release governance.
  • Build change management processes for model, pipeline, and agent releases, including change advisory review, risk tiering, rollback authority, and communication protocols.
  • Establish a clear ownership and accountability model (RACI) across Engineering, Ops, and Governance for every production AI/ML asset.

Monitoring, Observability & Notifications

  • Build monitoring for performance, drift, latency, quality, and safety across production AI/ML systems.
  • Design the notification and alerting architecture: what gets flagged, to whom, at what severity, with what SLA for acknowledgment.
  • Implement in-production evals and guardrails; enforce governance policy at runtime in partnership with Data Strategy & Governance.

Incident Response & Escalation Management

  • Define and own SLOs/SLAs for production models, pipelines, and agents.
  • Build on-call rotations, incident response, escalation tiers, and postmortem practice for AI/ML systems.
  • Own the detection and escalation path for misuse, abuse, or safety incidents.
  • Drive mean-time-to-detect and mean-time-to-recovery down as the estate scales.

Deployment & Lifecycle Governance

  • Partner with Platform Engineering to stand up CI/CD, versioning, and rollback for models, pipelines, and agents, partnering with Engineering on execution.
  • Establish safe rollout patterns (canary, shadow, staged) in partnership with Engineering.
  • Own the retirement and deprecation process for models and agents no longer in use.

Cost & Capacity

  • Own inference and compute cost visibility and optimization; build unit economics per model and agent.
  • Partner with AI/Data Infrastructure on capacity planning. Organization Building
  • Define the operating model, team structure, and hiring plan for the pillar.
  • Build the feedback loop that routes production failure modes and cost signals back to Engineering.
  • Establish the pillar's KPIs and report on them to the Chief Data & AI Engineering Officer and broader leadership.

What we're looking for

  • Proven track record leading operations through a major transformation: building the operating model, monitoring and observability foundation, and escalation discipline for a function that didn't have one before, ideally in technology, platform, or shared-services operations.
  • Deep experience in change management: standing up change advisory processes, risk tiering, release governance, and rollback authority in a fast-moving technical environment.
  • Strong background in monitoring, observability, and notification and escalation design: knowing what to alert on, who gets paged, and how severity and ownership are defined.
  • Experience building incident response and postmortem practices, including on-call rotations and MTTD/MTTR reduction, in any production technology environment. AI/ML-specific experience is a strong plus, not a prerequisite.
  • Working knowledge of (or demonstrated ability to quickly learn) ML/LLM system failure modes: drift, degradation, hallucination, latency and cost blowups, and how to instrument against them.
  • Experience partnering with governance and risk functions to enforce policy in live systems.
  • Strong track record hiring, developing, and leading technical or operational teams, ideally from an early stage.
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and building process from scratch, not just running an existing playbook.

The Role at a Glance

Lincoln Financial's AI, Data and Analytics (AIDA) organization is building the capabilities required for an AI-enabled business. Within AIDA, Data Strategy & Governance turns priority insurance and retirement use cases into governed, reusable data products and services. We work backward from the decisions and actions AI agents and applications must support, then build the common meaning, quality, metadata, lineage, and secure access needed to trust the result. We deliver with AIDA's infrastructure, platform, engineering, MLOps, and AI-native platform teams, with governance built into the product.

This role will build and operate the data and service components behind Lincoln's priority AI-ready data products. You will use Python and SQL to connect legacy sources, implement transformations and agent-facing interfaces, encode defined business rules, and make testing, lineage, and provenance part of the build. You will learn from senior engineers and business experts while taking increasing ownership of production work.

What you'll be doing

  • Build ingestion, transformation, and curated data models using SQL, Python, and approved AWS services.
  • Build and maintain FastAPI and Pydantic services and Model Context Protocol tools with clear schemas, validation, error handling, and documentation.
  • Turn source mappings and defined business rules into tested logic; work with business experts to clarify definitions and exceptions.
  • Write unit, integration, contract, reconciliation, and data-quality tests using pytest, mocks, and reusable fixtures.
  • Deploy through GitLab CI/CD or comparable pipelines; use logs, metrics, traces, and runbooks to support production workloads.
  • Capture metadata, lineage, provenance, and access requirements as part of the definition of done.

What we're looking for

Must Haves

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience, plus typically 1 to 3 years of relevant experience or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • Hands-on Python and SQL, with a solid grasp of joins, keys, data types, and foundational data modeling.
  • Working experience with FastAPI, Pydantic, pytest, and testable Python design.
  • Experience building or extending a Model Context Protocol server or a comparable agent-facing tool interface, plus working knowledge of Git, CI/CD, and a cloud data environment.
  • Ability to learn an unfamiliar business domain quickly, explain implementation choices clearly, and handle sensitive data with care.

Nice to Haves

  • AWS Glue, Athena, Lake Formation, IAM, Lambda, ECS, or comparable services.
  • Dbt, Apache Airflow or Amazon MWAA, Spark, or comparable data-engineering technologies.
  • Document ingestion, classification, retrieval or RAG data preparation, or experience in insurance, financial services, healthcare, or another regulated industry.

Responsibilities

We have an opportunity for a Director, Claims - Public Entity to join our team! You will be responsible for the review, oversight, and specific handling of Professional Liability, General Liability, and Automobile claims including: Law Enforcement and Sexual Abuse involving schools, municipalities, and other public entities. This is an individual contributor role.

  • Identify and evaluate risk transfer opportunities pursuant to contracts, lease agreements, certificates of insurance.
  • Evaluate claims for coverage, liability, and damages to negotiate and resolve claims on reasonable terms and at an appropriate value.

  • Public Entity experience, preferred.
  • Proven track record of building and maintaining strong business relationships with insureds, agents, brokers, and TPAs.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of degree)
  • 4+ years of Supplemental Health underwriting experience
  • Strong analytical, communication, and relationship-building skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

Nice-to-have:

  • Expertise in experience rating and renewal underwriting

Company Details

As an elite Excess and Surplus Lines market, Nautilus Insurance Group offers commercial property and casualty insurance solutions to appointed wholesale surplus lines producers countrywide. We have specialized in providing these solutions for more than 35 years.

We have more flexible policy terms and premium rates on a non-admitted basis. Our focus is small to medium Property and Casualty risks on both an admitted and a non-admitted basis.

Responsibilities

Nautilus Insurance is seeking a Senior Underwriting Quality Consultant to join their team. This role can be located on a hybrid schedule in our Scottsdale, AZ office or remotely for a highly qualified candidate.

The Underwriting Excellence Team is responsible for driving underwriting quality, consistency, and operational excellence across the organization.

The role serves as a key resource for identifying emerging trends, monitoring agency and underwriting effectiveness, supporting regulatory and compliance expectations, and providing actionable insights that enhance decision making.

Key Functions/Duties of Position

  • Conduct comprehensive reviews of new business, renewals, and quotes to evaluate risk quality and file handling from underwriting, pricing, and policy construction perspectives, ensuring adherence to established underwriting procedures and authorities.
  • Mitigate potential future losses by escalating substandard risks requiring immediate action and identifying trends and opportunities for improvement among agents and underwriters.
  • Summarize results, analyze trends, and communicate findings.
  • Provide monthly reviews and quarterly territory reports, offering insights into agency results, trends, book performance, and supporting business development opportunities within partner management.
  • Facilitate KPMG, SOX, and internal corporate compliance audits.
  • Offer recommendations to influence underwriting appetite, guidelines, and execution across all lines of business.
  • Identify training needs for underwriting staff and agents based on results, work with Underwriting Training Coordinators to develop appropriate training programs and objectives.
  • Represent the department in departmental meetings as requested.
  • Maintain professional relationships with internal departments, external agents, vendors, and customers.
  • Perform other duties and projects as assigned.
  • Analyze underwriting data, quality metrics, loss trends, and operational performance indicators to identify emerging risks, underwriting opportunities, and areas requiring corrective action.
  • Partner with underwriting leadership to support strategic initiatives that improve underwriting consistency, portfolio quality, profitability, and customer outcomes.
  • Assist in the development, maintenance, and enhancement of underwriting standards, audit methodologies, scorecards, procedures, and governance frameworks.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of underwriting controls, workflows, and business processes, recommending enhancements to improve efficiency, accuracy, and risk selection.
  • Conduct targeted reviews and special studies to address emerging underwriting concerns, profitability challenges, catastrophe exposures, or strategic business objectives.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert and resource for underwriting staff regarding underwriting guidelines, authority interpretation, policy construction, and best practices.
  • Participate in calibration exercises to promote consistency in underwriting reviews, scoring methodologies, and quality standards across the organization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited four-year college or university required, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum three (3) years of commercial insurance underwriting experience.
  • Candidates must possess strong technical underwriting knowledge, analytical skills, and the ability to evaluate complex risks across multiple lines of business.
  • Excess & Surplus (E&S) underwriting experience is strongly preferred

The Role at a Glance

We are seeking an enthusiastic Senior IT Auditor who is a self-starter and initiative-driven, ready to take ownership of critical audit processes and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. This position is perfect for someone inclined to leverage their IT Audit and technology expertise in an internal audit environment, while focusing on an in-depth review of IT systems, cybersecurity, and data integrity controls. As a Sr. IT Auditor, you will independently manage IT audits, perform advisory reviews, and support integrated audits in collaboration with the broader Internal Audit team. If you are passionate about driving improvements and ensuring robust IT governance, we want to hear from you.

What you'll be doing

  • Plan audit engagements, identify inherent risks and control objectives, perform risk assessments and identify IT-related risks and vulnerabilities based on business objectives, regulatory requirements, and emerging threats.
  • Conduct end-to-end audit engagements, perform detailed testing, facilitate meetings, and document and review the results of testing according to internal audit methodology.
  • Perform advisory reviews by assessing project governance, risks, controls, and implementation activities.
  • Support integrated audits in collaboration with the broader Internal Audit team by evaluating IT risks and controls relevant to the audit objectives.
  • Demonstrate expertise in IT disciplines (but not limited to): cybersecurity, hardware, networking, firewalls, servers, database management systems, operating systems, disaster recovery, cloud technologies, identity and access management, incident management, vulnerability management, risk assessment, IT governance, and system development.
  • Provide IT subject matter expertise, audit knowledge, and professional judgment to assess a broad range of business processes, risks, and control objectives.
  • Prepare detailed audit reports outlining findings, risk criteria, and recommendations for management, lead audit closing meetings, and ensure all audit documentation is finalized and conforms with department policies and standards.
  • Monitor and report on issue remediation, retesting, and closure status.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and stay informed about emerging IT and industry trends, including developments in AI, and share those insights with team members.
  • Manage co-source partner(s) and ensure they are adhering to LF IA methodology, review deliverables, and hold them accountable for budget and scope.
  • Partner with IT infrastructure, security, risk management, and other control groups within the company to establish strong working relationships while maintaining independence.
  • Collaborate effectively and build strong relationships across Internal Audit, the department, and the broader organization while expanding knowledge of the insurance industry, products, and operations.
  • Perform duties in compliance with all state and federal regulations, as well as company policies and procedures.

What we're looking for

Must-haves:

  • Expertise in IT disciplines (but not limited to): cybersecurity, hardware, networking, cloud environments, firewalls, servers, database management systems, operating systems, disaster recovery, identity and access management, incident management, vulnerability management, risk assessment, IT governance, and system development
  • 4+ years of experience in IT audit and/or information technology that directly aligns with the specific responsibilities for this position
  • Certifications/Licensures: CISA, CISSP and/or CIA
  • Knowledge of internal controls, business / information technology risk, regulatory and compliance frameworks (ITIL, NIST, COBIT, NY DFS, CCPA/CPRA, SEC, PCI DSS etc.), project management, and audit techniques
  • Demonstrates problem solving skills, root-cause analysis, and critical-thinking skills to assess complex IT environments and identify control gaps
  • Demonstrates relationship management skills and organizational skills and can independently manage engagements and prioritize workload
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • 4 Year / Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or another related IT field

Nice-to-haves:

  • Interest in emerging technologies, including AI, and how they may impact business risk.
  • Experience with data analytics tools and techniques
  • Experience in the insurance or financial services industry
  • Other related certifications (PMP, GSNA, CRISC, CCSP, CISM, etc.)

Company Details

Berkley Medical Management Solutions (BMMS) provides a different kind of managed-care service for W.R. Berkley Corporation. We believe focusing on an injured worker's successful and speedy return to work is good for people and good for Berkley's insurance operating units. BMMS was first started in 2014 by reimagining the relationship between medical need and technology to deliver the best outcome for injured workers and Berkley's operating units. Our goal was clear: combine solid clinical practices, proven return-to-work strategies and robust software into one system for seamless management of workers' compensation cases.

To get it right, we started with a flexible technology platform that allowed for impressive customization without sacrificing the ability for expansion and continued innovation. We deploy integrated systems to give W.R. Berkley Companies recommendations and professional services for managing each individual case in an efficient and appropriate manner. The power of our technology takes medical bill-review services and clinical advisory services to a new level. Our unique marriage of technology, software platforms, data analytics and professional services ensures we provide Berkley's operating units with reliable results, and reduced time and expenses associated with case management.

Responsibilities

As a Telephonic Nurse Case Manager, you will assess, plan, coordinate, monitor, evaluate and implement options and services to facilitate timely medical care and return to work outcomes of injured workers.

  • Coordinate and implement medical case management to facilitate case closure
  • Timely and comprehensive communication with with employers, adjusters and the injured workers.
  • Assess appropriate utilization of medical treatment and services available through contact with physicians and other specialist to ensure cost effective quality care
  • Review and analyze medical records and assess data to ensure appropriate case management process occurs while providing recommendations to achieve case progress and movement to closure
  • Responsible for assigned caseloads, which may vary in numbers, territory and/or by state jurisdiction
  • Acquire and maintain nursing licensure for all jurisdictions as business needs require
  • Coordinate services to include home services, durable medical equipment, IMEs, admissions, discharges, and vocational services when appropriate and evaluate cost effectiveness and quality of services
  • Document activities and case progress using appropriate methods and tools following best practices for quality improvement
  • Reviewing job analysis/job description with all providers to coordinate and implement disability case management. This includes coordinating job analysis with employer to facilitate return to work.
  • Engage and participate in special projects as assigned by case management leadership team
  • Occasionally attend on site meetings and professional programs
  • Foster a teamwork environment
  • Maintaining and updating evidence based medical guidelines (such as Official Disability Guidelines, MD Guidelines and all required state regulated guidelines) in reference to the injured worker treatment plan and work status.
  • Obtain and maintain applicable state certifications and/or licensures in the state where job duties are performed.
  • Obtain case management professional certification (CCM) within 2 years of hire date
  • Earn Continuing Education Units to maintain certifications and licensures

Qualifications

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in workers compensation insurance and medical case management preferred
  • Ability to work Pacific Standard Time business hours
  • California RN license greatly preferred
  • Minimum of 4 years medical/surgical clinical experience required
  • Exhibit strong communication skills, professionalism, flexibility and adaptability
  • Possess working knowledge of medical and vocational resources available to the Workers' Compensation industry
  • Demonstrate evidence of self-motivation and the ability to perform case management duties independently
  • Demonstrate evidence of computer and technology skills
  • Oral and written fluency in both Spanish and English a plus

Education

  • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing and possess a current RN license.
  • *RN compact license preferred, CCM preferred, Bachelor of Nursing preferred*

The Role at a Glance

Lincoln Financial Group is seeking a Data Scientist to join our AI Product & Delivery organization, focused on the agentic AI systems powering our next generation of products. You will generate insights from data, build and validate models, design experiments, and measure the business value AI agents deliver — while establishing rigorous evaluation frameworks that keep agentic systems accurate, safe, and reliable in a regulated financial services environment. You will partner closely with product owners, engineers, and business stakeholders to turn analysis into decisions and evals into guardrails.

What you'll be doing

Insights & Analysis

  • Analyze usage, performance, and outcome data to surface actionable insights on how agentic AI features are used and where they fall short.
  • Translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for product, engineering, and business stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that track agent performance and business impact.

Modeling & Agentic AI Systems

  • Design, build, and validate models and agentic workflows.
  • Evaluate model and agent architecture choices, balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and risk.
  • Collaborate with engineering to productionize models and agents and monitor them post-launch.

Experimentation

  • Design and run experiments — A/B tests, offline evaluations, holdouts — to test agent behavior, prompt or model changes, and feature variants.
  • Define hypotheses, success metrics, and sample size or power requirements; ensure statistical rigor.
  • Interpret results and translate them into clear go/no-go recommendations.

Value Measurement

  • Define and track metrics that connect agentic AI features to business value — efficiency gains, cost savings, revenue, and customer or employee experience.
  • Build measurement frameworks that isolate AI-driven impact from other contributing factors.
  • Report on ROI and value realization to product and business leadership.

Evaluations (Evals) for Agentic AI

  • Design and maintain eval suites and benchmarks covering task success, reasoning quality, tool-use correctness, safety, and failure modes.
  • Build regression frameworks and test case libraries to catch performance degradation across model or prompt updates.
  • Partner with product owners on human-in-the-loop review processes and use eval findings to guide model and agent improvements.

What we're looking for

Must haves:

  • 3–8 years of experience in data science, applied machine learning, or a related analytical role.
  • Hands-on experience building and evaluating ML models; experience with agentic AI systems (LLM agents, tool use, multi-step reasoning) strongly preferred.
  • Experience designing and analyzing experiments (A/B testing, causal inference, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, and standard ML/data science tooling.
  • Strong ability to communicate technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Grade level: final grade level for this position will be determined based on the selected candidate's experience.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience building or evaluating LLM-based agents or multi-agent systems.
  • Familiarity with eval frameworks and observability tools (e.g., LangSmith, Weights & Biases, Ragas).
  • Experience with LLM APIs or enterprise AI platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, Google Vertex AI).
  • Advanced degree (Master's or Ph.D.) in a quantitative field.
  • Domain experience in life insurance, annuities, retirement planning, or employee benefits.

The Role at a Glance

Lincoln's Investment Strategy & Portfolio Management team is evolving its Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) and asset liability modeling toolkit to better support enterprise risk appetite, capital, liquidity, and new business growth across U.S.A. and Bermuda entities.

The team partners with insurance businesses and the Investments team to design and maintain the enterprise SAA across legal entities, integrating new business pricing with in force optimization, and operating within U.S. and Bermuda regulatory regimes. In this role, you will own the quantitative modeling and analytics that power strategic asset allocation, in-force optimization, and new business pricing support — drawing on ALM analytics as a key input, and building select ALM components as needed. You will work as a close quantitative partner to investment strategy and portfolio management, bringing deep understanding of SAA and portfolio construction to develop models and dashboards, and ensuring our analytics incorporate regulatory requirements for NAIC and Bermuda Monetary Authority standards. Your efforts will enable our investment strategies to be produced faster across regimes and improve our documentation and governance controls.

What you'll be doing

Build and own the SAA analytics platform
•Engineer reliable Python services and SQL backed data pipelines that ingest asset, liability, and market data; orchestrate runs; and expose results to strategy and risk partners (APIs, notebooks, dashboards).
•Productionize research prototypes into hardened components (configuration management, unit/integration tests, logging, lineage, and automated documentation) supporting enterprise wide SAA across U.S. and Bermuda entities.


Portfolio construction & optimization enablement
•Implement and scale optimization, scenario analysis, and stress testing tools used to construct SAA under capital, rating, liquidity, and ALM constraints; parameterize for both U.S. RBC and Bermuda BSCR frameworks.
•Integrate cash flow projections (e.g., BondEdge outputs) and reconcile them to portfolio views with auditable data controls.

Regulatory aware data modeling
•Model and map security master and position data to NAIC designations and statutory schedules and to BMA BSCR asset categories and SBA portfolios; embed validation checks aligned to reporting rules.

Partner across the enterprise
•Work across the Investments team to partner with insurance business units, ALM, Actuarial, Enterprise Risk Management, and Finance.

What we're looking for

Quantitative & technical skills
•Fluent in multiple languages with depth in Python and SQL (required). You also bring working proficiency in other languages for legacy model integration.
•Hands on experience building scalable, object-oriented solutions/components for model enhancements/extensions across different products/assumptions. Enhancing existing core framework to scale model with change requests from product owners (annuities, life, group etc.) while maintaining code readability, documentation, and audit trail.
•Hands on data engineering: relational modeling, performance tuning, data integration (with tools like Bloomberg & Intex), orchestration, version control, testing frameworks, and observability.
•Quant/optimization toolkit experience (e.g., pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Pyomo/OR Tools) and time series/scenario modeling.
•Code testing/automation using CI/CD framework, Backtesting of strategy – creating backtesting data and summarizing model results and reporting Investment analytics by potentially leveraging Lincoln's AI tools/suite of products.
•Experience in producing asset cashflows utilizing tools like Factset/Bloomberg/Intex is a plus.

Insurance investing & regulatory literacy
•Required: Practical familiarity with NAIC investment regulations, statutory accounting and reporting (including RBC capital concepts and statutory investment schedules)

•Required: Deep understanding of SAA optimization incorporating the matching of insurance product liability cash flows across multiple economic scenarios

Domain context

Ways of working

•Demonstrated track record building production data/analytics platforms supporting portfolio construction or risk/ALM.

Responsibilities

The Sr. Claims Specialist is a Subject Matter Expert responsible for the quality handling and resolution of complex, high exposure liability claims in a timely and professional manner with emphasis on providing quality service while controlling expenses. This position routinely handles claims involving complex coverage issues, catastrophic bodily injuries, personal and advertising injuries and employment practices liability. Exposures are routinely reserved greater than $500,000.

Key functions include but are not limited to the following:

• Appropriately manage litigated and other complex or high exposure claims through coverage analysis, investigation, damage evaluation, reserving, and resolution.

• Attend mediations and trials.

• Manage file inventory to ensure timely resolution of cases.
• Handle files in compliance with state regulations.
• Provide excellent customer service to meet the needs of the insured, agent and all other internal and external customers.
• Perform administrative functions such as document preparation, expense accounts, time off reporting, etc. as required.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

Candidate must reside and work in the office in one of the following states: GA, NC, SC, TN, AL, MS, LA, FL, VA, AR or KY.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

• Minimum of 10 years' experience handling significant litigation claims with exposure of $500,000 or more.

• Proven ability to identify and address coverage issues, complete investigations to determine exposure, set timely reserves and develop detailed action plans.

• Excellent interpersonal, communication, and collaboration skills.

• Excellent negotiation, time management, and organizational skills.

• Knowledge of tort and contract law.

• Effective presentation skills.

• Working knowledge of legal billing software, claim systems, spreadsheet and word processing software applications.

• Adjusters' licenses for states of: AL, GA, MS, NC, SC & TN and/or ability to obtain within (90) days of hire.

Responsibilities

The Underwriting Assistant supports our Excess & Surplus lines book of general/excess liability, garage and professional liability business. The Underwriting Assistant (UA) is responsible for providing Underwriters with technical and clerical support with the information necessary to make prudent underwriting decisions on new business, renewals and endorsements. The UA supports the underwriting life cycle from pre- submission through policy issuance and renewal.

  • Identifying key issues in the decision-making process with the guidance from the underwriter.
  • Identifying and use of appropriate resources that assist in the analytical process; this includes making formal recommendations to underwriters on account management needs.

  • Develop, maintain and nurture positive working relationships with underwriters, customers, and other business partners to provide an enhanced customer experience (i.e., researches and resolves issues, responds to inquiries and questions).
  • Display a strong sense of urgency, recognizing customer needs.
  • Ability to apply judgement and present negotiation on more complex accounts and processes.
  • Quotes accounts within authority limits by reviewing exposures and experience rating, updating account information, rates and adjusts the price.
  • Examines inspection reports, prior audits, and endorsements, and refer any issues to underwriters.
  • Ability to effectively manage and balance multiple demands.

  • Experience with Professional Liability or Commercial Casualty coverages is a plus.
  • Strong oral/written communication skills, displaying a positive attitude.
  • Ability to provide written referrals where thought process is well documented and easily interpreted by others.
  • Detail-oriented with initiative and ability to work in fast-paced team environment.
  • A strong focus and passion for delivering exceptional customer service.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
  • High sense of urgency and ability to function well in a high-volume and time sensitive environment.
  • Computer literate including use of Word, Excel and various project management tools.
  • Flexible and open to change and enhancements to help evolving in a competitive market.
  • Adaptive to adjusting priorities and/or work on multiple tasks.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability as a result of being highly motivated.
  • Some market experience preferred, but not required.
  • This is an in-office, in-person role.

Berkley Luxury Group is an operating unit of W.R. Berkley Corporation, one of America's largest commercial lines writers in the United states. At Berkley Luxury Group we offer tailored, all-inclusive insurance solutions for luxury condo, co-op, rental properties and fine dining restaurants.

At Berkley Luxury Group, our employees are our most important asset. About this job

National General seeks a Non-Standard Bodily Injury Claims Adjuster to investigate, evaluate, and resolve attorney-represented auto claims. The role handles complex bodily injury exposures with authority to manage high-volume caseloads and requires 8am-5pm PST hours.

Good fit if you have bodily injury claims experience, can work PST hours, and will surrender any insurance licenses held.

Full job description

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

National General is seeking a Non-Standard Bodily Injury Claims Adjuster - Attorney Represented (Remote, PST).

In this role, you will investigate, evaluate, negotiate, and resolve attorney-represented bodily injury claims arising from automobile accidents. The ideal candidate has experience handling complex bodily injury exposures, working with plaintiff attorneys, evaluating demands, and negotiating settlements within established authority levels.

This position supports a non-standard auto insurance book of business, requiring a strong understanding of liability investigations, injury evaluation, coverage analysis, and claims resolution strategies. Successful candidates are skilled at managing a high-volume caseload while delivering exceptional customer service and maintaining strong file quality. Candidates must be able to work 8am--5pm Pacific time zone hours.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Handles investigation regarding all aspects of bodily injury claims (coverage, damages, subrogation, litigation) with the exercise of discretion and independence within increased level of authority.
  • Applies intermediate understanding of insurance policies written by the company, the industry, and organizational relationships within the company and department.
  • Determines subrogation or fraud potential and how to handle.
  • Identifies customer needs and works to meet those needs using appropriate customer service skills.
  • Recognizes and identifies body parts of a vehicle and understanding of other potential property damage.
  • For claims involving fraud or subrogation, partners with assigned reps from those areas to achieve best outcome.
  • Supervisory Responsibilities:
  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.


Functional Skills

  • Customer service orientation.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong time management skills from a global case management and pending perspective (vs. transactional).
  • Effective problem solving and analytical skills; ability to detect differences and issue recognition from multiple sources.
  • Proficient in Word and Outlook.

Skills

Auto Insurance Claims, Bodily Injury Claims, Case Management, Casualty Insurance, Claims Resolution, Claims Review, Communication, Customer Service, Insurance Claims Investigations, Insurance Policies, Negotiation, Problem Solving, Time Management, Written Communication

Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of an Inside Property Adjuster, and what it take to do the job!

As an Inside Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve virtually inspecting damages, investigating coverage, preparing estimates, and settling claims promptly and accurately. You will be interacting with customers, contractors, and vendors through various software platforms such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. This communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. This role places a particular focus on water losses, ensuring that our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Property claim. You lead with empathy, always.

  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Schedule:HYBRID (IN OFFICE & REMOTE)

  • Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm with rotational Saturday duty

  • Mondays and Fridays (remote)

  • Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays (in-office)

  • 1+ years of previous customer service experience.

  • Excellent organization skills.

  • Ability to multi-task.

  • Excellent negotiation and communication skills to interact with customers and stakeholders remotely.

  • Ability to work independently and manage time efficiently in an office and virtual work environment.

  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality and efficient claim resolutions.

  • Previous industry experience is highly desired.

Youreprovided with comprehensive training:

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in yourday-to-daywork.

  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing anadditionalbackground check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you willbe requiredto secure license(s) within60 daysof hire.

Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license wheninstructed toby the licensing team. Sign On Bonus:

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as anAllstater,youllenjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.

  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer to support and enhance enterprise access management platforms that secure critical applications and digital services across the organization. This role will serve as a lead responsible for designing, configuring, implementing, and supporting commercial IAM solutions while partnering with business and technology teams to deliver secure, scalable access management capabilities.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience with web access management and identity platforms such as IBM Verify Identity Access, IBM Verify Access, IBM Security Access Manager (ISAM), PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud (PAIC), Ping Access, PingFederate, PingAM, or similar enterprise IAM technologies. This individual will play a key role in product strategy, solution design, vendor management, application integrations, troubleshooting, testing, issue resolution, and mentoring team members.

The Allstate job title for this is role is Vended Application Lead Consultant.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support and guide the design, configuration, enhancement, and support of enterprise Identity and Access Management solutions, with a focus on vended access management platforms.

  • Develop technical and functional designs that address complex business requirements, application access needs, and security objectives.

  • Configure, develop within, and maintain IAM platforms that support authentication, authorization, single sign-on (SSO), federation, and access control capabilities.

  • Partner with business stakeholders, security teams, infrastructure teams, application owners, and vendor support teams to deliver secure access management solutions.

  • Contribute to product planning by creating, refining, and guiding user stories for complex features, including coaching team members who may be learning the platform or process.

  • Facilitate feature review sessions for complex business issues and requirements, document key decisions, and ensure alignment across business and technical teams.

  • Create functional designs using moderate technical skills to address complex business processes, product features, and application integration needs.

  • Support the planning, execution, and review of module, integration, and system testing for assigned features and product stories.

  • Manage issues, blockers, defects, and implementation risks through resolution for assigned features and product stories.

  • Review and validate new vendor release features, assess impact, and identify opportunities to improve platform capability and reliability.

  • Use vendor defect resolution processes, support tools, product documentation, and developer groups to troubleshoot issues and influence future product direction.

  • Evaluate proposed vendor software products and enhancements in alignment with strategic corporate direction, platform standards, and vendor roadmaps.

  • Provide knowledge and support for resolving technology issues across multiple business areas and application processes.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for access management processes, vended IAM platforms, and related application integrations.

  • Provide training, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to strengthen team capability and bench strength.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, process documentation, support procedures, and implementation guidance.

Essential Qualifications

  • 5 years or more of experience implementing, configuring, administering, or supporting enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions. (Or Equivalent)

  • Hands-on experience with one or more enterprise web access management or IAM platforms, such as IBM Verify Identity Access (IVIA), IBM Verify Access, IBM Security Access Manager (ISAM), IBM Verify Access Appliance or related earlier versions, Okta, ForgeRock, PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud (PAIC), Ping Access, PingFederate, PingAM, or similar vended access management tools. (Or Equivalent)

  • Experience configuring or developing within vendor software to support access management, application authentication, authorization, and secure application access.

  • Experience implementing and supporting single sign-on (SSO), federation, and access management solutions for enterprise applications.

  • Experience writing automation scripts to complete the integration mapping automation using scripting languages, such as JavaScript, Python, Groovy, YAML or PowerShell. (Or Equivalent)

  • Knowledge of common identity and access standards and protocols, including SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and federation concepts.

  • Experience gathering complex business requirements and translating them into functional and technical designs.

  • Experience supporting module testing, integration testing, issue resolution, and production troubleshooting for enterprise applications or platforms.

  • Ability to lead technical discussions, organize requirements or feature review sessions, and document resulting decisions.

  • Experience working with vendor support processes, product documentation, defect resolution procedures, or developer support groups.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, identify blockers, drive issue resolution, and support delivery of assigned product features.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder partnership skills.

  • Ability to mentor, coach, or train team members and share knowledge across technical and business teams.

  • Equivalent combinations of technical training, certifications, and relevant work experience will be considered.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large enterprise IAM or access management environments.

  • Experience with cloud-based identity platforms, SaaS application integrations, or hybrid identity environments.

  • Knowledge of directory services such as Active Directory, LDAP, or related identity stores.

  • Experience with API security, access gateways, reverse proxies, policy configuration, or application onboarding for access management platforms.

  • Familiarity with Identity Governance Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), adaptive authentication, multi-factor authentication (MFA), or related security technologies.

  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, Product Engineering, or similar delivery environments.

  • Experience evaluating vendor roadmaps, testing new release features, and recommending platform enhancements.

  • Relevant identity, security, cloud, or vendor certifications.

  • Experience in creating technical documentation, operational procedures, training materials, or platform standards.

Quick facts
