  • Minimum of 2 years completed and currently enrolled in a 3rd or 4th year undergraduate program in Risk Management, Finance, Business Management, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Master's degree candidates will also be considered.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
  • Experience with Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting, and basic modeling.
  • Interest in insurance, underwriting, risk assessment, and business analytics.

Other Skills

  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Professional demeanor and positive attitude.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Ability to learn new systems and applications quickly.
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and making sound recommendations based on available information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong computer skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Experience using data visualization or analytical tools (Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar) is a plus.
  • Coursework in insurance, risk management, finance, statistics, or related disciplines preferred.

Remote Opportunity

About this job

Assistant Client Service Specialist supporting commercial insurance clients with administrative tasks, client communications, and policy support. Position requires bilingual English and Spanish proficiency and is based in Poughkeepsie.

Good fit if you have insurance experience, speak English and Spanish fluently, and are detail-oriented and organized.

Full job description

Why Join Marshall+Sterling?

As a 100% employee-owned company with roots dating back to 1864, Marshall+Sterling offers the strength of a time-tested organization and the energy of an ownership-driven culture. Guided by our mission to empower clients to predict, prepare for, and preempt risk, we are relentlessly focused on helping people and businesses protect what matters most — so they can move forward with confidence. Our vision of creating a future that's safer and more secure drives everything we do.

Innovation is not optional here — it's imperative. We constantly seek better, smarter ways to serve our clients and improve as a company. Collaboration is at our core, because we know we are stronger together — across teams, with our clients, and in the communities we serve. Our employee-owners are not only valued and empowered, but also directly invested in our collective success.

At Marshall+Sterling, you're not just joining a company — you're joining an inclusive culture built on integrity, impact, and people-first values. Your ideas matter, your growth is prioritized, and your work helps shape a more secure future for all.

This role will be based out of Marshall+Sterling's Poughkeepsie Office

We're hiring for an Assistant Client Service Specialist to provide superior service and administrative support to the department. Responsibilities include supporting client communications, coordinating administrative tasks, and help ensure an exceptional client experience.

  • This role requires the ability to communicate professionally in both English and Spanish to support our clients and internal teams.
  • Be a welcoming voice for incoming calls and offer hands-on support with tasks like quoting policies, ordering MVRs, and processing documents.
  • Support Client Service Specialists by assisting with customer requests and maintaining smooth operations behind the scenes.
  • Issue proof of insurance and request loss runs to support our clients' coverage needs.
  • Document all client and carrier communications regarding coverages and exposures in the management system.
  • Follow workflow procedures, adhere to agency guidelines, and promptly report any actual or potential E&O claims.
  • Maintain required professional accreditations and participate in continuing education programs when available.
  • Perform other duties and projects as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency with AI tools, task management systems, and Microsoft Office.
  • Experience with AMS360 is a plus
  • Prior experience in insurance; commercial insurance is a plus.
  • Brings a positive attitude and works well with fellow employee owners, leaders, and others inside and outside the company.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented.

Total Rewards Package:

Compensation: $37,500 - $42,500, based on experience, education, and work location.

Benefits: Comprehensive package including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with match, Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), thirteen paid holidays, company-paid life insurance for you and your dependents, employee assistance fund and programs, wellness perks, and more!

Employee Stock Ownership Program

As a 100% employee-owned company, Marshall+Sterling offers you the unique opportunity to build long-term wealth while growing your career. Here's what makes our ESOP so valuable:

  • Long-Term Rewards: The value of your ESOP account grows over time, rewarding your commitment and contributions to the company's success.
  • Collaborative & Engaged Culture: Employee ownership fosters a team-oriented environment where everyone has a stake in the company's growth and success.
  • No Out-of-Pocket Costs: Unlike stock purchase plans, our ESOP is entirely company-funded, meaning you gain equity without any personal investment.

For more information on our culture and benefits, please visit us at : Careers | Marshall+Sterling

#PGM26

Quick facts

  • Pay: $110,000 to $135,000 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: New York, NY
  • Experience: 3+ years
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off, tuition assistance

About this job

Conduct on-site and virtual risk assessments for high-value homes in New York City, identifying exposures and developing customized loss prevention strategies. Serve as a trusted advisor to affluent homeowners while supporting underwriting decisions on property characteristics and replacement costs.

Good fit if you have 3+ years in risk management, loss control, underwriting, or related property roles, and knowledge of residential construction and valuation.

Full job description

Company Details

Berkley One is a modern insurance provider for a modern generation of affluence. We serve clients who live dynamic, adventurous lives and expect their insurance experience to match. Our mission is to deliver highly personalized risk and claims management through a blend of expert independent agents, cutting-edge digital tools, and the strength of the W.R. Berkley brand.

Why Join Us?
At Berkley One, you'll be part of a forward-thinking team that's reimagining personal insurance. We're building solutions that are as sophisticated and agile as the clients we serve—individuals and families who value innovation, simplicity, and exceptional service. You'll collaborate with passionate professionals, leverage modern technology, and help shape the future of our industry.

What We Value

  • A client-first mindset with a passion for delivering exceptional experiences
  • Curiosity, creativity, and a drive to challenge the status quo
  • Collaboration across disciplines to build smarter, more intuitive solutions
  • Integrity, expertise, and a commitment to excellence

Join us in creating a new standard in personal insurance—where protection meets possibility.

#LI-AV1 #LI-REMOTE

The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer.

Responsibilities

As a High Value Home Risk Consultant, you'll serve as a trusted advisor to affluent homeowners, helping them protect their homes, families, and valuable assets from preventable loss. Through on-site and virtual risk assessments, the consultant identifies vulnerabilities and exposures, educates clients on emerging and common risks, and develops practical, customized loss prevention strategies.

By combining technical expertise with a consultative approach, the Risk Consultant helps clients understand their risks, evaluate mitigation options, and make informed decisions that enhance safety, resilience, and long-term asset protection. The role is focused not only on identifying exposures, but also on influencing action and supporting clients throughout their loss prevention journey.

You'll be an essential partner to Underwriting by validating property characteristics, assessing overall risk quality, establishing accurate replacement cost estimates, and escalating material underwriting concerns that may impact eligibility, pricing, or coverage decisions.

This is a fully remote/work-from-home position supporting accounts throughout New York City with heavy concentration in Manhattan, and serving the Brooklyn/Kings county area.

What you can expect:

  • Culture of innovation, teamwork, supportive colleagues and leaders willing to invest in talent
  • Internal mobility opportunities
  • Visibility to senior leaders and partnership with cross functional teams
  • Opportunity to impact change
  • Benefits – competitive compensation, paid time off, comprehensive wellness benefits and programs, employer funded health savings account, profit sharing, 401k, paid parental leave, employee stock purchase plan, tuition assistance and professional continuing education

We'll count on you to:

  • Conduct comprehensive risk assessments for high-value homes to identify exposures that could lead to property damage, personal liability, or threats to client safety and security.

  • Evaluate risks associated with water damage, fire, electrical systems, severe weather, natural catastrophes, homes under construction, personal security, and other exposures common to affluent homeowners.

  • Deliver tailored loss prevention recommendations designed to reduce the likelihood and severity of loss while improving the resilience of the home and lifestyle.

  • Act as a trusted advisor by educating clients on risks, explaining mitigation options, and supporting informed decision-making.

  • Encourage and influence adoption of loss prevention measures through effective consultation, clear communication, and ongoing engagement with clients and brokers.

  • Maintain knowledge of emerging loss trends, technologies, and best practices to provide relevant and actionable risk management guidance.

  • Collaborate with brokers, clients, contractors, and service providers to facilitate the implementation of recommended risk mitigation solutions.

  • Validate and document property characteristics, construction features, protective systems, and occupancy information to support sound underwriting decisions.

  • Develop, validate, and maintain accurate replacement cost estimates to help ensure adequate insurance-to-value.

  • Identify, evaluate, and escalate material underwriting concerns, changes in risk profile, or coverage adequacy issues discovered during the assessment process.

  • Prepare clear and concise risk assessment reports that communicate exposures, recommendations, and underwriting considerations.

  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

What you'll need to have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent

  • 3+ years of experience in risk management, loss control, underwriting, claims, construction, appraising, or a related property risk discipline.

  • Strong ability to identify property loss exposures and provide effective loss prevention and risk mitigation recommendations.

  • Knowledge of residential construction, building systems, property valuation, and replacement cost methodologies.

  • Experience working with affluent clients and a solid understanding of personal insurance products and risk management principles.

  • Proficiency with e2Value or similar valuation platforms.

About this job

Good fit if you have 3+ years in risk management, loss control, underwriting, or related property disciplines, and understand residential construction and personal insurance.

Full job description

Company Details



Berkley One is a modern insurance provider for a modern generation of affluence. We serve clients who live dynamic, adventurous lives and expect their insurance experience to match. Our mission is to deliver highly personalized risk and claims management through a blend of expert independent agents, cutting-edge digital tools, and the strength of the W.R. Berkley brand.

Why Join Us?
At Berkley One, you'll be part of a forward-thinking team that's reimagining personal insurance. We're building solutions that are as sophisticated and agile as the clients we serve—individuals and families who value innovation, simplicity, and exceptional service. You'll collaborate with passionate professionals, leverage modern technology, and help shape the future of our industry.

What We Value

  • A client-first mindset with a passion for delivering exceptional experiences
  • Curiosity, creativity, and a drive to challenge the status quo
  • Collaboration across disciplines to build smarter, more intuitive solutions
  • Integrity, expertise, and a commitment to excellence

Join us in creating a new standard in personal insurance—where protection meets possibility.

#LI-AV1 #LI-REMOTE

The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer.

Responsibilities

As a Property Risk Consultant, you'll serve as a trusted advisor to affluent homeowners, helping them protect their homes, families, and valuable assets from preventable loss. Through on-site and virtual risk assessments, the consultant identifies vulnerabilities and exposures, educates clients on emerging and common risks, and develops practical, customized loss prevention strategies.

By combining technical expertise with a consultative approach, the Risk Consultant helps clients understand their risks, evaluate mitigation options, and make informed decisions that enhance safety, resilience, and long-term asset protection. The role is focused not only on identifying exposures, but also on influencing action and supporting clients throughout their loss prevention journey.

You'll be an essential partner to Underwriting by validating property characteristics, assessing overall risk quality, establishing accurate replacement cost estimates, and escalating material underwriting concerns that may impact eligibility, pricing, or coverage decisions.

This is a fully remote/work-from-home position supporting accounts throughout Texas. The assigned territory includes the entire state; however, candidates must reside in or near the Dallas or Austin, TX metropolitan areas, where the highest concentration of clients is located.

What you can expect:

  • Culture of innovation, teamwork, supportive colleagues and leaders willing to invest in talent
  • Internal mobility opportunities
  • Visibility to senior leaders and partnership with cross functional teams
  • Opportunity to impact change
  • Benefits – competitive compensation, paid time off, comprehensive wellness benefits and programs, employer funded health savings account, profit sharing, 401k, paid parental leave, employee stock purchase plan, tuition assistance and professional continuing education

We'll count on you to:

  • Conduct comprehensive risk assessments for high-value homes to identify exposures that could lead to property damage, personal liability, or threats to client safety and security.
  • Evaluate risks associated with water damage, fire, electrical systems, severe weather, natural catastrophes, homes under construction, personal security, and other exposures common to affluent homeowners.
  • Deliver tailored loss prevention recommendations designed to reduce the likelihood and severity of loss while improving the resilience of the home and lifestyle.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by educating clients on risks, explaining mitigation options, and supporting informed decision-making.
  • Encourage and influence adoption of loss prevention measures through effective consultation, clear communication, and ongoing engagement with clients and brokers.
  • Maintain knowledge of emerging loss trends, technologies, and best practices to provide relevant and actionable risk management guidance.
  • Collaborate with brokers, clients, contractors, and service providers to facilitate the implementation of recommended risk mitigation solutions.
  • Validate and document property characteristics, construction features, protective systems, and occupancy information to support sound underwriting decisions.
  • Develop, validate, and maintain accurate replacement cost estimates to help ensure adequate insurance-to-value.
  • Identify, evaluate, and escalate material underwriting concerns, changes in risk profile, or coverage adequacy issues discovered during the assessment process.
  • Prepare clear and concise risk assessment reports that communicate exposures, recommendations, and underwriting considerations.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

What you'll need to have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • 3+ years of experience in risk management, loss control, underwriting, claims, construction, appraising, or a related property risk discipline.
  • Strong ability to identify property loss exposures and provide effective loss prevention and risk mitigation recommendations.
  • Knowledge of residential construction, building systems, property valuation, and replacement cost methodologies.
  • Experience working with affluent clients and a solid understanding of personal insurance products and risk management principles.
  • Proficiency with e2Value or similar valuation platforms.
  • Exceptional communication, consulting, and relationship-management skills.
  • Customer-focused with the ability to influence action, build trust, and advocate for client needs.
  • Highly organized, accountable, and collaborative, with strong judgment and problem-solving skills.

What makes you stand out:

  • Curious, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Ability to travel throughout the assigned territory, including occasional overnight travel and flexible scheduling

We are Farmers – where ambition meets opportunity.

At Farmers, we're not just known for unforgettable jingle – we're a team with a passion for purpose and making a real difference in people's lives. We deliver peace of mind when it matters most. Ready to make your mark? Discover our vibrant culture and explore career opportunities at www.Farmers.com/careers/corporate. Connect with us on Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok, and let's build something incredible together!

Workplace: Hybrid ( #LI-Hybrid ), Remote ( #LI-Remote )

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days virtual for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office. Applicants beyond fifty (50) miles may still be considered.

Job Summary

This position collaborates with business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver technical solutions that support complex to highly complex business initiatives. The role acts as a subject matter expert to provide systems-level views of technology and devise technical solutions aligned with business objectives. It focuses on enhancing solution design, optimizing development processes, and effectively implementing CI/CD pipelines to deliver impactful solutions that meet business needs. The position ensures technology delivery is successful within lines of business and across the enterprise. It performs work independently while receiving guidance or direction for only the most complex scenarios. Mentors, trains, and coaches team members at all levels.

Essential Tasks & Leadership Philosophy

  • Partners with cross-functional business stakeholders and technical teams to understand and address complex to highly complex initiatives within a business unit or at the enterprise level. Leads discussions to gather requirements, develop solutions, validate technology assumptions, and evaluate implementation alternatives. Influences solution strategies by leveraging comprehensive business knowledge and depth of expertise in solution engineering.
  • Acts as a servant leader for the solution by ensuring Agile Release Trains operate effectively. Anticipates and removes constraints across the development and delivery process while collaborating with Release Train Engineers to coordinate delivery. Provides a systems view of the development lifecycle to lead technology delivery and align architecture with business objectives. Serves solutions with multiple Agile Release Trains or business units. Primarily serves solutions at the enterprise level but may support solutions at all levels as needed.
  • Leads multiple technical projects simultaneously by prioritizing and coordinating solution engineering efforts across teams and initiatives. Establishes performance metrics to measure effectiveness and continuously optimize performance. Manages non-functional requirements and ensures compliance with industry standards throughout the solution development and delivery process.
  • Develops and refines robust technical designs to meet business requirements for complex to highly complex solutions while ensuring scalability and performance. Collaborates with developers and Agile Release Trains to align solutions with enterprise architecture. Works with DevOps teams to implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines that streamline deployment and integrate new features. Engages with quality assurance teams to validate that technical solutions meet performance and reliability standards.
  • Leads development and delivery of complex to highly complex solutions by ensuring technical implementation s align with product roadmaps and overarching business strategies. Monitors progress, resolves issues affecting delivery timelines, and leads technical problem-solving efforts during development and deployment phases. Partners with business stakeholders and technical teams to address challenges and optimize solutions.
  • Oversees the maintenance of technical documentation for solutions to ensure effective knowledge sharing. Engages in continuous learning to stay current with trends and technologies in solution engineering. Applies learning to enhance own skills and impact the achievement of team and project objectives. Acts as a subject matter expert to consult and advise on solution engineering across business units and the enterprise. Leads pioneering of design and development practices to promote innovation and improvements across solutions. Performs other duties as assigned.

First Year Success Factors

  • Establish credibility as a trusted AI partner and primary AI contact for both IT and Business organizations.
  • Translate business opportunities into a sequenced portfolio of AI initiatives, clearly defining target outcomes, required capabilities, dependencies, and success measures.
  • Partner across business, architecture, engineering, data, security, and governance teams to identify and remove barriers to execution, accelerate delivery from concept through production, and ensure solutions are scalable, supportable, and reusable across the enterprise.
  • Drive adoption of the enterprise Spec-Driven Development (SDD) framework and AI-assisted engineering practices, achieving 90% adoption across targeted teams.
  • Drive measurable business and technology outcomes through faster delivery cycles, improved software quality, increased automation adoption, and successful deployment of AI capabilities that deliver enterprise value.
  • Lead multiple AI initiatives from concept through production readiness, partnering with engineering ensuring successful delivery while proactively removing obstacles and managing risks.
  • Establish reusable AI delivery assets, including implementation playbooks, patterns, templates, evaluation frameworks, governance controls, CI/CD standards, and production-readiness checklists.
  • Build a portfolio of AI success stories and reusable solutions that accelerate adoption across the enterprise.
  • Champion AI adoption across IT through hackathons, innovation challenges, monthly technology summits, workshops, and enablement programs.
  • Coach and enable engineers, architects, product owners, and technical teams on AI technologies, SDD, and modern engineering practices.
  • Ensure all AI solutions adhere to enterprise architecture, security, privacy, governance, and Responsible AI standards.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and AI-driven transformation across the IT organization.

Education & Career Experience Requirements

  • Bachelors degree required in computer science, engineering, or similar field.
  • Minimum 9 years of experience required in solution engineering, software development, systems architecture, or related.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and working in Agile teams required.
  • Experience in the insurance industry preferred.
  • Lead Solution Engineer is in support of AI COE / Forward Deployed Engineer in the AI and Automation Team.
  • This role is targeting the IT / Systems AI FDE (Forward Deployed Engineer) in support of Farmers IT Core SDLC Functions.

Additional Qualification

  • Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Able to clearly communicate technical information to non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated written communication skills.
  • Excellent collaboration and team building skills.
  • Demonstrated problem solving skills. Able to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues of varying complexity.
  • Possesses flexibility to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ability to drive multiple projects to successful completion.
  • Demonstrated project management skills.
  • Possesses strong technical aptitude. Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite. Deep knowledge of software architecture principles and design patterns. Strong proficiency in one or more phases of the software development lifecycle. In-depth knowledge of multiple systems and their key components. Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and version control systems. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, etc.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Frequently sits for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including, navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and/or places objects or materials weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Rarely performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category require rare, if any, travel.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Claims Consultant Mass Tort & Environmental
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Take your complex claims expertise to the next level in a highly specialized role focused on some of the most challenging exposures in the casualty space.

As a Senior Claims Consultant Mass Tort & Environmental, you will independently manage sophisticated legacy and long-latency claims involving asbestos, environmental contamination, talc, PFAS, and other mass tort exposures. You will apply advanced coverage analysis, strategic claims handling, negotiation, and litigation management skills to claims arising from historical CGL, umbrella, and excess liability policies.

This is an opportunity to join a specialized team where your judgment, technical expertise, and ability to navigate complex coverage issues will have a direct impact. The role supports claims across multiple U.S. jurisdictions and Canada and offers significant autonomy in managing complex matters from evaluation through resolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Complex Claims & Coverage Analysis

  • Independently manage complex, high-exposure casualty claims involving historical CGL, umbrella, and excess liability policies.
  • Analyze historical policy language, underlying facts, applicable law, and long-latency exposures to determine coverage positions and claims strategy.
  • Manage legacy runoff claims arising primarily from policies issued during the 1970s through the mid-1980s.
  • Develop thoughtful, well-supported strategies for resolving complex coverage and liability issues.

Mass Tort & Environmental Claims

  • Handle complex asbestos bodily injury, talc, PFAS, environmental contamination, and other mass tort claims.
  • Evaluate environmental exposures involving soil and groundwater contamination and remediation.
  • Manage claims involving large commercial and industrial insureds with significant liability exposure.
  • Navigate complex, multi-jurisdictional claims across the U.S. and Canada.

Litigation, Negotiation & Resolution

  • Manage litigated claims and coverage actions involving Allstate.
  • Partner with internal and external counsel to develop effective litigation and resolution strategies.
  • Participate in mediations, arbitrations, settlement negotiations, and other dispute-resolution activities.
  • Serve as a witness when required.

Financial & Strategic Management

  • Establish, document, and adjust case reserves and financial projections based on evolving claim exposure.
  • Develop and execute strategic action plans designed to move complex claims toward resolution.
  • Provide clear, well-supported analysis and recommendations to key stakeholders.

Caseload & Operational Excellence

  • Independently manage a diverse portfolio of complex claims while maintaining accurate and thorough documentation.
  • Ensure claim files comply with applicable internal guidelines and standards.
  • Work effectively across multiple claims systems and adapt to evolving technology and AI-supported workflows.
  • Communicate complex coverage and claim issues clearly and effectively in both written and verbal settings.

What You Bring:


Preferred Experience

  • 3+ years of experience handling mass tort, asbestos, environmental, or other long-latency claims.
  • Casualty claims experience involving complex coverage analysis, excess liability policies, or legacy runoff portfolios strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing claims across multiple U.S. jurisdictions and/or Canada.
  • Experience with litigation, negotiation, mediation, arbitration, or complex claim resolution.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Strong knowledge of complex casualty claims and coverage analysis.
  • Ability to interpret and apply historical insurance policy language.
  • Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven negotiation and settlement capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage complex, high-exposure matters and competing priorities.
  • Comfort working across multiple systems and adapting to new technology and AI-supported processes.
  • High level of ownership, sound judgment, and accountability in a remote environment.

Why This Role

This opportunity is ideal for a seasoned claims professional who enjoys digging into complex coverage questions, sophisticated litigation, historical policies, and high-exposure claims. You will have the autonomy to own challenging matters while collaborating with experienced claims professionals and legal partners on issues that require both technical expertise and strategic thinking.


Work Environment

  • Remote-friendly opportunity within a highly specialized claims team.
  • Independent role suited for a self-starter who is comfortable taking ownership of complex matters.
  • Collaborative environment with exposure to legal partners and sophisticated casualty claims.

Skills

Claims Administration, Claims Resolution, Complex Claims, Mass Torts, Settlement Negotiations

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 65,600.00 - 110,075.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Job.JobTitle: Privacy Counsel, Law & Regulation - Remote (IL, NC, TX, AZ, NY, CA)
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Data Privacy Officer, Compliance / Legal, Insurance Attorney
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated, business-minded attorney with deep privacy expertise who is excited to work at the intersection of law, technology, data, mobility, and consumer innovation. This is a unique opportunity to join Arity's legal team and help shape the future of data-driven products and services in an increasingly complex and evolving regulatory landscape.

In this role, you will serve as a trusted legal advisor to Arity, Allstate's mobility and technology subsidiary, providing practical, real-time, and strategic counsel on a broad range of privacy, data governance, emerging technology, and regulatory compliance matters. You will partner closely with business, product, technology, marketing, and data teams to enable innovation while effectively managing legal and regulatory risk.

As a recognized subject matter expert in state privacy laws and emerging privacy regulations, you will play a key role in developing scalable compliance strategies, advising on novel business initiatives, new data models and products, and influencing cross-functional decision-making. The ideal candidate is a collaborative leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and has a proven ability to drive solutions, build consensus, and deliver results across diverse stakeholder groups.

Key Responsibilities & Core Competencies


  • Serve as a trusted privacy advisor providing strategic counsel on U.S. state privacy laws, GDPR, and other global privacy frameworks. Conduct complex legal analysis to determine the applicability of laws, regulations, exemptions, and compliance requirements across evolving business models and technologies.

  • Partner proactively with privacy program leads to ensure ongoing compliance with existing legal and regulatory requirements while supporting the implementation of emerging privacy, data governance, and artificial intelligence (AI) regulations.

  • Provide legal counsel to advertising, marketing, and product teams across the audience lifecycle, including audience creation, activation, measurement, attribution, and the deployment of tags, pixels, SDKs, and related technologies. Advise on consent management, consumer choice mechanisms, and regulatory requirements governing data collection and use.

  • Advise on Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) matters related to the collection, use, and sharing of consumer report data, including permissible purpose requirements, notice obligations, and disclosure considerations.

  • Lead privacy support for complex data-driven transactions and commercial arrangements, including data licensing agreements, data supply agreements, clean room agreements, strategic partnerships, and other transactions where data rights and regulatory considerations are critical.

  • Counsel business stakeholders on data strategy and governance matters, including data provenance, permitted use rights, consumer-facing disclosures, data sharing practices, licensing rights, retention requirements, and data lifecycle management.

  • Collaborate effectively across Law & Regulation, product, technology, marketing, data, compliance, and business teams to support strategic initiatives and deliver practical, business-oriented legal solutions.

  • Anticipate legal and regulatory developments, identify potential risks, and develop creative, solution-oriented approaches that enable innovation while appropriately managing legal exposure.

  • Conduct risk-benefit analyses of key business initiatives, considering enterprise-wide implications and providing actionable recommendations to support informed decision-making.

  • Advise business partners on emerging legal, regulatory, technology, and risk management issues affecting the organization.

  • Play a key role in executing legal strategy, driving action plans, and fostering effective communication and alignment across business units and legal stakeholders.

Location & Travel Requirements


  • This role is fully remote and includes travel as needed to support business objectives and team collaboration. We welcome candidates from across the United States, with a preference for those located in Illinois, North Carolina, Texas, Arizona, New York, or California.

Education & Experience


  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree required; active license to practice law and in good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive legal experience within a law firm and/or in-house legal department supporting a mid-sized to large organization.

  • Demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following areas: privacy, advertising technology (AdTech), Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), technology transactions, commercial contracting, data governance, and/or other highly regulated industries.

  • Experience advising within corporate structures, including parent companies and affiliated entities, with the ability to navigate diverse business and regulatory environments.

  • Proven ability to provide strategic legal counsel that balances risk management with business objectives.

Key Competencies


  • Leadership capabilities, with experience building, developing, mentoring, and guiding high-performing teams.

  • Executive presence with strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to influence stakeholders and translate complex legal concepts into practical business guidance.

  • Demonstrated business acumen with the ability to assess legal and operational risks, develop business cases, and quantify return on investment for strategic initiatives.

  • Effective budget management and resource planning experience.

  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

  • High degree of professionalism, integrity, and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and other technology tools relevant to the practice of law and business operations.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • This job does not have supervisory duties



#LI-PC1

Skills

Advertising Technologies, Advertising Technologies, Business Initiatives, Collaboration, Consultation, Counseling, Cybersecurity, Data Privacy, Data Privacy Law, Data Privacy Standards, Data Protection Privacy, General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Global Privacy, Legal Advisory, Legal Consulting, Legal Research, Negotiation, Prioritization, Privacy Awareness, Privacy Compliance, Privacy Laws, Privacy Management, Privacy Protection, Privacy Regulations, Strategic Collaborations {+ 4 more}

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 120,000.00 - 193,725.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Director of Risk Management, Risk Management / Loss Control, Risk Manager
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Madison, WI
  • Experience: 12 to 15 years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Director leading enterprise risk management for an insurance company, responsible for developing and maintaining the ERM framework, managing emerging risks, and overseeing the Business Continuity Program. Includes supervisory responsibilities for staffing, training, and performance management.

Good fit if you have 12-15 years of risk management experience, a bachelor's degree, demonstrated management experience, and proficiency with ERM tools and reporting.

Full job description

BASIC PURPOSE: 

Responsible for the leadership, innovation, governance, and management necessary to identify, evaluate, mitigate, and monitor the company's enterprise risks.  Evaluate emerging risks and trends that may impact the company's risk appetite and present mitigation strategies.  Prioritize risks within the company's ERM framework, enterprise risk register, and risk profile to ensure risks are managed to minimize negative financial and operational impact.  Manage tools, practices, and policies to analyze and report enterprise risks; evaluate new methodologies and risk technologies for continuous improvement.  Responsible for creating organizational awareness of risk management through training and education.  Develop, maintain, and administer the Business Continuity Program.  Supervisor responsibilities to include staffing, training and development, performance management, and workforce planning. 

PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: 

  • Supervisor/Manager responsibilities may include all of the following: 
    • Staffing needs, to include interviewing and onboarding for new employees. 
    • Training and development, as well as coaching and motivation, for staff. 
    • Performance management, goal setting, employee engagement, and salary administration. 
    • Workforce management to include:  unit equipment, software, and space needs; approving time off and overtime usage; and budget recommendations. 
  • Lead or coordinate the development, maintenance, and governance of Own Risk and Solvency Assessment materials, ensuring alignment with regulatory expectations, capital adequacy considerations, the ERM framework, and enterprise risk appetite.
  • Monitor emerging strategic, operations, financial, regulatory, cyber, technology, third-party data, and AI-related risks and recommend practical mitigation strategies that support risk-informed business decisions.
  • Lead the design, development, implementation, and ongoing enhancement of CM Group's ERM framework. Responsible for the leadership, innovation, governance, and management necessary to identify, evaluate, mitigate, monitor, and report the company's enterprise risks.
  • Facilitate the determination of the company's risk appetite, tolerances, and limits.  Identify and report key regulatory changes, external factors, emerging risks, and trends that might impact the company's risk profile and present mitigation strategies for management's review. 
  • Develop, analyze, quantify, and prioritize risks within the company's risk universe, enterprise risk register, and risk profile. Develop and maintain Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), risk appetite metrics, and related reporting to actively monitor risk exposures and trends. Ensure risks are recognized and managed in a manner the minimizes negative financial and operational impact while supporting efficient, cost-effective mitigation strategies.
  • Ensure the ERM framework is appropriate to the nature, scale, and complexity of the business.  Work with crossfunctional business leaders to regularly identify key risks across all types and categories.  Assess risks based on likelihood, impact, and level of mitigation. 
    • Prepare and present ERM reporting, risk assessments, emerging risk updates, risk appetite results, ERI trends, and mitigation plans for senior leadership, management committees, the Risk Management Committee, Board-level audiences, regulators, and auditors, as appropriate.
  • Lead the Business Continuity Program.  Complete risk analysis, business impact analysis, assessment, and evaluation for all CMGroup internal departments and critical outsourced partners.  Identify comprehensive strategic solutions to satisfy the various business, regulatory, and technology requirements. 
  • Manage the development and delivery of training that facilitates corporate ERM and Business Continuity awareness. 
  • Manage the development and implementation of tools, practices, policies, and risk technology solutions to analyze, monitor, and report enterprise risks.
  • Leverage internal and external relationships of the ERM Department to deliver projects on time.  Exerts influence appropriately on outside teams to meet project deliverables while creating positive impact within the organization. 
  • Professionally represent the company's position with regulators, auditors, rating agencies, external vendors, and other key stakeholders. 

QUALIFICATIONS: 

  • Professional certification or designation in risk management, business continuity, audit, information security, compliance, or a related discipline is preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in business or a related field is required. 
  • 12-15 years' risk management experience developing and implementing enterprise risk management programs, including writing policies and procedures, producing executive materials, supporting risk committees/meetings, and instituting industry best practice risk management principles and practices.
    • Experience supporting insurance regulatory reporting, ORSA-related activities, risk appetite development, KRI reporting, enterprise risk assessments, and management or Board-level risk governance forums is preferred. 
  • Demonstrated management experience. 
  • Proficient in current ERM tools, risk reporting processes, and, where applicable, governance, risk, and compliance technology platforms. Able to add to and/or build complex models, tools, dashboards, or reporting solutions and monitor their effectiveness. . 
  • Excellent oral communication and writing skills to produce clear and concise materials. 
  • Highlevel critical thinking skills, including strategic thinking, effective analysis of data, and the ability to aggregate information. 
  • Strong project management discipline and demonstrated success overseeing multiple projects to completion. 
  • Proven ability to foster productive relationships with diverse staff, including senior leadership. 
  • Strong ability to influence and lead a successful team. 
  • Detail oriented, with a hands-on approach. 
  • Ability to travel as necessary. 

WORK ENVIRONMENT: 

Professional office environment. 

NOTE: This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties performed by this employee.  Employees may be requested to perform jobrelated tasks other than those specifically presented in this job description.  The employer reserves the right to change or assign other duties to this position. 

The CM Group is made up of Church Mutual Insurance Company, S.I., CM Regent Insurance Company, and CM Vantage Specialty Insurance Company.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Loss Control Consultant, Risk Management / Loss Control
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Advance your career with Liberty Mutual Insurance A Fortune 100 Company

Are you looking for an opportunity to use your degree in the business world? Then Liberty Mutuals Equipment Breakdown Risk Control group might be right for you. Our team works closely with customers to help them identify, quantify, mitigate, or eliminate serious threats to their businesses. In the process, we help fulfill Liberty Mutuals mission of helping people live safer, more secure lives.

Liberty Mutual is currently hiring an Equipment Breakdown Risk Control Consultant to provide jurisdictionally required inspections and other services to an assigned group of customers.

This role is 100% remote within the assigned territory. This role is also eligible for a company car. Additional information will be provided if you moved forward to speak with a recruiter.

The role provides commercial lines customers with boiler and pressure vessel inspections services through the successful completion of an entry-level training program and experience. Conducts extensive research, data collection and evaluation and analysis in order to make recommendations to control customer's source of risk, loss and/or costs.

The selected candidate will support projects and customer needs throughout Virginia, West Virginia, and Washington, DC and will be required to travel regularly within the region. This is a remote, home-based position with significant field-based responsibilities, and candidates must reside within the assigned territory. Preferred locations include northern VA, Washington DC, and Eastern WVand surrounding areas. Residency within or near the designated territory is strongly preferred to facilitate effective business operations, customer engagement, and timely travel to support project and operational requirements.

This position may be filled at various levels, commensurate with the candidates qualifications and possession of an NBIC Commission. Candidates who do not yet have an IS Commission are considered at a trainee level. The role involves a hybrid work arrangement, combining remote responsibilities with field-based activities. The Risk Control team operates in a collaborative environment, working virtually across multiple target territories to support operational objectives.

Reporting to the Equipment Breakdown Engineering Manager, you will:

  • Perform internal and external inspections of boilers, pressure vessels, steam and hot water systems, combustion equipment and associated piping and controls.
  • Conduct non destructive testing (ultrasonic thickness, magnetic particle, dye penetrant) and verify results.
  • Evaluate combustion efficiency, flue gas conditions and burner operation where applicable.
  • Assess water treatment and chemistry records and advise on corrosion or scaling risks.
  • Verify compliance with applicable codes, standards and regulations (e.g., ASME Boiler & Pressure Vessel Code, NBIC, and local/state requirements).
  • Prepare clear, accurate inspection reports, deficiency notices and certificates of inspection.
  • Recommend and document required repairs or modifications, and inspect completed repairs for compliance.
  • Coordinate inspections with owners, contractors and regulatory authorities.
  • Stay current on code updates, inspection techniques and industry best practices.
  • Exposure to noise, heat, confined spaces, and industrial environments; use of personal protective equipment required.
  • After hours or emergency inspections may be required.
Qualifications
  • Bachelors degree or equivalent with coursework in mathematics and engineering or related area, plus a minimum of 3 years of directly related consulting experience.
  • NBBI IS Commission or ability to obtain NBBI IS Commission.
  • Demonstrated ability to retrieve and enter information using various proprietary software applications and create/modify documents and spreadsheets using Microsoft Office suite.
  • Knowledge, skills, and experience in boiler and pressure vessel inspections, service planning and delivery, risk assessment, risk analysis, solutions management, and progress measurement.
  • Fully effective interpersonal, writing, and other communication skills required to develop and maintain relationships with customers, peers, and industry contacts.
  • Ability to work closely with Claims and Underwriting.
  • Position requires regular travel.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

About this job

Associate Attorney representing Liberty Mutual and policyholders in civil litigation and workers' compensation matters involving moderately complex claims. Primarily remote in New York with required in-person appearances, managing cases from inception through resolution under moderate supervision.

Good fit if you are admitted to the New York bar, have knowledge of insurance and workers' compensation law, and can manage litigation matters independently with senior counsel support.

Full job description


Description

This role is primarily remote in the state of New York except for required appearances.

At Liberty Mutual, were committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders rights and positively impacting our business. As an Associate Attorney at Liberty Mutual, youll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligibleperformance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If yourelooking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where youll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual Insurance offers an engaging opportunity for an Associate Attorney to represent the company and its policyholders in routine civil litigation and workers' compensation matters involving moderately complex legal issues and claims for monetary damages or compensation related to personal injury or property damage. Under moderate supervision, you will manage cases from inception through resolution, applying your legal knowledge, research skills, and client relationship capabilities in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Litigation Execution: Manage all phases of litigation, including discovery, hearings, trials, mediations, and drafting legal documents such as pleadings and motions. Support Senior Trial Counsel and Senior Litigation Counsel in all aspects of case handling through trial, including preparation, management, and assistance at every stage of the litigation process.
  • Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Provide clear and reasoned legal opinions and strategic advice to Claims Representatives and insured clients. Develop and maintain strong client relationships through transparent and effective communication.
  • Technology Utilization: Utilize e-discovery and case management technologies to streamline legal processes, improve efficiency, and reduce operational costs. Demonstrate effective coordination with remote team members and proficiency in remote work settings.
  • Risk Evaluation and Case Resolution Facilitation: Identify, evaluate, and collaborate on strategies to mitigate legal risks, working closely with clients and senior counsel to facilitate effective resolutions.
  • Documentation Accuracy and Compliance: Ensure all legal documents, pleadings, and motions are meticulously prepared, accurate, and compliant with applicable standards and client expectations.
  • Timely Client Communication: Provide clear, consistent, and timely updates and recommendations to insured clients and claims professionals to maintain alignment with case objectives.
  • Contribution to Organizational Improvement: Participate in initiatives aimed at enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and best practices within Staff Legal and Global Legal & Compliance organizations.
  • Ethical Compliance Adherence: Uphold the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance, following legal regulations and licensing requirements and promoting a culture of integrity within the legal team.
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in New York and in good standing; special licenses to practice before particular boards or federal courts may be required.
  • General knowledge of insurance law, and as necessary, workers compensation and/or No Fault law.
  • Proficient in e-discovery, case management systems, and basic legal analysis tools.
  • Strong analytical, research, and legal writing skills.
  • Basic knowledge of negotiation techniques including preparation, active listening, and problem-solving.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cases from start to finish under supervision.
  • Effective communication and persuasion skills, both written and oral.
  • Ability to collaborate with clients, claims professionals, and senior attorneys.
  • Organized, process-oriented with strong time management skills.

About this job

Provides consultative services to customers in loss prevention, conducting on-site evaluations and developing risk control plans. Mentors less experienced consultants and collaborates on developing policies and new service offerings.

Good fit if you have a bachelor's degree, at least 5 years of loss prevention or safety consulting experience, and can travel regularly.

Full job description


Description

Provides moderately complex consultative services to an assigned group of customers within a loss prevention specialty area or territory. Conducts on-site evaluations, evaluates data, and creates/implements service plans to control customer source of risk, losses and costs. Provides risk assessment services and information to track progress and demonstrate the value of doing business with Liberty Mutual. Serves as a trainer/mentor to less experienced consultants in their specialty area at the discretion of their manager. Enhances the Company`s leadership position in the safety field through developing key relationships.

  • Provides an array of expert consultative services to an assigned group of customers within a specialized technical area or territory.
  • Conducts on-site evaluations, evaluates data, and creates/implements service plans to control customer's source of risk, loss and/or costs.
  • Provides expert technical support to other loss prevention employees by advising them about resources available, legislation and applicable regulations, technology, industry trends and effective methods to reduce risk, improve customer satisfaction and demonstrate the value of doing business with Liberty Mutual. Monitors and evaluates the technical quality of loss prevention services provided by less experienced consultants.
  • At the discretion of their manager, provides coaching, mentoring and training to enhance their development and effectiveness.
  • Collaborates with management in developing policies, procedures, service tools, technical resources, techniques and new products in order to support and enhance the delivery of loss prevention consulting services.
  • Participates in actively acquiring and retaining profitable business.
  • Identifies new business opportunities for LP services and may design and execute programs that improve results and increase the number and quality of services customers choose to buy.
  • Enhances Liberty Mutual` s leadership position in the safety field and increases brand awareness by developing a network of contacts.
Qualifications
  • Bachelors degree with coursework in math, engineering or related areas (or equivalent) and at least 5 years of directly related consulting experience in loss prevention or progressive safety/heath field.
  • Candidates are typically working towards (or obtained) an advanced degree and/or professional certification in one or more of the following areas: CSP, ARM, CRM, CPCU, CIH, or CPE.
  • Advanced knowledge, skills and experience in a specialized field, service planning and delivery, risk assessment, risk analysis, solutions management and progress measurement.
  • Fully effective interpersonal, writing and other communication skills required to develop and maintain relationships with customers, peers, and industry contacts.
  • Demonstrated ability to retrieve and enter information using various proprietary software applications and create/modify documents and complex spreadsheets using Microsoft Office suite.
  • Position requires regular travel.

Provides risk assessment services and information to track progress and demonstrate the value of doing business with Liberty Mutual. Serves as a trainer/mentor to less experienced consultants in their specialty area at the discretion of their manager. Enhances the Company`s leadership position in the safety field through developing key relationships.

  • Provides an array of expert consultative services to an assigned group of customers within a specialized technical area or territory.
  • Conducts on-site evaluations, evaluates data, and creates/implements service plans to control customer's source of risk, loss and/or costs.
  • Provides expert technical support to other loss prevention employees by advising them about resources available, legislation and applicable regulations, technology, industry trends and effective methods to reduce risk, improve customer satisfaction and demonstrate the value of doing business with Liberty Mutual. Monitors and evaluates the technical quality of loss prevention services provided by less experienced consultants.
  • At the discretion of their manager, provides coaching, mentoring and training to enhance their development and effectiveness.
  • Collaborates with management in developing policies, procedures, service tools, technical resources, techniques and new products in order to support and enhance the delivery of loss prevention consulting services.
  • Participates in actively acquiring and retaining profitable business.
  • Identifies new business opportunities for LP services and may design and execute programs that improve results and increase the number and quality of services customers choose to buy.
  • Enhances Liberty Mutual` s leadership position in the safety field and increases brand awareness by developing a network of contacts.
Qualifications
  • Bachelors degree with coursework in math, engineering or related areas (or equivalent) and at least 5 years of directly related consulting experience in loss prevention or progressive safety/heath field.
  • Candidates are typically working towards (or obtained) an advanced degree and/or professional certification in one or more of the following areas: CSP, ARM, CRM, CPCU, CIH, or CPE.
  • Advanced knowledge, skills and experience in a specialized field, service planning and delivery, risk assessment, risk analysis, solutions management and progress measurement.
  • Fully effective interpersonal, writing and other communication skills required to develop and maintain relationships with customers, peers, and industry contacts.
  • Demonstrated ability to retrieve and enter information using various proprietary software applications and create/modify documents and complex spreadsheets using Microsoft Office suite.
  • Position requires regular travel.

Description

Join a high-impact underwriting team focused on building and growing a profitable, diversified Public Entity and Education portfolio. In this role, you will combine technical underwriting expertise, strategic market insight, and strong agent/broker relationships to help drive business growth and portfolio performance. Youll serve as a trusted subject matter expert on multi-line business, including professional liability, while collaborating closely with internal partners on key initiatives that shape the business. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact, mentor emerging talent, and help influence underwriting strategy in a dynamic, market-facing role.

Responsibilities:

Risk Selection:

  • Reviews, evaluates, and underwrites new and renewal business by assessing risk quality, determining premium and coverage terms, obtaining approvals as needed, and presenting proposals to agents and brokers. Negotiates terms and conditions to secure profitable business within authority and underwriting guidelines.

External Market Presence:

  • Establishes, develops, and maintains successful relationships with Agents and Brokers to facilitate marketing of products, through responsive service, site visits, in person renewal meetings or enhanced knowledge of their customers businesses.
  • Builds a strong market presence and maintains strong relationships with agents and brokers to support profitable growth, enhance market visibility, and strengthen long-term pipeline quality
  • Maintains a high level of responsiveness and provides effective service through renewal meetings, site visits, and other market-facing interactions.

Portfolio Management:

  • Manages a complex portfolio by analyzing performance, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, and executing targeted marketing and cross-marketing strategies to improve market share, diversification, and retention.

Documenting the Deal:

  • Documents underwriting decisions clearly and thoroughly to reflect sound judgment, compliance with state regulations, letter of authority, and underwriting guidelines. Maintains strong file quality through account reviews, referrals, and sign-offs.

Leadership:

  • Provides technical and professional coaching to underwriters and account analysts, sharing expertise and contributing to the development of underwriting talent.
  • Serves as a resource for complex underwriting questions and provides feedback to management on employee progress and development needs.
  • Partners with leadership on influencing underwriting standards

Continuous Improvement:

  • Participates in continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, improve underwriting efficiency, and enhance team performance.

About this job

Underwrite middle market commercial property and casualty risks, making independent pricing and coverage decisions within delegated authority. You will manage broker relationships, handle complex accounts, and mentor junior underwriters.

Good fit if you have 2.5+ years of underwriting experience, a business degree or equivalent, and can work in-person in Plano, Texas.

Full job description


Description

We are seeking an experienced Middle Market Senior Underwriter to underwrite commercial property & casualty risks in the middle market segment. As an individual contributor, you will make analytical, data-driven underwriting decisions within delegated authority, with limited guidance from leadership. You will evaluate and price moderately complex to complex accounts, manage broker and client relationships, and help shape product and portfolio strategy for your book of business.

To be considered for this role, candidates must reside within the specified geographic location. This position requires regular in-person visits with local brokers and agents, so remote hires outside the designated territory cannot be accommodated.

Key Responsibilities

  • Underwrite middle market commercial accounts within assigned authority by assessing submissions, reviewing coverage terms, exposures, loss history, financials, and supporting information to determine accept/decline, terms, and pricing.
  • Make independent, data-driven decisions on risk selection and pricing consistent with underwriting appetite and profitability objectives.
  • Coordinate referrals for accounts above individual authority or that require specialized support.
  • Manage a portfolio of brokers, agents, and insureds:
  • Maintain and grow relationships with producing brokers and agents; act as a visible Liberty representative in the market.
  • Develop targeted broker strategies to source profitable middle market business and expand market share.
  • Provide timely, clear responses to brokers and clients; negotiate coverage and terms while protecting portfolio profitability.
  • Underwrite higher-limit, complex, or unusual submissions typical to middle market clients (specialty exposures, large single-location risks, multi-location schedules, or industry-specific hazards).
  • Engage internal partners (Claims, Actuarial, Risk Control, Legal) to structure appropriate terms and risk mitigation plans.
  • Mentor and coach junior underwriters and new hires on middle market underwriting practices, decision-making, and Liberty processes
Qualifications
  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 2.5 years, typically 3 or more years, of progressive underwriting experience and/or other related experience
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate and judge underwriting risks within scope of responsibility that includes competence with all phases and aspects of the underwriting process, and proficiency in the use of qualitative and quantitative tools and techniques
  • Must demonstrate comprehension of complex technical underwriting issues and be capable of defining and implementing necessary underwriting and administrative processes/workflows to properly manage or administer those issues
  • Proven track record of developing and underwriting profitable business

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, youll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What youll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who Were Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive you follow through and do what you say youll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing youre comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy youre able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

Full job description


Description

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, youll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed no prior insurance experience required.

THIS IS NOT A REMOTE POSITION and you must be able to commute to the office located in Fairfax, VA

Description

What youll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who Were Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive you follow through and do what you say youll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing youre comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy youre able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.
