Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$126,500.00 - $208,700.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Within the Claim Behavioral Science function, apply behavioral science frameworks, the scientific method, and design thinking to practical business challenges across the Property and Casualty Insurance industry. Acting as an internal consultant, researcher, and data analyst, conduct pilots and implement evidence-based interventions that influence customer, claimant, and employee decision-making throughout the claim lifecycle - spanning initiatives such as digital adoption, change management, and product development. Work collaboratively with fellow behavioral scientists and key stakeholders, contributing independent project management and research expertise to design, execute, and analyze experiments with rigor and creativity to achieve measurable business outcomes.

What Will You Do?

  • Collect and analyze quantitative data, conduct semi-structured interviews, facilitate group design thinking sessions, and conduct test-and-learns with follow up measurements to calculate financial impact.
  • Apply behavioral science frameworks to test interventions that inform product design and experiences, and that impact financial results.
  • Collaborate with product designers, data scientists, project managers and marketing and communications to design, develop, conduct and evaluate projects and proofs of concept.
  • Help to develop and document research to support multiple recommendations to improve Claim business line results.
  • Implement agreed upon interventions in partnership with various sponsors.
  • Apply insights internally to influence how employees within the organization react to and manage transformational changes.
  • Provide insights, best practices, tools, and training to help develop organizational capabilities in the application of behavioral science.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 5+ years of applied industry experience in a business setting.
  • Ph.D., with certification and/or applied experience in Data Science.
  • Proven ability to design, conduct, analyze and communicate research results and recommendations as business cases.
  • Proficiency with Excel, R, SAS, and/or Python.
  • Experience in natural language processing and/or statistically based text analysis methods.
  • Experience in designing and conducting semi-structured interviews or user research for Behavioral Science interventions.
  • Group-led facilitation using design thinking collaboration software across multi-disciplinary groups.
  • Natural curiosity is key - demonstrated ability to understand problems and ask the right questions.
  • Strong research and analytical skills including an ability to observe and record behaviors.
  • Experience advocating for and influencing business partners to adopt behavioral science research, experimentation, and interventions.
  • Strong Project Management Skills and the ability to bring projects from idea to testing, and implementation; ability to balance priorities while working on multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Teamwork and Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work in a team environment and effectively collaborate across business areas.
  • Insurance or financial services industry experience.

What is a Must Have?

  • Master's Degree in Behavioral Science, Psychology, Economics, HCI, UX, People Analytics or a related field.
  • 2 years of experience applying behavioral science frameworks, insights, and experimental research in a business setting.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Job.JobDescription:
Company Details

We're a member company of W. R. Berkley Corporation, an A. M. Best A+ rated Fortune 500 holding company. Berkley is comprised of individual operating units that serve a defined insurance market segment. BTU is a global insurance provider, offering property, casualty, professional and cyber insurance coverage for technology firms and businesses with technology exposure.

Responsibilities

The Assistant Vice President, Risk Engineering is responsible for setting and executing the national risk engineering strategy for Berkley Technology Underwriters. This role provides executive-level leadership, oversight, and consultation to support profitable growth, portfolio management, and client value. The position leads a team of risk engineering professionals and partners closely with underwriting, claims, legal, and marketing leadership.

  • Establish and execute the national risk engineering strategy aligned with Berkley Technology Underwriters' business objectives.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of risk engineering professionals, including performance management and succession planning.
  • Manage relationships with vendors associated with supplying risk engineering services to the company.
  • Serve as an executive advisor to underwriting and executive leadership on emerging risks within the technology sector.
  • Oversee development of innovative risk engineering services, tools, and client-facing educational content.
  • Engage with key brokers and insured leadership to strengthen strategic relationships.
  • Represent Berkley Technology Underwriters in industry and broker associations and thought leadership forums.
  • Ensure consistency, quality, and scalability of risk engineering services delivered nationally.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to support underwriting decisions, new product development, and portfolio management.
  • Develop client service educational content around technology business risk engineering including but not limited to white papers, panel participation, and physical and e-tool platforms.
  • Oversee and coordinate risk engineering efforts within the key account management initiative.
  • Maintain and monitor regulatory compliance as respects statutory loss control provisions to meet individual state requirements.
  • May perform other functions as assigned.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in risk management, safety, risk engineering, or related disciplines within a corporate environment, preferably in the technology and/or property & casualty insurance industries.
  • Professional certifications such as CSP, CIH, CHMM, CFPS, ARM, or equivalent credentials are strongly preferred.
  • Highly motivated and results-oriented professional with exceptional analytical, influencing, relationship management, and business development skills.
  • Demonstrated organizational excellence, sound judgment, personal integrity, and a proven track record of delivering on commitments with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to challenge conventional thinking, drive innovation, and influence change while fostering strong collaborative partnerships across all levels of the organization.
  • Broad expertise across risk engineering disciplines, with a particular emphasis on technology operations, operational risk, and loss prevention strategies.
  • Strong customer-centric mindset with a solutions-oriented approach. Known for responsiveness, pragmatism, and the ability to navigate complex issues while maintaining positive and productive stakeholder relationships.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage, influence, and present to diverse audiences, including senior leaders and external partners.
  • Experience in corporate risk management, risk engineering, or significant leadership responsibility for environmental health and safety (EHS), regulatory compliance, facilities management, and/or supply chain risk within the technology sector.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and other business technologies. Demonstrated ability to thrive in a highly automated and autonomous environment through self-motivation, effective time management, accountability, and independent execution of strategic objectives.
  • Proven ability to lead and manage complex projects, collaborate across multiple disciplines, and balance competing priorities while aligning actions with both short- and long-term organizational goals.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in the following fields: Safety Management, Risk Management and Insurance, Business Management, Industrial or Environmental Engineering, Engineering and Science Majors.

  • Schedule: Full-time, includes weekends

About this job

Full-time remote insurance sales representative role selling Allstate products via phone, chat, and SMS to warm leads. Offers base pay of $18/hour plus uncapped performance incentives, paid training, licensing support, and home office equipment.

Good fit if you have at least one year of sales or customer service experience and can obtain an insurance producer license in your state.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

Licensed Insurance Sales Representative (Remote / Home-Based)

  • Licensing support: study materials, exam reimbursement, and assistance
  • Monthly internet reimbursement

  • Active Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license in your state of residence (preferred)
  • If unlicensed, ability to obtain a Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license with Allstates support
  • Sales Representatives are required to obtain and maintain all required resident and non-resident Producer licenses necessary to sell insurance products in any state designated by Allstate. This includes obtaining non-resident Producer licenses in all states as required for the role.
  • If hired, Sales Representative must relinquish all non-Allstate insurance carrier appointments and may not hold active appointments with other carriers while employed in this role, in accordance with Allstate licensing and appointment policies.

  • Able to work independently and hold yourself accountable for your performance
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously

Essential Job Functions

  • Handle inbound and outbound customer calls as the primary method of engagement
  • Maintain consistent availability during assigned work hours to meet call volume and service expectations, especially during the first 90 days of employment

Job.JobTitle: Claims Specialist, Workers Compensation - West Region
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Workers' Compensation Adjuster, Claims, Claims Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Chandler, AZ
  • Experience: 2+ years

About this job

Claims Specialist role with Liberty Mutual in Chandler, Arizona, handling moderately complex to complex workers compensation claims. Responsibilities include investigating claims, determining liability and compensability, negotiating settlements, and managing caseloads within assigned authority limits.

Good fit if you have at least 2 years of workers compensation claims handling experience with lost time and litigated claims, and a BS/BA degree or equivalent work experience.

Full job description


Description

Are you looking for an opportunity to join a fast-growing company that consistently outpaces the industry in year-over-year growth? Liberty Mutual offers an exciting opening for a Workers Compensation Claims Specialist within the West Region!

As a Workers Compensation Claims Specialist, you will work within a Claims Team, using the latest technology to review, analyze, and process claims that are routinely characterized as moderately complex to complex within assigned authority limits. This includes making decisions about liability/compensability, evaluating losses, negotiating settlements, and managing an inventory of commercial property/casualty claims involving bodily injury or property loss. You may also assist the Claims Team Manager with assigning new claims to team members, providing technical direction, and monitoring caseloads.

Depending on your overall skills and experience, you may be considered as a Claims Specialist II, Senior Claims Specialist I, or Senior Claims Specialist II. The salary range posted reflects the varying pay scale across various locations.

Candidates must reside within 50 miles of Lake Oswego, OR; and Chandler, AZ; and will be required to work onsite twice a month. Candidates residing in CA and WA will be considered in all locations and may be eligible for 100% remote work. Please note that this policy is subject to change.

Responsibilities:

  • Plans and conducts investigations of claims (including such activities as interviewing insureds, witnesses and claimants, collecting and evaluating appropriate documentation and securing evidence and protecting the chain-of-custody) to analyze and confirm coverage and to determine liability, compensability and damages.
  • Determines need for, and engages independent adjusters, cause and origin experts and independent medical examiners.
  • Refers to claim to subrogation group or Special Investigations Unit as appropriate.
  • Assesses policy coverage for submitted claims and notifies the insured of any issues; determines and establishes reserve requirements, adjusting reserves, as necessary, during the processing of the claim.
  • Assesses actual damages associated with claims and conducts negotiations, within assigned authority limits, to settle claims.

Position based in Lake Oswego, Oregon, with onsite attendance required twice monthly or full remote eligibility depending on location.

Good fit if you have at least 2 years of workers compensation claims handling experience with lost time and litigated claims, and a bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

Full job description


Description

Are you looking for an opportunity to join a fast-growing company that consistently outpaces the industry in year-over-year growth? Liberty Mutual offers an exciting opening for a Workers Compensation Claims Specialist within the West Region!

As a Workers Compensation Claims Specialist, you will work within a Claims Team, using the latest technology to review, analyze, and process claims that are routinely characterized as moderately complex to complex within assigned authority limits. This includes making decisions about liability/compensability, evaluating losses, negotiating settlements, and managing an inventory of commercial property/casualty claims involving bodily injury or property loss. You may also assist the Claims Team Manager with assigning new claims to team members, providing technical direction, and monitoring caseloads.

Depending on your overall skills and experience, you may be considered as a Claims Specialist II, Senior Claims Specialist I, or Senior Claims Specialist II. The salary range posted reflects the varying pay scale across various locations.

Candidates must reside within 50 miles of Lake Oswego, OR; and Chandler, AZ; and will be required to work onsite twice a month. Candidates residing in CA and WA will be considered in all locations and may be eligible for 100% remote work. Please note that this policy is subject to change.

Responsibilities:

  • Plans and conducts investigations of claims (including such activities as interviewing insureds, witnesses and claimants, collecting and evaluating appropriate documentation and securing evidence and protecting the chain-of-custody) to analyze and confirm coverage and to determine liability, compensability and damages.
  • Determines need for, and engages independent adjusters, cause and origin experts and independent medical examiners.
  • Refers to claim to subrogation group or Special Investigations Unit as appropriate.
  • Assesses policy coverage for submitted claims and notifies the insured of any issues; determines and establishes reserve requirements, adjusting reserves, as necessary, during the processing of the claim.
  • Assesses actual damages associated with claims and conducts negotiations, within assigned authority limits, to settle claims.
  • Coordinates the litigation activities associated with assigned claims to ensure a timely and cost-effective resolution; attends trials as a representative of the company.
  • Acts as senior technical professional on team, assisting team members with escalated issues.
  • Mentors and trains new team members.
  • Participates in Quality Review process.
  • Participates in conducting Suit Committees, Roundtables, Arbitrations, Mediations, field investigations and may assist in conducting closed file reviews.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

To be considered for the role, candidates should possess the following:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in Workers' Compensation claims handling lost time and litigated claims. Direct claims handling experience from investigation through resolution is required.
Qualifications
  • BS/BA degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum of 2 years experience in claims adjustment, general insurance or formal claims training.
  • Required to obtain and maintain all applicable licenses.
  • Continuing education courses leading to industry certifications preferred (e.g., AEI, IIA, CPCU).
  • Knowledge of claims investigation techniques, medical terminology and legal aspects of claims.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Boston, MA
  • Experience: 4+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Senior Analyst role supporting sourcing, underwriting, execution, and monitoring of commercial real estate credit investments. You will build cash flow models, conduct due diligence, and prepare investment memoranda while working closely with senior investment professionals on live transactions.

Good fit if you have 2-4+ years of real estate investment banking or private equity experience with direct underwriting and transaction execution exposure.

Full job description


Description

The Company:

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is the investment firm for Liberty Mutual Group (Liberty) andis responsible forpowering Libertys strategy amid profound change in global capital markets. With deep expertise in fixed income, equity, and alternative strategies,LMI invests $120+ billion (as of 12/31/2025) of capital globally,taking a long-term approach across its integrated platform and has a team of over 350 investment, finance, and operations professionals located in Boston, MA, and New York, NY.

LMI has a clear purpose: build enduring businesses side-by-side with our partners, drive economic growth, and generate superior risk-adjusted returns that power Libertys strategy and secure its promises.Weoffer the best of both worlds the look and feel of a boutique investment firm with the reputation and financial strength of a global leader. As the investment firm of a mutual with long-term capital, LMI has a single client mandate. This gives us the freedom to focus on what we do best.

Our portfolio spans a broad spectrum of public and private investments, and we are committed to expanding our capabilities and our toolkit in support of our mission. We invest across diverse asset classes, financial structures, and industries, including real estate, digital infrastructure, healthcare, renewable energy, and technologywith the aim of creating value and powering innovation. We pride ourselves on our extensive network of mutually beneficial partnerships, and we use our substantial influence, capital, and energy to drive towards a better future.#LMI #LI-LMI

The Position:

We are seeking a Senior Analyst to join the Real Estate Credit investment team. In this role, you will support the sourcing, underwriting, execution, and monitoring of commercial real estate (CRE) credit investments, working closely with senior investment professionals on live transactions from initial screening through investment committee approval and ongoing portfolio management. You will gain broad exposure to deal work across property types, geographies, and structures.

This role offers the opportunity to invest long-term capital on behalf of a single client, giving the team the flexibility to evaluate opportunities on their merits and take a long-term view. As a Senior Analyst, you will take on meaningfuldeal responsibility early, own key parts of the underwriting process, and have direct visibility into how investment decisions are made.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain detailed cash flow models for CRE loans and underlying properties, including sensitivity and downside scenario analysis, to evaluate credit risk and relative value.
  • Conduct property, market, and sponsor due diligence, including review of rent rolls, operating statements, appraisals, third-party reports, and market comparables.
  • Prepare investment memoranda and presentations that clearly articulate the investment thesis, key risks and mitigants, and proposed structure.
  • Support the structuring and negotiation of loan terms and documentation alongside senior team members, legal counsel, and internal partners.
  • Track the performance of existing investments, monitor covenant compliance and market conditions, and proactively flag emerging risks to the team.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Real Estate, Accounting, or a related field; progress toward the CFA or a masters degree a plus.
  • 2-4+ years of experience in real estate investment banking, or real estate private equity, with direct exposure to underwriting and transaction execution.
  • Advanced Excel financial modeling skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; sound credit judgment and strong attention to detail; ability to manage multiple transactions simultaneously and work independently; demonstrated interest in real estate credit markets.
  • Demonstratesstrong AI literacy and uses AI-enabled tools to enhance speed, accuracy, and insight generation whilemaintainingsound judgment and compliance with governance standards

Job.JobDescription:
Description

Join us as a Field Property Claims Adjuster where youll be responsible for helping our customers navigate the claims process and get back on their feet following damage to the homeowners property. This is a role where people who love every day to be new, different and exciting, can thrive youll be traveling on the road to meet customers in person, providing hands-on assessment of damage and empathetic support.

The Field Property Claims Adjuster will be traveling locally to insured homes within Coeur D Alene, ID (83815) and surrounding areas. To be successful within the role, candidates should live within or near this area.

Sign-On Bonus Available! Were offering a sign-on bonus for experienced and actively licensed new hires.

What youll do

  • Investigate and evaluate onsite to resolve complex coverage and damage issues to include preparing complete estimates of repair for the covered damages. This may include accessing roofs by ladder, inspecting attics, crawl spaces and basements in search of damage.
  • Handle moderate to complex claims independently while managing your workload, from first notice of loss to final closure.
  • Be expected to work in a vehicle in the field daily while occasionally handling assignments from the desk.
  • Explain coverage of loss, assist policyholders with itemization of damages, emergency repairs and additional living arrangements.
  • Work with and coordinate a few vendor services such as contractors, emergency repair, cleaning services and various replacement services.
  • May be called upon for catastrophe duty.

Position details

  • Territory-based work:Most workdays will be spent in the field within your assigned local territory, giving you the opportunity to work directly with customers and gain hands-on experience.

  • Training & support:To set you up for success, youll participate in a comprehensive 5-month training program, which includes:
    • Primarily virtual and on-the-job learning.
    • Two short in-person training sessions (Weeks 4 and 7) at our Lewisville, TX office.
    • Limited overnight travel for training and team meetings (typically less than 10%).

  • Mileage Reimbursement:This role offers mileage reimbursement. You may qualify for a company-provided vehicle once mileage requirements are met. Additional details will be provided if you advance in the selection process.
Qualifications
  • Working knowledge of claims handling procedures and operations.
  • Proven ability to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Effective negotiation skills.
  • Ability to effectively and independently manage workload while exhibiting good judgment.
  • Strong written/oral communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Computer skills with the ability to work with multi-faceted systems.
  • The capabilities, skills and knowledge required through a bachelors degree or equivalent experience and at least 1 year of directly related experience.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.
  • The ability to handle multiple competing priorities and organize your day.
  • Strong time management and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated understanding of building construction principles.

Description

  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.

Day One Skills & Traits

Preferred Qualifications

The Cash Management Specialist performs accounting, treasury, and cash management work relating to the designated operational area(s). This could include but is not limited to the transfer of funds, preparation of journal entries, reconciling general ledger accounts, and internal and external report preparation.

This is a hybrid position reporting to the Harrisburg, PA office. The initial training period will take place in-office.

POSITION COMPETENCIES

  • Attention to Details
  • Quality Orientation
  • Planning & Organizing
  • Positive Approach
  • Applied Learning

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Accurately prepares E-vouchers, cash receipt vouchers, and general expense vouchers in support of business transactions.
  • Prepares accurate journal entries to record transactions.
  • Prepares reconciliations for information in the general ledger.
  • Responsible for preparing and distributing internal and external financial reports.
  • Responsible for maintenance of files and archives.
  • Monitors daily cash activity and initiates cash transfers and other banking requests as necessary.
  • Develops and maintains spreadsheets to record financial activity for use by others in the financial division.
  • Processes special deposit interest payments and initiates replacement of special deposit securities and other correspondence with appropriate financial institutions.
  • Identifies more critical and less critical activities and assignments; adjusts priorities when appropriate.
  • Allocates appropriate amounts of time for completing own and others' work; avoids scheduling conflicts; develops timelines and milestones.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • May research laws and regulations to ensure proper compliance
  • Performs other duties as may be assigned by the Director, Treasury & Billing Services
  • Looks for and communicates the positive qualities and longer-term benefits of challenging situations (while facing the real problems).
  • May provide assistance to other team members with General Ledger, Accounts Payable, and Payroll duties as assigned by management.
  • Adheres to the work group's expectations and guidelines; fulfills team or work group responsibilities; demonstrates personal commitment to group goals.
  • Puts new knowledge, understanding, or skill to practical use on the job; furthers learning through practice and ongoing feedback.
  • Performs other duties as may be assigned by the Director, Treasury & Billing Services.

SPECIAL RELATIONSHIPS

  • Interacts with all levels of the organization internally, as well as interaction with external entities.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Credentials

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, other business administration related discipline preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience preferred.

Technical/Professional Knowledge

  • Must use analytical and problem solving skills for daily activities
  • Personal Computer experience in a Windows environment including Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, and Outlook
  • Basic understanding of accounting principles
  • Ability to work in deadline driven/team environment.
  • Ability to work with automated accounting systems
  • Must possess strong organizational skills

The compensation has been carefully determined by considering a variety of important factors, including skill sets, experience, training, and certifications. With these considerations in mind, the estimated hiring range is $48,000 - $67,000. Additionally, you may be able to participate in our annual incentive program, depending on eligibility under the plan.

JOB REQUIREMENTS (as required by ADA – Americans with Disabilities Act)

  • This position is primarily a sedentary position that requires occasional standing and walking throughout the office environment.
  • Must be able to perform computer-based tasks and access digital information necessary for job duties, including through the use of assistive technologies.
  • Must be able to complete computer-based tasks and utilize office equipment as needed to perform essential job functions.
  • Must be able to access and enter information accurately using automated systems.
  • Must be able to communicate effectively with internal and external clients using telephone, electronic, or other communication systems.
  • Must be able to present information to individuals and groups.
  • Must be able to interpret and apply concepts that may or may not be based upon established guidelines.
  • Must be able to maintain acceptable attendance and adhere to scheduled work hours.

The Commercial Lines Territory Manager serves as a liaison between the company and agents and acts as a relationship manager for our agents, regional underwriting team and corporate departments. Incumbent assesses the strengths and weaknesses of agents and assists them in achieving a mutual goal of profitable growth in both premium volume and policy count. This position ensures agents are familiar with Penn National Insurance commercial lines initiatives, products, policies, procedures and services, and is responsible for commercial lines agency prospecting, planning and agency management initiatives. Incumbent provides collaboration and support to Underwriters and RVPs on small business and mid-market decisions, as well as other branch initiatives. The Commercial Lines Territory Manager utilizes assigned position authorities to favorably impact agent, team, and branch commercial lines results. At the direction of President-Partners Mutual or Regional Vice President, this may include limited direct underwriting of small commercial new business.

The territory for this position covers NC and VA. The ideal candidate would reside in the Raleigh or Richmond area.

POSITION COMPETENCIES

  • Business Acumen
  • Negotiation
  • Results Oriented
  • Time & Priority Management
  • Decision Making

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Sales/Premium Growth

  • Develop the agency force to pre-qualify, rate, and bind profitable commercial lines business.
  • Utilize authority to assist agency partners in helping them write profitable business.
  • Develop professional working relationships with agents, regional underwriting and claim teams and corporate departments.
  • Conduct thorough evaluation of all prospective agents and submit written recommendation to Regional Vice President.
  • Keeps two-way communication between agent and company continuously open and viable.
  • Monitors agency results and follows up with agent as to growth and compliance with company's initiatives, procedures and policies.
  • Stays alert for and shares industry information, new ideas, products, or changes in other carrier philosophies that could positively or adversely affect Penn National Insurance with appropriate colleagues.
  • Conduct ongoing agency prospecting within territory to create a pipeline of potential future appointments.
  • Participates in commercial lines rate reviews as requested.
  • Utilizes authority to make consistent underwriting decisions, adhere to company acceptability and pricing philosophies, and promote ease of doing business initiatives with Penn National Insurance.

Profitability

  • Profiles commercial lines book of business to assist in profitability analysis.
  • Develops and implements effective agency profitability plans when warranted.
  • Monitors agency results and follows up with agent as to profitability and compliance with company's initiatives, procedures and policies.
  • Facilitate agency reviews with other team members to review agent's performance as compared to established goals and implement corrective actions as needed.
  • Develop and implement agency action plans to achieve profitability.

Agency Management

  • Provide training to agency plant on programs, products, services, and systems.
  • Develop annual agency/company marketing plans.
  • Analyze territory profitability, premium growth, and agency representation, and implement corrective actions where appropriate.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Applies data to solve common business problems.
  • Compiles, manipulates, and analyses data of varying complexity.
  • Knowledgeable and proficient about what tools are available for data analysis and when they are appropriate to use.
  • Performs other duties as may be assigned by the President-Partners Mutual or Regional Vice President.

SPECIAL RELATIONSHIPS

  • Direct contact with all levels of branch underwriting and supporting claims service office personnel
  • Direct contact with all levels of Home Office Underwriting Operations personnel
  • Direct contact with agents and insureds

QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Credentials

  • Four year college degree preferred.
  • Continuing education in specialized insurance courses such as IIA, AU, CPCU, and CIC, as well as other educational experiences that enhance product knowledge and technical business relations.
  • Maintenance of an active agent's P&C license in domiciled state preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum of three years' property/casualty commercial lines underwriting and/or marketing experience with a Property and Casualty carrier preferred.
  • Agency or broker experience with heavy concentration in underwriting exposure/risk and marketing may substitute for carrier experience

Technical/Professional Knowledge

  • Must have technical underwriting knowledge of the commercial lines of business written by Penn National Insurance
  • Effective oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate information of a highly technical nature
  • Proven sales, negotiations, and solution-selling skills
  • Working knowledge and skill in agency and Company automation systems, to include fundamental knowledge on the use of personal computers, with emphasis on Microsoft Office Suite
  • Exceptional customer service skills
  • Good financial analysis skills
  • Excellent time management skills

  • Strong commercial lines underwriting analysis skills.

    The compensation has been carefully determined by considering a variety of important factors, including skill sets, experience, training, and certifications. With these considerations in mind, the estimated hiring range is $90,000 -$125,000. Additionally, you may be able to participate in our annual incentive program, depending on eligibility under the plan.

JOB REQUIREMENTS (as required by ADA – Americans with Disabilities Act)

  • This position is primarily a sedentary position that requires occasional standing and walking throughout the office environment.
  • Must be able to see and effectively use a computer monitor.
  • Must be able to operate a computer, keyboard and applicable printers and other general office equipment.
  • Must be able to access and enter information accurately using automated systems.
  • Must be able to hear and communicate via the telephone and/or monitoring devices to both internal and external clients.
  • Must be able to present information to individuals and groups.
  • Must be able to interpret and apply concepts that may or may not be based upon established guidelines.
  • Must be able to maintain acceptable attendance and adhere to scheduled work hours.
  • Must have a valid driver's license and be able to operate a motor vehicle.
  • Must be able to travel, with overnight stays required.

Summit provides independent insurance agents and their clients with market-leading workers' comp insurance and elite customer service. We're growing and currently serve more than 7,000 independent agents and 31,000 policyholders across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic.

Our strength comes from a single-minded focus on workers' comp and a commitment to long-term customer relationships. Summit is who you turn to when you need a specialist who not only knows workers' comp but also gets to know your business and your priorities.

Our field team members are located in every state in which we operate.

Summit is a member of the Great American Insurance Group where our highest goal is for all employees to feel included, respected, and empowered to perform at their best.

Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities

  • This position is a field role in Pennsylvania.
  • Conducts thorough audits of insureds financial records to verify the accuracy of reported premiums, ensuring that all calculations are precise and compliant with company policies, industry regulations, and legal requirements.
  • Conducts reviews and analysis of complex financial statements, payroll records, and other relevant documents, identifying trends and anomalies that may impact premium accuracy.
  • Resolves complex discrepancies in policyholder records by coordinating with producers, underwriters, insureds, leadership, and other internal departments, ensuring that all issues are addressed promptly and effectively.
  • Evaluates and determines the applicability of insurance certificates and class codes to specific exposures.
  • Analyzes claim activity on policies to ensure that employee coding is consistent and accurate.
  • Prepares and presents detailed audit reports to management, providing clear and actionable findings that support strategic decision-making.
  • Collaborates with underwriters and other internal departments to ensure accurate premium calculations.
  • Provides excellent customer service to policyholders by addressing complex audit-related inquiries and ensuring a positive experience throughout the audit process.
  • May monitor and evaluate premium audit practices, assisting with implementing strategic adjustments to improve overall effectiveness and outcomes.
  • May have responsibility for performance and coaching of staff and may have a participatory role in decisions regarding talent selection, development, and performance management for direct reports.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

About this job

Manage commercial lines agencies and underwrite mid-market new business for Penn National Insurance in Eastern PA. Serve as liaison between agents, underwriters, and company, developing agency profitability plans and driving growth through training and collaboration.

Good fit if you have five years of P&C commercial underwriting experience and prefer a four year college degree and active P&C license.

Full job description

The Senior Commercial Lines Territory Manager serves as a liaison between the company and agents, and acts as a relationship manager for our agents, regional underwriting team and corporate departments. Incumbent is responsible for all commercial lines agency planning and agency management initiatives for assigned agents, to include providing collaboration and support to Underwriters and RVPs on small business, mid-market renewal decisions, and other branch initiatives. The Senior Commercial Lines Territory Manager is also responsible for the direct underwriting of mid-market new business as well as growth objectives for assigned commercial lines agents. Incumbent evaluates the strengths and weaknesses of assigned agents and facilitates new business action plans that drive profitable commercial lines growth in both premium volume and policy count. To leverage new business, the Incumbent provides necessary training to ensure assigned agents are familiar with Penn National Insurance commercial lines products, policies, procedures, and services.

The territory for this position is Eastern PA.

POSITION COMPETENCIES

  • Business Acumen
  • Negotiation
  • Results Oriented
  • Time & Priority Management
  • Decision Making

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Sales/Premium Growth

Job Description

Posting Description

Surety Account Manager, Processor Team Lead

Summary

The Surety Account Manager is responsible for managing client relationships, overseeing surety account service activities, and providing leadership and direction to the Surety Processing team. This role serves as the primary point of contact for clients, carriers, and internal stakeholders while ensuring the accurate and timely issuance, renewal, and servicing of surety bonds. The Surety Account Manager drives operational excellence through workflow management, quality control, staff development, and process improvement while delivering exceptional client service and maintaining strong carrier relationships.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, surety carriers, producers, and internal business partners.

  • Oversee the day-to-day operations of the Surety Processing team, including workflow distribution, prioritization, and quality assurance.
  • Provide guidance, training, and mentorship to surety processors to support performance, productivity, and professional development.
  • Monitor departmental service standards and ensure timely completion of bond issuance, renewals, endorsements, cancellations, and reinstatements.
  • Manage and maintain client records, bond schedules, policy information, and supporting documentation within agency management systems and carrier portals.
  • Review and approve bond requests, renewal processing, invoices, finance agreements, and related surety transactions.
  • Coordinate the issuance of new and renewal bonds, including bid, performance, payment, maintenance, and miscellaneous bonds.
  • Track bond renewals and ensure all required documentation and billing information is processed accurately and within established service timelines.
  • Address client service issues, billing inquiries, and bond-related concerns while collaborating with carriers and internal departments as needed.
  • Assist with process development, workflow enhancements, and operational efficiency initiatives to improve overall team performance.
  • Maintain compliance with agency procedures, carrier requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
  • Support special projects and departmental initiatives as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of surety bonds, bond administration processes, and surety industry practices.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to motivate, coach, and develop team members.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong client relationship management and customer service skills.
  • Ability to make sound independent decisions and exercise professional judgment.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with clients, carriers, producers, and internal teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office products, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Experience working with agency management systems and carrier platforms preferred.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities, processes, and technology.

Education and Experience

  • Associate's degree or equivalent experience required; Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • 3+ years of insurance industry experience, including surety account management, surety operations, or related client service experience.
  • Previous leadership, supervisory, or team lead experience preferred.
  • Experience managing bond issuance, renewals, and surety servicing activities preferred.

Certificates, Licenses, and Registration

  • Property & Casualty Insurance License required or obtainable within 30 days of hire.
  • Surety-specific industry designations or advanced insurance certifications are a plus.

What we Offer:

We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $75,000.00 – $85,000.00. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

Design, develop, and operationalize secure agentic AI capabilities in risk & security operations

$109,300.00 - $180,200.00

What Is the Opportunity?

What Is in It for You?

What Is the Opportunity?

Cybersecurity operations is responsible for the identification, protection, detection, response and disruption of cybersecurity events across Travelers through critical analysis, threat intelligence gathering, and agile cybersecurity techniques to assess, support, and resolve cyber incidents. Within Cybersecurity Operations, our Email Security team protects a complex messaging environment with a hybrid architecture spanning more than 50,000 mailboxes. As a Cybersecurity Ops Technologist I on this team, you will own the day-to-day administration, configuration, and optimization of our Proofpoint infrastructure, acting as the subject-matter authority on email threat prevention, authentication, and mail flow across Travelers. This is a hands-on technical operations role for someone who has deep, product-level expertise in enterprise email security and is ready to apply that expertise at scale.

What Will You Do?

  • Administer and optimize our enterprise Proofpoint deployment - including Targeted Attack Protection (TAP), Threat Response Auto-Pull (TRAP), Secure Email Relay, Adaptive Email Security/Email DLP, Email Isolation, and Email Fraud Defense - to protect a hybrid M365/on-premises Exchange environment.
  • Design, configure, and maintain secure email gateway rulesets, mail flow policies, and quarantine management strategies, balancing threat containment against business continuity across 50,000+ mailboxes.
  • Own DKIM, SPF, and DMARC strategy end-to-end: authoring and maintaining records, tuning alignment and enforcement policies, and troubleshooting authentication failures across multiple sending domains and third-party senders.
  • Manage and troubleshoot complex mail relay and connector configurations spanning Microsoft 365 and on-premises Exchange, ensuring reliable mail flow through the Proofpoint gateway.
  • Analyze internal and external threat intelligence and TAP telemetry to identify emerging phishing, BEC, and malware campaigns targeting the organization, and tune detection rules and policies in response.
  • Partner with the SOC to build and refine automated response playbooks for email-borne threats, including TRAP-driven message remediation.
  • Serve as the email security escalation point of contact for operational inquiries and troubleshooting, providing technical analysis on message trace, header forensics, and delivery/authentication failures.
  • Evaluate and integrate complementary controls such as M365 Defender for Office 365 (Safe Links, Safe Attachments, Threat Explorer) to strengthen a layered email defense strategy.
  • Communicate email threat trends, platform health, and risk posture clearly to security leadership and business stakeholders.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Degree or Certificate in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 3+ years of dedicated email security engineering experience, including substantial hands-on administration of the Proofpoint platform (TAP, TRAP, Secure Email/Secure Email Relay, Adaptive Email Security, Email Isolation, Email Fraud Defense, CLEAR) within a large enterprise deployment - strongly preferred for this role.
  • Alternatively, multiple years of comparable, production-level depth administering another leading secure email gateway platform (e.g., Mimecast, Cisco Secure Email/IronPort, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Abnormal Security, Barracuda), with demonstrated command of secure email gateway architecture and policy management at scale.
  • Proven experience configuring and managing quarantine policies, end-user digest and release workflows, and gateway rulesets in a high-volume mail environment.
  • Deep working knowledge of DKIM, SPF, and DMARC; able to independently design authentication strategy, diagnose alignment/enforcement failures, and manage third-party sender exceptions.
  • Solid understanding of email relay architecture, MX/connector design, and mail flow troubleshooting in a hybrid Microsoft 365 and on-premises Exchange environment.

What Is the Opportunity?

At Travelers, our Cybersecurity Engineering teams are responsible for the overall implementation and management of strategic platforms that provide oversight, process management, protection and enablement of security control processes and allow for an effective Cybersecurity practice. As a Director, Cybersecurity Engineering, you will manage cybersecurity professionals who are responsible for the successful configuration, enhancement, automation, and implementation across multiple cybersecurity platforms. You are the point of contact for Cybersecurity and business leaders. You will ensure alignment with goals and objectives and provide technical guidance and leadership to your teams.

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the US. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, this this role.

What Will You Do?

  • Architect, implement, and maintain SailPoint IdentityNow solutions at enterprise scale
  • Oversee connector development, integration with SaaS applications and other sources/applications.
  • Maintain and support lifecycle management automation including joiner, mover, and leaver (JML) workflows
  • Lead role engineering, role mining, and role-based access control (RBAC) design initiatives
  • Lead access certification and recertification campaigns to support audit readiness
  • Collaborate with Internal Audit and Risk teams to address access control findings
  • Own the IAM support model including incident response, escalation paths, and SLA management for identity-related issues
  • Establish and maintain a tiered support structure (L1/L2/L3) for SailPoint platform issues
  • Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for critical IAM incidents and drive permanent remediation
  • Manage on-call rotation and ensure 24/7 platform availability for critical identity services
  • Oversee patch management, upgrades, and platform health monitoring for SailPoint environments
  • Develop and maintain runbooks, knowledge base articles, and operational documentation
  • Monitor and report on IAM KPIs, KRIs, and access anomalies
  • Oversee project delivery using Agile/Scrum methodologies for IAM initiatives
  • Manage team capacity, budget planning, and resource allocation
  • Responsible for the strategic development of platforms which includes assessing efficiency, overall operations, and potential enhancements. 
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  • SailPoint Certified IdentityNow Engineer or IdentityIQ Architect certification
  • 10+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management, 5+ years of hands-on SailPoint experience (IdentityNow and/or IdentityIQ), 3+ years in a leadership role.
  • Deep expertise in IAM concepts: IGA, SSO/Federation, MFA, RBAC, ABAC, Zero Trust
  • Experience integrating SailPoint with enterprise directories (Active Directory, LDAP, Azure AD/Entra ID, Salesforce etc)
  • Strong knowledge of identity protocols: SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, LDAP, SCIM
  • Proven track record managing cross-functional teams and enterprise-scale programs
  • Broad knowledge of Cloud computing and automation concepts.
  • Expert knowledge of cybersecurity privacy principles, cyber threats and vulnerabilities, and cyber defense and information security policies, procedures, and regulations.
  • Ability to apply cybersecurity and privacy principles (confidentiality, integrity, availability and zero trust architecture) to organizational needs, with expertise in Identity & Access Management, including authentication, authorization, and the principle of least privilege.
  • Strategic thinking with strong operational execution
  • Experience leading and managing complex projects with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact with all levels of the organization.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, similar degree, or its equivalent in work experience.
  • 5 years of experience in Information Technology Security Engineering or Software engineering.

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As an Associate Senior Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to use your legal expertise and litigation skills to independently handle a caseload of predominatly moderate to higher complexity matters, which may include Major Case matters depending on line of business. You will deliver optimal results for Travelers' insured customers, and will mentor less experienced attorneys.

What Will You Do?

  • In the handling of a caseload of predominantly moderate and higher exposure cases, including Major Case litigation matters depending on line of business, your responsibilities will include:
  • Leverage pre-trial and trial experience to apply effective use of litigation skills and techniques to try cases to verdict or negotiate resolution.
  • Conduct proficient to advanced legal research and demonstrate strong and persuasive legal writing and presentation skills.
  • Draft substantive pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery and other legal documents.
  • Attend court events, depositions, and other appointments independently.
  • Provide in-depth, substantive case analysis and recommendations to insured clients and Claim partners on file handling strategies.
  • Collaborates with expert witnesses and consultants to develop case strategies, evaluate technical matters, and prepare compelling testimony for litigation.
  • Build and maintain strong internal and external client and business partner relationships, including accountability for managing client and business partner relationships.
  • Provide internal and external training, seminars and legal updates to insured clients and Claim partners.
  • Provide leadership through mentoring other attorneys and legal support staff.
  • Contributes to special projects and identifies other opportunities to support office goals/business needs.
  • Fully and effectively utilize available technology, case management system and automation.
  • Travel as required to meet business needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 5+ years of insurance defense litigation experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Demonstrates an aptitude for trying cases to a jury; proven track record of preparing and/or litigating jury trials, with a history of successful courtroom outcomes.
  • Demonstrates strong technical knowledge in the practice area(s) and the ability to effectively communicate complex information on litigated matters to diverse audiences.
  • Proficient oral and written advocacy skills, with a demonstrated track record of summary judgment and/or appellate successs.
  • Possesses in-depth knowledge of the bench, bar, local jurisdictional practices, adversaries.
  • Capably fosters collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners to deliver exceptional customer service.
  • Demonstrates leadership through mentoring and influencing skills.
  • Exercises sound decision making and possesses advanced negotiation skills.
  • Effectively manages multiple priorities with an attention to detail, sense of urgency and responsiveness.
  • Possesses a flexible and agile mindset with a willingness to take on new challenges as needs evolve.

What is a Must Have?

  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent International legal degree; graduate of an accredited law school.
  • 4 years experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Active license in good standing to practice law in the state(s) in which representation is required.
  • Regularly handles hearings, trials, dispositive motion arguments, depositions, or other court proceedings and has the ability to transport to those meetings. Valid driver's license required depending on the location.

Job.JobTitle: Summer 2027 Intern: Manufactured Housing Product Analysis Intern
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Miami, FL
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

12-week paid internship analyzing manufactured home insurance products at a Fortune 500 company. You will work with data and cross-functional teams to analyze product performance, conduct market research, and develop insights and recommendations.

Good fit if you are pursuing a degree in risk, insurance, finance, or related field and have strong Excel skills and analytical ability.

Full job description

Manufactured Home Product Analyst Intern:

The Assurant Internship Program is a 12-week immersive experience where interns do not sit on the sidelines. You will gain real-world experience by tackling business challenges and helping drive meaningful outcomes. The program combines hands-on work with learning and development opportunities, mentorship, networking and engagement opportunities, and resources designed to support your professional growth. This program offers students meaningful, real-world experience while building foundational technical and business skills in a Fortune 500 organization.

As a Manufactured Home Product Analyst Intern, you will support efforts to shape and improve the manufactured home insurance product. Working alongside experienced team members, you will gain exposure to the intersection of data, product strategy, and execution. You will help analyze product performance, identify trends and opportunities, conduct competitive analysis, and turn findings into clear insights, documentation, and recommendations.

This is a great opportunity for a curious and motivated student who enjoys working with data, asking thoughtful questions, and learning how products perform. Our team will teach you about the products and insurance industry. Successful interns will bring analytical ability, initiative, attention to detail, and a genuine interest in learning and contributing.

What You'll Do

  • Assist with analyzing product performance, profitability, customer needs, and market trends to identify potential risks and opportunities.
  • Help turn data into clear reports, visualizations, and insights for team members and business partners.
  • Conduct competitive and market research to support product decisions including development of state specific competitive analysis documentation of our top competitors.
  • Identify risk management concerns, analyze client specific risk management items, and suggest corrective actions based on data analysis.
  • Gain exposure to product changes throughout the development lifecycle, including planning, quality assurance, regulatory filing, implementation, and post-launch analysis.
  • Collaborate with teams such as Product Management, Actuarial, Underwriting, Sales, and Technology.
  • Help identify opportunities to improve products, reporting, and team processes.
  • Participate in team meetings, ask questions, share ideas, and contribute to assigned projects.

Basic Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a bachelor's degree in Risk/Insurance, Finance, Business Administration, Marketing, Mathematics, Data Analytics, Economics, or a related field.
  • Interest in product analysis, business analysis, data analysis, market research, insurance, or product development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel (pivot tables, lookups, data cleaning).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple assignments.
  • A willingness to learn, ask questions, accept feedback, and collaborate with others.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience working with data through coursework, academic projects, student organizations, or a previous internship.
  • Familiarity with data visualization concepts or tools.
  • Exposure to SQL, Power BI, or similar data and reporting tools.
  • An interest in insurance products, customer behavior, or market trends.
  • Automation/AI exposure

Why Join This Team

  • Gain hands-on experience supporting products with meaningful opportunities for improvement and innovation.
  • Learn about the product lifecycle and how insurance products are developed, evaluated, and enhanced.
  • Build practical skills in data analysis, market research, business documentation, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Work with a supportive and flexible team that values questions, new perspectives, and professional development.
  • Receive guidance and mentorship from experienced product professionals.
  • Explore potential career paths in product analysis, product management, business analysis, and related fields.

Hybrid Opportunity: 2 days per week in office

Paid Internship: $25/hour

Start Date: 5/17/2027
End Date: 8/7/2027

Note: You must be work authorized in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to F-1 (student) visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or cannot work now on a full time basis.


If no application deadline is provided, this role may be a pipeline requisition, and we'll continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis, or there is no requirement for this information in the location where the role is posted.

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience, and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Helping People Thrive in a Connected World
Connect with us. Bring us your best work and your brightest ideas. And we'll bring you a place where you can thrive. Learn more at jobs.assurant.com.

What's the culture like at Assurant?
Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America's Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture The Assurant Way.

Company Overview
Assurant is a leading global business services company that supports, protects, and connects major consumer purchases. A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world's leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.

AI and Biometric Usage
Assurant supports the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), but we want to know the real you. Visit our AI Usage Guidelines page to understand what we expect from applicants regarding their use of AI during the application process. Since we would like to know the real you, we require that all of our virtual interviews be conducted on video.

Employment is contingent upon completion of a required identity verification process, which may include biometric technology, where permitted by applicable law and subject to applicable notice and consent requirements. See our Privacy Notice to learn about Assurant's privacy practices, including our use of AI-enabled technology, automated decision making, and biometric information.

Equal Opportunity Statement
Assurant is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not use or consider race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law in employment decisions.

Job Scam Alert
Please be aware that during Assurant's application process, we will never ask for personal information such as your Social Security number, bank account details, or passwords. Learn more about what to look out for and how to report a scam here.

Benefits That Go Beyond The Basics

Immediately responds to unusual or emergency situations implementing established protocols and when necessary using the appropriate escalation of force, consistent with training and applicable department procedures. Understands, agrees to, and abides by security operations procedures, protocols and policies.

Implements in an orderly manner established crisis event response plans, following all policies and procedures These include but are not limited to: all fire alarms, security breaches, suspicious mailings/items found, criminal offenses, injuries and accidents or other suspicious activity that could be criminal in nature or emergency events. Reports any infractions to the security operations management, following established reporting methods.

About this job

VP, Chief Claims Officer leads claims strategy, operations, and compliance for Berkley Mid-Atlanta Group, a property and casualty insurance provider. Reports to the Operating Unit's Executive Committee and manages the Claims Leadership Team while contributing to enterprise-wide strategy.

Good fit if you have 10+ years of advanced multiline commercial claims leadership experience and expertise in auto, property, general liability, workers compensation, and umbrella claims.

Full job description

Company Details

Berkley Mid-Atlantic Group (BMAG) is a property and casualty insurance provider serving the Mid-Atlantic. We are a member of W. R. Berkley Corporation, one of the largest commercial lines property and casualty insurance holding companies in the United States. With the resources of a large Fortune 500® corporation and the ability to operate with the closeness and flexibility of a small company, we exclusively work with select independent agents to insure the future of business.

Our culture is one that empowers employees to question the status quo and seek innovative ways to continue to exceed the expectations of our customers. We practice collaboration, creativity, and teamwork on a daily basis, with a commitment to innovation and high performance.

Company URL: https://www.wrbmag.com/

The company is an equal opportunity employer.

Responsibilities

The Chief Claims Officer (CCO) serves as the highest level of Claims leadership in the Operating Unit (OU) and is responsible for Claims strategy, operations, compliance, customer service, and overall management of loss costs. The CCO serves as a member and key contributor on the OU's Executive Committee and Senior Leadership Team (SLT), working above and beyond the Claims functional area as a co-leader of the OU in general. The CCO is also responsible for all aspects of people management, engagement, and performance of the Claims staff. The CCO leads innovation in both the Claims function and beyond.

  • Develops and communicates the vision, strategy and priorities of the Claims organization; including operational plans and controls to assure they are effectively executed.
  • Leads development and achievement of department goals including aligned performance objectives for all Claims staff. Assures effective metrics are in place, monitored, analyzed and reported regularly.
  • Assures sound case reserving practices and achieves favorable total claim outcomes, balancing loss costs, ALAE, and ULAE, with minimal claims leakage.
  • Leads Innovation ideation and experimentation to enhance the customer experience and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of claim operations.
  • Attains high levels of claims file quality through a robust, self-critical Quality Assurance program supplemented by a strong compliance model with effective controls and monitors.
  • Serves as the highest level of technical authority for claims pricing (reserve and settlement) and decision-making.
  • Directly manages the Claims Leadership Team comprised of Claims managers at various levels.
  • Assures optimal and high-performing relationships with other WRBC entities (RSS, BTS, BSS, BMMS, MEC, AMP, other Regional Segment companies, WRBC Corporate Claims) as well as all other BMAG functional areas.
  • Identifies and manages outsourced partnerships with law firms, independent adjusting firms, and other service providers; assures SLAs are in place and met, and services are priced appropriately.
  • Monitors emerging issues in Commercial claims, sharing knowledge across the organization and devising claims responses and mitigations to new and emerging risks.
  • Participates as an active member in industry trade groups, associations, and conferences.
  • In collaboration with the President and SLT, contributes significantly to the OU's strategy, planning and execution of enterprise-wide imperatives.
  • Leads a PeopleFirst culture that attracts, develops, engages, and retains top talent.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 10 years of advanced multiline commercial claims leadership experience, preferably in the Chief Claims Officer role in a similar company or as a direct-reporting subordinate in a larger company.
  • Extensive multi-lines claims technical experience including Auto, Property, General Liability, Workers Compensation, and Umbrella claims.
  • Executive level skill and expertise in strategy, communications, and people management.
  • Executive level competency in the Berkley Innovation behaviors of Effective Collaboration, Courage, Managing Self, Resiliency, Challenging the Status Quo, Evidence-Based Decision Making, and Reflective Listening.
  • Bachelor's Degree or higher required.
  • CPCU, CCP, AIC or other professional industry certifications preferred.

Leadership Competencies

Strategic enterprise thinking: Connects actuarial evidence to long-term competitive advantage, capital deployment, and operating priorities.

Commercial and underwriting acumen: Understands how product, appetite, distribution, claims, expense, and price interact to create sustainable returns.

Quality decision making: Balances rigor and speed; distinguishes what is known, uncertain, assumed, and actionable.

Influence and communication: Creates clarity, earns trust, constructively challenges, and turns analysis into commitment and action.

Technology and AI stewardship: Recognizes high-value use cases and establishes proportionate governance, controls, and human oversight.

Talent multiplication: Builds successors, broadens capabilities, and creates an environment where diverse perspectives improve decisions.

Execution and accountability: Sets priorities, simplifies work, assigns ownership, monitors outcomes, and closes the loop.
