The Chief Customer and Revenue Officer (CCRO) is a senior executive with enterprise accountability for revenue growth, customer acquisition, retention, and market execution across Agency, Sales, and Marketing. The CCRO leads through experienced functional leaders across Agency, Sales, and Marketing, setting strategy, creating alignment, and holding leaders accountable for coordinated execution and profitable growth and is responsible for building a durable, profitable growth engine aligned with Intrepid Direct's underwriting appetite, customer promise, and strategic priorities.

This executive will work in close partnership with the President and will increasingly represent the company in high-value customer and partner relationships. The CCRO is expected to personally visit, develop, negotiate with, and help close large and strategically important customers, expanding executive-level commercial leadership capacity while maintaining close alignment with the President on material opportunities.

As a key member of the senior leadership team, the CCRO will help shape enterprise strategy, identify future verticals and partnerships, and translate market opportunities into disciplined execution, sustained revenue growth, strong retention, and profitable portfolio performance.

Key functions include but are not limited to:

Enterprise Revenue Ownership & Go-to-Market Strategy

  • Own enterprise revenue strategy and results across Agency, Sales, and Marketing, including new business production, customer retention, revenue quality, and profitable growth.

  • Represent Intrepid Direct at customer meetings, industry events, conferences, and other external forums.
  • Travel approximately 20% based on business needs, primarily for strategic customer, partner, and market-development activity.

Agency & Client Success Leadership

  • Provide executive oversight of the Agency and client success organization through its functional leader, ensuring the function is aligned with Intrepid Direct's revenue strategy, retention priorities, service standards, and customer experience expectations.
  • Partner with the Agency leader to establish service standards, operating disciplines, governance, and performance measures that deliver a responsive, consultative, and best-in-class customer experience.
  • Ensure the Agency is positioned as a strategic revenue and retention function, not solely a service operation.
  • Align Agency, Sales, Marketing, Underwriting, Claims, and Operations around customer needs, franchise requirements, service trends, renewal strategy, and profitability drivers.
  • Sponsor scalable process improvements and talent capability planning within Agency that support growth without sacrificing service quality or customer intimacy.

Sales Leadership

  • Serve as the primary executive leader for the sales strategy and operating model, including prospect data acquisition, territory and vertical planning, pipeline discipline, forecasting, production expectations, strategic account development, and executive-level deal support.
  • Provide executive oversight of the sales organization and hold leaders and team members accountable for production, pipeline quality, conversion, strategic account development, and growth results.
  • Maintain active involvement in high-value opportunities, complex deals, and material account negotiations.
  • Build a disciplined sales culture focused on preparation, customer insight, consultative selling, accountability, and profitable growth.

Marketing & Brand Leadership

  • Provide executive oversight of Marketing, empowering the Marketing leader to execute brand, campaign, content, event, and demand-generation strategies while holding the function accountable for measurable commercial outcomes.
  • Set enterprise commercial direction for positioning, customer acquisition priorities, market experiments, and growth campaigns, in partnership with the Marketing leader.
  • Ensure consistent and differentiated expression of the Intrepid Direct brand and value proposition across every customer touchpoint.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and analytics to evaluate marketing effectiveness and improve return on investment.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate closely with the President and with underwriting, claims, operations, technology/data, actuarial, and finance leaders to align customer, risk, process, and enablement priorities.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve revenue growth, retention, operating efficiency, customer experience, and market responsiveness.
  • Create clear governance, decision rights, and handoffs across revenue-generating and customer-serving functions.
  • Establish a consistent revenue operating cadence that provides the President and senior leadership team with transparent visibility into pipeline, retention, revenue quality, marketing effectiveness, customer opportunities, market conditions, and cross-functional execution risks.

Team Leadership & Organizational Capability

  • Lead a high-performing team of functional leaders across Agency, Sales, and Marketing, creating shared priorities, clear accountabilities, and coordinated execution across the revenue organization.
  • Evaluate and evolve the organizational structure, leadership roles, capabilities, and talent required to support Intrepid Direct's growth strategy.
  • Set measurable goals, KPIs, performance standards, and accountability mechanisms across all revenue functions.
  • Coach and develop functional leaders, ensuring they have the clarity, resources, decision rights, accountability, succession plans, and talent pipelines needed to lead effectively and support continued growth.
  • Develop a strong working knowledge of the CRM and related revenue technology to improve visibility, execution, and coordination across departments

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, risk management, insurance, or a related field required.
  • Advanced degree preferred.
  • Relevant insurance or industry designations preferred
  • 15+ years of progressively responsible leadership experience in commercial insurance, including significant experience in sales, distribution, agency operations, underwriting, marketing, or customer strategy; 20+ years preferred.
  • Demonstrated success owning a broad revenue agenda and delivering sustained, profitable growth across multiple customer-facing functions.
  • Experience leading through experienced functional managers, integrating Agency, Sales, and Marketing into a coordinated commercial organization, and creating accountability while enabling leaders to execute within their areas of expertise.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop executive relationships, visit and advise large customers, lead complex negotiations, and close strategic accounts or partnerships.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial property and casualty products, underwriting dynamics, direct and intermediary distribution models, customer lifecycle management, and service operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into execution, establish accountability, use data to support decisions, and build scalable processes.
  • Executive presence, sound judgment, high personal accountability, and the ability to serve as a trusted partner to the President and senior leadership team.
  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 20% based on business needs.

Responsibilities

At Berkley Technology Services, we believe AI-assisted ways of working are becoming a foundational part of how excellent engineering work gets done - much like the way digital communication tools did a generation ago. We expect every member of our team to actively integrate AI tools into their daily work, not as a substitute for expertise, but as a natural extension of it. Candidates who bring genuine curiosity about AI, and a demonstrated habit of using it to work smarter, will find themselves at home here.

The IAM Automation Engineer designs, develops, and supports automation solutions that improve Identity and Access Management (IAM) operations, governance, compliance, and the security of both human and non-human identities. This role focuses on automating identity lifecycle processes, integrating IAM platforms with enterprise systems, and establishing governance for non-human identities such as service accounts, service principals, managed identities, APIs, bots, and machine credentials. The position also enables secure AI-assisted capabilities that increase operational efficiency while maintaining strong security controls, regulatory compliance, and audit readiness.

• Design and automate IAM processes including onboarding, offboarding, access requests, provisioning, deprovisioning, access reviews, and privileged access management.
• Implement automated Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) workflows to streamline identity lifecycle management and access provisioning.

• Support the governance, lifecycle management, and security of non-human identities (NHIs), including service accounts, service principals, managed identities, APIs, bots, and machine credentials; establish ownership, automate provisioning and deprovisioning, monitor credential health, and ensure compliance with organizational security policies.

• Develop and implement Joiner, Mover, Leaver (JML) processes and workflows.
• Develop integrations between Microsoft Entra ID, HR systems, ITSM platforms, and business applications.
• Oversee the development of automated IAM governance across both on-premises and cloud environments and implement solutions across workforce IAM, PAM, and customer IAM ecosystems.
• Identify and implement AI-assisted use cases such as ticket summarization, access review support, audit evidence collection, and process documentation.
• Establish governance processes for AI agents, service principals, managed identities, and other non-human identities.
• Create dashboards, metrics, runbooks, and documentation to improve operational visibility and efficiency.
• Support compliance initiatives, audits, and continuous process improvement efforts.

Required Qualifications

• 8+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management, cybersecurity, cloud identity, or security automation.
• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID and identity lifecycle management processes.
• Hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ, Identity Security Cloud (ISC), or comparable Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platforms.
• Experience designing and supporting identity lifecycle management, access certifications, role management, and automated provisioning workflows using SailPoint.

• Demonstrated comfort using AI-assisted tools in a professional context; approaches AI as a standard part of modern workflow rather than a specialized or optional capability

• Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, JSON, and Microsoft Graph API.
• Experience with IAM, IGA, and PAM platforms such as SailPoint IdentityIQ/Identity Security Cloud (ISC), Saviynt, Okta/Auth0, CyberArk, or BeyondTrust.

• Experience managing and governing non-human identities (NHIs), including service accounts, service principals, managed identities, bots, API accounts, secrets, certificates, and machine credentials across cloud and on-premises environment.

Responsibilities

The Cloud Security & Automation Engineer is a hands-on engineering role responsible for improving security across public cloud, hybrid, container, and cloud-native environments. The role owns the day-to-day engineering and operation of cloud exposure management capabilities, including platforms such as Wiz or Prisma Cloud, and converts prioritized risk into durable technical controls, automated workflows, and measurable remediation outcomes. The engineer will work closely with Vulnerability Management and AI Security Teams.

Cloud exposure management and platform ownership Configure, administer, optimize, and troubleshoot cloud security and exposure management platforms such as Wiz or Prisma Cloud. Manage cloud account and subscription onboarding, connectors, permissions, policies, rules, integrations, dashboards, and platform health across Azure, AWS, and other in-scope cloud services.

CTEM operations and risk prioritization Support the continuous threat exposure management lifecycle by identifying and validating cloud exposures, analyzing attack paths and toxic combinations, prioritizing material risk, coordinating remediation with accountable teams, validating closure, and tracking exceptions. Translate platform findings into a focused, risk-based backlog rather than a high-volume queue of uncontextualized alerts.

Security automation and engineering Design and build reusable automation for cloud security operations using Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, JSON/YAML, workflow orchestration, serverless services, and Infrastructure as Code. Automate asset onboarding, policy deployment, enrichment, ticket routing, evidence collection, remediation validation, reporting, and other repeatable engineering tasks.

Cloud security architecture and guardrails Define and implement cloud security requirements, reference patterns, preventive guardrails, and detective controls for identity, network, workload, container, Kubernetes, data, secrets, logging, and configuration security. Contribute security requirements to cloud landing zones and platform engineering standards.

Cross-functional remediation and enablement Partner with Cloud, DevOps, Vulnerability Management, IAM, infrastructure, and application teams to assign ownership, develop practical remediation patterns, integrate controls into delivery workflows, and improve adoption of secure cloud practices.

AI security partnership Provide cloud security engineering for AI platforms and services, including secure architecture reviews, identity and non-human identity controls, secrets management, data-flow protection, logging and monitoring, exposure analysis, and automation. Help translate emerging AI security requirements into repeatable cloud controls and engineering patterns.

Metrics, governance, and continuous improvement Develop dashboards and operating metrics for cloud coverage, critical exposures, attack paths, remediation aging, exceptions, automation effectiveness, and control adoption. Use metrics to identify systemic issues and recommend improvements to architecture, tooling, and operating processes.

Incident support and technical escalation Provide cloud security expertise during investigations and incidents, including exposure validation, cloud configuration analysis, identity and access review, log analysis, containment support, and corrective-action engineering. Participate in senior escalation or Person in Charge coverage when assigned.

Standards, documentation, and knowledge sharing Create and maintain technical standards, standard operating procedures, runbooks, architecture diagrams, operational playbooks, and control documentation. Share knowledge through design reviews, demonstrations, and hands-on coaching.

Technical leadership and recruiting Lead technical workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs and automation, and contribute to resume reviews, technical interviews, and practical assessments for cloud security engineering roles.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering or related discipline
  • 5 or more years of experience in cloud security engineering, security engineering, DevSecOps, cloud platform engineering, or a related technical security role.
  • Hands-on experience securing and operating production environments in Microsoft Azure and/or Amazon Web Services; multi-cloud experience is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with a CNAPP, CSPM, or cloud exposure management platform such as Wiz or Prisma Cloud, including policy configuration, findings analysis, integrations, reporting, and remediation workflows.
  • Demonstrated comfort using AI-assisted tools in a professional context; approaches AI as a standard part of modern workflow rather than a specialized or optional capability
  • Demonstrated experience prioritizing cloud risk using business context, exploitability, attack paths, asset criticality, identity exposure, network exposure, and data sensitivity.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python and/or PowerShell, REST APIs, JSON/YAML, source control, and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code and policy-as-code technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, CloudFormation, Open Policy Agent, or equivalent controls.
  • Solid understanding of cloud identity and access management, non-human identities, least privilege, network security, workload and container security, secrets management, encryption, logging, monitoring, and incident response.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues, communicate risk clearly, and drive remediation across teams without relying solely on direct authority.
  • Ability to produce clear technical documentation, operating metrics, and leadership-ready status or risk updates.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing or operating a formal CTEM program or exposure management operating model.
  • Experience integrating cloud security platforms with ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Jira, SIEM/SOAR platforms, messaging platforms, data pipelines, or reporting tools.
  • Experience securing Kubernetes, containers, serverless services, CI/CD pipelines, software supply chains, and cloud-native application architectures.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML security, including AI service architecture, model and data access, agent or workload identities, prompt and data-flow risks, AI security posture management, and governance of AI-enabled services.
  • Working knowledge of cloud and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, CIS Benchmarks, CSA CCM, MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP, and relevant regulatory or audit requirements.
  • Relevant certifications such as CCSP, CISSP, CCSK, Microsoft Azure Security Engineer, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, or vendor platform certifications.
  • Ability to sit at a desk and work on a computer for extended periods of time.
  • Must occasionally lift and/or move up to ten pounds.
  • Vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

Lead AIG's Multinational insurance business across the U.S. Northeast Zone, managing a team of client executives and coordinators. Full job description

Join us as the Multinational Zonal Lead – Northeast Zone to take on key responsibilities within a world-class Multinational function.


Make your mark in Multinational

AIG's Multinational business is an exciting area that provides multinational insurance solutions for our global customers, empowering them to navigate their cross-border risks with confidence and consistency. AIG Multinational professionals have the diverse skills and expertise necessary to deliver customized, compliant and seamless solutions that support our clients' risk management objectives. You can work alongside a dynamic, multi-disciplinary team to explore new opportunities for customers.


How you will create an impact


The Multinational Zonal Leader is responsible for the overall management and performance of the U.S. Northeast Zone multinational portfolio. This role reports directly to the Head of Multinational – North America. Responsibilities include:

  • Manage a team of Multinational Client Executives and Multinational Client Coordinators in alignment with AIG's Global Multinational Business Model, to deliver superior Multinational client service and stakeholder experience.
  • Engage and partner with internal and external stakeholders to promote AIG Multinational's segmented value proposition to assigned Multinational segment, aligned with the Multinational end to end process and business model, product strategies and appetite, and the client's needs.
  • Ensure the team effectively manages the design, development and execution of targeted multinational programs (including captive fronting), delivering within target service delivery standards and in alignment with AIG U.S. growth strategies.
  • Support the Head of Multinational – North America, to expand AIG Multinational's presence across the U.S market by optimizing alignment, integration, adoption and execution of AIG's global multinational strategies, business plans, operating model and segmented value proposition(s).
  • Represent AIG as the central point of Multinational client and program management across the Northeast Zone.
  • Manage assigned portfolio of Tier 1 and Tier 2 Multinational clients working in partnership with product and distribution to deliver service excellence.
  • Lead all pre and post bind activities on assigned portfolio and embed core principles of end to end process.
  • Ensure that all service level standards and performance metrics are met on assigned portfolio and improve multinational client experience as measured by client and broker survey results.
  • Ensure Multinational service fee discipline and rate adequacy for assigned portfolio of accounts.
  • Drive the execution of the Multinational strategy within the zone and establish and execute a regular business cadence with key zonal stakeholders in product and distribution.
  • Represent Multinational and actively participate in regularly scheduled zonal management meetings to ensure alignment with zonal strategies.
  • Develop multinational zonal business plan to improve management fundamentals, ensure alignment to goals and execution on strategy.
  • Align with zonal product heads and distribution to support profitable growth strategies.
  • Foster an environment where employees can grow and maximise their talent including appropriate training, career development, and succession planning.
  • Adhere to Multinational audit and controls procedures and global fronting underwriting guidelines.
  • Support broader zonal Multinational growth strategies, business development and thought leadership as appropriate.
  • Provide Multinational subject matter expertise (SME) and training throughout the zone including the management of the Broker Academy training.
  • Help identify, support and contribute to internal and external strategies that align our product offerings and grow AIG multinational business.
  • Represent AIG at external industry events held in the zone.

What you'll need to succeed

  • Client focused with significant experience of dealing with senior client personnel, risk managers and client board level representatives as well as senior colleagues, including Executive Leadership.
  • Effective Team and People Manager, able to attract, engage, retain and develop a high performing team to meet current and future business needs with the ability to clearly articulate and execute plans.
  • Ability to handle multiple priorities, organize work and meet tight deadlines and service standards.
  • Ability to identify operational improvements and gain technical knowledge and experience to carry out those improvements.
  • Must demonstrate a high level of proficiency in the following skills:
    • Analytical
    • Customer service
    • Interpersonal
    • Communication and PC skills
    • Broker relationship management
    • Negotiation
    • People Management


Technical Skills/ Experience

  • Strong technical knowledge of multinational programs with an intimate knowledge of territorial issues and the systems and processes that support multinational business.
  • Experience / extensive knowledge in multiple lines of business - Commercial & Consumer
  • Captive Reinsurance/ Global Fronting experience beneficial – ideally candidates have sufficient experience or potential to secure Global Fronting underwriting (captive insurance programs) authority
  • Experience communicating directly with external parties, including large and/or multinational corporations
  • 10 years + of insurance experience in a client & broker facing role (broker or company background)
  • Knowledge of non-conventional insurance programs
  • IT packages: MS Outlook, Excel and Word.
  • Professional Insurance qualifications such as ACII, ARe, CPCU, ARM or equivalent qualifications are desirable

About this job

Senior Multinational Client Executive role managing a portfolio of Tier 1 multinational insurance programs. Responsibilities include overseeing service delivery, ensuring regulatory compliance, managing global fronting authority, and partnering with underwriters and brokers on complex captive fronting and indemnity programs.

Good fit if you have experience managing multinational insurance programs, understand global fronting and captive structures, and can coordinate across underwriting, compliance, and client stakeholders.

Full job description

At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as a Senior Multinational Client Executive to play your part in that transformation. It's an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.


Multinational

AIG's Multinational business is an exciting area within General Insurance that will challenge you every day to explore new opportunities for our clients worldwide. As a trusted advisor, you will tailor multinational insurance solutions for our global clients, empowering them to operate across borders with confidence and consistency. Partner with a dynamic, global team of experts, including underwriters, risk engineers, and analytics and claims professionals, to design, implement and service multinational insurance programs. This includes issuing timely policies, providing regulatory advice, sharing local knowledge, supporting efficient money movement capabilities and deploying large fronted limits. AIG Multinational professionals have the diverse skills and expertise necessary to deliver customized, compliant and seamless solutions that support our clients' risk management objectives. With in-depth knowledge of local markets, practices and regulations, Multinational provides world-class insurance solutions and helps clients successfully navigate their cross-border risks, wherever in the world their businesses take them.


Role Summary

This opportunity is an external broker and client facing role that manages an assigned portfolio of Tier 1 Multinational programs working in partnership with product underwriters and distribution. Subject matter expert in the structure, design and execution of complex Multinational captive fronting and indemnity programs. This role has global fronting authority and supports all major Multinational lines of business.


How you will create an impact


  • Manage and oversee all aspects of the multinational service delivery for the assigned portfolio and be accountable for the multinational client experience. This would include:
    • The proactive management and oversight of all multinational service activities, coordinating communication and project management across all internal and external stakeholders throughout the program lifecycle.
    • Provide direction and guidance to all relevant stakeholders across Multinational Business Model and AIG Network to ensure appropriate design and effective delivery and service of assigned multinational programs.
    • Provide multinational technical expertise to underwriters to ensure a compliant program structure and design, and adherence to all local regulatory requirements.
    • Lead the promotion and adoption of the AIG Multinational End-to-End process, so that all parties understand and commit to roles, responsibilities and expected timelines, to provide an elevated service performance and deliver contract certainty.
    • Ensure Multinational service fee discipline by utilizing available tools.
    • Lead and manage the day-to-day service delivery across all assigned programs to ensure the timely issuance of accurate local policy and invoice documentation and meet agreed program Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
    • Partner with Product Underwriters to manage the approval of facultative reinsurance panel participants and the collection of compliant reinsurance documentation for all assigned programs.
    • Engage with multinational claims to ensure timely development of multinational claims bulletins / protocols and support on ad hoc program enquiries.
    • Partner with underwriting to draft legal documentation for loss sensitive programs and obtain approval from AIG legal counsel.
    • Monitor performance and escalate where necessary to ensure all agreed Multinational service SLAs are being met.
    • Operate as the senior external service contact and – working in collaboration with Product Underwriters and Distribution - provide regular updates to the appointed broker (or client if direct) on program performance until fully implemented.
    • Manage and partner with Distribution to coordinate periodic client/program stewardship meetings to be conducted in alignment and collaboration with underwriting and distribution.
  • Manage and be accountable for all compliance elements of assigned portfolio of global fronting programs as documented within the Multinational Global Fronting Underwriting guidelines and per the dual signature model. This would include:
    • Accurate and timely submission of credit application and all associated program information required to complete credit analysis and obtain approval.
    • Engagement with underwriting and AIG legal to ensure compliant reinsurance documentation is in-force, fully executed and held on file.
    • Completion of Risk Transfer Validations (RTVs) and binding status in Credit Risk Database (CRDB).
    • Work in partnership with credit and collateral management group to ensure the timely collection of all required security and collateral per agreed credit terms.
    • Accountable for the coordination and completion of all High Limit Referrals and continuing engagement with MN Chief Underwriting Office (CUO) if clarifications required for granting of approval.
    • Engagement with AIG's reinsurance division/stakeholders to ensure monitoring of losses and the collection of any additional security or collateral as required by credit and per the terms of the in-force captive reinsurance agreement.
    • Monitoring of exposure on assigned portfolio to ensure the proactive engagement with relevant stakeholders and the collection of compliant security to mitigate year-end statutory penalties, per MN CUO guidelines.
    • Manage and oversee cash-flow to captives, working with collections and reinsurance division to ensure agreed SLAs are being met.
    • Completion of Peer Reviews for assigned portfolio.

  • General:
    • Drive the profitable growth of the Multinational global fronting portfolio by working with product and distribution to identify target opportunities and articulate AIG's value proposition in the market.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Claims Adjuster - Casualty Coverage and Mass Tort
Job.JobDescription:
At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as a Casualty Coverage and Mass Tort Senior Claims Adjuster to play your part in that transformation. You'll work with some of the best claims and underwriting minds in the industry addressing challenging claims and sophisticated coverage issues, and helping our businesses develop products to address the rapidly evolving risk environment. Grow your career at the forefront of Casualty insurance.


In Casualty Coverage and Mass Tort Claims, we strive to live AIG's corporate values: Take Ownership, Set the Standard, Win Together, Be an Ally, Do What's Right. At AIG, we are committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other's talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through our flexible work arrangements, diversity and inclusion learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The diversity of our people is one of AIG's greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.


Make your mark in Casualty Claims

As an experienced professional, in this role you'll deal with sophisticated litigation and coverage issues, including long-tail bodily injury and property damage exposures, claims arising under Coverage B of Primary/Excess CGL policies, construction defect, as well as environmental and toxic tort claims. You'll handle emerging risks; this team has been at the forefront of managing exposures from PFAS, opioids, and other cutting-edge issues. You'll also be a coverage resource for Casualty adjusters, managers and underwriters. You'll be supported by a management team that's deeply invested in achieving the right outcomes for claims and that's also invested in your success:


How you will create an impact

  • Evaluate coverage on sophisticated insurance products
  • Hire and manage counsel to help evaluate coverage and to defend our insureds.
  • Assess damages with support of outside experts
  • Evaluate financial impact to AIG and to our insureds
  • Formulate and execute strategies for favorable claim resolution; negotiate with insureds and third parties.
  • Advise business partners concerning exposures and concerning potential product changes and enhancements.
  • Advise claims and business leaders on emerging risks.

What you'll need to succeed

  • 4+ years of Legal, Insurance, Construction Defect or Environmental experience preferred.
  • The ability to handle complex claims involving diverse coverage issues related to GL and Environmental policies.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills, along with excellent communication, negotiation and investigation skills.
  • Veterans encouraged to apply.

Ready to take your career to the next level? We would love to hear from you.

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Jeffersonville, IN
  • Education: High school diploma or GED

About this job

Warranty Claims Examiner role at AIG Warranty involves processing claims from service providers for major appliances, electronics, and home systems. You will review repair authorizations, verify coverage under contract terms, adjudicate charges, and maintain relationships with clients and service partners.

Good fit if you have customer service experience, strong communication skills, analytical ability, and prefer working in an office-based environment in Jeffersonville, Indiana.

Full job description

At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as a Warranty Claims Examiner play your part in that transformation. It's an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.


Make your mark in Warranty


AIG Warranty delivers a full range of service solutions including warranty management administration, extended service contracts and mobile insurance theft/loss programs, customer service support, service network management, claims processing services, and service contract underwriting.


How you will create an impact


Our Claims Analysts work directly with Service Partners and our Customers to ensure that the project moves forward with the support they need. Claims Analysts are responsible for receiving incoming calls and emails from Service Providers needing authorization or payment for repairs on major appliances, consumer electronics, heating and air, or other home systems. They also ensure pricing, quotes, and invoices submitted are in line with pre-defined costs. The Claims Analysts verify that failure and repairs are covered under the terms and conditions prior to authorizing or paying the Service Providers assigned to the project. Claims Analysts are the ones our clients turn to in times of need. They act with speed, composure, compassion, and knowledge to solve problems, and the work they do every day is the heart of our business. As a Claims Analyst you will:

  • Answer incoming phone calls and emails from service providers seeking repair authorizations or payment on work performed.
  • Adjudicate claims for fair and reasonable repair charges.
  • Purchase small appliances, plumbing products, and HVAC equipment if necessary to fulfill contract requirements.
  • Evaluate terms and conditions, program agreements, and repair times matrix to ensure accurate and efficient payment of claims.
  • Research claims to determine what coverage options were purchased; make denial/approval of claims per the terms and conditions.
  • Maintain knowledge of covered equipment and applicable programs.
  • Reconcile monthly statements.
  • Handle research assignments and reporting as delegated by management.
  • Maintain excellent working relationships with clients, colleagues, service providers, and third parties.
  • Serves as a Subject Matter Expert between internal teams, answering questions and relaying any identified training and process gaps to management.
  • Take responsibility for continuously improving processes and product knowledge, including but not limited to understanding of program coverage and exclusions.

What you'll need to succeed


  • A record of providing outstanding customer service
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to adapt as the need requires
  • Experience in conflict resolution, or the ability to de-escalate tense situations, and comfortable in a role that requires some negotiations.
  • Analytical skills and the ability to search the internet for answers and market data.
  • Results oriented, and able to perform in a fast-paced environment and perform a wide variety of tasks and change focus quickly as internal and external demands change.
  • Excellent organizational skills- flexible with moving from project to project while keeping track of progress and prioritizing workload to meet deadlines.
  • Professional Attitude: We are looking for someone enthusiastic, reliable, and a team player.
  • Basic Excel, Word, and Outlook skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills
  • Ability to consistently meet deadlines
  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Understanding of Warranty or Insurance products is recommended but not required
  • Prior claims experience preferred
  • Basic experience with accounts payable and statement reconciliation
  • Technical experience a plus

Ready to prove your potential? We would love to hear from you.

Job.JobTitle: Commercial Liabilty Claims Adjuster, TPA Oversight
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Dallas, TX

About this job

Analyze and process commercial liability claims, including coverage assessment, reserve management, and vendor coordination. Oversee third-party administrator compliance and work with litigation management, arbitrations, and mediations.

Good fit if you have 4+ years of property claims experience and expertise in complex claims, litigation management, and insurance contract interpretation.

Full job description

At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as a Commercial Liability Claims Adjuster, TPA Oversight to play your part in that transformation. It's an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.

Make your mark in TPA Claims

Our Claims teams are the proven problem solvers of choice for clients, delivering consistent technical excellence and showcasing our service differentiation to create an unparalleled global claims handling experience. Through a robust stakeholder feedback loop and supported by consistent processes and leadership, we take pride in delivering responsive, fair and professional service with empathy and efficiency.

How you will create an impact

  • Analyze and process first party property damage claims by investigating and gathering information to determine the exposure on the claim; ensure proactive claims handling aimed at the prompt and cost-effective resolution of claims through well-developed action plans. Determine need for and direct independent adjusters to gather information to determine exposure on the claim and control their costs.

  • Identify and evaluate coverage issues; prepare comprehensive coverage letters with supervisory review and analysis; retain and provide direction to coverage counsel when necessary.

  • Assess exposure and resolve claim within established evaluation. Maintain diaries and complete tasks within required timeframes as set forth by department guidelines; ensure claim files are timely and properly documented with clear and concise analysis on coverage, damages, reserves, and liability including an action plan for resolution. Process and pay invoices within a timely manner.

  • Coordinate vendor referrals for additional investigation and/or litigation management. Calculate and assign timely and appropriate reserves; monitor reserve accuracy throughout the life of the claim.

  • Refer case as appropriate to supervisor and management. Respond to requests or directions in a professional and timely manner.

  • Attend arbitrations, mediations, settlement conference and trials.

  • Successfully complete required State licensing examinations and continuing education requirement.

  • Communicate with all internal business partners including underwriters to make sure underwriting is aware of large losses and industry trends.

  • Partner with TPA Governance and Relationship Management to help TPAs and Insureds comply with claim handling and reporting guidelines.

  • Work with TPA Claims Financial to check the accuracy of TPA financials ensuring alignment with TTPO financials.

What you'll need to succeed

  • 4 plus years of Property claims experience.

  • Experience with complex and high exposure Property damage and Business Interruption claims

  • Excellent communication skills (verbal/written) and strong negotiation skills

  • Advanced experience and capabilities in litigation claims management, including ADR and mediation processes, involving auto/GL exposures.

  • Strong technical expertise interpreting insurance contracts.

  • In depth knowledge of claim handling procedures, claims performance strategies, and claim best practices.

  • Advanced analytical and problem solving skills.

  • Should also have a demonstrated ability to initiate and champion change initiatives that leverage technology and improve skills in benchmarking.

  • Creativity in resolving challenging business problems, as well as ability to achieve business goals and objectives is essential.

Ready to accelerate your career? We would love to hear from you.

Compensation for this position includes base salary and eligibility for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan. In addition, we're proud to offer a range of competitive benefits, a summary of which can be viewed here: 2026 Benefits Overview

The Workers' Compensation Medical Only Claims Specialist manages non-complex and non-problematic, medical only claims under close supervision, supporting the goals of the Claims Department and of CorVel.

CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in the Northern New Jersey area.

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families. Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others. This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

      • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
      • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
      • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
      • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Training & Development Specialist, Human Resources & Training
Job.JobDescription:
The Nurse Trainer is responsible for developing, assessing, administering, and revising training material for all positions in a clinical setting. This role reviews all existing training material, identifies areas in which it is lacking, and creates new supplemental material and training content to complement existing material. The goal of this process is to ensure that the triage program has adequate substance to determine whether existing nurses are adequately meeting job requirements and to equip all potential new nurses with the information and experience necessary to fulfill their new roles.

Strong verbal and written communication skills are important in this position, as these trainers not only create and edit written training material, but also interface with existing nurses at all levels to ascertain their training. As such, strong memory skills, close attention to detail, and high adaptability are all beneficial for the position.

This is a remote position.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop Training curriculum with full agenda
  • Coordinate training for all nurses and stakeholders, ensuring appropriate training assignments are assigned and the scoring is provided to the supervisor
  • Monitor for QA trends regarding new hires to improve training material
  • Participate in monthly QA calibrations
  • Communicate with new hires weekly up until orientation start date – to ensure nurse has internet set up and getting applications submitted
  • Train users on equipment, software and/or technology
  • Maintain a document of important things to remember when documenting/working with medical records
  • Follow up with newly hired nurses after 90 days to review the training and answer any questions
  • Develop Lessonly content and track nurses' progress
  • Identify and find solutions for performance issues both technically and in user behavior
  • Work with existing nurses that are struggling and need remedial training and communicate progress with the supervisor/manager
  • Provide summary updates to each supervisor following individual nurse assistance
  • Attend monthly staff meeting to stay apprised of updates/issues/team conversations
  • Occasionally answer calls when asked by supervisor due to additional help being needed to clear out the customer service queue
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Strong knowledge and experience in quality assurance and training programs
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to skillfully manage multiple, complex projects and competing priorities, while meeting deadlines and maintaining strong customer service
  • Effective quantitative and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment while functioning as an educator rather than an auditor
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, and Excel

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • BSN, unencumbered RN license required
  • 2+ years of training experience

CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in Dallas, TX.

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families. Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others. This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker's injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment

  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful

Job Summary

WORKPLACE: REMOTE

The Learning Experience Designer is responsible for designing, developing, and measuring learning and performance solutions that build capabilities, improve learner outcomes, and drive meaningful business results across University of Farmers.

This role owns learning solutions end to end — from needs analysis and consultation through design, development, launch, and evaluation. You will partner closely with business leaders, line-of-business representatives, trainers, and subject matter experts to understand business challenges and translate them into effective learning experiences.

Solutions may include instructor-led training, virtual learning, e-learning, video, interactive digital experiences, job aids, performance support, coaching materials, and content delivered through learning platforms and technologies.

The ideal candidate combines strong instructional design expertise with consulting skills, creativity, visual and digital design capabilities, and a strong understanding of how learning can influence business performance.

Essential Job Functions

  • Conduct learning and performance needs analyses for new and existing programs, identifying capability gaps and opportunities for improvement
  • Design and develop end-to-end learning solutions aligned with business objectives and learner needs
  • Develop training curricula, certificate programs, instructor-led materials, virtual learning, e-learning, job aids, coaching resources, and performance support tools
  • Apply adult learning principles, instructional design methodologies, and innovative learning techniques to create engaging and effective learning experiences
  • Create storyboards, learning journeys, course materials, interactive experiences, and digital learning content
  • Use tools such as Articulate 360, Rise, Storyline, Adobe Creative Cloud, video editing platforms, and AI-powered video tools to develop learning experiences
  • Recommend the most appropriate learning format, technology, and delivery approach based on the audience, business need, and desired outcome
  • Research emerging learning technologies, instructional design practices, and industry trends to continuously improve learning solutions
  • Partner with business leaders, school leads, subject matter experts, trainers, and other stakeholders to understand business challenges and design effective solutions
  • Lead consultations and business meetings to identify learning opportunities and recommend solutions that support business objectives
  • Analyze learner outcomes and business results to identify opportunities for improvement and recommend modifications to learning solutions
  • Support trainers and facilitators with learning materials, measurement approaches, facilitation resources, and evaluation activities
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of complex learning solutions and use findings to improve future programs
  • Establish measurement approaches to track learner success, learning effectiveness, and business results generated by learning initiatives
  • Collaborate with learning, performance, technology, and business teams to ensure solutions are scalable, sustainable, and aligned with organizational priorities
  • Develop recommendations based on data, learner feedback, business performance, and evaluation findings
  • Stay current with trends in instructional design, learning technology, adult learning, digital learning, and emerging AI capabilities
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of learning design standards, processes, tools, and best practices

Experience Requirements

  • Years of professional experience, with at least 3 years in instructional design, learning experience design, educational content development, or a related field
  • Bachelor's degree in Education, Instructional Design, Design, Technology, Communication, or a related field preferred
  • Fluent English, with the ability to communicate effectively with international stakeholders
  • Demonstrated experience designing scalable learning solutions across classroom, virtual, and online environments
  • Strong knowledge of instructional design methodologies and adult learning principles
  • Experience conducting needs analysis and translating business requirements into learning solutions
  • Experience with storyboarding, course development, visual design, and learning content production
  • Experience with Articulate 360, particularly Rise and Storyline
  • Familiarity with LMS/LXP platforms and digital learning technologies
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud or similar visual design tools
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining quality and deadlines
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to evaluate learning effectiveness and connect learning outcomes to business results
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative, and continuously evolving environment

Additional Qualification

Ability to work on multiple projects at the same time with coinciding deadlines. Strong interpersonal, communications, presentation, and problem-solving skills. Ability to use the suite of Microsoft Office products including Word, PowerPoint.

A Day in the Life of a Field Property Adjuster:

  • Conduct both virtual and on-site investigations by visiting policyholders' residences to assess propertydamage, determine liability, evaluate the extent of loss, and negotiate fair settlements.
  • Use claims handling software, a company car, and a laptop to determine claims-related damage and write estimates in a paperless environment.
  • Evaluate and report on potential subrogation opportunities.
  • Reports incidents involving theft, fraud, or arson to appropriate state and industry agencies.
  • Perform duties independently, with work directly impacting management outcomes.
  • Acts as a company representative in public interactions, maintaining a professional demeanor consistentwith management standards.
  • Engages regularly with a variety of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses,contractors, law enforcement, fraud and arson investigators, attorneys, medical professionals, and otherrelevant parties.
  • Use strong customer service skills to negotiate with policyholders to settle the claim.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomicstandards as outlined in relevant company published manuals.

Employees assigned to the Catastrophe team will be required to travel away from their residence for a specified period of time, usually consisting of 23 days.

  • Although this is not a CAT-specific role, hires will be expected to commit to 1–3 CAT deployments per year.

  • High School diploma or equivalent required.
  • Prior general work experience with demonstrated customer service and time management skills is preferred.
  • Strong written/verbal communication, critical thinking and negotiation skills.
  • Must have the ability to work in a fast paced environment while multi-tasking.
  • Proficiency with smartphones and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Eagerness to learn about insurance policies and property damage from the inside out to identify how coverage applies to a particular loss.
  • Outgoing personality that would enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses, and fraud investigators.
  • Valid driver's license and Bondable.
  • Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position may include a company vehicle.

Candidates Must be Willing & Able to:

  • Climb Ladders to inspect roofs, and be comfortable working on rooftops, multiple times per day,
  • Work in small, confined spaces that have been damaged; such as attics and crawlspaces.
  • Achieve a minimum passing score on all claims training exams; where applicable.

Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

As a Product Engineer you will design, build, and support high quality digital products using modern engineering practices and tools. In this role, you will partner closely with product managers and fellow engineers to deliver scalable, cloud native, user-centered solutions. You will be accountable for the success of your digital product(s), from design and implementation through production support and performance management against pre-defined key metrics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and enhance full stack software products

  • Design and implement testing strategies to validate acceptance criteria

  • Practice pair programming and test-driven development (TDD) as part of daily engineering work

  • Establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines, supporting continuous integration, delivery, and deployment

  • Collaborate with the team on system and application design, selecting the simplest and most effective technical solutions

  • Participate in iteration planning, ensuring a shared understanding of backlog stories and technical requirements

  • Actively engage in daily standups, cross-site collaboration, and product team ceremonies

  • Contribute to and participate in retrospectives, identifying actionable improvements for the team and product

  • Provide production support for software products

  • Share knowledge and contribute to the growth of team and organizational engineering practices

  • Collaborate with other digital product teams and clearly communicate technical designs

Experience

  • 3 + years experience in the below technologies

Core Technologies & Frameworks

  • Strong proficiency in Java 17+ and Spring Boot 3.x+

  • [Required for full stack] Experience in frontend engineering ReactJS/AngularJS/Typescript

  • [Required for full stack] Strong state management experience (Redux Toolkit or equivalent)

  • [Required for full stack] Experience building responsive, accessible, data-driven User Experiences [ Required for full stack]

  • [Preferred] Working knowledge of Python

  • [Preferred] Understanding of JVM and Application Performance Architecture/Management

Architecture & System Design

  • Strong understanding of REST APIs and distributed systems

  • Experience building microservices and event-driven systems (Kafka preferred)

  • [Preferred] Understanding of cloud and hybrid environment(s), including Azure, AWS, and various on-premises systems

Data Management

  • Experience with relational/NoSQL databases

  • Familiarity with schema standards (OpenAPI/JSON/AVSC)

  • [Preferred] Understanding of MongoDB Performance Tuning

DevOps & Infrastructure

  • CI/CD experience (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), Docker, Kubernetes

  • Leverage Datadog or similar tools for application monitoring and troubleshooting

Development Practices

  • Practice Test-Driven Development (TDD)

  • Strong understanding of secure development

  • Comfortable working in a pair-programming (XP) environment

  • [Preferred] Understanding and ability to leverage, and or build, generative and agentic AI tooling to build solutions

#LI-JK1

Skills

AngularJS, Communication, Docker (Software), Java (Programming Language), Java Spring, Kubernetes, Microservices Architecture, Python (Programming Language), React.js, RESTful APIs, Software Development, Spring Boot

Compensation offered for this role is 70,100.00 - 121,475.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Job.JobTitle: Databases & Data Stores Service (Lead) Consultant- Exposure Intelligence
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Technology / Insurtech, Customer Service / Account Support
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Chicago, IL

About this job

Lead Consultant role in Allstate's cybersecurity Exposure Management function, focusing on identifying and prioritizing security vulnerabilities across databases and data storage systems including RDBMS, NoSQL, and object storage. Position requires translating data access risks into business impact and partnering with data platform teams on remediation.

Good fit if you have 3+ years in data platform security or exposure management and understand data access models and common misconfiguration patterns.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Service (Lead) Consultant- Exposure Intelligence - Databases & Data Stores (RDBMS / NoSQL / Object Storage / Permissions)

Job Profile & Family: Lead Consultant- Threat & Incident Response

Team and overall work scope

  • The team operates within a newly established Exposure Management function in the broader cybersecurity organization, focused on modernizing how the enterprise identifies, prioritizes, and mitigates security vulnerabilities shifting from traditional patch approaches to a more strategic focus on true business risk and exploitability

  • Individual Contributor/ Lead Consultant roles are designed to bring in deep respective domain expertise (network, endpoint, cloud, identity, infrastructure, Databases & Data Stores, etc.) to bridge the gap between security insights and practical remediation strategies

  • The Exposure Intelligence Analyst Databases & Data Stores is the SME responsible for identifying and prioritizing exposure risk across data platforms, including RDBMS, NoSQL systems, data warehouses, object storage, and data permissions models. This role applies CTEM principles to identify exploitable exposure conditions that lead to unauthorized access, data exfiltration, or privilege misuse, partnering with data platform and engineering teams to reduce real enterprise exposure.

Success Measures

  • Reduction in high-impact data exposure conditions (permissions and access pathways).

  • Improved visibility and prioritization of data-access-related attack paths.

  • Stronger partnership with data platform teams and fewer recurring access control failures.

Key Responsibilities (Core + Domain)

Exposure Intelligence (Core)

  • Correlate security signals into exposure narratives focused on exploitability and impact.

  • Identify attack paths that lead to data access, privilege expansion, and sensitive data exposure.

  • Provide clear prioritization and remediation guidance; track closure outcomes.

Databases & Data Stores (Domain)

  • Own SME coverage for data-layer exposure: insecure permissions, exposed storage, weak encryption posture, misconfigured access policies, risky service-to-service access.

  • Identify systemic patterns: over-broad access, stale entitlements, misconfigured storage endpoints, weak auditability.

  • Partner with data owners/platform teams to reduce exposure creation and improve prevention guardrails.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years in data platform security, cloud security, security engineering, or exposure management.

  • Understanding of data access models, permissioning, and common misconfiguration patterns.

  • Ability to translate data risk into business impact and remediation priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with object storage security, database hardening concepts, and data access governance.

  • Familiarity with cloud data services and their permission models.

  • Strong analytical skills; ability to validate exposure hypotheses with queries/logs.

Skills

Cloud Data Storage, Data Applications, Data Management Platforms, Data Storage Platforms, Exposure Management, Object Storage, Threat Monitoring

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 100,000.00 - 170,500.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Job.JobTitle: Applications & APIs Service (Lead) Consultant - Exposure Intelligence
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Team and overall work scope

  • The team operates within a newly established Exposure Management function in the broader cybersecurity organization, focused on modernizing how the enterprise identifies, prioritizes, and mitigates security vulnerabilities shifting from traditional patch approaches to a more strategic focus on true business risk and exploitability
  • Individual Contributor/ Service Lead Consultant roles are designed to bring in deep respective domain expertise (network, endpoint, cloud, identity, infrastructure, Databases & Data Stores, Applications, APIs etc.) to bridge the gap between security insights and practical remediation strategies
  • Exposure Intelligence Service Consultant Applications & APIs is the SME responsible for identifying and prioritizing exposure risk across application ecosystems, including web applications, APIs, authentication/authorization flows, and application security testing signals (SAST/DAST). The role applies CTEM principles to connect findings to real attack paths and partners with engineering teams to drive remediation that measurably reduces exploitable exposure.

The role:

  • This is a software engineering but security related role for someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems and has practical experience incorporating security into application design, development, testing, or remediation.
  • You do not need to be an Application Security specialist. The ideal candidate is an experienced software engineer who understands how applications and APIs can be exposed to security risks and is interested in helping engineering teams build more resilient solutions.
  • You will work across software engineering and cybersecurity teams to evaluate application and API risks, understand how vulnerabilities may affect the broader technology environment, and help translate security findings into practical engineering improvements.

Why This Role

This opportunity is well suited for a software engineer who wants to remain close to code and technical problem-solving while expanding their influence in application security. You will have the opportunity to improve individual applications while also helping shape broader engineering patterns that make software more secure from the start.

If you are an experienced software engineer who enjoys building dependable systems, improving existing applications, and solving security-related engineering challenges, we would like to hear from you.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means helping engineering teams resolve meaningful application and API risks without losing sight of software quality, delivery, and maintainability. Your work will contribute to:

  • Fewer exploitable application and API attack paths.
  • Faster and more effective remediation of software vulnerabilities.
  • Reduced recurrence of common coding and design weaknesses.
  • More accurate prioritization of application security findings.
  • Stronger collaboration between software engineering and cybersecurity teams.
  • Greater adoption of secure engineering practices throughout the software development lifecycle.

What Youll Do- Key Responsibilities (Core + Domain)

Exposure Intelligence (Core)

  • Translate application findings into exposure intelligence and exploitability-based prioritization.
  • Identify attack paths involving auth flaws, insecure APIs, weak session handling, and privilege boundaries.
  • Produce clear remediation guidance and partner with app owners to validate closure.

Applications & APIs (Domain)

  • Own SME coverage for web/app/API exposure including OWASP-class risks and API misuse patterns.
  • Identify systemic patterns: broken auth, insecure direct object references, injection paths, weak access controls, insecure secrets handling.
  • Partner with dev teams and AppSec stakeholders to improve secure patterns and reduce recurring exposure creation.

What You Bring- Qualifications

  • Professional experience designing, developing, testing, and supporting modern software applications.
  • Strong programming and software engineering fundamentals, including experience working with production code, APIs, service integrations, and distributed application environments.
  • Experience building or supporting web applications, backend services, APIs, microservices, or cloud-based applications.
  • Working knowledge of secure coding practices and common application or API security risks.
  • Hands-on experience addressing security findings, improving vulnerable code, participating in security reviews, or partnering with Application Security teams.
  • Ability to analyze complex technical issues and turn them into practical, maintainable engineering solutions.
  • Experience collaborating across engineering, architecture, product, operations, and cybersecurity teams.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risk and remediation options to different audiences.

Experience That Would Be Helpful

  • Familiarity with common web and API risks, including the OWASP Top 10 and API security concepts.
  • Exposure to static or dynamic application security testing tools, commonly referred to as SAST and DAST.
  • Understanding of authentication and authorization concepts, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, access controls, session management, and privilege boundaries.
  • Experience with API gateways, microservices, cloud-native applications, or modern service architectures.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability triage, threat modeling, secure software development lifecycle practices, or continuous exposure management.
  • Experience using engineering automation, testing, or deployment pipelines to identify and prevent recurring software weaknesses.

Skills

API Development, API Programming, Application Design, Application Development, Application Programming Interface (API), Application Security, Authentication, Secure Software Development, Secure Software Development Lifecycle, Software Application Development, Web Application Development

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 100,000.00 - 170,500.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Job.JobTitle: Homeowner Liability Property Adjuster -Consultant II / Senior Consultant I -Remote
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $77,500 to $105,800 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Chicago, IL
  • Experience: 3+ years

About this job

Investigate and settle homeowner liability and property damage claims for Allstate, handling moderately to occasionally complex cases involving multiple policy types. Work remotely from a home office while negotiating with attorneys and third parties.

Good fit if you have 3+ years of claims experience and strong communication skills, with ability to work independently and manage claims remotely.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Consultant II / Senior Consultant I is responsible for investigating moderately complex and occasionally complex, represented and unrepresented claims. The individual also may handle moderate and occasionally complex CPL (comprehensive personal liability) claims. The individual takes recorded statements, resolves loss of use claims, makes payments to appropriate parties, and negotiates and settles property damage to third parties. This desk handles multiple types of homeowners, condos, boat, and ATV policies as well as all perils related to third party liability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Negotiates and settles claims in accordance with business unit best practices.
  • Reviews estimates in preparation for claims settlement evaluation.
  • Coordinate the appraisal process for highly complex, disputed claims, ensuring adherence to policy provisions.
  • Determines and explains minimum coverage limits in moderately complex and occasionally complex claims involving single or multiple claimants, also determines claim value.
  • Sets initial reserve, updates reserve, documents rationale and claim summary notes.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for policyholder attorneys, leading direct negotiations to resolve disputes efficiently.
  • Draft and respond to attorney correspondence, requests for information, and demands to maintain compliance and mitigate legal exposure.
  • Researches and responds to moderately complex and occasionally complex customer communications, concerns, conflicts or issues.
  • Summarizes documents and enters into claim system notes, documenting a claim file with notes, evaluations and decision-making process.
  • Analyzes contracts such as lease agreements and condominium documents.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of claims experience.
  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.
  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.
  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.
  • The ability to handle condo claims and property liability.
  • Prior large loss claim and litigation handling.

Notes
The preceding description is not designed to be a complete list of all duties and responsibilities. May be required to perform other related duties as assigned. Regular, predictable attendance is an essential function of this job.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This job does not have supervisory duties.

Remote Home-Based Work:

This position is a permanent remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States. This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii, or Washington residents.

When you work from home full time, youll need:

  • A home office a dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.
  • Appropriate work surface and seating.

What will Allstate provide?

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, mouse).
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset some of the cost of internet.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment.
  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign-on Bonus:

  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.
  • Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Allstate Benefits:

  • Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:
  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Skills

Business Communications, Contract Management, Critical Thinking, General Liability Claims, Homeowners Claims, Information Collection, Investigative Skills, Negotiation, Policy Documentation, Property Claims, Third Party Liability, Time Management

Compensation

Compensation Range for this position is $77,500 - $105,800 per year, based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.
