Job.JobTitle: Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster - CST - Remote
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Springfield, IL

About this job

Investigate automobile accidents involving property damage and bodily injury with attorney involvement. Work remotely from home Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm CST, assessing coverage, liability, and damages while negotiating settlements.

Good fit if you have 2+ years represented bodily injury claim handling experience and reside in Central or Eastern time zones.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job:

As a Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster, your main focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and/or bodily injury with attorney/litigation involved. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair injury settlements with all parties involved.

Candidates for this role must reside in the Central or Eastern time zones. This position is not available to residents of California, Washington, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

The Customer Service Expert you will live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.

The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate casualty claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

The Effective Communicator you will use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

The Negotiator you will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

The Problem Solver you will utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

The Recorder you will protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years ' Represented 3rd party Bodily Injury claim handling experience.

  • Texas casualty claim handling experience.

  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.

  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.

  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination.

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.

  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.

Remote Home-Based Work:

Job.JobTitle: Senior Trial Attorney (Remote - Brooklyn, Queens, Manhattan, Long Island, New York)
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Join the legal frontline and champion the defense for both the insured and the Company! As a Senior Trial Attorney, you'll handle bodily injury, property damage lawsuits, and more, with mediations, arbitrations, and occasional trials. Beyond the courtroom, you'll provide vital counsel to business clients and coordinate between legal teams. Stay ahead of the game by monitoring new laws and regulations, ensuring our strategies remain sharp. Embrace the excitement of constant challenges and victories in this dynamic role!

Key Responsibilities

  • Representsinsured individuals and the Company in the defense of bodily injury and property damage lawsuits cases.

  • Prepares thoroughly for and conducts hearings, trials, arbitrations, mediations, and depositions.

  • Prepares and presents pre- and post-trial motions effectively.

  • Assistscolleagues in resolving calendar conflicts in a collaborative manner.

  • Offers counsel to business clients on day-to-day legal matters.

  • Manages projects efficiently, fostering coordination and collaboration among legal teams.

  • Keeps abreast of and evaluates new laws, regulations, and case law; identifies and summarizes relevant issues; collaborates with other areas of the Law and Regulation (L&R) department; provides proactive advice and counsel to business units on the impact of new laws; monitors legal representation.

Education

  • Juris Doctorate and active membership in good standing with theNew York State Bar.

MinimumRequirements

  • 5+ years of proven litigation experience or strong litigation-type skills, such as case strategy development, legal research, and advocacy, with the ability to manage complex disputes and work effectively under pressure.

  • First or second chair jury trial experience.

  • Proficiencyin Microsoft Office, LexisNexis (preferred), and internet research.

  • Strong teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with attorneys, paralegals, and administrative assistants under the guidance of Lead Counsel.

  • Capacity to manage a substantial case load.

  • Comfortable working in a remote environment and willing to travel throughout Brooklyn, Queens, Manhattan, and Long Island for court appearances.

Explore the Benefits of Joining Allstate's Client Legal Services:

  • Exceptional Work-Life Balance:At Allstate, we understand the importance of achieving harmony between work and personal life. Our in-house litigation roles provide more predictable schedules, allowing you to excel professionally while enjoying a fulfilling personal life.

  • Professional Growth Opportunities:Withample opportunitiesfor advancement and professional development,you'llhave the support and resources you need to reach new heights in your legal career.

  • Holistic Understanding of the Business:Aspart of the Allstate legal team,you'llgain invaluable insight into our diverse business operations,objectives, and culture. This comprehensive understanding enables you to align legal strategies closely with the company's goals, fostering impactful contributions and strategic partnerships across departments.

  • Direct Client Collaboration:Working in-house at Allstate means collaborating directly with internal stakeholders and business units. This close partnership cultivates deeper client relationships,facilitatinga nuanced understanding of their needs and priorities. By providing proactive legal guidance and support,you'llplay a pivotal role in driving the company's success.

  • Strategic Influence and Impact:As an integral member of our legal team,you'llhave the opportunity to shape strategic decisions and risk management initiatives. Your insights andexpertisewill inform key business decisions, empowering you to mitigate risks effectively and drive positive outcomes that directlyimpactAllstate's bottom line.

  • Diverse Legal Challenges:In-house litigation roles at Allstate encompass a broad spectrum of legal work beyond traditional litigation, including regulatory compliance, risk assessment, and dispute resolution. This diversity of challenges ensures continuous professional growth and development, expanding your skill set and enhancing your career trajectory.

  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition

About this job

P&C Actuary Consultant II role at Allstate focused on insurance reserving projects. Executes actuarial analysis and modeling of moderate complexity using accepted methodologies to support business goals.

Good fit if you have a bachelor's degree, are actively pursuing Casualty Actuarial Society exams, and have 2+ years of actuarial or analytical experience.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The P&C Actuary Consultant II job is responsible for executing projects in support of reserving insurance business utilizing accepted actuarial and statistical standards, as well as methodologies and knowledge gained through on the job training. This role works closely with analytics management and key business partners to develop and execute appropriate reserving methodologies and modeling techniques of moderate complexity to support business goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leverages understanding of insurance business, products, markets and regulatory environments in the creation of business strategies and decisions, building expertise within a specialized area
  • With limited coaching, reviews and ensures quality of data used to perform actuarial and statistical services within multiple tools/applications
  • Manages, and/or contributes on projects that are moderate complexity and are of moderate scale using accepted project management standards, with limited guidance
  • Communicates analysis results to management and non-technical users, making recommendations and providing support for assumptions and methodologies
  • Uses best practices, with limited coaching, to perform basic to moderately complex analysis, using traditional actuarial, statistical and/or predictive modeling techniques, including proper documentation and evaluation, to provide insights and meet business needs

Education

  • 4 year Bachelors Degree
  • Active pursuit of Casualty Actuarial Society exams is required for this role

Experience

  • 2 or more years of experience (Preferred)

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

Education & Experience (in lieu)

  • In lieu of the above education requirements, an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

About this job

Managing Engineer who architects and designs digital products using modern technologies like Java, Spring Boot, and cloud platforms. Leads medium to large software engineering teams, manages production applications, and is accountable for product success through KPIs.

Good fit if you have 7+ years software engineering experience, strong Java and Spring Boot skills, and experience leading engineering teams.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Managing Engineer architects and designs their digital products using modern tools, technologies, frameworks, and systems. They apply a systematic application of scientific and technological knowledge, methods, and experience to the design, implementation, testing, and documentation of software. They own and manage running their application in production and ultimately becomes accountable for the success of their digital products through achieving KPIs. The Managing Engineer plans, directs, designs, and executes IT-related activities and programs that are of a complex and critical nature. The Managing Engineer selects, leads, counsels, motivates, sets expectations and evaluates medium to large teams. At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. Job Description


At Allstate's Enterprise Architecture organization, we define the technology strategies, platforms, and standards that enable a data-driven enterprise. Our team partners across business and technology to modernize data platforms, accelerate cloud adoption, and advance analytics and AI capabilities that power smarter decisions across the company.

The Opportunity

  • Defining and socializing the data analytic practices across the Allstate corporation. This role will provide strategic guidance for technical and business teams on ingestion, integration, data visualization, and advanced analytics including generative AI, ultimately enabling our business to advance.

  • This role will focus on large scale data lake implementation and data lake house modernization through engagements that will focus on customer solutions such as data warehousing, business intelligence, and advanced analytics tools. You'll work with senior leaders, engineers, and architects across the organization to build solutions that make enterprise-scale analytics and intelligence possible. ,

  • You'll be expected to roll up your sleeves, develop prototypes, evaluate emerging technologies, and influence how the next generation of data and AI platforms are built across Allstate.

What We're Looking For

  • You are a senior data architecture leader who combines deep technical expertise with strong business influence. You have experience leading cloud and data modernization initiatives, remain close to the technology, and can confidently communicate architectural strategy to both engineers and executives. You thrive in fast-changing environments and are passionate about the future of analytics, cloud, and AI.

Primary Responsibilities Include:

  • Drive the evolution and data architecture for a scalable and secure data platform
  • Work closely with business partners, architecture, security, and engineering teams to design and implement a modern data lake and lake house architecture
  • Engage with strategic customers and ensure their future needs and vision are top of mind for a data-driven enterprise
  • Oversee deployment of long-term strategic data products and infusing key data and analytics services in applicable areas of business and IT
  • Build POCs of cloud native microservices architecture for data with focus on IaaS, metadata driven frameworks and DevOps
  • Design and guide practices for data models, data flows, and integration patterns for the data lake, lake house , and consumption data layers
  • Support delivery leaders and engineers in building and managing conceptual, logical, and physical architecture
  • Collaborate, design and provide hands-on development of high-priority prototypes in a cloud platform and demonstrate value and feasibility of the solutions and architecture
  • Be involved in all project phases and drive architecture initiatives
  • Communication with senior and executive leadership on architecture initiatives
  • Strong communicator individually, in groups and in presentations with a vision for how cloud data platforms can enable a better future powered by data

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelors degree or equivalent professional experience
  • Rich experience building POCs with at least 1-2 successful adoptions across Enterprise
  • 10 to 15 years of experience in at least two IT disciplines such as data architecture, technical cloud architecture, analytics & data science, big data technologies, database management, data governance & security in a heterogeneous environment.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in implementation and performance tuning MPP (Massively Parallel Processing) databases (Oracle Exadata, Teradata, Netezza, Greenplum, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience in lead roles architecting solutions at scale for cloud data platforms including experience with major cloud providers (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Experience designing analytics environments for use with data visualization and model development tools and AI driven data agents
  • Hands-on experience with business intelligence tools (Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
  • Experience in analyzing Data Warehouses such as Teradata, Netezza, Oracle, etc.
  • Experience in analyzing Cloud Data Warehouses such as AWS Redshift, Azure Synapse, or Snowflake, etc.
  • Experience designing database environments, analyzing production deployments, and making recommendations to optimize performance
  • Hands on experience architecting and building secure, scalable, and flexible enterprise data projects using AWS, Microsoft Fabric and other on-prem and cloud native platforms
  • Expertise in building secure and scalable data ingestion, ETL/ELT solutions using various server-based and serverless tools
  • Experience with data warehouse data structure and dimensional modeling and key definition with tools such as ERWIN or others
  • Experience with data structures and models for a microservices environment, data lake and cloud lake houses and supporting downstream applications based on various modeling tools and platforms
  • Hands on experience in leading large-scale enterprise data warehousing (EDW) projects
  • Strong SQL skills
  • Product development mindset and expertise in CI/CD pipeline
  • Experience with big data platforms, SQL & no SQL databases

Leadership & Communication:

  • Collaborative influence, intellectual humility, and enterprise-first decision making; demonstrate intellectual curiosity and humility, balancing conviction with flexibility by considering alternative viewpoints and championing solutions that best serve organizational goals, regardless of origin
  • Experience with prioritization of projects that mitigate trade-offs
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills. Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • Experience driving architectural direction across multiple teams and organizations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric and modern lakehouse architectures.
  • Experience building AI-enabled analytics platforms, AI agents, or generative AI solutions.
  • Experience leading large-scale cloud and analytics transformation programs. Cloud architecture certifications (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
  • Insurance or other highly regulated industry experience.
  • Working within a scaled agile program and collaborating with product managers in creating and managing technical backlog of stories and epics
  • Experience in cloud based services such as: S3, IAM, SNS/SQS

Analytics Architecture, Cloud Data Architecture, Data Lake, Data Lakehouse Architecture, Data Strategies, Enterprise Architecture (EA), Enterprise Data Architecture

Based on an assessment of each candidate's experience, technical expertise, and leadership background, candidates may be considered for the opportunity that best aligns with their qualifications.

Key Responsibilities


People and Engineering Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and coach Data Engineers while supporting their technical and professional development.
  • Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
  • Establish engineering standards and encourage consistent use of best practices.
  • Balance hands-on engineering with technical leadership, team development, and delivery responsibilities.
  • Depending on the position level, support or lead hiring, onboarding, performance feedback, career development, and workforce planning.

Data Solution Design and Development

  • Lead the design, development, implementation, and support of scalable batch and streaming data solutions.
  • Develop reusable patterns for data ingestion, transformation, storage, and access.
  • Integrate data from APIs, databases, event streams, third-party platforms, and enterprise systems.
  • Remain actively involved in architecture discussions, solution design, code reviews, troubleshooting, and complex problem-solving.
  • Ensure data solutions are reliable, maintainable, secure, scalable, and cost-effective.

Engineering Excellence and Production Support

  • Promote modern engineering practices, including version control, automated testing, continuous integration, automated deployment, and infrastructure automation.
  • Establish standards for data quality, validation, monitoring, lineage, and observability.
  • Optimize data pipelines, databases, queries, and storage solutions for performance and cost.
  • Support production operations and provide leadership during critical incidents, root-cause analysis, and preventative improvements.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and operational risk.

Product Collaboration and Delivery

  • Partner with Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, Analysts, and business stakeholders to understand priorities and deliver effective data solutions.
  • Translate business and product needs into technical roadmaps and clearly defined engineering work.
  • Lead or contribute to planning, prioritization, estimation, and delivery activities.
  • Manage risks, dependencies, resource needs, and competing priorities.
  • Communicate progress, technical recommendations, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders and leaders.

Data Governance, Security, and Standards

  • Promote data governance practices, including metadata management, data lineage, classification, and data quality.
  • Ensure solutions meet applicable security, privacy, governance, and regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with Architecture, Security, Risk, and Governance teams to align solutions with enterprise standards.
  • Support the responsible access, use, storage, and movement of enterprise data.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

  • Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and engineering practices that may improve data capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to increase automation, simplify development, and improve engineering productivity.
  • Support cloud modernization and data platform transformation initiatives.
  • Promote continuous learning and the responsible use of generative and agent-based artificial intelligence tools.

Job.JobTitle: Large Loss Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Detroit, MI
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Detroit, MI
  • Experience: 4+ years
  • License: Valid driver's license

About this job

Large Loss Field Property Adjuster handling on-site inspections, damage investigations, estimates, and claims settlements in Detroit. Expertise in water losses with travel to customer homes and virtual claims handling using Xactimate and ClaimsX.

Good fit if you have 4 years outside adjuster experience, can handle claims over $100,000, and are comfortable traveling and accessing roofs.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Large Loss Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Large Loss Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.


You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Qualifications:

  • 4 years previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.
  • Experience handling claims with multiple trades and over $100,000 in losses.
  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

Required Qualifications:

  • Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.
  • Must be able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access roofs with up to a 6/12 pitch.
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.
  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Youre provided with comprehensive training:

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.
  • You will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.


*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.


Company Car:

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.


Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more. #LI-TW1

Skills

Communication, Critical Thinking, Customer Service, Empathy, Multitasking, Working Independently

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is $72,000 - $115,000 and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment while making adifference, then apply to join our team today!


As a Direct Sales Agent Specialist, you will:

  • Achieve sales goals through new business, cross-sell, and retention
  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline, including local lead generation and referrals
  • Develop relationships within the community (e.g., dealerships, events, local partners) to support business growth
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and follow-ups to convert opportunities into sales
  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives
  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition
  • Deliver results aligned with performance standards, compliance requirements, and customer experience expectations

Job Description

Are you someone who enjoys being on the move, solving problems, and making a real impact for customers? As a Field Auto Adjuster, you'll be at the forefront of our claims processmeeting customers where they are, whether it's at their home, a repair shop, or a tow yard.

You'll take the lead in writing estimates and guiding customers through the repair or total loss process, using a mix of in-person visits, virtual inspections, and written communication. No two days are the samewhether you're evaluating damage on-site or collaborating with body shops and service providers, you'll enjoy a fast-paced, hands-on role that keeps you engaged and on your toes.

If you're looking for a career that blends technical know-how, customer service, and the freedom of field work, this is your chance to thrive in a role where your expertise truly matters.


Sign-On Bonus: A $5,000 sign-on bonus may be offered to qualified candidates who receive and accept an employment offer. Eligibility, payment timing, and conditions will be outlined in the official offer letter.


Preferred Qualifications

  • 18+ months experience in auto collision estimating using CCC One
  • You have a High School Diploma or a GED
  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with customers
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to write precise and comprehensive estimates
  • Comfortable with utilizing technology and various platforms for claims processing
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills to manage multiple assignments effectively
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements

A day in the life of the Field Auto Damage Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate casualty (and applicable LOB (line of business)) claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder Your Eye for Detail Keeps Everything on Track- In this role, youll ensure claims are documented accurately and in line with policy agreements. As you handle each case, youll maintain clear, timely records in our claims system (which well train you on). Your attention to detail helps keep the process smooth, organized, and transparent from start to finish.

Work Location

  • This position is a field-based role.To be eligible for this role, you must be located in the following locations: Springfield or Manassas, VA

Company Car
Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.


Please note, you may be required to attend 2 weeks of training held in person at our Dallas, TX office.


Notice of Licensing Requirement

  • As a condition of employment, you may be expected to obtain an adjusters license in multiple markets (Appraiser's license required in RI as well)
  • All required licenses will need to be obtained within 60 days of hire
  • You must maintain all licensing required for your role. This includes any continuing education and/or other state-affiliated requirements for licensing renewal
  • This role offers a sign on bonus of $1,000 if you have an active appraiser license or active adjuster license in TX, FL, or your resident state (current employees and candidates who have previously worked for and are seeking to be rehired at Allstate and its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus)

Benefits

Allstate cares about you and your wellbeing. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that includes pay, benefits, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. You can choose whatever benefits are most important you. Here are some of our offerings:

  • Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Allstate pension plan and 401(k) savings plan
  • Ayco financial coaching
  • Spring Health mental and emotional wellbeing resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Adoption reimbursement
  • Paid time off
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Wellness incentives

The Legal Summer Associate will be responsible for providing legal research, preparing discovery, drafting briefs, motions, and observe proceedings in various courts.

During this internship, the Legal Summer Associate will receive comprehensive mentoring, including opportunities to attend depositions, mediations, arbitrations, court appearances, and trials/hearings.  The Legal Summer Associate will also have opportunities to collaborate with Travelers Staff Counsel attorneys, support staff and business partners while receiving substantive feedback on all assignments.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Talent Acquisition Specialist, Human Resources & Training
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Milwaukee, WI
  • Experience: 3+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Lead talent acquisition strategy and recruiting operations for Church Mutual Insurance in Milwaukee. Combine recruiting leadership with process optimization and recruiting technology implementation while managing critical searches and developing team capabilities.

Good fit if you have 7+ years of talent acquisition experience, 3+ years leading recruiting teams, and expertise in recruiting technology and process improvement.

Full job description

Serve as a player-coach responsible for leading the organization's talent acquisition function while actively managing key recruiting initiatives and strategic searches. Develop and execute a forward-looking talent acquisition strategy that enables the organization to attract, engage, and hire top talent in a rapidly evolving workforce landscape. Lead recruiting operations, develop team capabilities, drive recruiting innovation, and implement enablement strategies that improve recruiter effectiveness, hiring manager engagement, candidate experience, and hiring outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines strong recruiting leadership with expertise in talent acquisition enablement, process optimization, workforce insights, recruiting technology, and change leadership. This individual will serve as a strategic partner to business leaders and help position Talent Acquisition as a critical driver of organizational growth and long-term workforce success.

PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Talent Acquisition Strategy

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive talent acquisition strategy aligned with organizational goals and workforce needs.
  • Partner with business leaders and Human Resources to anticipate future talent requirements and develop proactive hiring strategies.
  • Translate workforce trends, labor market intelligence, and business priorities into actionable recruiting plans.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen talent pipelines for critical and emerging roles.

Recruiting Enablement & Innovation

  • Lead recruiting enablement efforts by optimizing processes, tools, resources, and recruiter capabilities.
  • Evaluate and implement modern recruiting technologies, automation solutions, sourcing tools, and AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Develop recruiting playbooks, sourcing methodologies, interviewing frameworks, and hiring manager resources.
  • Drive adoption and utilization of recruiting technology and best practices across the organization.
  • Continuously assess and improve the effectiveness of the recruiting function through innovation and process improvement.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop Talent Acquisition team members.
  • Establish performance expectations and support individual professional growth.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, partnership, customer service, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Provide ongoing coaching related to sourcing strategies, stakeholder management, candidate engagement, and consultative recruiting.

Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Personally manage a portfolio of critical, complex, leadership, or hard-to-fill positions.
  • Execute full-cycle recruitment activities including sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer development, and closing.
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future workforce needs.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to hiring leaders throughout the recruitment process.

Hiring Manager Partnership

  • Develop strong relationships with leaders across the organization.
  • Consult with hiring managers on market conditions, recruiting strategies, talent availability, and selection practices.
  • Improve hiring manager capability through training, tools, and best-practice guidance.
  • Promote consistent and effective interviewing and candidate evaluation practices.

Talent Analytics & Workforce Insights

  • Establish and monitor recruiting metrics that measure effectiveness and business impact.
  • Utilize data to identify trends, improve decision-making, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Provide reporting and insights related to talent acquisition performance, market conditions, and workforce needs.

Candidate Experience & Employer Brand

  • Champion a candidate-centric recruiting experience.
  • Support initiatives that strengthen the organization's employer brand and talent value proposition.
  • Ensure high-quality candidate communications and engagement throughout the hiring process.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of of progressive talent acquisition experience.
  • 3+ years of leadership experience within recruiting or talent acquisition.
  • Demonstrated success leading full-cycle recruiting efforts across a variety of functional areas and levels.
  • Experience developing recruiting strategies and implementing process improvements.
  • Experience utilizing applicant tracking systems, sourcing technologies, recruitment marketing platforms, and recruiting analytics.
  • Strong business acumen, communication skills, and consultative leadership capabilities.

 

Preferred

  • Insurance or financial services industry experience.
  • Experience leading recruiting transformation, enablement, or technology initiatives.
  • Experience implementing AI-enabled recruiting tools, automation solutions, talent CRM platforms, or candidate engagement technologies.
  • Professional HR certification (SHRM, HRCI, or equivalent).

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Professional hybrid office environment.

NOTE:   This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties performed by this employee.  Employees may be requested to perform jobrelated tasks other than those specifically presented in this job description.  The employer reserves the right to change or assign other duties to this position.

The CM Group is made up of Church Mutual Insurance Company, S.I., CM Regent Insurance Company, and CM Vantage Specialty Insurance Company.

Description

We are seeking a motivated and personable Insurance Sales Agent to join our growing team in our SouthCharlotte,NCoffice.

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career.

This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, youll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed no prior insurance experience required.

Please note: While No Insurance Experience is required, you must obtain P&C and Life License prior to employment.

Description

What youll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

    • $1,000 Professional Start Bonus
    • Unlimited commission and renewal income potential for earnings growth over time.
    • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
    • Paid training and ongoing development.
    • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
    • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
    • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.

Compensation Details:

  • The typical training salary is $51k-55k
  • Through a combination of base, bonuses, and uncapped commissions, typical total first year compensation ranges from $65k - $80k
  • Potential for top performers to earn over $100k in their first year
Qualifications

Who Were Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive you follow through and do what you say youll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing youre comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy youre able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain P&C and Life licenses prior to being hired.

About this job

Sell auto, home, life, and specialty insurance to individuals and families as an outside sales agent. Base salary plus uncapped commissions, with training, benefits from day one, and flexibility to work hybrid, field, or remote.

Good fit if you are self-motivated, relationship-focused, outgoing, tech-savvy, and comfortable in customer-facing or sales roles.

Full job description


Description

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, youll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What youll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who Were Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive you follow through and do what you say youll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing youre comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy youre able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

Description

We are seeking an experienced aviation leader to join a well-established aviation team as our current Chief Pilot retires. Based at our dedicated hangar facility at Hanscom Field in Bedford, Massachusetts, we operate three Gulfstream aircraft (two G650ERs and a G500) in support of the companys global business activity.

Our flight department is built around three priorities: safety, grounded in a just culture; providing a superior service experience in every facet of the department; and a continuous focus on operational excellence. The Chief Pilot leads the Flight Operations team and is responsible for ensuring our pilots are prepared, qualified, and supported to conduct safe, consistent, and effective aircraft operations. Serving as both a people leader and an active line pilot, the Chief Pilot works closely with the Director of Aviation and Aviation Leadership Team to provide operational oversight and maintain the standards and culture necessary to support these priorities and the departments mission.

Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Culture: Leads the Flight Operations (pilot) team, fostering a culture of trust, engagement, and shared accountability.

  • Leads the Flight Operations team within Corporate Aviation.
  • Fosters a culture of trust, respect, and open communication by modeling behavior that embodies Liberty Mutual's Identity and Values, remaining highly engaged with the pilot team, and soliciting input to keep a sharp focus on operational excellence.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Leadership Engagement: Represents Flight Operations within the Aviation leadership team, ensuring alignment across the department.

  • Works closely with the Corporate Aviation leadership team including attending and actively participating in Aviation Leadership Team / Safety Officer meetings to ensure effective communication and coordination among all personnel groups in support of the department's goals and objectives.

Recruiting, Onboarding & Pilot Development: Partners with the Director of Aviation to build the pilot team, from hiring through onboarding.

  • Works with the Director of Aviation to identify and hire captains and first officers.
  • Responsible for onboarding, indoctrination, and training of new pilots.

Training & Qualification Standards: Establishes and maintains the training curriculum, qualification standards, and standardization program for all pilots.

  • Establishes and periodically reviews the training curriculum and performance standards (safety, technical, and service) in coordination with the Director of Aviation and Aviation leadership team, ensuring pilots have the aircraft systems, equipment, and operating limitations knowledge necessary for safe operations on each assigned type, and that standards remain current with fleet, mission, and regulatory changes.
  • Tracks and ensures pilots meet all training, qualification, and administrative requirements, including flight reviews, medical certificates, and recurrent training due dates.
  • Establishes and manages pilot standardization processes to maintain consistency of training and evaluation across the pilot group.
  • Leads pilot-side planning for fleet changes, including transition training and manual updates for new aircraft types.

Core Flight Operations Management: Oversees and supports daily flight operations.

  • Serves as the pilot group's primary resource for day-to-day operational matters, including crew assignments aligned to departmental needs, qualifications, and mission requirements.
  • Guides pilots on safety, technical, and service performance standards, working collaboratively to address deficiencies as they arise.
  • Supports pilots in coordinating with Maintenance, Passenger Services, and Operations Support on daily operational matters, including aircraft discrepancies and Minimum Equipment List (MEL) issues.
  • Ensures pilots are knowledgeable on and prepared to address operational factors, including traffic management delays, Temporary Flight Restrictions (TFRs), and NOTAMs.

Operating Standards, Procedures & Documentation: Develops and maintains the operating standards, procedures, and documentation that govern flight operations.

  • Develops, implements, and monitors operating standards and procedures for pilots, ensuring compliance with regulatory and OEM guidance including staying current on OEM procedural and equipment updates and alignment with industry best practices.
  • Identifies process and standards gaps with regulatory and OEM guidance and formulates solutions in collaboration with Corporate Aviation partners.
  • Develops, maintains, and monitors the currency of operational documentation pertinent to flight operations, including department operating manuals and aircraft publications (printed and digital).
  • Reviews and manages electronic plotting records.
  • Communicates pertinent process and procedure changes to affected personnel, considering the broader impact of those changes on other teams in the department.

Regulatory & Operational Authorizations: Obtains and maintains the regulatory and operational authorizations required to support the department's operations.

  • Obtains and maintains all regulatory and operational authorizations required to support the department's operations and mission profile, including state jurisdictional authorizations and operational approvals such as RVSM, RNP/RNAV, and international operations approvals.
  • Serves as the responsible party for FAA letters of authorization.

Vendor, Expense & Budget Management: Manages vendor relationships and financial resources supporting flight operations.

  • Identifies, maintains, and coordinates vendor relationships supporting flight operations, engaging Corporate Aviation leadership as needed to ensure departmental needs are met and benefits maximized.
  • Oversees pilot expenses and manages the pilot training budget in coordination with the Director of Aviation, ensuring the team operates within established guidelines.

Flight Duties & Operational Support: Maintains proficiency and provides hands-on operational support as an active line pilot.

  • Actively participates in the schedule as a pilot on each aircraft type operated by the department, maintaining a high degree of operational and systems knowledge on each type.
  • Provides guidance on airport suitability, including seeking out information about airport accessibility when it is not readily available.
Qualifications

Leadership / Experience:

Previous experience as a people leader, preferred

Demonstrated leadership ability, including coaching, development, and accountability

Strong organizational, verbal, and written communication skills

Sound judgment and decision-making ability in a dynamic operational environment

Ability to build trust and productive relationships across teams and organizational levels

Demonstrated ability to collaborate, influence, and drive alignment across functional areas

Commitment to fostering a culture of safety, service, continuous improvement, and shared accountability

Technical Requirements:

Minimum 5 years as a turbojet PIC; preference for business aviation operations conducted globally

Valid FAA ATP with Airplane Multiengine Land rating

Valid FAA First Class Medical

Valid U.S. passport

Type rating and operational experience in Gulfstream GVI or GVII or comparable aircraft type

College degree, or equivalent experience

Job.JobTitle: Executive Underwriter, Construction Wrap-Up & Loss Sensitive Programs
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Our Lare Construction casualty team is seeking an experienced Underwriter to join a high-performing group focused on large accounts, complex wrap-ups, and joint venture projects nationwide. This role will be responsible for growing and developing the Central region while maintaining a profitable book of business through sound underwriting decisions, strong customer and broker partnerships, and effective use of underwriting tools, systems, and specialized resources.

The successful candidate will also mentor and guide less experienced underwriters within their area of expertise, providing regular coaching and feedback to support employee development. In addition, this role will participate in strategic projects that advance the goals of the department and the company.

  • Risk Selection and Underwriting: Evaluate, price, and underwrite complex construction risks by assessing account eligibility, exposures, coverage needs, program structure, pricing, terms, and conditions. Secure appropriate approvals, develop and present proposals, and negotiate favorable outcomes with agents and brokers.
  • Agent and Broker Relationship Management: Build and sustain strong partnerships with key agents and brokers through responsive service, proactive communication, site visits, renewal discussions, and a thorough understanding of their customers businesses. Develop a strong personal brand and maintain a high-quality, long-term pipeline of opportunities.
  • Portfolio Management and Growth: Manage a sizable, complex book of business with a focus on profitable growth, retention, diversification, and market share. Analyze portfolio performance, identify opportunities, execute targeted marketing strategies, and partner with preferred brokers to market and cross-sell products. Contribute insights on marketing plans, product opportunities, geographic priorities, service needs, and broker intelligence.
  • Underwriting File Quality and Compliance: Maintain thorough, well-documented underwriting files that demonstrate sound judgment and a clear decision-making process. Ensure account reviews, referrals, approvals, and signoffs comply with applicable regulations, underwriting guidelines, and delegated authority.
  • Technical Leadership and Talent Development: Mentor, coach, and provide technical guidance to underwriters and account analysts. Support the development of both underwriting expertise and professional skills, share best practices, and provide regular feedback to leadership regarding employee progress.
  • Continuous Improvement and Strategic Projects: Participate in department and company initiatives that improve processes, tools, service, and underwriting results. Contribute ideas, engage in problem-solving activities, and use continuous improvement practices to support team objectives.
Qualifications
  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 7 years expected, typically 10 years or more, of progressive underwriting experience and/or other related business experience
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate and judge underwriting risks within scope of responsibility
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex analyses and information in understandable written and/or oral directives to other persons in the organization for underwriting or training purposes
  • Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills in dealing with internal and external stakeholders
  • Must demonstrate comprehension of most complex technical underwriting issues and be capable of defining and implementing necessary underwriting and administrative processes/workflows to properly manage or administer those issues
  • Proven track record of developing and underwriting profitable business

One-day discovery program for college sophomores and juniors exploring careers in insurance claims at Liberty Mutual's Plano office on October 29, 2026. Participants tour facilities, navigate mock claims scenarios, and connect with claims leaders to prepare for summer internship opportunities.

Good fit if you are a current college sophomore or junior on track to graduate in 2026-2028, authorized to work in the U.S., and located in the Dallas/Fort Worth area.

Description

Liberty Mutual Overview

At Liberty Mutual, our purpose is to help people embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow. Part of how we do that is bycreating a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplacewhere we are committed torecognizing, appreciating, andembracingthe unique insights, perspectives, and backgroundsof our employees.

About the Claim Your Career Discovery Program

Claim Your Career offers a unique, immersive experience designed specifically for college sophomores and juniors who are interested in exploring the insurance industry with a focus in the field of claims. This program provides an in-depth look at the dynamic career pathways within claims.

Participants in the program will engage in a variety of activities, including building connections with employees and executive leadership, touring our Plano, TX office and visiting our interactive training facility. By the end of the program, participants will have a clear understanding of careers in claims and the role of claims at a Fortune 100 Company.

Claim Your Career will take place on Wednesday, October 29th in Libertys Plano, TX Office. This in-person event is for those located in the Dallas/Fort Worth area.

How it works

As an CYCProgram participant, you will get the opportunity to:

Explore opportunities

  • Learn firsthand about different career paths
  • Build connections with claims leaders and recruiters

Get a hands-on preview

  • Navigate claims scenarios using our mock house and vehicles
  • Take an exclusive tour of our state-of-the-art training facility

Through this program, participants will have the opportunity to enhance their business acumen and be prepared to secure a Summer 2025internship.

When it starts

The externship will take place October 29th, 2026. Applicants who meet basic criteria must complete a virtual interview before being invited to Claim Your Career. This is a highly competitive program with limited space, so be sure to apply today!

Pursue your tomorrow, today and apply now.

Qualifications
  • Must be currently enrolled in a 4-year university pursuing a bachelor's degree
  • Be available to participate and attend the full length of the program in person
  • Be on track to graduate in 2026, 2027 or 2028
  • You are fully authorized to work in the U.S. without restrictions now and in the future

Job.JobDescription:
Description

Data Science Summer Internship Program

Its a data-driven world. Be part of a growing community of data science professionals that harness the power of data and cutting-edge technology to analyze performance trends, identify opportunities, and keep Liberty Mutual moving forward.

The details

Calling all aspiring data scientists! Heres the perfect opportunity to grow your knowledge and skills in key areas such as GenAI, machine learning, and various modeling techniques and software, just to name a few.

In this 11-week Data Science Summer Internship Program, youll work both independently and as part of a team to research, gather, and analyze data, build or enhance robust models, and recommend solutions that impact business decisions all while you augment your technical skillset and build business acumen.

This internship program may be your first step toward pursuing a rewarding career at Liberty Mutual, one of the leading property and casualty insurers in the United States and a global Fortune 100 company. Our interns often transition into full-time data scientists at our Boston Headquarters.

Note:We encourage interested candidates to apply promptly, as the role may be unposted once weve received a sufficient number of candidates. We conduct interviews and extend offers on a rolling basis.

Qualifications

What youve got

  • Currently pursuing a masters degree in Statistics, Data Science, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline
  • 0-2 years of professional experience
  • Intermediate experience with programming languages such as Python or R
  • Foundational knowledge of statistical analysis concepts, techniques, and tools
  • Demonstrated experience with exploratory data analysis, regression analysis, and model development and evaluation through coursework and/or internships
  • Strong communication, analytical, critical thinking, and interpersonal skills
  • Permanent work authorization in the United States

About this job

Remote underwriting operations support role with insurance carrier clients. Perform data entry, transaction processing, and operational tasks like ordering MVRs and handling new business submissions. Flexible full or part-time schedule with company benefits.

Good fit if you have 25 years of work experience with 10 recent years in insurance carrier operations.

Full job description

Put your Insurance Experience to work – FROM HOME!

At WAHVE, we value significant insurance experience and want to revolutionize the way people think about phasing into retirement by offering qualified candidates the opportunity to continue their career working from home. As we say – retire from the office but not from work.  Our unique platform provides you with real work/life balance and allows you to choose a full or part-time work schedule while continuing to utilize your insurance expertise in a remote, long-term position which includes company benefits!

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WAHVE

We created a welcoming place to work with friendly and professional leadership. We are known for the great care we take with our staff and our clients. We are passionate and determined about delivering the best customer service, preserving insurance industry knowledge, and making a difference by the work that we do.

WHAT WE ARE SEEKING

We have assignments available to help our insurance carrier clients in Operations Support or Underwriting Assistant positions. Responsibilities include:

  • Perform required support functions for Underwriting.
  • Work directly with underwriting and audit staff on ensuring the accuracy and completeness of all transactions to maximize product quality delivered to our customers.
  • Complete operational tasks such as ordering MVR's, inspections and reviews, financial reports, and other similar tasks as requested.
  • Perform new business submission clearance, data entry of new business submission information and Broker of Record requests.
  • Process new business and renewal related transactions in a timely manner. Transactions may include data input, quoting, rating, or pricing revisions, billing, coding, policy issuance, forms attachment, endorsements, premium audits, cancellations, and reinstatements for multiple lines of business.
  • Work with underwriters and other functional areas to resolve any discrepancies.

TO BECOME A WORK-AT-HOME VINTAGE EXPERT, WE REQUIRE

  • 25 years of full-time work experience
  • 10 most recent years of insurance carrier experience

BENEFITS OF BECOMING A WAHVE VINTAGE EXPERT

  • Health insurance based on eligibility.
  • 401(k) with a 4% match based on eligibility.
  • Voluntary Dental, Vision, Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D).
  • Retire from the office but not from work.
  • Eliminate the office stress and the commute.
  • Choose the work you would like to do now.
  • Available in either full or part-time schedules.
  • Utilize your years of insurance industry knowledge.
  • Be part of our dynamic yet virtual team environment and connect with other experienced insurance professionals like yourself!

HOW TO GET STARTED

WE LOOK FORWARD TO MEETING YOU!
