Job.JobTitle: Lead Product Engineer (AIOps for Observability) - Remote
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Chicago, IL
  • Experience: 5+ years

About this job

Lead Product Engineer role at Allstate designing AI-powered observability platforms for hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Focus on agentic AI, autonomous anomaly detection, automated remediation, and AIOps frameworks to enhance enterprise reliability and operational efficiency.

Good fit if you have 5+ years engineering experience, 4+ years with observability platforms, 2+ years building agentic AI systems, and expertise in Java, Python, or Node.js.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Allstate is seeking a forward-thinking Lead Product Engineer to drive innovation in its AI-powered Observability platform. This role sits at the intersection of AI engineering, observability, and software development, with a strong focus on automation, intelligent insights, and self-healing systems across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

You will lead the design and development of next-generation observability solutions powered by agentic AI, enabling proactive detection, diagnosis, and remediation of issues. This role emphasizes building scalable platforms, intelligent automation, and developer-centric tooling that enhance reliability, performance, and operational efficiency.

As a technical leader, you will shape product strategy, drive engineering excellence, and deliver AI-driven monitoring and automation capabilities that transform how applications and platforms are operated across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

AI & Intelligent Automation

  • Design and build agentic AI solutions for observability, including autonomous agents capable of anomaly detection, root cause analysis, and automated remediation.
  • Embed AI/ML capabilities into observability platforms to enable predictive insights, anomaly detection, and intelligent alerting.
  • Develop AIOps frameworks that reduce noise, automate workflows, and improve incident response times.
  • Leverage LLMs and AI orchestration frameworks to create self-service diagnostics and operational assistants.
  • Architect and implement end-to-end observability solutions across logs, metrics, traces, and events.
  • Enhance observability platforms (Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, AppDynamics, OTEL) with custom integrations, automation, and AI enhancements.
  • Build real-time insights and health analytics to ensure system reliability, scalability, and performance.
  • Lead development of scalable, reusable platform components and APIs for observability and automation.
  • Build developer-first tools and frameworks that simplify instrumentation, monitoring, and diagnostics.
  • Apply modern software engineering practices including TDD, CI/CD, microservices, and cloud-native design.
  • Develop full-stack solutions (backend services, dashboards, automation tooling) using Java/Spring Boot, Python, Node.js, and React.
  • Drive automation-first strategies to eliminate manual operations and improve efficiency.
  • Build self-healing systems that automatically detect and remediate issues.
  • Lead initiatives in infrastructure-as-code, Observability-as-code and automated deployment pipelines.
  • Engineer highly resilient systems by focusing on performance, scalability, and fault tolerance.
  • Define and evolve enterprise observability architecture, incorporating AI and automation as core principles.
  • Collaborate with architecture, platform, and security teams to align solutions with enterprise standards.
  • Champion standardization, reusable patterns, and platform scalability across the organization.
  • Act as a technical leader and mentor, guiding teams in AI, observability, and engineering best practices.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver integrated, high-impact platform solutions.
  • Communicate technical concepts and strategies effectively to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, automation, and continuous improvement.

Essential Skills

  • 5+ years of engineering experience building software, platforms, or automation solutions, with a strong emphasis on observability and distributed systems.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with observability platforms (Datadog, Dynatrace, OTEL).
  • 3+ years of software development experience using Java (Spring Boot), Python, Node.js, or React.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building agentic AI systems (autonomous agents, AI workflows, or AI-native applications).
  • Proven ability to design and implement AI-driven automation and AIOps solutions.
  • Experience integrating LLMs, orchestration frameworks, or AI pipelines into production systems.
  • Strong experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures.
  • Hands-on experience in hybrid environments (on-prem + cloud) across Linux and Windows.
  • Expertise in API development, event-driven systems, and microservices architecture.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and DevOps practices.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on automation and innovation.
  • Excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical solutions.
  • Passion for emerging technologies, particularly AI in observability and operations.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

(#LI-NJ1)

Skills

Agentic AI, Agentic AI, Agile Methodology, AI Agents, AI Ops, Anomaly Detection, API Development, AppDynamics, Application Monitoring, Application Programming Interface (API), Automation, Automation Solutions, Back-End Development, Building Architecture, Business, Business Direction, Business Objectives, Business Operations, Business Processes, Business Software, C (Programming Language), Cloud Infrastructure, Cloud Native, Collaboration, Collaborative Development {+ 65 more}

Job Description

Are you someone who enjoys being on the move, solving problems, and making a real impact for customers? As a Field Auto Adjuster, you'll be at the forefront of our claims processmeeting customers where they are, whether it's at their home, a repair shop, or a tow yard.

You'll take the lead in writing estimates and guiding customers through the repair or total loss process, using a mix of in-person visits, virtual inspections, and written communication. No two days are the samewhether you're evaluating damage on-site or collaborating with body shops and service providers, you'll enjoy a fast-paced, hands-on role that keeps you engaged and on your toes.

If you're looking for a career that blends technical know-how, customer service, and the freedom of field work, this is your chance to thrive in a role where your expertise truly matters.


Sign-On Bonus: A $5,000 sign-on bonus may be offered to qualified candidates who receive and accept an employment offer. Eligibility, payment timing, and conditions will be outlined in the official offer letter.


Preferred Qualifications

  • 18+ months experience in auto collision estimating using CCC One
  • You have a High School Diploma or a GED
  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with customers
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to write precise and comprehensive estimates
  • Comfortable with utilizing technology and various platforms for claims processing
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills to manage multiple assignments effectively
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements

A day in the life of the Field Auto Damage Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate casualty (and applicable LOB (line of business)) claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder Your Eye for Detail Keeps Everything on Track- In this role, youll ensure claims are documented accurately and in line with policy agreements. As you handle each case, youll maintain clear, timely records in our claims system (which well train you on). Your attention to detail helps keep the process smooth, organized, and transparent from start to finish.

Work Location

  • This position is a field-based role.To be eligible for this role, you must be located in the following locations: Amarillo, TX

Company Car
Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.


Please note, you may be required to attend 2 weeks of training held in person at our Dallas, TX office.


Notice of Licensing Requirement

  • As a condition of employment, you may be expected to obtain an adjusters license in multiple markets (Appraiser's license required in RI as well)
  • All required licenses will need to be obtained within 60 days of hire
  • You must maintain all licensing required for your role. This includes any continuing education and/or other state-affiliated requirements for licensing renewal
  • This role offers a sign on bonus of $1,000 if you have an active appraiser license or active adjuster license in TX, FL, or your resident state (current employees and candidates who have previously worked for and are seeking to be rehired at Allstate and its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus)

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Join Allstate Technology Solutions as a Digital Product Manager building AI-powered insurance experiences. You will shape product direction, solve customer problems, and guide ideas from concept to launch. We are looking for a hands-on product leader who uses data, works well across teams, and thrives in ambiguity.

The Team

Allstate Technology Solutions is building a nextgeneration insurance platform by combining modern product design with advanced AIincluding Generative AI and agentic technologies. Our mission is to deliver transformational customer experiences while unlocking operational efficiency and personalized protection at scale.


Become a part of our story.

Youll join a collaborative, fastmoving team that continuously explores new ideas, tests assumptions, learns from data, and delivers real impact.


The Role

As a Digital Product Manager, you turn strategy into tangible outcomesstories, designs, and shipped capabilities. Youre comfortable working handson with data, using insights to influence direction, and navigating ambiguity to solve hard problems.

You value strong problem framing, clear success metrics, and effective stakeholder management. You collaborate easily across engineering, UX, architecture, and business, ensuring teams stay aligned and focused on outcomesnot just output.


Youre someone who....

  • Thrives in evolving problem spaces and continuously learns
  • Contributes meaningfully to design, data, and retrospective discussions
  • Uses AI and modern tools to innovate and problemsolve
  • Takes initiative and drives work through execution
  • Manages stakeholder expectations and demand by prioritizing highvalue work and making tradeoffs explicit
  • Partners closely with technical and nontechnical teammates toward shared goals

  • Product Direction: Own and execute a prioritized product roadmap aligned to strategy, customer value, and measurable outcomes
  • Stakeholder & Demand Management: Manage crossfunctional demand by clarifying intent, evaluating value, and driving transparent, outcomebased prioritization
  • Problem Framing: Define clear problem statements and success criteria in partnership with users and stakeholders
  • DataDriven Decisions: Use research, analytics, and raw data to surface insights, validate assumptions, and inform roadmap and delivery decisions
  • User Experience: Advocate for intuitive experiences and contribute to solution design from concept through execution
  • AI Innovation: Identify and apply AI (including GenAI and agentic tech), rapidly experimenting to responsibly scale ideas into production

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of handson product management experience with a strong execution track record
  • Experience working with AI technologies (Google, Anthropic, Azure, or AWS); scaling AIpowered products is a plus
  • Proficiency in Agile product development
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity
  • Strong data literacy with the ability to independently analyze and query data

Skills

Analytics, Business Case Analyses, Prioritization, Product Design, Product Development, Product Direction, Product Management, Product Roadmap, Product Roadmapping, Systems Thinking

About this job

Counsel position handling insurance defense litigation cases from inception through trial and appeal. Work with a national legal organization while maintaining local focus, managing predominantly low to moderate complexity caseloads based in Salt Lake City.

Good fit if you have 3+ years insurance defense litigation experience, an active law license, and can independently handle cases through trial.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$106,300.00 - $175,400.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As a Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to use your legal expertise and litigation skills to handle a caseload of predominantly low to moderate complexity and deliver optimal results for Travelers' insured customers.

What Will You Do?

  • In the handling of a caseload of predominantly low to moderate complexity, your responsibilities will include:
  • Develop and apply effective use of litigation skills and techniques to try cases to verdict or negotiate resolution.
  • Conduct legal research and demonstrate strong and persuasive legal writing and presentation skills.
  • Draft pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery and other documents.
  • Attend court events, depositions, and other appointments independently.
  • Provide case analysis and recommendations to insured clients and claim partners on file handling strategies.
  • Build and maintain strong internal and external client and business partner relationships.
  • Provide advice and training to Claim partners and clients.
  • Fully and effectively utilize available technology, case management system and automation.
  • Travel as required to meet business needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 3+ years of insurance defense litigation experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Experience independently handling cases from inception through trial/hearing & appeal.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to present information on litigated matters to diverse audiences
  • Skilled in fostering collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners to deliver exceptional customer service
  • Demonstrates persuasive legal writing skills and oral advocacy skills.
  • Strong legal research skills & ability to utilize technology.
  • Effectively manages multiple priorities with an attention to detail, sense of urgency & responsiveness.
  • Exercises sound decision making and possesses strong negotiation skills.
  • Possesses a flexible and agile mindset with a willingness to take on new challenges as needs evolve.

What is a Must Have?

  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent International legal degree; graduate of an accredited law school.
  • 2 years experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Active license in good standing to practice law in the state(s) in which representation is required.
  • Regularly handles hearings, trials, dispositive motion arguments, depositions, or other court proceedings and has the ability to transport to those meetings. Valid driver's license required depending on the location.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

  • Underwriter and skillfully negotiate complex customer accounts to minimize risk and maximize profitability.
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with internal partners within the business unit and across the enterprise to create sales plans and identify cross-selling opportunities.

  • Deep knowledge of commercial lines products, the regulatory environment, and the local insurance market.
  • Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to proactively identify underwriting, marketing, or financial challenges and analyze available information to make timely decisions in alignment with our risk appetite.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to successfully negotiate in difficult situations with agents and brokers.
  • CPCU designation.

What is a Must Have?

Job.JobTitle: Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist - Southwest Region
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist

Southwest Region

Lead With Expertise. Deliver Impact That Matters. Grow With a Company That Invests in You.

At Liberty Mutual, we show up for people in their toughest moments, and we show up for our employees with the same commitment. We areseeking a Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist for our Southwest Region who brings deep technical expertise, sharp critical thinking, and a passion for doing whats right.

If youre energized by the challenge of managing highexposure, complex, and catastrophic injury claims, and you want to work in an environment where professionalism, integrity, and empathy guide everything we do, this is the role for you.

What Makes This Role Special:

You Own the Complex Work

Youll be the point person on severe and catastrophic auto and homeowners casualty claims, navigating litigation, partnering with counsel, and driving strategy.

Your Expertise Is Valued

Your judgment plays a key role in shaping outcomes. Youll influence decisions on some of our most significant claims, backed by leaders who respect your experience.

Flexibility Meets Purpose

This role is remote or hybrid depending on location, with only a modest two days a month expectation if you live near a hub.

Youll Keep Growing

From advanced technical training to mentorship opportunities, were dedicated to helping you expand your impact.

Competitive Bonus Opportunity

External candidates with an activeFL or TX AllLines Adjuster License(CEs current) may qualify for a$2,500 signon bonus.

What Youll Do:

  • Manage the investigation, evaluation, and resolution of complex auto and homeowners casualty claims.
  • Assess coverage, liability, and damages; recommend settlement strategies and escalate appropriately for authority review.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Collaborate closely with trial counsel; attend mediations, arbitrations, trials, hearings, and conferences.
  • Prepare detailed litigation and trial reports for local management and Home Office.
  • Communicate effectively with policyholders, witnesses, attorneys, and claimants to gather information and provide guidance.
  • Responds to various written and telephone inquiries including status reports.
  • Maintain accurate reserves, recommending increases on cases in excess of authority.
  • Safeguard financial and confidential information across all claim files.
  • Oversee billing practices of outside and inhouse counsel to ensure compliance and cost efficiency.
  • May assist as a resource to the team, stepping in for the Claims Team Manager when needed or mentoring colleagues; or representing the company on matters involving state or federal regulatory agencies.
  • Participate in special projects at the direction of leadership.

Ideal Experience Includes:

  • 5+ years managing complex and litigated casualty claims
  • Deep expertise handling severe to catastrophic injuries and fatalities
  • Strong analytical thinking, negotiation skills, and sound judgment
  • Ability to thrive in a fastpaced, highstakes environment
  • Professionalism, empathy, and exceptional communication skills
  • California and Arizona Casualty claims handling

Where You Can Work:

If you live within 50 miles of one of our hub locations, the role is hybrid (2 days in office). Otherwise, it may be fully remote. Candidates located in the Central, Mountain, or Pacific time zones would be most ideal as this position supports claims located in the Pacific/Mountain Time Zones.

Ideal candidate will be located in Scottsdale, AZ.

Hub Locations:
Chandler, AZ
Clifton Park, NY
Columbus, OH
Indianapolis, IN
Lake Mary, FL
Liberty Lake, WA
Marlton, NJ
Plano, TX

Scottsdale, AZ
Suwanee, GA
Warrenville, IL
Westborough, MA

Travel:10% for mediations, arbitrations, trials, or inperson events.

Training That Sets You Up for Success:

Your growth begins on day one.Active engagement and reliable attendance during training are mandatoryand crucial to your success in this highimpact role.

Qualifications
  • Must have an advanced knowledge of coverage, liability, and complex claims handling procedures.
  • Must be knowledgeable of state and federal laws in the adjuster's jurisdiction.
  • A full working knowledge of claims operations and procedures is required.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills required as well as strong interpersonal, analytical, investigative, and negotiation skills.
  • The capabilities, skills and knowledge required is normally acquired through a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience and at least 5-7 years of directly related experience.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.

Description

We deliver our customers peace of mind every day by helping them protect what they value most. Our passion for placing the customer at the center of everything we do is driving a transformational shift at Liberty Mutual. Operating as a tech startup within a Fortune 100 company, we are leading a digital disruption that will redefine how people experience insurance.

Note: This role has a hybrid (2x per week in office) work arrangement in our Boston, MA location.

LMI Technology is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead a team of data, configuration, and software engineers supporting the Finance, Accounting, and Operations domain, including our Accounting and CECL platforms, integrations, and reporting and analytics solutions. This role owns end-to-end solution delivery across a platform-centric ecosystem in close partnership with product and business stakeholders, with direct accountability for team effectiveness, stakeholder relationships, delivery quality, and fostering an engineering culture of continuous learning and accountability.

Key Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Development

  • Managing, coaching, and developing a team of engineers; fostering a culture of continuous learning, quality, and accountability.
  • Driving high-performing engineering practices across the team, with AI and agentic tool adoption as a core enabler.
  • Owning performance management, professional development, and team health across both full-time and contract resources
  • Engaging actively in hiring and talent development as the team evolves.

Solution Delivery

  • Owning delivery outcomes across data integration, configuration, and reporting solutions, increasingly leveraging AI and agentic capabilities to improve quality and accelerate delivery.
  • Partnering with product owners to define priorities, track delivery against commitments, and maintain a clear line of sight from team output to business value.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Building and maintaining direct relationships with business stakeholders in the Finance, Accounting, and Operations domain.
  • Serving as the primary technology point of contact for business partners; communicating delivery status and trade-offs clearly and ensuring business needs are well understood by the team.

Engineering Practice & Continuous Improvement

  • Elevating engineering craft across the team setting a high bar for solution design, data engineering discipline, and technical decision-making as AI reshapes what great engineering looks like.
  • Championing agile delivery practices within the team while staying aligned to broader engineering community standards and best practices.
  • Leading platform and solution modernization efforts retiring legacy approaches, reducing complexity, and evolving the team's tooling and practices over time.
  • Driving adoption of AI-assisted and agentic engineering tools and workflows to improve solution quality, accelerate delivery, and reduce manual effort.
  • Engaging with the broader LMI engineering community to share practices and drive consistency across teams.
Qualifications

  • Background in financial services, asset management, or a related domain is strongly preferred; familiarity with financial and accounting data in a regulated environment is a meaningful advantage.

  • 7+ years of experience in a relevant engineering discipline, including experience leading or working closely with data engineering teams across integration, pipeline, or analytics delivery.

  • 3+ years in an engineering leadership or management role.

  • Familiarity with agile delivery practices and experience managing delivery within an agile team structure.

  • Experience working within or alongside large enterprise platforms, with an understanding of integrations, reporting, and analytics solutions.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools and a working understanding of how AI is reshaping engineering practices and solution delivery.

  • Experience managing mixed teams of full-time and contract resources.

  • Strong communication skills and comfort engaging directly with business stakeholders.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical or business discipline, or equivalent experience.

Description

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, youll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What youll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who Were Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive you follow through and do what you say youll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing youre comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy youre able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

Build a career for yourself, not by yourself. Launch a rewarding insurance sales career today.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $250,000 to $300,000 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: New York, NY
  • Education: Bachelor's degree
  • Benefits: Paid time off, tuition assistance

About this job

Senior Underwriter role reporting to Head of North America GL and WC Casualty at AXIS Re. Responsible for underwriting and managing General Liability and Workers Compensation treaty reinsurance portfolios across North America, with accountability for business production, portfolio performance, and broker relationships.

Good fit if you have strong expertise in GL and WC reinsurance markets, a track record of profitable underwriting and portfolio management, and experience with treaty reinsurance and underwriting strategy.

Full job description

This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

Senior Underwriter - North America Casualty Reinsurance
Job Profile: Senior Underwriter, Reinsurance
________________________________________
How does this role contribute to our collective success?
Reporting to the Head of North America GL and WC Casualty, AXIS Re, the successful candidate will be responsible for underwriting and managing a portfolio of General Liability and Workers Compensation Treaty Reinsurance business across North America.
The role carries significant responsibility for business production, portfolio performance, broker and client relationship management, underwriting strategy execution and portfolio management. The successful candidate will work closely with Casualty leadership to identify growth opportunities, support portfolio construction, manage market cycle dynamics and contribute to broader casualty initiatives.
In addition to their core General Liability and Workers Compensation responsibilities, the individual will have opportunities to contribute across other casualty lines, including Professional Liability and Cyber, supporting a diversified underwriting platform and long-term talent development objectives.
________________________________________
What will you do in this role?
• Originate, negotiate and underwrite General Liability and Workers Compensation treaty reinsurance business in compliance with AXIS Re underwriting guidelines, authority, risk appetite and portfolio objectives.
• Manage and grow a portfolio of business with accountability for underwriting performance, profitability and portfolio quality.
• Support the development and execution of underwriting strategy, business plans, portfolio construction initiatives and market engagement efforts.
• Build, maintain and expand broker and client relationships to support profitable business origination and long-term franchise value.
• Lead complex underwriting analyses and develop creative and effective reinsurance solutions that balance client needs with AXIS Re profitability objectives.
• Monitor portfolio performance and proactively identify emerging opportunities, trends and risks.
• Track legal, regulatory, economic and market developments affecting casualty lines and incorporate insights into underwriting decision-making.
• Participate in strategic discussions with brokers and clients regarding portfolio performance, market developments and emerging risk issues.
• Participate in underwriting audits, peer reviews, referral discussions and portfolio monitoring activities.
• Mentor and support the development of less experienced underwriting professionals.
• Collaborate closely with actuarial, claims, finance, operations and exposure management teams to support effective portfolio management and business decision making.
• Support underwriting initiatives across other casualty portfolios, including Professional Liability, where appropriate.
• Maintain a strong understanding of current issues affecting the insurance and reinsurance industries with respect to General Liability, Workers Compensation and broader casualty markets.
• Travel frequently to service clients and brokers and attend industry conferences.
You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.
________________________________________
About You
The successful candidate will be a highly regarded casualty reinsurance professional with a demonstrated track record of underwriting and managing profitable General Liability and Workers Compensation portfolios within a leading reinsurance, insurance or brokerage organization.
The individual will possess strong technical underwriting expertise combined with portfolio management, relationship management and business development capabilities. They will be comfortable engaging with senior client executives, brokers and internal stakeholders while contributing to portfolio management and strategic underwriting discussions.
Candidates should demonstrate the ability to balance underwriting judgment, portfolio management, client advocacy and commercial execution within a dynamic and evolving market environment.
We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table. While there are qualifications and experiences we believe are important for success, we are open to discussing how your individual background can contribute to our objectives and long-term success.
________________________________________
What you need to have
• Strong expertise in General Liability and Workers Compensation insurance and reinsurance markets.
• Demonstrated track record of profitable underwriting and portfolio management.
• Experience managing treaty reinsurance portfolios and contributing to underwriting strategy and business planning.
• Strong understanding of casualty loss trends, claims dynamics, policy coverage, treaty structures and emerging risks.
• Working knowledge of actuarial, pricing and portfolio management concepts.
• Ability to communicate technical underwriting concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including Executive Leadership.
• Strong communication, negotiation and influencing skills.
• Proven ability to develop and maintain productive broker, client and internal stakeholder relationships.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Sound judgment and decision-making skills when faced with ambiguity and competing priorities.
• Strong understanding of contract wording, policy forms and underwriting governance principles.
• Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities during peak renewal periods.
• Highly collaborative with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
• Ability to lead projects and influence outcomes across functions.
• Bachelor's Degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent professional experience.
________________________________________
What we prefer you to have
• CPCU, ARe, ARM or other relevant industry designation.
• Based in the New York metropolitan area.
• Minimum 8 years of casualty insurance or reinsurance underwriting and/or broking experience.
• Significant experience in General Liability and Workers Compensation underwriting.
• Experience working across multiple casualty classes, including Professional Liability and other specialty casualty lines.
• Strong industry relationships and reputation among leading brokers and insurers.
• Demonstrated portfolio management and business planning experience.
• Experience mentoring and developing junior underwriting talent.
• Ability to build dashboards and data models using Power BI.
• Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups and data analysis.
________________________________________
Role Factors
In this role, you will typically be required to:
• Travel frequently to visit clients, brokers and attend industry conferences.
• Be in the office (or visiting brokers/clients) three days per week.
• Attend broker and client events in the evenings and occasionally on weekends as required.
________________________________________
What We Offer

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $250,000 to $300,000 (NY). Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. 
In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate performance and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical coverage, retirement plans, health and wellness programs, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation and much more.
This role is Exempt for FLSA purposes.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Quick facts

  • Pay: $120,400 to $198,700 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Hartford, CT
  • Education: Bachelor's degree
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off

About this job

Software Engineer II role at Travelers Insurance in Hartford, Connecticut, focused on end-to-end engineering tasks including design, development, testing, and implementation. Position requires four years of programming experience with demonstrated expertise in cloud computing, API development, AI enablement with LLMs, and Infrastructure as Code.

Good fit if you have four years of software engineering experience, proficiency with Python or TypeScript, cloud platform experience, and familiarity with AI/LLM interactions.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$120,400.00 - $198,700.00

Target Openings

3

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers is seeking a Software Engineer II to join our organization as we grow and transform our Technology landscape. Individual will complete advanced end to end engineering tasks for specific system assignments including designing, developing, analyzing, configuring, testing, debugging, troubleshooting, documenting, health monitoring/alerting, and implementing based on user or system specifications, consulting with users to determine hardware, software or system functional specifications, managing interaction between the systems and other technical support areas and defining technical requirements and coordinating team resources to solve problems.

What Will You Do?

  • Perform analysis, design, development, and configuration functions (includes defining technical requirements) with a high degree of accuracy and speed, operating as an individual contributor to team goals.
  • Perform analysis, assessment and resolution for defects and incidents of advanced complexity and escalate appropriately.
  • Work independently to tackle well-scoped and loosely scoped problems.
  • Seek opportunities to expand technical knowledge and capabilities.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to less experienced employees.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Four years of programming/development experience.
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud computing (e.g., AWS (Serverless/EKS) and/or Azure)
  • Proficiency with API development (e.g., REST and/or GraphQL)
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) (e.g., Terraform, AWS CDK)
  • Working knowledge of frameworks/libraries (e.g., React.js and/or Node.js.)
  • Proven proficiency with scripting languages (e.g., JavaScript, TypeScript, and/or Python)
  • Understanding of and experience with eventing systems (e.g., Kafka)
  • Experience with relational databases, such as DB2, MySQL, and/or PostgreSQL
  • Familiarity with document databases, such as MongoDB and/or DynamoDB
  • Demonstrated experience with AI Enablement:
    • Experience in programmatic LLM interactions (e.g., Open AI, Anthropic, and MCP)
    • Experience in agentic design
    • Experience in prompt generation and refinement
  • Coding Assistant Usage (e.g., familiarity with Claude and GitHub Co-Pilot)
  • Experience with automated testing and unit testing (NUnit/XUnit, Moq, Jest, and Cypress)
  • Proficiency with source control (Git/GitHub)
  • Proven CI/CD experience  (CloudBees Jenkins, Jenkins Open Source, and/or Azure DevOps)
  • Understanding of OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC)
  • Experience with observability/monitoring platforms, such as Dynatrace, ELK stack, and OpenTelemetry
  • Familiarity and experience working with Agile / Scrum methodologies and tools (Jira and Rally)
  • Delivery - Intermediate delivery skills including the ability to estimate accurate timelines for tasks and deliver work at a steady, predictable pace to achieve commitments, contribute to the software design strategy and methodologies used to best meet the system requirements, consider and build for many different use cases, avoid over engineering, and ensure automation, deliver complete solutions but release them in small batches, and identify important tradeoffs and negotiate them.
  • Domain Expertise - Demonstrated track record of domain expertise including understanding technical concepts necessary to do the job effectively and aware of industry trends, demonstrate willingness, cooperation, and concern for business issues and priorities, and possess in depth knowledge of immediate systems worked on and some knowledge of adjacent systems.
  • Problem Solving - Strong problem solver who ensures solutions are built for the long term, is able to resolve new issues, recognizes mistakes using them as learning and teaching opportunities and consistently breaks down large problems into smaller, more manageable ones.
  • Communication - Strong communicator who possesses the ability to articulate information clearly and concisely with the business, document work in a clear, easy to follow manner, collaborate well with team members as both a mentor and mentee, take in vague requirements and ask the right questions to ensure clarification, offer feedback appropriately and effectively, seek out and receives constructive criticism well, listen when others are speaking and make space for colleagues to share their thoughts.
  • Leadership - Intermediate leadership skills with the ability to help create a safe environment for others to learn and grow as engineers and a proven track record of self-motivation in identifying opportunities and tracking team efforts.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience.
  • 4 additional years of software engineering experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $25.00 to $26.00 an hour
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Hartford, CT
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Ten-week summer internship in business insurance underwriting at Travelers, running early June to mid-August in Hartford, Connecticut. Interns complete training modules, project work, and gain exposure to commercial insurance underwriting with potential pathway to full-time Professional Development Program.

Good fit if you are pursuing a Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, risk management, or related field, with working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The hourly salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual hourly rate for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards. 

Salary Range

$25.00 - $26.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning in October. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. now and in the future. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role. Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Are you curious by nature? Do you enjoy managing relationships and employing your critical thinking skills? Underwriters perform the critical function of evaluating the acceptability of risk and determining appropriate pricing for insurance products. The Business Insurance (BI) Underwriting Professional Development Internship Program provides students with an amazing opportunity to gain exposure to this critical function at Travelers. The 10-week program (running from early June to mid-August) provides qualified interns with an excellent opportunity to gain first-hand commercial insurance underwriting experience, receive valuable on-the-job training, and learn more about the property and casualty insurance industry from industry professionals. Given that, we are seeking interns that are serious about entering the insurance industry and who are excited about the prospect of making underwriting their future career choice. This role is a potential pathway to our full-time Underwriting Professional Development Program (UPDP). Housing assistance is not provided.

What Will You Do?

  • Within your assigned business unit, each intern will be given a designated coach and be expected to:
  • Complete core assignments and training modules geared toward insurance and underwriting principles.
  • Participate and complete self-paced professional development courses in time management, presentation skills, and other key areas.
  • Complete challenging and meaningful project work over the course of this program at the discretion of your manager. You may work independently or with other interns and will be asked to present your findings to local leadership. Sample projects include a territorial risk assessment to determine profitability and underwriting opportunities as well as a business process analysis to determine underwriting gaps.
  • Learn to leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms with the ability to apply critical thinking to evaluate limitations related to quality and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs.
  • Learn about other areas at Travelers such as Risk Control, Claims, and related corporate functions. Interns may also engage in agency visits with Account Executives.
  • Participate in the Enterprise Internship experience which includes Executive Speaker Series, Networking events, and Rising Senior Intern Symposium.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Preferred cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Obtained or pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Liberal Arts (with business focus preferred), Management, Marketing, Risk Management and Insurance.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

What is a Must Have?

  • Pursuing or obtained a Bachelor's degree.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

We are committed to providing accommodation to persons with disabilities. If you require accommodation during the recruitment or interview process we will work with you to accommodate your needs.

Salary Range

$169,400.00 - $279,600.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Collaborative Environment, Transformational Projects, and a Growing Team!

As a member of AI and Emerging Technology Architecture, you'll be joining a strategic and collaborative team that is passionate about transforming our business and technology capabilities and paving the way for best-in-class solutions.

As a Lead Architect, you will collaborate with senior Technology and Business leaders and apply your deep technical proficiency and visionary thinking to architect AI systems that drive business value while maintaining ethical standards. In this role we will look to you to:
* Apply your hands-on expertise in AI/ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI systems - including autonomous agent design, multi-agent orchestration frameworks (LangChain, Strands, Crew AI), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Agent2Agent integration - to architect scalable, production-grade AI solutions across the enterprise
* Provide consulting expertise to division and domain architects, driving architecture alignment across lines of business and serving as a champion for establishing an enterprise AI solutions architecture practice
* Align AI platform capabilities to the strategic needs of business groups - spanning LLM selection and routing, RAG pipelines, memory systems, and tool/function-calling patterns - while promoting reusability, interoperability, and responsible AI design
* Help establish governance, risk, and control processes that ensure safe, compliant, and sustainable AI deployments, informed by frameworks such as the EU AI Act, GDPR, NAIC, and NIST AI RMF, and grounded in strong AI ethics and bias mitigation principles
* Demonstrate a strong passion for tracking and communicating the evolving AI platform roadmap - spanning foundation models, agentic frameworks, and emerging autonomous systems - while surfacing competitive landscape insights and highlighting opportunities and challenges that complement enterprise initiatives
* Bring strong collaboration, communication, and mentoring skills to bridge complex AI concepts for non-technical stakeholders, build consensus across diverse teams, and foster a knowledge-sharing culture within the architecture community
Let us help you accelerate your career as we grow our team and transform our business!

What Will You Do?

  • Scope:
  • Responsible for architecture for multiple technology and or/ business segments/domains for a single business unit.
  • Technical Execution:
  • Define and lead technology proof of concepts to ensure feasibility of architecture solutions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to capitalize on technology advances through analysis of key industry and technology trends to assess potential impact on the enterprise.
  • Drive continuous technology transformation to minimize technical debt.
  • Conduct hands-on prototyping of new technology solutions.
  • Partner with Technology and Business leadership to ensure proper alignment with technology direction and execution of proof of technologies.
  • Strategic Accountability:
  • Provide strong thought leadership in pursuit of modern architecture principles and technology modernization.
  • Engage with the senior leadership within Technology and Business to develop architecture priorities and direction to enable business imperatives and gain buy-in.
  • Prepare and deliver communications to convey architectural direction.
  • Drive strategic relationships and champion organizational buy-in.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Technical Expertise & Education:
  • Bachelor's degree in technology-related field or equivalent, with 8 to 10 years of architecture experience.
  • Advanced level architecture and recent hands-on strong engineering experience with modern technologies.
  • Successful execution of complex, large scale technology strategies.
  • Leadership & Influence:
  • Advanced leadership skills with the ability to leverage cross-functional networks to collaborate with architecture and engineering leaders on problem-solving, build company-wide credibility, prioritize critical architectural challenges, and strengthen the Architecture organization through knowledge sharing, mentoring, and creating development opportunities for team members.
  • Strategic & Business Acumen:
  • Extensive experience working in an agile operational model.
  • Advanced experience supporting transformational change. Able to adjust plans, priorities and strategies in response to changing circumstances.
  • Experience developing technology target states and roadmaps that align to short- and long-term business goals.
  • Insurance technology experience preferred.
  • Strong understanding of value creation and business capability models.
  • Strong knowledge of the insurance industry.
  • Advanced experience identifying and analyzing current/future problems and opportunities, evaluating information to understand root causes, and exploring alternative solutions for effective decision-making.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively with colleagues to achieve mutually responsible results.
  • Extensive experience exercising sound judgment, making decisions and committing to a position.
  • Advanced and effective verbal, written and listening communication skills.
  • Proven track record defining scalable, production-grade AI systems, including distributed and parallel processing architectures
  • Hands-on expertise in AI/ML development and deployment, with deep knowledge of ML algorithms, neural network architectures, and optimization techniques
  • Strong mathematical foundation in linear algebra, statistics, and probability theory, supporting rigorous model design and evaluation
  • Experience with MLOps & AI Ops practices and CI/CD pipelines for AI/ML systems
  • Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools such as Claude Enterprise/CLI/Code, OpenAI Codex, and GitHub Copilot
  • Hands-on experience with Generative AI foundation - including transformer architectures, LLMs, diffusion models, VAEs, GANs, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and RLHF
  • Experience with multimodal AI systems
  • Experience building autonomous AI systems with planning and reasoning capabilities, including reinforcement learning and decision-making frameworks
  • Hands-on experience with agentic patterns - tool use, function calling, API integration, memory systems, RAG, vector databases, and multi-agentic orchestration 
  • Hands-on or working experience with agent orchestration frameworks (LangChain, Strands, Crew AI) and protocols including MCP and Agent2Agent
  • Deep experience with cloud AI services AWS Bedrock including AgentCore (optional: Azure Foundry/Agent 365, or GCP/Gemini AI), including SaaS AI and agentic capabilities
  • Knowledge of AI ethics, bias mitigation, responsible AI practices, and regulatory frameworks (EU AI Act, GDPR)
  • Experience with AI governance frameworks and model risk management

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience.
  • 7 additional years of architecture/software engineering experience.
  • 2 years of technical leadership experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

Job.JobDescription:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. Salary Range

$132,800.00 - $219,100.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

The Sourcing and Supplier Management (S&SM) team drives enterprise-wide sourcing strategy, supplier governance, and supplier risk management across Travelers' technology and operations supplier portfolio. This multi-disciplinary team manages Travelers' global sourcing and supplier relationships, and is accountable for implementing strategic sourcing models that optimize supplier relationships and deliver measurable business outcomes.

This Senior Director leads S&SM's Sourcing Risk & Operations function, managing a team responsible for supplier risk reviews, business continuity and disaster recovery (BC/DR) planning, offshore development center (ODC) management, site audits, and various other supplier operations and governance functions. The Risk & Operations team is shifting from a reactive, process-facilitation model to a proactive, portfolio-based approach to supplier risk management - this role is accountable for leading that transition and for building the frameworks, cadence, and team capability needed to deliver a holistic, enterprise view and approach to risk management for these suppliers.

Additionally, this role will play a key role in expanding Sourcing and Supplier Management's strategic partnership role with Tech & Ops platform and product partners, enhancing governance frameworks and relationship management protocols. Additionally, the role encompasses developing and maintaining executive briefing materials that provide leadership visibility into strategic vendor partnerships and performance outcomes.

This senior director role is also a key member of the extended S&SM leadership team, which is responsible for developing and executing Tech & Ops sourcing strategies that align supplier selection, relationship management, and strategic sourcing models with enterprise objectives. The position partners closely with Line of Business Technology & Operations leadership and cross-functional stakeholders - including SLT/ELT, Procurement, Legal, and Workforce Management. Leveraging Travelers' scale and strategic positioning, this role partners with technology and business leaders on managed services models, sourcing strategies, and supplier selection aligned to workforce planning initiatives.

This position manages a team.

What Will You Do?

  • Supplier Risk Program Leadership & Proactive Risk Monitoring: Own end-to-end supplier risk management for the Tech&Ops strategic supplier portfolio - including risk reviews, due diligence, and ongoing monitoring. Lead the team's transition from reactive, case-by-case process facilitation to proactive, portfolio-based oversight that gives S&SM and Tech & Ops leadership a holistic, enterprise view of supplier risk exposure. Drive continuous improvement to how the work is completed, emphasizing value-add activities and approaches while reducing reactive, manual work wherever possible.
  • Portfolio Design and Management: Develop a portfolio-based approach to Tech&Ops strategic supplier population, including a framework for determining which suppliers are in-scope, how suppliers align to portfolios, what level of governance/operational support are required for each supplier, and how to align portfolios to team members. Lead the growth of the team's role in ongoing supplier governance - identifying opportunities to add value, deepen the team's knowledge of the supplier's footprint, and partner to help business stakeholders drive the most value from each supplier relationship. Leverage S&SM's mature professional services sourcing (GSO) program to drive the development of a strategic, substantive approach to Tech&Ops non-GSO strategic providers.
  • Executive Briefings: Lead the development, maintenance and continued improvement of briefing materials for senior executives within Tech&Ops, in partnership with stakeholders across the organization, ranging from the supplier's executive sponsor to leaders responsible for day-to-day operations with the supplier, to procurement, finance and legal. Ensure materials are comprehensive, provide a holistic view of the total supplier footprint, and include timely, actionable information; additionally, prepare distilled talking points as required to summarize key aspects of each supplier relationship to support senior executive meetings.
  • BC/DR and Incident Management: Manage business continuity and disaster recovery planning and readiness across S&SM's strategic suppliers, including partnering with BC/DR stakeholders to plan and facilitate annual tabletop testing, drafting/disseminating communications to strategic suppliers in connection with incident management/DR events, and identify opportunities to improve BC/DR preparedness.
  • ODC Management, Site Audits & Other Operational Controls: Oversee oversight of Travelers' offshore development center footprint, evaluating site changes - capacity shifts, technology updates, operational control changes - for risk and operational impact, and directing site audits toward the areas of greatest control exposure. Own SOC review outcomes for strategic professional services partners, assessing findings for substantive risk and driving suppliers to remediate gaps rather than simply tracking review completion.
  • Team Leadership: Lead and manage the Sourcing Risk & Operations team, setting direction, priorities, and performance expectations. Build team capability - through coaching, role clarity, and tooling - to support the shift to portfolio-based risk management.
  • Maintain substantive, current knowledge of strategic suppliers' delivery capabilities, fit within our priorities and roadmaps and competitive positioning.
  • Serve as a credible, technically substantive counterpart to supplier leadership and delivery teams - able to engage directly rather than operating solely through account managers or relationship cadence.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Procurement, Legal, Workforce Management, and Tech & Ops leadership to align supplier risk and governance frameworks to enterprise objectives.
  • Participate in the Enterprise Supplier Management Steering Committee and represent Risk & Operations in enterprise governance forums.
  • Define and consult on risk measurement strategies, scorecards, and reporting cadence across the organization.
  • Maintain awareness of supplier risk indicators and emerging industry/regulatory trends, surfacing anomalies and risks proactively to senior leadership rather than waiting for escalation.
  • Support ad hoc analytical requests and special projects aligned to S&SM's strategic priorities.
  • Serve as the point of resolution for supplier risk issues, audit findings, or governance gaps prior to leadership review.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Typically 9+ years of Finance, Audit, Procurement or Sales/Servicing related experience.
  • Master's or other advanced degree.
  • Thorough knowledge of project management processes.
  • Thorough knowledge of business law, legal contracts and various financial issues including cash flow and working capital.
  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency of eSourcing and Ariba procurement applications.
  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency of MS Access, Excel, PowerPoint and Word.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
  • 8 years of supplier management or related experience.
  • Advanced communication skills, advanced computer literacy and ability to analyze and resolve complex issues.
  • Ability to successfully operate in a team and in a fast-paced environment.
  • Requires a demonstrated record of initiative, problem solving, and change management.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

  • Evaluate and determine the most appropriate disposal method for salvage assets in accordance with applicable state titling laws and regulations. Establish follow-up activities to ensure prompt and efficient sale of the asset.

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role.

What Will You Do?

  • Build and operationalize complex data solutions, correct problems, apply transformations, and recommend data cleansing/quality solutions.
  • Design data solutions.
  • Analyze sources to determine value and recommend data to include in analytical processes.
  • Incorporate core data management competencies including data governance, data security and data quality.
  • Collaborate within and across teams to support delivery and educate end users on data products/analytic environment.
  • Perform data and system analysis, assessment and resolution for defects and incidents of moderate complexity and correct as appropriate.
  • Test data movement, transformation code, and data components.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree in STEM related field or equivalent.
  • Six years of related experience.
  • Experience in data transformation using the dbt tool and/or Databricks PySpark.
  • Experience building data pipelines using AWS cloud services and Databricks .
  • Experience using AI tools and solutions to improve productivity.
  • Strong skills in writing complex SQL queries.
  • Experience interacting with business partners on requirements, design, and solutions.
  • Proficient use of tools, techniques, and manipulation including Cloud platforms, programming languages, and an understanding of software engineering practices.
  • The ability to deliver work at a steady, predictable pace to achieve commitments, decompose work assignments into small batch releases, and contribute to tradeoff and negotiation discussions.
  • Demonstrated track record of domain expertise including the ability to understand technical concepts and possess in-depth knowledge of immediate systems worked on.
  • Proven problem solving skills including debugging skills, allowing you to determine source of issues in unfamiliar code or systems and the ability to recognize and solve repetitive problems.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact with team members and business partners.
  • Leadership - Intermediate leadership skills with a proven track record of self-motivation in identifying personal growth opportunities.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience.

When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
