Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$43,200.00 - $71,300.00

Target Openings

2

What Is the Opportunity?

As an Associate Claim Rep, Auto Express, you will receive comprehensive training in claim handling, customer service, and policy interpretation while working alongside experienced claim professionals. This position focuses on developing your skills and knowledge to successfully manage personal insurance claims involving various types of automobiles and property damage. This role involves frequent customer interactions through telephone and written communications. This program is typically 8-12 months and upon successful completion of this program, you will have the skills needed to handle claims independently and progress toward full claims handling responsibility.

What Will You Do?

  • Actively participate in structured training classes covering insurance policies, specific claim processes, systems, and procedures, including virtual, classroom, and on-the-job training.
  • Assess coverage to determine compensability.
  • Investigate by gathering information from policyholders and claimants to verify the facts of loss.
  • Assess coverage and bring claim to resolution with accurate payment in a timely manner.
  • Communicate and apprise all parties regarding claim status.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) to comply with state and Travelers' requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Previous internship or work experience in customer service or insurance.
  • Willingness to obtain an active adjuster license where required by state law.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); willingness to learn claims management systems.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions within established authority.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for insureds and claimants.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Basic conflict resolution skills; willingness to learn techniques for facilitating productive discussions and negotiations.
  • Demonstrate openness to continuous learning.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED and one year of customer service experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.

  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

About this job

Insurance Sales Associate supporting a sales agent in new business sales and customer retention at Comparion Insurance in Brentwood, Tennessee. In-office role involving consultative sales techniques, customer contact, and community prospecting. Training and licensing support provided.

Good fit if you have 1-2 years of sales experience, strong communication skills, and a state Property and Casualty or Life insurance license or willingness to obtain one.

Full job description


Description

We are looking for an Insurance Sales Associate to join our team in our Brentwood, TN office. This is an in-office position.

Were Hiring Immediately!

As an Insurance Sales Associate, you will work alongside with and support a Comparion Insurance Sales Agent in profitable growth through new business sales and customer retention. Your ability to listen and empathize are key in being the initial contact for our customers. Success in this role will require building a strong local network and in-person relationship in the community.

Working for Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company, means working for a company thats committed to advancing an inclusive environment. We do that through leadership development programs aimed at advancing, engaging, and retaining under-represented talent and our Employee Resource Groups, which strengthen our inclusive workplace, enhance personal development, and provide ways for employees to connect, learn and engage.

Ready to find out what it means to work for an agency that is backed by Liberty Mutuala Fortune 100 company thats committed to putting people first, acting responsibly and making things better?

Responsibilities:

  • Utilize consultative sales techniques to prospect and initiate new business sales.
  • Assists in the processing of new business, including contacting customers to finalize sales and service transactions.
  • Identifies cross selling opportunities for Sales Agent.
  • Contributes to and executes a marketing plan with the Sales Agent.
  • Identifies mass marketing prospects through existing book of business and community prospecting opportunities.
  • Meet monthly goals for new business sales.
  • Completes follow-ups on new policies in order to keep retention level high and capitalize cross-selling opportunities.
  • Coordinates activities with other departments to ensure quality customer service
  • Acts as initial contact in addressing customer concerns regarding establishment of policies and new account status.
  • Unlicensed candidates will be enrolled in a new hire training class once they begin working for Comparion. The training includes a licensing training program in which Comparion covers the cost of training materials and exam fees.
Qualifications
  • High School Degree
  • 1-2 years of relevant sales experience preferred
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to handle common objections and educate customers in a consultative manner
  • Demonstrated self-starter, motivated to learn and grow in a professional sales organization
  • Professional business acumen, strong presence and confidence
  • Resourceful team player that can contribute and accept new ideas
  • A state insurance licenseor willingness to earn one with training and supportin Property & Casualty, and Life
About Us

Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

About this job

Sell auto, home, life, and specialty insurance products to individuals and families using a consultative approach. Base salary plus unlimited commission and renewal income, with training, licensing support, and benefits provided from day one.

Good fit if you are self-motivated, relationship-focused, outgoing, tech-savvy, and comfortable in customer-facing sales roles.

Full job description


Description

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, youll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed no prior insurance experience required.

This is an in-office position in Charleston, Wheeling , Morgantown, WV

What youll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who Were Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive you follow through and do what you say youll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing youre comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy youre able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

Build a career for yourself, not by yourself. Launch a rewarding insurance sales career today.

Description

Training is a critical component to your success and that success starts with reliable attendance. Attendance and active engagement during training is mandatory

  • Manages, investigates and resolves assigned Property Contents claims under limited supervision.
  • Compiles and values inventory of damaged/lost contents associated with property claims.
  • Provides policyholders with quality customer service.
  • May assist Claims Representatives with in-person inspection/policyholder contact where necessary.
  • Responsible for claims handling personal property losses to include large loss.
  • Works in concert with large loss adjuster for scheduling, inventorying, adjustment and relocation assistance.
  • Performs on-site inventory inspection and specific detail capture (50% minimum on-site) to provide to policyholder for pricing.
  • Develops expert list/websites for various product categories. Utilizes internet VIA/Insurer's World/vendors for pricing and/or validation. Documents the file accordingly.
  • Provides quality customer service. Provides insured with policy information to include coverage, limitations, replacement or ACV options.
  • Works with and may coordinate a number of vendor services such as contractors, emergency repair, cleaning services and various replacement services.
  • May assist on files handled by Claims Reps with in-person inspection/policyholder contact when needed.
  • Attends product seminars/shows to build personal property expertise.
  • May be called upon for catastrophe duty
Qualifications
  • Strong written and oral communications skills required.
  • Good interpersonal, analytical and negotiation skills required.
  • Customer service experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of coverages provided within various homeowner policies.
  • Experience in interior design, electronics, appliances, antique-collectibles, clothing and furniture retail preferred.
  • Bachelors degree or equivalent experience and 18-24 months of directly related experience.

Job.JobTitle: Sr Analyst/Associate, Energy & Infrastructure - Liberty Mutual Investments
Job.JobDescription:
Description

The Company

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is the investment firm for Liberty Mutual Group (Liberty) andis responsible forpowering Libertys strategy amid profound change in global capital markets. With deep expertise in fixed income, equity, and alternative strategies,LMI invests $120+ billion (as of 12/31/2025) of capital globally,taking a long-term approach across its integrated platform and has a team of over 350 investment, finance, and operations professionals located in Boston, MA, and New York, NY.

LMI has a clear purpose: build enduring businesses side-by-side with our partners, drive economic growth, and generate superior risk-adjusted returns that power Libertys strategy and secure its promises.Weoffer the best of both worlds the look and feel of a boutique investment firm with the reputation and financial strength of a global leader. As the investment firm of a mutual with long-term capital, LMI has a single client mandate. This gives us the freedom to focus on what we do best.

Our portfolio spans a broad spectrum of public and private investments, and we are committed to expanding our capabilities and our toolkit in support of our mission. We invest across diverse asset classes, financial structures, and industries, including real estate, digital infrastructure, healthcare, renewable energy, and technologywith the aim of creating value and powering innovation. We pride ourselves on our extensive network of mutually beneficial partnerships, and we use our substantial influence, capital, and energy to drive towards a better future.#LMI #LI-LMI

The Position

The Energy & Infrastructure (E&I) team,part of the $22 billion Global Alternative Markets portfolio, is seeking a Senior Analyst / Associate as the mandate executes on its next phase of growth. The strategy invests holistically across the infrastructure landscape including opportunities in:

(i) traditional energy

(ii) digital infrastructure

(iii) diversified infrastructure

(iv) renewables

(v) energy transition

(vi) services and software into the infrastructure ecosystem

E&I's mandate is to deliver compelling, risk-adjusted returns featuring strong downside protection and asymmetric upside. The team leverages subject matter expertise, ability to underwrite complexity, speed to execute, and a peer-oriented go-to-market strategy to establish E&I as a differentiated capital partner of choice. This hire will be an integral member of the E&I team with significant ownership of the investment process across thematic research, underwriting, deal execution and ongoing portfolio management. The individual hired will be centrally involved in the execution of direct/co-investment transactions as well as primary fund commitments and relationship management.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute as an integral member of the E&I Equity team to invest in opportunities across the infrastructure landscape.
  • Manage investment diligence from start to finish, performing comprehensive analysis and developing recommendations on directs investments, co-investments and fund commitments.
  • Effectively screen opportunities, identifying and succinctly communicating the most relevant investment highlights and key risk considerations.
  • Lead the creation of investment committee materials (complete with financial projections) and support in presenting the teams investment recommendations to internal investment committees.
  • Assist in the evaluation, structuring, and negotiation of economic and legal terms.
  • Actively monitor existing investments, maintain external relationships with partners, and provide detailed updates to team members as needed.
  • Contribute to regular engagement with external stakeholders and market participants to support the E&I teams origination goals and enhance market presence.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with additional LMI teams including Legal, Finance, Accounting, and Risk Management to execute transactions and manage the portfolio.

This is a range posting between a Senior Analyst and Associate position; level will be determined by hiring team based on experience.

Qualifications
  • 3-6+ years of relevant work experience in energy and infrastructure investment banking, consulting or investing.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and evaluate transaction risks, value-creation opportunities and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable understanding investment recommendations, and addressing questions from, an investment committee.
  • Detail-oriented, accurate, and capable of producing consistent work product.
  • Strong interpersonal skills; comfortable with consensus decision-making and working in a collaborative, team-based environment.
  • Self-motivated and creative with the ability to work independently; flexibility to take on additional responsibilities depending on the needs of the business.
  • Proven ability to interact and build relationships with internal and external investment professionals and executives.
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and time-sensitive deliverables with a high degree of quality and accuracy.
  • Strong interest in energy and infrastructure with a passion for investing.
  • Minimum of a Bachelors degree required
  • Demonstrates strong AI literacy and uses AI-enabled tools to enhance speed, accuracy, and insight generation while maintaining sound judgment and compliance with governance standards.

Job Description: Senior Tax Associate

About the Team

The North America Tax team supports tax reporting, planning, and compliance across the U.S., Canada, and Bermuda. The team partners with Finance, Legal, HR, Underwriting, Operations, and external advisors to ensure accurate reporting and strong governance. The Senior Tax Associate plays a key role in delivering timely and reliable tax outcomes.

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

This role strengthens AXIS' global tax function by supporting accurate tax reporting, maintaining compliance across multiple jurisdictions, and improving processes that support financial integrity. The Senior Tax Associate helps ensure AXIS meets regulatory requirements while supporting business decisions with clear and reliable tax insights.

What will you be doing in this role?

  • Supporting day‑to‑day tax activities for the U.S., Canada, and Bermuda

  • Assisting with quarterly GAAP and STAT tax provisions under ASC 740 and SSAP 101

  • Partnering with international tax teams to align global provisions with U.S. GAAP

  • Helping consolidate global tax calculations for management reporting

  • Supporting internal and external reporting, including Board materials and annual tax footnotes

  • Coordinating compliance activities across U.S., Canadian, and Bermuda tax regimes

  • Supporting withholding tax documentation, including residency certificates and FATCA

  • Performing tax research to interpret authoritative guidance

  • Responding to audits and notices across multiple jurisdictions

  • Maintaining accurate process documentation and contributing to internal training

You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.

About you:

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.

What we're looking for from you:

  • Possess a CPA or Tax LLM

  • Bring at least three years of tax experience in public accounting or a multinational company with extensive experience with ASC 740, account reconciliation, tax compliance and return-to-provision analysis

  • Demonstrate strong technical tax knowledge across U.S. federal, state, and indirect taxes

  • Demonstrate familiarity with BEAT, Pillar II and other international tax concepts

  • Apply knowledge of SOX 404 requirements

  • Use advanced Microsoft Office skills

  • Communicate clearly and build strong relationships across teams

  • Manage competing priorities in a fast‑paced environment

  • Show strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with attention to detail

Role factors:

In this role, you will typically be required to:

  • Be in the office 3 days per week

  • Travel within the U.S. and internationally as needed

What we offer:

You will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid annual leave, and much more.

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $90,000 to $110,000. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance.

Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is exempt for FLSA purposes.

Job Description: Strategic Delivery Lead – COO

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

The Strategic Delivery Lead – COO oversees the internal COO of strategic initiatives spanning operations, technology, and data & analytics. This role provides a clear, integrated view of delivery and helps ensure that initiatives are prioritized, governed, and executed in support of COO business objectives.

Key responsibilities include maintaining cross-functional delivery roadmaps, managing budgets, risks, dependencies, and initiative-level reporting, and ensuring alignment across operations, technology, and data & analytics priorities. The role operates in a matrixed environment, partnering with business leaders, Product Owners, Value Stream Leads, Release Train Engineers, Application Delivery, Data & Analytics, AI, and COE teams to shape, launch, and oversee COO initiatives.

What will you do in this role?

Drive and guide strategy for COO projects in collaboration with Business Leaders, Product Owners, Value Stream Leads, Release Train Engineers, and delivery partners, ensuring alignment across operations, technology, and data & analytics objectives. Specifically, they will execute:

Strategic Alignment: In support of COO leadership, the Strategic Delivery Lead ensures that operations, technology, and data & analytics initiatives align with enterprise priorities, COO objectives, and measurable business outcomes.

Governance and Management: The Strategic Delivery Lead manages governance, financials, delivery status, dependencies, and reporting across COO projects, including budgets, actuals, Objectives & Key Results (OKR) attainment, delivery metrics, and other KPIs.

Risk Management: The Strategic Delivery Lead identifies and mitigates risks that could impact success.

Stakeholder Communication: The Strategic Delivery Lead maintains clear communication with stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment on goals and progress.

Resource Allocation: The Strategic Delivery Lead supports prioritization and allocation of resources required to deliver COO initiatives, including work that spans operations teams, technology delivery teams, data & analytics teams, and initiatives not supported by Agile Teams.

Participating in PI Planning: The Strategic Delivery Lead actively participates in Program Increment (PI) Planning, identifying cross-Value Stream dependencies, helping set priorities, and mitigating impediments.

You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.

About You:

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.

What you need to have:

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration or a related field.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean Six Sigma certifications, Agile delivery certifications (e.g. SAFe SPC, SAFe Lean Portfolio Management, PMI-ACP) , or other relevant certifications are advantageous.
  • Proven experience in strategic delivery leadership, portfolio or project management with a track record of successfully leading and delivering large-scale projects in a matrixed environment.
  • Proven experience in the insurance industry preferred.
  • Experience overseeing cross-functional progrmas that include business operations, technology delivery, data & analytics, process improvement, and transformation initiatives.

Critical competencies:

  • Ability to think strategically and align project goals with the overall business objectives of the COO organization, including operations, technology, and data & analytics priorities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities, including strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and manage ambiguity.
  • Keen attention to detail to ensure project plans and deliverables are accurately developed and maintained.
  • Strong collaborative skills to work effectively with various teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to balance structure and flexibility, with a focus on results and accountability.
  • Strong executive presence and credibility, with experience dealing with senior business leaders.
  • Effective influencing, negotiating, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate and manage multiple priorities.
  • Proficiency in using AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, improve analysis, streamline communication, and support effective delivery management.
  • Proficiency in project management tools and software platforms.

Role Factors:

In this role, you will typically be required to:

  • Embrace the hybrid culture offered at AXIS, you need to be in office 3 days per week.
  • Much of the work involves using computers for data entry, analysis, and communication. Comfort with prolonged screen time is necessary.
  • While much of the work may be desk-bound, there might be occasions requiring mobility within the office environment, such as attending meetings or accessing filing systems.

What we offer:

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $160,000 -$180,000. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. Job.JobTitle: Consultant Leave of Absence Case Manager
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $57,900 to $95,600 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Hartford, CT
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off

About this job

Manage leave of absence cases for US, Canada, and Europe employees at Travelers Insurance HR Shared Services. Handle case administration, compliance reviews, medical documentation evaluation, and process improvements across multiple leave types.

Good fit if you have two years of benefits or leave of absence case management experience and strong communication skills.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$57,900.00 - $95,600.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

The Employee Services Unit (ESU) is a global HR Shared Services center that provides customer support, program design and operational excellence across a diverse spectrum of HR domains: Benefits, Contact Center, Leave of Absence, Learning, Onboarding, Payroll, Staffing, Talent Management, Work Arrangement, and Workforce Data Management. The ESU is a foundational component of the Travelers HR operating model supporting the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland and various subsidiaries. As a part of the Leave of Absence (LOA) team, the Consultant applies understanding and a high-level knowledge of Travelers leave of absence policies, procedures, and the absence management system, and utilizes that to ensure leaves are handled properly from a compliance, process, and experience standpoint. As a Consultant, you will manage all aspects related to leave of absence cases for US, Canada, and Europe (STD/LTD/USESRRA/personal leaves/etc.), assisting with leave administration items (employment verifications, reports, payroll balancing, work comp checks, etc.), completing daily audits for leave and payroll entries, reviewing medical documentation to determine FMLA approval, researching and resolving employee leave of absence related questions, and assisting in training leave of absence team when needed. You will also create and maintain process documents for Europe and Canada leaves. This role serves as a subject matter expert in all aspects of leave of absence for US, Europe, and Canada employees and uses knowledge to identify and implement process improvements within and across COE's.

What Will You Do?

  • Consult with and advise employees on eligibility, provisions, and other matters related to leave of absence (LOA) for all countries (US, Canada, Ireland, UK).
  • Respond to cases forwarded by the Employee Services Unit call center, responding to employees and/or managers regarding their cases via email or phone. Provide support to other Human Resources departments on leave-related issues.
  • Collaborate with Employee Relations, Human Resources Business Partners, managers, employees, and other functional areas including Legal Services, Benefits, Employee Services Unit, Workers Compensation, etc. on complex leave-related issues.
  • Regularly review and maintain International process documentation in partnership with manager and the Benefits team, as needed.
  • Perform complex leave and pay-related calculations and International billing, as needed.
  • Create and distribute employee eligibility and determination notices for all leave types, ensuring they meet all federal and state compliance requirements.
  • Complete daily audits for LOA team, verifying that all appropriate steps have been taken from both a leave and pay standpoint, and recommend new and/or improved LOA processes and/or cost-saving measures. May update and document LOA-related administrative processes.
  • Review provided medical documentation to evaluate and determine approval period for family medical leave requests.
  • Ensure all reports (both US and International) are completed accurately and on time.
  • Provide support to LOA managers and other team members and complete all other LOA related tasks as assigned.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's and/or associate degree or equivalent.
  • Three or more years of benefits or Leave of Absence experience.
  • Experience with managing leaves of absences.
  • Experience using benefits administration software and Workday.
  • Customer service oriented, strong verbal and written communication skills, results driven, excellent organization, and prioritization skills.
  • Excel, Word, and related software package skills.
  • Strong attention to detail with an execution focus and the ability to multi-task with multiple competing priorities.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills and the ability to thoroughly analyze information and make timely, practical decisions and recommendations.
  • Ability to understand complex payroll calculations and a strong understanding of how system interactions impact pay.
  • Able to work well in a team environment-establishes and maintains effective working relationships and highly ethical and can maintain confidentiality.
  • CEBS exams and designations a plus.

What is a Must Have?

  • Two years of benefits, leave of absence, case management experience, including experience communicating benefits plan details with employees.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$132,800.00 - $219,100.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As a Senior Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to use your legal expertise and litigation skills to independently handle a caseload of higher exposure cases and more complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim matters depending on line of business. You will deliver optimal results for Travelers' insured customers and will mentor less experienced attorneys.

Venues for this role typical cover Southwest & Central Georgia including but not limited to Macon, Columbus, and Warner Robbins.

What Will You Do?

  • In the independent handling of a caseload of higher exposure cases and most complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim depending on line of business, your responsibilities will include:
  • Leverage trial experience to apply effective use of litigation skills and techniques to try cases to verdict or negotiate resolution.
  • Conduct advanced legal research and demonstrate strong and persuasive legal writing and presentation skills.
  • Draft substantive pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery and other legal documents.
  • Attend court events, depositions, and other appointments independently.
  • Provide in-depth, substantive case analysis and recommendations to insured clients and Claim partners on file handling strategies.
  • Collaborates with expert witnesses and consultants to develop case strategies, evaluate technical matters, and prepare compelling testimony for litigation.
  • Build and maintain strong internal and external client and business partner relationships, including independent responsibility for managing client and business partner relationships.
  • Provide internal and external training, seminars and legal updates to insured clients and Claim partners.
  • Provide leadership through mentoring other attorneys and legal support staff.
  • Initiate special projects and identifies other opportunities to support office goals/business needs.
  • Fully and effectively utilize available technology, case management system and automation.
  • Travel as required to meet business needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 7+ years of insurance defense litigation experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Strong aptitude for trying cases to a jury; proven track record of litigating jury trials, with a history of successful courtroom outcomes
  • Demonstrates strong technical knowledge in the practice area(s) and the ability to effectively communicate complex information on litigated matters to diverse audiences.
  • Advanced oral and written advocacy skills, with a demonstrated track record of summary judgment and/or appellate successs.
  • Possesses in-depth knowledge of the bench, bar, local jurisdictional practices, adversaries.
  • Excels in fostering collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners to deliver exceptional customer service
  • Demonstrates strong leadership through mentoring and influencing skills.
  • Exercises sound decision making and possesses advanced negotiation skills.
  • Effectively manages multiple priorities with an attention to detail, sense of urgency & responsiveness.
  • Possesses a flexible and agile mindset with a willingness to take on new challenges as needs evolve.

What is a Must Have?

  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent International legal degree; graduate of an accredited law school.
  • 7 years experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Active license in good standing to practice law in the state(s) in which representation is required.
  • Regularly handles hearings, trials, dispositive motion arguments, depositions, or other court proceedings and has the ability to transport to those meetings. Valid driver's license required depending on the location.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

About this job

Senior underwriter managing excess casualty accounts for commercial lines, partnering with agents and brokers to assess complex risk and drive profitability. Role involves independent underwriting decisions, client relationship management, and travel to meet external partners.

Good fit if you have six to eight years of commercial underwriting experience, CPCU designation, and strong negotiation skills.

What Is the Opportunity?

Excess Casualty offers protection against unforeseen catastrophic losses where additional layers of insurance are needed-from devastating auto accidents to product liability claims, which can result in multimillion-dollar lawsuits. The Account Executive Officer (AEO), Excess Casualty will partner with agents and brokers to provide coverage for new and renewal business based on customers' needs. This role is seen as a technical resource. As an AEO, you are decisive, detail-oriented, and know how to build relationships internally and externally to drive results. Your ability to independently assess complex risk and sell our products in challenging markets will contribute to the profitability and success of Travelers.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage the profitability, growth, and retention of an assigned book of business.
  • Underwriter and skillfully negotiate complex customer accounts to minimize risk and maximize profitability.
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with internal partners within the business unit and across the enterprise to create sales plans and identify cross-selling opportunities.
  • Foster and maintain relationships with external partners by regularly meeting in person with agents and brokers to market and sell Travelers products with a goal of writing and retaining accounts consistent with our risk appetite. Must be able to travel to such meetings.
  • Identify and capture new business opportunities using consultative marketing and sales skills.
  • Independently develop and execute agency sales plans and frequently partner with your Managing Director (MD) to develop region/group sales plans.
  • May assist in the training and mentoring of less experienced Account Executives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Six to eight years of relevant underwriting experience with experience in commercial lines.
  • Deep knowledge of commercial lines products, the regulatory environment, and the local insurance market.
  • Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to proactively identify underwriting, marketing, or financial challenges and analyze available information to make timely decisions in alignment with our risk appetite.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to successfully negotiate in difficult situations with agents and brokers.
  • CPCU designation.

What is a Must Have?

  • Four years of underwriting, claim, operations, risk assessment, actuarial, sales, product, or finance experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $55,200 to $91,100 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Overland Park, KS
  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off

About this job

Handle auto physical damage claims from start to finish for Travelers Insurance in Overland Park, Kansas. Evaluate coverage, investigate claims, coordinate with appraisers and repair facilities, and negotiate settlements for multi-vehicle cases with unclear liability.

Good fit if you have one year of auto claim handling experience and strong communication and organizational skills.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. What Is the Opportunity?

As a Claim Rep, Auto Damage, you will support our customers and third-party claimants through the claims process when they experience vehicle damage. In this role, you will serve as a trusted resource and will deliver exceptional customer service by providing clear explanations of policies and coverage options while investigating and evaluating claims to ensure accurate payments.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage auto physical damage claims from first notice of loss through resolution and settlement, handling low to moderate complexity cases, including total loss evaluations and vehicle repair oversight. Types of claims are typically multi-vehicle (2 or more cars) auto damage with unclear liability and no injuries.
  • Evaluate and analyze policy terms, conditions, and exclusions to determine coverage, liability, and damage; negotiate equitable settlements within your authority.
  • Coordinate and partner with appraisal team(s) and repair facilities to obtain necessary information and ensure thorough accurate damage assessments and timely claim resolution.
  • Leverage all internal and external resources to conduct thorough investigations to gather all relevant facts accurately document findings in the claim management system and maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Determine settlement amounts based upon appraisal estimate, negotiate and convey claim settlements within authority limits to insureds and claimants. As appropriate, write denial letters, Reservation of Rights and other necessary correspondence to insureds and claimants.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, representatives, and internal stakeholders.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) to comply with state and Travelers' requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Two years of auto claim handling experience.
  • Active adjuster license, where applicable.
  • Proficient in claims management systems with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers throughout the claim process.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated conflict resolution skills; ability to facilitate productive discussions and reach equitable outcomes.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Basic understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations and claim handling requirements.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • One year auto claim handling experience or comparable claim experience, or successful completion of Travelers Auto Claim Representative training program.

What Is the Opportunity?

Provides support surrounding Host, Distributed, Network, Voice technologies or Print Center Operations. The incumbent applies experience and technical expertise to ensure high level of customer service and satisfaction, product quality, and timeliness of product, technical and/or business deliverables. The incumbent has technical background in one of the four disciplines and is proficient in supporting at least one product and/or tool.This is a 3rd shift/weekend worksite essential position that is based in our Omaha, NE office. Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the US. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, this this role.

What Will You Do?

  • Provides support for at least one product and/or tool in the Host, Distributed, Network, Voice and Printing environments.
  • Resolves incidents and issues associated with Host, Distributed, Network, Voice, Tape and/or Output Processing products and/or tools with direction from senior specialists and/or management and escalates incidents/problems when necessary by following established processes and procedures.

Job.JobDescription:

As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards. 

Salary Range

$25.00 - $26.00

Target Openings

2

What Is the Opportunity?

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. now and in the future. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role.

Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Are you curious by nature? Do you enjoy managing relationships and employing your critical thinking skills? Underwriters perform the critical function of evaluating the acceptability of risk and determining appropriate pricing for insurance products. The Business Insurance (BI) Underwriting Professional Development Internship Program provides students with an amazing opportunity to gain exposure to this critical function at Travelers. The 10-week program (running from early June to mid-August) provides qualified interns with an excellent opportunity to gain first-hand commercial insurance underwriting experience, receive valuable on-the-job training, and learn more about the property and casualty insurance industry from industry professionals. Given that, we are seeking interns that are serious about entering the insurance industry and who are excited about the prospect of making underwriting their future career choice. This role is a potential pathway to our full-time Underwriting Professional Development Program (UPDP).
Housing assistance is not provided.

What Will You Do?

  • Within your assigned business unit, each intern will be given a designated coach and be expected to:
  • Complete core assignments and training modules geared toward insurance and underwriting principles.
  • Participate and complete self-paced professional development courses in time management, presentation skills, and other key areas.
  • Complete challenging and meaningful project work over the course of this program at the discretion of your manager. You may work independently or with other interns and will be asked to present your findings to local leadership. Sample projects include a territorial risk assessment to determine profitability and underwriting opportunities as well as a business process analysis to determine underwriting gaps.
  • Learn to leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms with the ability to apply critical thinking to evaluate limitations related to quality and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs.
  • Learn about other areas at Travelers such as Risk Control, Claims, and related corporate functions. Interns may also engage in agency visits with Account Executives.
  • Participate in the Enterprise Internship experience which includes Executive Speaker Series, Networking events, and Rising Senior Intern Symposium.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Preferred cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Obtained or pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Liberal Arts (with business focus preferred), Management, Marketing, Risk Management and Insurance.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

What is a Must Have?

  • Pursuing or obtained a Bachelor's degree.

The Material Processor Lead is responsible for working with the Supervisors and assisting in training and developing the team, monitoring production performance, ensuring production and quality controls are met while adhering to the work instructions for the area of responsibility.


This is an onsite role in our Lewisville, TX facility with a schedule of Monday - Friday, 8:00AM - 4:30PM.


What will be my duties and responsibilities be in this job?

  • Working knowledge of shop floor systems such as Oracle
  • Participate in daily stand-up meetings with Supervisor
  • Participate in internal and external customer or vendor meetings
  • Work with Supervisor to reallocate resources (people/supplies/products etc.) as needed to meet customer goals

About this job

12-week paid internship at Fortune 500 Assurant in Atlanta, rotating through Ethics & Compliance teams. Includes hands-on projects in regulatory compliance, risk management, and a capstone focused on AI applications in compliance.

Good fit if you pursue a degree in business, law, compliance, data analytics, or related field, with strong analytical skills and interest in AI and technology.

Full job description

The Assurant Internship Program is a 12-week immersive experience where interns do not sit on the sidelines. You will gain real-world experience by tackling business challenges and helping drive meaningful outcomes. The program combines hands-on work with learning and development opportunities, mentorship, networking and engagement opportunities, and resources designed to support your professional growth. This program offers students meaningful, real-world experience while building foundational technical and business skills in a Fortune 500 organization.


The Ethics & Compliance Intern will gain hands-on experience across multiple compliance disciplines while supporting strategic initiatives that advance Assurant's culture of integrity and responsible innovation. Through a rotational program, the intern will work with a number of Ethics & Compliance teams, contributing to projects involving regulatory compliance, ethics and investigations, policy governance, risk management, and emerging technologies.


A key component of the internship will be a capstone project focused on the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) within Ethics & Compliance. The intern will research, evaluate, and recommend innovative approaches that enhance compliance effectiveness, operational efficiency, and employee engagement.

This internship is designed for candidates who are curious, analytical, and interested in the intersection of compliance, ethics, technology, and business operations.

What You Will Do


Rotational Experience:

The intern will rotate through multiple Ethics & Compliance teams, which may include:

  • Business Unit Compliance
  • Ethics and investigations
  • Compliance communications and training
  • Risk assessment and monitoring
  • Enterprise policy management
  • Compliance operations and reporting

Potential Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist with research related to regulatory requirements, industry trends, and emerging risks.
  • Support the development, review, and maintenance of compliance policies, procedures, and governance documents.
  • Analyze data and prepare reports, dashboards, presentations, and executive summaries.
  • Help identify opportunities to improve compliance processes and operational efficiencies, including from the AI lens.
  • Participate in compliance risk assessments, monitoring activities, and program evaluations.
  • Assist in developing employee communications, training materials, and awareness campaigns.
  • Collaborate with team members across multiple business functions and compliance disciplines.
  • Present findings and recommendations to Ethics & Compliance leadership.

AI & Compliance Capstone Project:

As part of the internship experience, the intern will:

  • Explore how AI and emerging technologies can enhance Ethics & Compliance programs.
  • Assess opportunities to improve compliance processes through automation, analytics, and responsible AI practices.
  • Conduct stakeholder interviews and research leading practices across industries.
  • Develop recommendations for practical AI use cases within Ethics & Compliance.
  • Deliver a final presentation summarizing findings, recommendations, and potential business impact.

Qualifications


Required

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in: Business, Risk Management, Compliance, Law, Public Policy, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or related field

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skill risk management, governance, or regulatory affairs.
  • Interest in artificial intelligence, emerging technologies, and responsible innovation.
  • Experience with data analysis, research projects, or process improvement initiatives.
  • ·Demonstrated leadership through academic, volunteer, or extracurricular activities.

What You Will Gain

  • Exposure to multiple areas of a global Ethics & Compliance program.
  • Experience working alongside compliance and business leaders.
  • Understanding of compliance governance, regulatory requirements, and ethical business practices.
  • Real-world experience evaluating AI applications in a corporate environment.
  • Professional development opportunities, mentoring, and networking across the organization.
  • Experience presenting recommendations to senior leaders.

Hybrid Opportunity: Atlanta Office

End Date: 8/7/2027

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Policy Administration Specialist, Operations & Policy Administration
Job.JobDescription:
This job is responsible for working with the Supervisors and assisting in training and developing the team, monitoring production performance, ensuring production and quality controls are met while adhering to the work instructions for the area of responsibility.


This role is based at our Irving, TX location with a schedule of Monday - Friday from 11:30 am to 8:00 pm

What will be my duties and responsibilities be in this job?

• Participate in daily stand-up meetings with the Supervisor.

• Work with the Supervisor to reallocate resources, including employees, supplies, equipment, and products, as needed to meet customer and operational goals.

• Collaborate with other departments to ensure proper workflow and timely resolution of operational issues.

• Serve as a point of contact for employees and assist with escalations during the shift.

• Identify process improvement opportunities and submit recommendations to the Supervisor and Engineering teams.

• Assist the Supervisor with implementing operational changes and adjustments on the warehouse floor.

• Perform on-the-job training, refresher training, and workstation assessments.

• Monitor inventory levels and aging inventory within the area of responsibility.

• Monitor daily KPIs, SLAs, productivity, and quality metrics, and proactively support corrective actions when performance falls below target.

• Compile and analyze operational data and complete daily reports.

• Communicate effectively with employees, supervisors, managers, and cross-functional teams.

• Maintain proficiency and certification in the operational area being supported.

• Promote and maintain a safe work environment by ensuring associates follow all safety procedures and immediately escalating safety concerns.

• Lead by example and maintain a hands-on presence in the operation, supporting associates and assisting with operational activities when necessary to meet business objectives.

• Train, coach, and mentor associates while reinforcing productivity, quality, safety, and attendance expectations.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

• 1+ years of experience leading, training, coaching, or directing employees in a manufacturing, logistics, warehouse, or operations environment.

• High level of computer proficiency, including the ability to navigate multiple systems, analyze data, and utilize reporting tools effectively.

• Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed productivity, quality, and operational performance expectations while serving as a role model for associates.

• Strong leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple operational priorities.

• Ability to communicate effectively with employees at all levels of the organization.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently while also collaborating with Supervisors and cross-functional teams.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

• Forklift certification or ability to obtain certification.

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, Outlook, Teams, and Power BI.

• Experience analyzing operational data and generating reports to support business decisions.

• Experience using Oracle, Power BI, SQL, warehouse management systems, or similar reporting and operational platforms.

• Experience training, coaching, and developing associates in a warehouse or operational environment.

• Strong continuous improvement mindset with the ability to identify and recommend process improvements.


Pay Range

$17.34 - $27.75

11/07/2026
