  • 2+ years experience delivering high-quality customer service in a fast-paced call center environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills across multiple channels (phone, chat, email)
  • Strong problem-solving, and interpersonal skills
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with technology and ability to quickly learn new systems and platforms
  • Commitment to teamwork, continuous improvement, and operational excellence
  • Proficiency with technology and Microsoft Office required

Job.JobTitle: Assistant Vice President, Health Analytics Data Scientist
Job.JobDescription:
Job Description

Aon is looking for an Assistant Vice President, Health Analytics Data Scientist

Chicago, IL; Atlanta, GA; Denver, CO; Seattle, WA are preferrable locations but open to other Aon locations or possibly remote for the right fit

We are seeking a hands-on, statistically grounded health data scientist, health actuary or medical economics expert to work on cost-of-care measurement, causal inference and predictive modeling workstreams and development of Aon analytics capabilities. You will own the design, validation, documentation, and delivery of the statistical and machine learning / predictive modeling algorithms and analyses that help employers and their partners understand cost, risk, and the impact of health programs – including total-cost-of-care predictive modeling and causal evaluations of programs and vendors using matched cohort trial emulation, difference-in-differences, and risk adjustment. You will work to evolve capabilities and model performance, review code and models, document and present results to clients and senior leaders, and take models from development into governed, monitored production, working closely with actuaries, consultants, clinical and innovation specialists, Aon Business Solutions / Technology (ABS), technology architects, and engineering teams.

The ideal candidate has 7+ years of experience including commercial health insurance and/or health benefits consulting, a strong foundation in applied statistics and causal inference, and a track record of building and deploying tabular predictive models on large medical and pharmacy claims datasets. The ability to document methods rigorously and present results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences is critical. Practical experience with MLOps and model governance, and with partnering with enterprise technology and distributed engineering teams to move models into scalable, supported production, is essential.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

  • Develop and deliver causal inference and predictive modeling workstreams for the US Health Analytics practice, ensuring methodological rigor while staying hands-on in building, reviewing, and validating models and code within project timelines
  • Collaborate closely with Aon Business Solutions / Technology (ABS), cloud architects, and offshore engineering and data science teams to align on data pipelines, model architecture, and deployment standards, coordinate delivery across locations and time zones, and move models from development into scalable, supported production
  • Design, build, and tune tabular analyses and predictive models including gradient-boosted, statistical methods and emerging AI modeling techniques– such as cost and utilization forecasting, high-cost claimant prediction, risk stratification, and program engagement propensity – on large eligibility, medical claims, and pharmacy claims datasets from multiple sources
  • Design and execute medical economics and causal inference studies that estimate the impact of programs, treatments, vendors, and point solutions on financial, utilization, and clinical outcomes, using matched cohort target trial emulation (explicit eligibility, time zero, and follow-up definitions; propensity score matching or weighting), difference-in-differences and event-study designs with parallel-trends and sensitivity testing, and risk adjustment
  • Document methods, assumptions, data definitions, and results thoroughly – methodology write-ups, technical appendices, model cards, and reproducible analysis records – and present findings, uncertainty, and limitations clearly to clients, carriers, consultants, and senior leaders through polished reports and presentations
  • Ensure MLOps and model governance end-to-end, including experiment tracking, model registries, reproducible training pipelines, automated testing, CI/CD, drift and performance monitoring, and model documentation, validation, and approval workflows aligned with Aon's risk, privacy, and compliance standards
  • Serve as senior technical, code, and methodology reviewer for analytics deliverables, and set standards for model validation, explainability, bias and fairness review, and quality control
  • Partner with senior leaders across Aon's health actuarial, consulting, clinical, innovation, and specialty practice areas, and stay current on emerging vendors and startups in healthcare navigation, digital health, and care delivery
  • Mentor and coach data scientists, and lead multiple projects with clear priorities, timelines, and milestones

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Minimum 7 years of total experience, including health insurance, with a track record of delivering value to clients and colleagues
  • Strong foundation in applied statistics or medical economics, including model training and validation, statistical testing, regression and generalized linear models, and experimental and quasi-experimental design
  • Deep hands-on experience building, tuning, and interpreting tabular predictive models, including feature engineering, cross-validation, hyperparameter optimization, calibration, class imbalance, and explainability methods
  • Hands-on experience applying causal inference to observational health data / medical economics, including matched cohort target trial emulation, propensity score methods, difference-in-differences (including staggered-adoption and event-study approaches), sensitivity analysis, and risk adjustment, with financial, utilization, and clinical outcomes metrics

  • Expert Python and/or R and strong SQL; Databricks, Spark, Azure, Docker, and CI/CD experience a plus

Job Description

Aon is looking for a US Health Analytics Models and Engineering Leader

This is a hybrid role preferrably in Denver, Chicago, or Atlanta, with flexibility for other US Aon offices. Fully remote may be considered

We are seeking a hands-on Health Analytics Models and Engineering leader to lead the development of analytics solutions, systems, and technology for Aon's US Health Analytics practice. You will own the design, delivery, and quality of the models, analytics applications, and AI-enabled systems that power our benefits financial modeling – including risk simulations, underwriting models, financial analytics, network modeling, benchmarking, plan design and cost-sharing modeling, migration modeling and related capabilities. You will set technical direction, lead a team, and write and review production code, working closely with actuaries, consultants, Aon Business Solutions (ABS), technology architects, and offshore engineering teams.

The ideal candidate has 8+ years of US Health experience, a track record of scaled model development using modern technologies, a deep understanding of US health data and employer benefits financial modeling, and a track record of building analytics applications end-to-end and leading technical teams. Experience translating actuarial and underwriting methods, peer review, and controls into well-engineered, maintainable code is essential.

What a day will look like

  • Lead analytics technical solution development and engineering, AI-enabled analytics solution development, and priority analytics roadmap workstreams for the US Health Analytics practice, setting technical direction while staying hands-on in writing, reviewing, and shipping production code
  • Collaborate closely with Aon Business Solutions (ABS), technology architects, and offshore engineering teams to align on architecture, standards, and priorities, coordinate delivery across locations and time zones, and move models into scalable, supported production
  • Design, build, and maintain modeling engines – simulations, underwriting and renewal tools, cost and risk modeling, reserving (IBNR), pricing and contribution setting, plan design valuations, and migration modeling – and extend them across domains such as Actuarial and Financial, Clinical and Pharmacy, Time Away Solutions, Audit, Network Analytics, and Consumer Benefits
  • Partner with actuaries, consultants, and subject matter experts to turn actuarial and underwriting methods into tested, governed, and documented code with consistent assumptions and outputs
  • Design and productionize AI systems and modular capabilities, including agent graphs, harness engineering, and orchestration, and advance AI-assisted development practices
  • Own quality and reliability end-to-end through strong DevOps practices, including infrastructure as code, automated testing, model validation, and CI/CD
  • Lead and coach technical colleagues, and run delivery through agile Scrum with clear priorities and objectives

You Bring Knowledge and Expertise

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in US Health & Benefits consulting, with a track record of delivering value to clients and colleagues
  • Strong understanding of employer benefits financial modeling, including health risk, underwriting forecasting, trend and seasonality, reserving, pricing, plan design valuations, and migration modeling, and of actuarial techniques such as completion factors, credibility, and Monte Carlo simulation
  • Expert knowledge of US health data, including benefit plan design, medical and pharmacy claims, eligibility, plan design, and benefits structure
  • Deep experience building and scaling analytics applications end-to-end
  • Experience partnering with enterprise technology and architecture teams and leading work with offshore or distributed engineering teams
  • Experience designing and productionizing AI systems; familiarity with AI-assisted and autonomous development including GitHub Copilot and Claude Code.
  • Experience leading technical teams, with strong agile Scrum and DevOps practices (infrastructure as code, testing, CI/CD, version control, Linux/WSL)
  • Python, C#, and R mastery are required; Docker, Azure, Databricks, and Terraform experience a plus
  • Ability to explain technical and modeling decisions clearly to actuaries, consultants, and non-technical audiences
  • ASA or FSA credential is viewed as a strong plus

Education

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in actuarial science, mathematics, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

Full job description

Job Description

Posting Description

Who We Are:

NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com.

Do you enjoy collaborating closely with the business rather than practicing law from the sidelines? As our Corporate Counsel (P&C), you'll support our evolving insurance businesses and work directly with the people making day-to-day decisions. The work ranges from high-volume contracts such as NDAs to more nuanced carrier, MGA/MGU and regulatory matters. You'll have room to take ownership, develop relationships and become a trusted legal resource for the businesses you support.

This role is a strong fit for an attorney who understands how the P&C insurance business operates and can turn legal analysis into practical guidance. Experience working with insurance carriers, MGAs/MGUs, brokers or related insurance businesses is especially valuable. Prior business-side insurance experience is also welcome.

What You'll Do

  • Draft, review and negotiate carrier agreements, MGA/MGU and program administrator agreements, client service agreements, NDAs and other commercial contracts.
  • Advise business teams on P&C insurance operations, regulatory matters, risk management and contract issues.
  • Review carrier and client agreements, identify meaningful legal and business risks, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Support MGA/MGU operations and carrier relationships as business needs and regulatory requirements evolve.
  • Partner directly with business leaders to understand their objectives and provide timely, business-focused legal guidance.
  • Handle routine agreements efficiently while knowing when an issue requires deeper analysis or escalation.
  • Ask questions, gather information and collaborate across legal and business teams to resolve issues.
  • Monitor relevant P&C insurance regulatory developments and help the business respond to changing requirements.
  • Contribute to legal team initiatives and share knowledge with colleagues across the organization.

Qualifications:

  • Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school and an active license to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
  • 5+ years of legal experience involving the property and casualty insurance industry.
  • Experience working with an insurance carrier, MGA/MGU, insurance broker, regulatory agency or insurance-focused law practice.
  • Experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial agreements.
  • Strong solid understanding of P&C insurance operations and the relationships among carriers, brokers and insurance intermediaries.
  • Ability to identify legal and business risks and translate them into clear, practical recommendations.
  • Ability to independently manage priorities, follow through on commitments and seek additional information when needed.
  • Communication skills that build credibility with legal colleagues and business partners.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable:

  • Carrier agreements or carrier relationship management
  • MGA, MGU or program administrator operations
  • Commercial Lines insurance
  • Retail insurance brokerage
  • P&C insurance regulatory matters
  • Claims or related risk issues
  • Business-side experience within the insurance industry
  • Technology or AI tools used for legal research, drafting or workflow improvement

What We Offer:

We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. Complex Director, Excess

At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as a Complex Director in Excess Claims to play your part in that transformation. It's an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.

Make your mark in Excess Claims

Our Claims teams are the proven problem solvers of choice for clients, delivering consistent technical excellence and showcasing our service differentiation to create an unparalleled global claims handling experience. Through a robust stakeholder feedback loop and supported by consistent processes and leadership, we take pride in delivering responsive, fair, and professional service with empathy and efficiency.

How you will create an impact

Are you interested in handling some of the largest and most complex Casualty claims in the industry? Your deep technical claims expertise will be put to the test in the investigation, evaluation and disposition of new and existing 3rd party property and casualty claims. These multimillion-dollar claims include multi-vehicle auto accidents, plant explosions, class action injury claims, catastrophic product liability claims. You will be required to review coverage under Excess Commercial General liability and auto policies, participate in the investigation of the claim and control litigation strategy. The adjuster will be required to direct the litigation, attend mediations and trials, assess liability and damages, and recommend reserves. It will be necessary for the adjuster to present the large value cases to senior management. The adjuster will need excellent customer service skills in communicating with insureds, brokers, attorneys, and claimants. Only the most highly skilled negotiators will succeed in resolving these claims in the toughest venues against the most elite plaintiff attorneys.

  • Determining the scope and extent of available coverage.
  • The investigation, evaluation and disposition of new and existing 3rd party property and casualty claims.
  • Preparation and execution of investigation strategies which identify critical issues effecting liability, causation and damages and assessment of risk transfer and contribution opportunities.
  • Clear and concise communication and contact with internal and external customers, including insureds, brokers, and underwriters, to provide guidance and manage expectations.
  • Proper documentation of exposure evaluation and resolution strategy.
  • Presentation to senior management of claim disposition recommendations.
  • Obtain the appropriate authority to independently negotiate multimillion-dollar claims with the top plaintiff attorneys nationwide. Document evaluation, thought process, and strategy. Utilize ADR as appropriate and necessary.
  • Effectively strategize and budget litigation of each claim through discussions with counsel, vendors, and insureds. Establish with defense and coverage counsel clear ground rules to maintain financial control of budget and expenses.

What you'll need to succeed

  • 8+ years of Commercial/Industry claims experience preferred
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal/written) and strong negotiation skills
  • Advanced experience and capabilities in litigation claims management including ADR and mediation process
  • Experience attending and controlling cases- pre-suit, litigated and post trial- at mediations, settlement conferences, etc.
  • Property and Casualty licenses required, must be obtained within 6 months.
  • Motivated individuals who are interested in the potential for an upwardly mobile career path.

Job.JobTitle: 2027 Early Careers: Summer Intern, Underwriting – Aviation – United States, Los Angeles, CA
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Los Angeles, CA

About this job

Nine-week summer internship in AIG's Specialty Aviation underwriting department in Los Angeles. You will support risk evaluation and underwriting decisions for aviation clients alongside experienced underwriters, with opportunities to develop technical knowledge and professional skills.

Good fit if you are a recent graduate or current student available June 7 through August 6, 2027, with strong analytical and communication skills.

Full job description

AIG is reimagining the way we help customers manage risk. Join us as a Summer Intern in the Underwriting - Aviation department to play your part in that transformation with opportunities to learn and grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.

About Us

At AIG, helping organizations and people discover new potential is our purpose. As a global risk leader, we do this for our clients every day. Through our deep expertise in their industries and our innovative solutions that help them smartly manage risk, we enable their growth in ways they never thought possible.

But we also do the same thing for our colleagues, because we know our people are our greatest strength – the source of every insight, every idea and every innovation. When we're working as one team to do what's right for our colleagues and our communities, we can achieve excellence together. We encourage colleagues to give back to the causes they care most about, supporting these efforts through our Volunteer Time Off and Matching Grants Programs.

Make your Mark

Our Specialty Aviation business helps clients navigate the unique risks of a fast-moving global industry. With more than 70 years of aviation expertise, we provide tailored insurance solutions for a wide range of aviation clients, from aircraft operators and airports to manufacturers and airlines, helping them minimize risk and maximize safety.

Working alongside experienced underwriters, claims professionals, attorneys, and risk specialists, you will help deliver innovative coverage solutions and exceptional client service. Supported by a global network spanning many countries and jurisdictions, Specialty Aviation professionals combine deep industry knowledge and technical expertise to help clients navigate complex challenges and keep their operations moving forward with confidence

How you will make an Impact

AIG's Summer Interns are immersed in the day-to-day operations of a fast-moving, global insurance company. During the 9-week program, you will gain valuable, hands-on experience and insurance industry knowledge, working with leaders on dynamic projects, with plenty of opportunity for challenges, learning and achievement.

Summer Interns join one of our key business teams, which offers a unique opportunity to obtain core technical knowledge and professional skills in a diverse environment. In addition to meaningful on-the-job experiences, interns will join instructor-led masterclasses, hear directly from senior leaders, and build meaningful connections through mentoring circles, networking events and volunteering.

Following completion of the internship program, interns may be considered for a role in the location where they completed their internship, with the Analyst program beginning in July 2028.

Responsibilities

  • Support the evaluation and underwriting of aviation risks across areas such as aircraft operators, airports, manufacturers, and airlines.

  • Review underwriting submissions, exposure information, loss history, and other relevant data to support risk selection, pricing, and coverage decisions.

  • Partner with experienced underwriters, claims professionals, attorneys, and risk specialists to develop tailored insurance solutions.

  • Build relationships with brokers and clients while supporting new business and renewal opportunities.

  • Monitor industry trends and emerging aviation risks to support informed underwriting decisions.

  • Develop technical knowledge of aviation insurance while building analytical, decision-making, and relationship-management skills.

Minimum Qualifications

Our Early Careers programs are designed for students and recent graduates who are beginning their professional careers, generally within one year of completing their degree.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree to be received no later than June 2028 (unofficial transcript required upon application).

Program Requirements

  • Available for the complete Summer Internship Program from June 7 through August 6, 2027.

  • Summer Intern positions are in-person opportunities, requiring interns to work in the office at least four days per week.

Core Qualifications

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively in a professional environment.

  • Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively, manage multiple priorities, and adapt in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Preferred majors include Risk Management & Insurance, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Aviation Management, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated interest in aviation, commercial insurance, or risk management.

  • Interest in evaluating complex risks.

Applications will be accepted through October 31, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. ET. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and we encourage candidates to apply early. We reserve the right to close this posting prior to the application deadline based on application volume.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Loss Control Consultant, Risk Management / Loss Control
Job.JobDescription:
Company Details

Acadia Insurance is a regional property casualty insurer with offices throughout the Northeast. As a member of W.R. Berkley Corporation (NYSE: WRB), one of the largest property casualty insurance holding companies in the United States, our financial strength and integrity are two of the main reasons why Independent Agents place business with us. Acadia is rated A+ (Superior) by A.M. Best, with an A+ claim paying ability rating by Standard & Poor's.

At Acadia, we value our employees, our customers and our communities. Employees at Acadia are part of a progressive company where everyone can make a difference. We promote an inclusive environment which encourages continuous learning and the chance to grow and develop.

Company URL: https://www.acadiainsurance.com/

Responsibilities

Assist in the acquisition and retention of profitable business by identifying and evaluating hazards and controls for new and existing accounts reduce and control potential losses.

  • Conducts surveys and services on large, complex accounts by identifying and evaluating hazards and controls pertaining to all lines of coverage.
  • Services existing accounts according to mutually agreed upon plans developed for each account.
  • Submits recommendations to improve conditions which will mitigate or control the hazards identified and follows-up on recommendations.
  • Assists accounts on potential exposures and promotes the value of Loss Control and sound safety program in the acquisition and retention of profitable business.
  • Appraises properties to determine replacement costs for fire insurance coverage.
  • Monitors own workload to ensure timely service and meet deadlines.
  • Participates in agency visits and staff meetings as needed.
  • Provides technical assistance to the claim department on losses.
  • Provides loss control services for all departments and assists other departments in their efforts to write and retain profitable business.
  • Coordinates the collection and dissemination of material related to specialized technical areas assigned.
  • Participates in training and self-development and may mentor/train others within the department.
  • Meets or exceeds Department Standards for production, quality and timeliness of survey work.
  • Keeps abreast of industry news and developments.
  • Exhibits proficiency in all types of surveys for all lines and programs.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of advanced commercial insurance loss control or safety consulting experience.
  • Demonstrated expertise evaluating large, highly complex, and specialized commercial accounts.
  • Proficiency in conducting all survey types across all lines of business and insurance programs.
  • Advanced understanding of property valuation methodologies, fire protection systems, industrial operations, regulatory compliance, and emerging risk exposures.
  • Ability to interpret complex operational risks and provide strategic recommendations to insureds and underwriting leadership.
  • Proven leadership abilities, including mentoring, coaching, and serving as a departmental subject matter expert.
  • Strong project management, analytical, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to build effective relationships with executive-level client contacts, agents, and internal business partners.
  • Valid driver's license with acceptable driving record and ability to travel extensively.
  • CSP, CPCU, ARM, ALCM, CFPS, PE, or other advanced industry designation. Preferred.
  • Specialized expertise in manufacturing, construction, healthcare, transportation, agribusiness, or other commercial industries. Preferred.
  • Experience leading large account service plans and complex risk improvement initiatives. Preferred.
  • Expertise in commercial insurance loss control and safety consulting.
  • Hazard identification and risk evaluation.
  • Survey and inspection proficiency across all lines of coverage.
  • Property valuation and replacement cost assessment.
  • Risk mitigation and loss prevention planning.
  • Fire protection systems knowledge.
  • Industrial operations analysis.
  • Regulatory compliance knowledge.
  • Strategic risk assessment and recommendations.
  • Mentoring and coaching.
  • Project management.
  • Analytical and decision-making skills.
  • Relationship management.
  • Technical claims support.
  • Time management and deadline management.
  • Ability to travel extensively.
  • Physical ability to travel regularly to insured locations.
  • Ability to walk construction sites, manufacturing facilities, farms, warehouses, and other commercial locations.
  • Ability to climb stairs, ladders, and navigate uneven terrain when conducting inspections.
  • Ability to lift and carry inspection equipment and materials up to 25 pounds.
  • Ability to operate a motor vehicle safely and maintain a valid driver's license.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Safety Management, Occupational Health & Safety, Risk Management, Insurance, Engineering, Fire Protection, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Company Details

We do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting agencies or firms.

The company offers a competitive compensation plan and robust benefits package for full time regular employees including:
• Base Salary Range: $105k-$125k
• Benefits include: Health, dental, vision, dental, life, disability, wellness, paid time off, 401(k) and profit-sharing plans

The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment.

Job.JobTitle: Regional Production Specialist Sr, Excess & Surplus Lines
Job.JobDescription:
At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as a Regional Production Specialist Sr, Excess & Surplus Lines to play your part in that transformation. It's an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.


Make your mark in Underwriting


AIG Underwriting teams help to find insurance solutions in areas including Financial Lines, Property, Casualty, Specialty Lines, Cyber, and Multinational Clients. We are reimagining how we help customers to manage risk, transforming our operating model and reshaping our role responsibilities and career pathways. The goal is to unlock the full potential in each colleague – empowering our people to grow as insurance professionals and add more value to our customers and AIG.


How you will create an impact

The Senior Regional Production Specialist must be able to illustrate the highest levels of technical proficiency and underwriting acumen combined with marketing and sales skills to meet production underwriting goals while maintaining budgeted loss and expense ratios. Candidates are expected to work effectively in a team environment to develop broker and portfolio strategies in addition to working independently to manage a profitable book of new and renewal business. The Head of Property for the Zone will rely heavily on this position to assist in guiding, mentoring and training more junior members of the team, as well as to assist in planning and budgeting, collaboration across AIG divisions and building a culture of diversity and inclusion across the team. Responsibilities include:


  • Underwrite risks to maintain and profitably grow our E&S portfolio across our desired business segments.
  • Collaborate with colleagues internally and be reliably visible to our wholesale trading partners.
  • Review and negotiate manuscript form wordings and coverages.
  • Act as a senior mentor to train and guide other members of the team within the Zone

What you'll need to succeed

  • 7+ years' experience in Commercial Property E&S underwriting.
  • Ability to underwrite property risks across the spectrum of E&S Property business while helping to set direction for your team and maintaining a balanced portfolio across both primary and excess placements.
  • Ability to underwrite 100%, primary/shared and layered, and excess structures.
  • A strong understanding of current market conditions, ability to quickly make decisions and turn around quotes and manage multiple prospects at one time are essential.
  • As a member of the senior leadership within Lexington, take on responsibilities beyond everyday management and underwriting, including mentoring, collaboration within the Zone across business divisions and driving a diverse and inclusive culture.
  • Must be able to work with regional Property leadership peers in order to continue to build a nationally renowned team and culture for Lexington.

Ready to take your career to the next level? We would love to hear from you.

About this job

Senior Paralegal supporting AIG Claims' Legacy Solutions team in managing casualty coverage litigation for a run-off client company. Responsibilities include managing litigation dockets, coordinating with counsel, organizing documents, handling discovery requests, and providing oversight of outside counsel paralegals.

Good fit if you have 3+ years of paralegal, case manager or legal secretary experience and are proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

Full job description

Join us as a Senior Paralegal – Legacy Manager to take on key responsibilities within a world-class Claims function.


Make your mark Claims

Our Claims team are the proven problem solvers of choice for clients, delivering consistent technical excellence and showcasing our service differentiation to create an unparalleled global claims handling experience. Through a robust stakeholder feedback loop and supported by consistent processes and leadership, we take pride in delivering responsive, fair and professional service with empathy and efficiency.

How you will create an impact

AIG Claims, Inc. is responsible for the orderly winding-up of discontinued operations of certain entities. The Legacy Solutions team ensures an operating environment that minimizes legal, regulatory and reputational risks in the course of timely and efficiently running off legacy exposures.


AIG Claims, Inc. is looking for an experienced paralegal in New York, NY to assist the Legacy Solutions team in their management of casualty coverage litigation involving a run-off client company. The position will report to the Head of Legacy Solutions and will provide day-to-day support on behalf of the client company to national coordinating counsel and local counsel.


Responsibilities include:

  • Help manage docket of litigation files, including gathering and inputting detailed case information, by utilizing internal electronic systems;
  • Coordinate payments to law firms, vendors and others through various electronic systems;
  • Assist with internal and external document searches in support of litigation needs including but not limited to discovery requests;
  • Organize documents for litigation files;
  • Draft and issue litigation hold notices;
  • Edit and organize reports to senior management concerning specified litigation matters;
  • Provide oversight of outside counsel paralegals in respect of assigned tasks;
  • Coordinate meetings; and
  • Assist with insurance inquiries.

What you'll need to succeed:

  • College degree and/or paralegal certificate is preferred;
  • 3+ year(s) of experience as a paralegal, case manager or legal secretary is preferred;
  • Must be proficient in Microsoft Office (with a focus on Excel) and have the ability to learn other computer applications;
  • Must possess excellent communication skills (both written and verbal);
  • Must be collaborative, highly organized, able to multi-task, deadline oriented and able to interact with senior leaders in the organization; and
  • Must be willing to be mentored and trained to meet the needs of the organization.

Ready to accelerate your career? We would love to hear from you.

About this job

Strategic liaison between technology and insurance business units at W.R. Berkley Corporation. Translates business needs into technology solutions, manages demand and portfolios, oversees delivery, and ensures compliance with enterprise standards.

Good fit if you have 8+ years in technology-business partnership or product management, understand insurance operations, and can work in complex, regulated environments.

Full job description

Company Details

Company URL: https://berkleytechnologyservices.com/

W.R. Berkley Corporation is comprised of 60+ businesses alongside Berkley Technology Services (BTS) and other shared services groups.

Here at Berkley Technology Services, the core of our success is our people. Our teams bring their own unique perspective and experiences which enables us to translate the needs of our business to deliver adaptable, secure solutions while providing an unmatched user-focused experience.

Our tagline “Thoughtful Minds | Empowering Possibilities” was crafted with our own teams in mind. At BTS, our teams thrive in Berkley's decentralized model - leveraging the power of being part of a long standing, heritage brand with extensive expertise while innovation and being entrepreneurial is encouraged.

Internally, we operate as a relatively flat organization valuing communication and feedback. We pride ourselves in an open-door policy where no one is treated differently based on title, fostering a culture of trust, transparency, and engagement.

Mission (what we stand for): We Believe in the value of every voice, Translate needs into capabilities, & Secure the future of Berkley.

Vision (where we're going): Be the foundation of Berkley through adaptable solutions, resilient environments, and an unmatched experience.

Come join us as we push forward into the future of industry leading technological solutions.

Responsibilities

The Solutions Delivery Manager serves as a strategic liaison between Technology and WRB Insurance Business Units. This role is responsible for understanding business strategies, operational needs, and regulatory requirements, and translating them into technology-enabled solutions that deliver measurable business value.

The Solutions Delivery Manager partners closely with business leaders, technology delivery teams, architecture, security, and vendors to ensure technology initiatives are well-defined, prioritized, funded, and executed in alignment with enterprise standards and roadmaps. The role balances relationship management, strategic planning, demand management, and project management across multiple insurance functions and business units.

Business Partnership & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Act as the single point of contact for assigned insurance operating units for all technology-related initiatives and needs.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior business leaders (e.g., Operations, Underwriting, Claims, Actuarial, Finance, Compliance).
  • Proactively understand business strategies, operational pain points, regulatory drivers, and market trends impacting insurance operations.
  • Facilitate ongoing communication between business and technology teams to ensure transparency, alignment, and shared accountability.

Demand & Portfolio Management

  • Facilitate intake, assessment, and prioritization of business technology demands in alignment with enterprise strategy, capacity, and funding models.
  • Partner with Product, Architecture, and Delivery teams to shape initiatives into well-defined business cases, roadmaps, and delivery plans.
  • Ensure initiatives are aligned with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data, and compliance standards by facilitating all necessary approval processes.
  • Support annual and multi-year planning, budgeting, and investment prioritization processes.

Delivery Oversight & Value Realization

  • Partner with delivery teams to monitor progress, manage risks, and resolve issues impacting business outcomes.
  • Ensure business readiness activities (change management, training, communications) are planned and executed.
  • Support the tracking and reporting on benefits realization, KPIs, and value delivered against approved business cases.
  • Drive continuous improvement based on feedback, metrics, and post-implementation reviews.

Governance & Risk Management

  • Ensure initiatives comply with regulatory, audit, data privacy, and security requirements common to insurance environments.
  • Participate in governance forums, steering committees, and portfolio reviews as the business-facing technology representative.
  • Identify and escalate risks, dependencies, and trade-offs impacting delivery or business value.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in technology-business partnership, IT relationship management, product management, project management, or consulting, preferably within insurance or financial services.
  • Strong understanding of insurance operations (e.g., policy administration, claims, underwriting, or billing).
  • Proven ability to translate business needs into technology initiatives and measurable outcomes.
  • Experience working in complex, regulated, and matrixed organizations.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related discipline. Equivalent experience and/or alternative qualifications will be considered.

Preferred Skills/Experience

  • Experience supporting large-scale transformation initiatives (digital, core system modernization, data, automation).
  • Familiarity with Agile, Product, or hybrid delivery models.
  • Experience with vendor management and third-party solution evaluation.
  • Knowledge of enterprise architecture concepts, data platforms, and cybersecurity considerations in insurance.
  • MBA or relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, SAFe, ITIL, Product Management).

The company is an equal opportunity employer

Company Details

Every Berkley Agribusiness team member must have the courage to challenge the status quo, collaboratively working with our clients to find creative property and casualty insurance solutions that drive them to succeed. We depend on our ability to listen to our clients — and our experience to help them make fact-based decisions that help their businesses thrive.

WRBC's international business operates in selected regions throughout the world, including Europe, South America, Australia, and Asia.

This position is based in our Urbandale, IA office which offers a hybrid work schedule with 4 days in the office; and 1 day remote where it makes sense to do so.

The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer. #LI-hybrid, #LI-LD1

Responsibilities

As an Actuarial Analyst for Berkley Agribusiness, you will be involved with completing rate reviews, actuarial indications, predictive modeling, completing regular estimates of adequate loss and expense reserves, participating in company's planning processes, and providing tools and analysis in support of pricing large accounts. These activities are to be completed with more independence, proactively, and demonstrate a working knowledge of the core principles and standard actuarial techniques.

What you can expect:

  • Culture of innovation, teamwork, supportive colleagues and leaders willing to invest in talent.
  • Internal mobility opportunities - be a key part of the succession plan.
  • Visibility to senior leaders and partnership with cross functional teams.
  • Opportunity to impact change.
  • Benefits – competitive compensation, paid time off, comprehensive wellness benefits and programs, employer funded health savings account, profit sharing, 401k, paid parental leave, employee stock purchase plan, tuition assistance and professional continuing education.
  • For the Actuarial Organization, we also offer an actuarial study program.

We'll count on you to:

  • Proactively seek out situations where the acquisition of Competitive Market Analytics and other competitive position reviews would have a material impact on business decisions and their outcomes.

  • Adapt and develop rating methodologies for both existing and new company products paying particular attention to opportunities to developing a competitive advantage through consideration and use of new variables, etc.

  • Identify, retrieve, and prepare data in support of actuarial analysis through R, SQL, Essbase, Databricks, and other data sources. This includes internal data (exposure, premium, loss, claims, price, etc.) and various forms of external data (bureau loss costs, bureau trends, macroeconomic data, market share, market pricing, etc.).

  • Ensure the accuracy and suitability of data for the business need at hand. Manipulates data, performs preliminary analysis and interprets data through Excel or other analytics platforms and presents recommendations.

  • Complete Rate Reviews, Ratemaking, and Actuarial Indications including support of forecasting investment rates of return, underwriting expense provisions, frequency/severity and exposure trends. Gain management support for recommended changes.

  • Complete regular estimates of adequate loss and expense reserves, including any financial information pertaining to reserves needed by the Financial Department, company management, or corporate including but not limited to Schedule P.

  • Identify segments with profitable growth potential; identify underperforming segments and propose corrective actions to improve profitability.

  • Perform advanced analytics and modeling techniques including but not limited to generalized linear modeling and other forms of multivariate analysis.

  • Participate in enterprise risk management initiatives, including support for catastrophe management, economic capital modeling, internal rate of return studies, etc.

  • Provide tools and analysis in support of Underwriting's pricing decisions with respect to large accounts as well as small commercial portfolio price adequacy analyses.

  • Perform other related duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications

What you need to have:

  • Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 2+ years of actuarial experience specifically within an insurance organization preferred.
  • Experience with data visualization tools, with a strong preference for Power BI.
  • Commitment to continuing education demonstrated by progression through the Casualty Actuarial Society exam program or other insurance professional designations, including more traditional forms of continuing education related to university work or other technical designations.

  • Ability to examine and break information into parts by identifying motives or causes. Make inferences and find evidence to support generalizations.

  • Ability to organize, prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment; respond promptly and professionally to inquiries from customers; and communicate effectively with all levels of the organization.

  • Should possess strong customer orientation and problem analysis and problem resolution skills. Regularly and consistently demonstrates commitment to company values and guiding principles.

  • Proficient in and have knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite as well as demonstrated ability to learn other software as needed. In particular, a more extensive working knowledge of Excel and a basic understanding of PowerBI, SQL or other data management software packages is expected.

Additional Company Details

We do not accept any unsolicited resumes from external recruiting agencies or firms.

The company offers a competitive compensation plan and robust benefits package for full time regular employees.

The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment.

CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Field (Medical) Case Manager position in Knoxville, TN.

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families. Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others. This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient's progress

  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney's visits

  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker's injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

    • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
    • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
    • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
    • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
    • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
    • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

    EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

    • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
    • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
    • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
    • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
    • A valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required

Job Summary

About the Role

Remote Position (Mexico-Brasil)

We are seeking aMarketing Consultant II to execute lead-nurture campaigns and optimize digital experiences for auto and home insurance products.

In this role, you will manage multi-channel campaigns across email, SMS, and direct mail, helping improve customer engagement, quote completion, lead conversion, and policy sales. You will collaborate with Marketing, Analytics, Operations, Product, Sales, Legal, external agencies, and channel partners to deliver accurate, compliant, and results-driven campaigns.

This opportunity is ideal for a hands-on marketing professional who combines campaign execution, customer journey thinking, project management, and data-driven optimization.

Essential Job Functions

What You'll Do

  • Manage end-to-end lead-nurture campaigns across email, SMS, direct mail, and other customer touchpoints.
  • Coordinate audience segmentation, campaign setup, creative deployment, scheduling, testing, quality assurance, and launch.
  • Optimize customer journeys through improved personalization, messaging, timing, and channel coordination.
  • Develop B2C acquisition content and B2B sales-enablement materials from concept through production.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams, agencies, and vendors to deliver campaigns accurately, on time, and within budget.
  • Validate campaign targeting, content, tracking, brand alignment, and regulatory compliance before launch.
  • Monitor engagement, lead progression, quote completion, conversion, and marketing ROI.
  • Translate campaign data and customer insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Develop test-and-learn plans to improve messaging, response rates, and customer experiences.
  • Create performance reports and present campaign results, key learnings, and optimization opportunities to stakeholders.

Education Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.

Experience Requirements

  • Fluent English proficiency.
  • 4 to 6 years of experience in marketing execution, lead nurture, email marketing, direct mail, or digital campaign management.
  • Experience managing multi-channel campaigns from planning through launch and performance analysis.
  • Strong project management, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Experience with audience segmentation, content development, campaign testing, and quality assurance.
  • Ability to analyze campaign performance and recommend data-driven improvements.
  • Familiarity with customer journey optimization, UX/UI principles, and e-commerce best practices.
  • Experience working with agencies, vendors, sales teams, and internal business partners.
  • Strong organizational, communication, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills.

Additional Qualification

  • Knowledge of marketing compliance and brand-review processes is preferred.
  • Experience in insurance or financial services is a plus.

The Product Manager plays a pivotal role in ensuring the accuracy, efficiency, and effectiveness of our Enterprise Claims liability product. This role requires a deep understanding of product knowledge, operational processes, liability claim regulations, and the ability to provide business requirements for development. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to enhance our product offerings, streamline workflows, and drive product development.

This is a hybrid role.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Conduct comprehensive analyses of product, including feature performance, utilization trends, and user feedback; identify areas for improvement and recommend actionable solutions to enhance product functionality and user experience
  • Data Analysis: Utilize techniques to extract meaningful insights and identify patterns to inform product development and optimization efforts
  • Regulatory Compliance: Stay abreast of evolving liability regulations, regulatory compliance rules and regulations, and industry standards impacting liability claim management practices
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with product management, software development, quality assurance, and customer support teams to obtain requirements, prioritize enhancements, and facilitate the successful implementation of product improvements; act as a subject matter expert and provide guidance on technical and functional aspects of the Enterprise Claim liability product
  • Quality Assurance: Participate in quality assurance activities to validate product enhancements, ensure accuracy and consistency in claim management, and verify compliance with predefined specifications and requirements; conduct thorough testing and troubleshooting to identify and resolve any issues or discrepancies
  • Documentation and Training: Assist the documentation and training team to develop comprehensive documentation, training materials, and user guides to support internal teams and external stakeholders in understanding and effectively utilizing the liability claim product; provide training sessions and demonstrations as needed to ensure proper product adoption and utilization
  • Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify opportunities for process optimization, automation, and efficiency gains within the claim management product lifecycle; drive initiatives to streamline workflows, reduce manual interventions, and improve overall product performance
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Strong understanding of claim management processes, reporting, and regulatory compliance
  • Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data sets, identify trends, and draw actionable insights
  • Solid understanding of software development methodologies, agile principles, and experience working in cross-functional teams
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills as well as verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively across diverse teams
  • Experience with creating and leading presentations and/or conducting training with various levels of users
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on accuracy, thoroughness, and continuous improvement
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  • Aptitude for learning systems and technical processes
  • Adept at thriving in a fast-paced environment with firm deadlines with demonstrated ability to manage details and timelines for multiple simultaneous complex projects
  • Demonstrated ability to provide product requirements and drive innovation

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree in related field
  • Advanced degree or professional certifications (e.g., SCLA, ARM) preferred
  • 5+ years of experience in healthcare industry roles with a focus on liability claim management
  • Proven leadership experience, especially in matrix or cross-functional settings, is highly desirable

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location. Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors: federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions. Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role. The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range: $99,250 - $166,777

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

ABOUT CORVEL:

CorVel, a certified Great Place to Work® Company, is a national provider of industry-leading risk management solutions for the workers' compensation, auto, health and disability management industries. CorVel was founded in 1987 and has been publicly traded on the NASDAQ stock exchange since 1991. We are a stable and growing company with a strong, supportive culture and plenty of career advancement opportunities. Job Description

Join a team focused on transforming how the organization manages risk, compliance, and business resilience. As a Product Engineer on the Fusion Governance, Risk, and Compliance Platform, you will design, develop, configure, and integrate enterprise solutions that support critical business functions, including risk management, compliance, auditing, business continuity, internal controls, and third-party risk oversight.

In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to create scalable, reliable solutions that improve efficiency and strengthen operational performance. The successful candidate will have experience working with the Fusion platform, Java, Spring Boot, application programming interfaces, and enterprise integrations, along with a passion for automation, continuous improvement, and delivering innovative technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Governance, Risk, and Compliance Platform Development

  • Configure, enhance, and support enterprise governance, risk, and compliance platform capabilities that help strengthen risk oversight and business decision-making.
  • Partner with business and technology teams throughout the full solution lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution design through testing, deployment, and ongoing support.
  • Build and maintain workflows, assessments, questionnaires, forms, dashboards, and reporting solutions that improve efficiency and visibility.
  • Deliver solutions that support risk management, regulatory compliance, internal controls, audit programs, and third-party risk oversight.
  • Investigate and resolve platform issues while collaborating with vendors and implementation partners to deliver effective solutions.
  • Support platform upgrades, new feature releases, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Integration and Solution Development

  • Design, develop, and implement integrations between the Fusion platform and enterprise applications.
  • Build integration services connecting governance, risk, and compliance solutions with finance, human resources, procurement, data, analytics, identity management, and service management systems.
  • Support data migration, transformation, validation, and reconciliation efforts to ensure accuracy and reliability.
  • Deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing integration solutions aligned with enterprise technology standards.

Product Delivery and Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Architects, and business partners to translate business needs into innovative technology solutions.
  • Participate in iterative planning, prioritization, demonstrations, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Transform business requirements into technical designs and actionable development plans.
  • Deliver high-quality solutions that meet business objectives and project timelines.
  • Support user testing, solution adoption, and successful production deployments.

Operational Excellence

  • Provide ongoing production support and timely resolution of application and integration issues.
  • Perform root cause analysis to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex technical challenges.
  • Monitor platform health, performance, and reliability while identifying opportunities for optimization and automation.
  • Support release planning, deployment activities, and change management processes.
  • Maintain technical documentation, support procedures, and operational best practices.

Security, Risk, and Compliance

  • Apply secure software development practices throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Ensure solutions align with security standards, regulatory requirements, and organizational policies.
  • Support audit and compliance initiatives through technical expertise and documentation.
  • Implement effective monitoring, logging, and access controls to protect systems, applications, and data.

Quick facts

About this job

Field Property Adjuster for Allstate conducting on-site home inspections, investigating claims, and preparing estimates. Position focuses on water loss claims and includes virtual claims work using Xactimate software.

Good fit if you have 2 years outside adjuster experience, can travel to customer homes, hold a valid driver's license, and live in Northern Virginia.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Opportunities are available for Northern Virginia

Interviews for these openings will take place in person on November 18 and 19.

In-Person Interview Location:

The Glass Factory

241 E 4th Street

Frederick, MD 21701


A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you willprovideexceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide,leveragingvarious platforms and software such as Xactimate andClaimsXVideo Collaboration. Yourexpertisewill be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'llwear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expertyoulllive into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you willaccomplishthat by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.

  • The Investigator youllconfidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies todeterminecoverage.

  • The Effective Communicatoryoulluse phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process.Youllalso incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on theclaimprogress.

  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants,in accordance withall legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

  • The Problem Solveryoullutilizemultiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, andadditionalsettlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

  • The Recorderyoullprotect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trainedin.Youllaccomplishthis by ensuringtimelyandaccuratedocumentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2years'previousexperience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

  • Construction Program or Construction or Mitigation Estimating desired.

  • Previousexperience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

  • Proficiencyin using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.

  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately andexpediteclaimssettlements.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.

  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.

  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.

  • This position is not available for California, Alaska,Hawaiior Puerto Rico residents.

Required Qualifications:

  • Residency within Northern Virginia is mandatory for this role.

  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch onaone to two-story roof.

  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

Youreprovided with comprehensive training:

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in yourday-to-daywork.

  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

  • You willbe requiredto attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place inDallas, TX.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing anadditionalbackground check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you willbe requiredto secure license(s) within60 daysof hire.

  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/orapplicableAppraiser License.

*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-onbonus.

Company Car:

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership teamdeterminesthis based on annual work mileage for this location. You maybe requiredto use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as anAllstater,youllenjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.

  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.

  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Chicago, IL

About this job

Analyze cloud and Kubernetes usage to identify cost optimization opportunities and build automation to help teams reduce spending. Partner with engineering, finance, and product teams to translate usage data into actionable recommendations.

Good fit if you have hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, know Python or another scripting language, and can communicate technical information clearly.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

About the Team


  • Our FinOps team helps technology and product teams better understand what they are spending in the cloud, where that spending is going, and how they can get more value from it. We partner across engineering, product, architecture, finance, and procurement to turn complex cloud-usage data into practical recommendations and measurable outcomes.
  • We are hiring because cloud usage continues to grow, and we need additional technical capability to identify optimization opportunities, automate analysis, and help teams take action.
  • The team plans to expand as we move beyond traditional cloud-cost reporting toward more proactive workload optimization, unit economics, automation, and cost management for emerging technologies such as AI.

What Youll Do


  • In this role, you will help teams understand and optimize the cost of their cloud and containerized workloads. You will analyze usage data, identify opportunities, build lightweight automation, and translate your findings into recommendations that engineering, product, finance, and leadership teams can act on.
  • You do not need to be an expert in every area of FinOps. We are looking for someone with a strong cloud or engineering foundation who enjoys working with data, solving open-ended problems, and learning new areas.

Why You May Be Interested


  • You will have the opportunity to shape how FinOps capabilities are built and delivered, rather than simply operating an established process.
  • You will work directly with cloud, Kubernetes, engineering, finance, architecture, and product teams.
  • You will see the measurable impact of your work through improved cloud efficiency and cost savings.
  • You will have the flexibility to test new ideas, recommend tools, and build practical solutions.
  • You will gain exposure to developing areas such as unit economics, AI cost management, and token-based consumption.
  • You will join a growing team where initiative, curiosity, and continuous learning are valued.

Job Responsibilities


  • Analyze cloud and Kubernetes usage to identify idle capacity, inefficient workloads, cost anomalies, and practical optimization opportunities.
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to evaluate recommendations, explain expected impact, and support implementation.
  • Build lightweight scripts, API integrations, and repeatable workflows that reduce manual analysis and connect relevant data sources.
  • Develop reports, dashboards, forecasts, and cost insights that help teams understand spending trends and plan future cloud usage.
  • Support cloud commitment planning, reservations, savings programs, and other strategies that improve overall cloud-cost efficiency.
  • Help expand FinOps practices through standards, documentation, education, and tools that enable product and engineering teams to take greater ownership of their cloud costs.

Mandatory Qualifications


  • Hands-on experience working with at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience analyzing or optimizing cloud infrastructure, containerized applications, or Kubernetes-based workloads.
  • Working knowledge of cloud billing, usage, cost allocation, forecasting, or cost-optimization concepts.
  • Ability to use Python or another scripting language for basic automation, API calls, data preparation, or systems integration.
  • Experience using data to identify trends, investigate issues, and develop clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical and financial information to engineering, finance, product, and leadership audiences.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with FinOps, cloud financial management, technology business management, or cloud-cost optimization.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Apptio Cloudability, VMware CloudHealth, Finout, Adaptive6, or cloud-native cost-management platforms.
  • Experience with Kubernetes cost allocation, workload rightsizing, autoscaling, cluster efficiency, or shared-cost analysis.
  • Experience using SQL, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Datadog, or similar analytical and observability tools.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, developer portals, or engineering automation workflows.
  • Exposure to unit economics, AI cost governance, token consumption, model-selection economics, or FinOps Foundation practices and certifications.

Synonymous titles: Cloud Cost Optimization Engineer, Cloud FinOps Engineer, Digital Cost Management Consultant, FinOps Platform Product Owner, Consumption Analytics Lead, Cloud Economics Consultant

Skills

AI Ops, API Calls, Cloud Economics, Cloud Infrastructure, Cloud Platform, Cost Optimization, IT Cost Optimization, Kubernetes, Scripting, Terraform (Software)

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 98,100.00 - 167,850.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
