Positivity. Flexibility. Determination and a persuasive personality. Qualities like these cannot be taught. But they can be sharpened, strengthened, and appropriately compensated when you join Liberty Mutual Insurance as a part of our Contact Center Sales Organization. Bring your unique sales talent to our Fortune 100 company and receive paid-training, licensing in all 50 states, and a dynamic role that directs only warm leads your way (no cold calls) because we believe in supporting your success, not holding it back. Join our sales team and realize the rewards of a career with unlimited earning potential, generous commissions, and a portfolio of benefits that start on day one.

Job Details

As an Inside Sales Agent you will be handling inbound calls and warm leads, consulting with customers on their insurance needs and match the correct coverages, products, and benefits to convert sales leads into policyholders.

Due to state licensing restrictions, employees must remain in their resident state for at least one year before relocating.

Youd be a great fit if you are:

A Passionate Seller:When a lead comes in, you skillfully pick up the phone and use your sales expertise to turn prospects into happy, confident Liberty Mutualpolicyholders.

A Front Lines Liaison:You rise to the role of representing the Liberty brand, you believe in what youre selling, and you enjoy connecting customers to the right products for their individual needs.

A Reliable Teammate:Whether you work at the office or from home, you adapt well to different environments, schedules, and the varying needs of ourpolicyholders.

A Customer-Centric Closer:While sales is in your title, integrity is in your nature. That means you sincerely care that our customers get exactly the quality products and services they need to embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.

Position Details:

From day one you will begin paid training in a remote work environment. All insurance representatives need to hold a Property & Casualty Insurance license. If you do not have one, no worries, paid training also includes licensing!

  • Training extends over a period of 16 weeks for licensed hires and 18 weeks for unlicensed hires.
  • Comprehensive medical benefits from Day 1.
  • No cold calls, all incoming warm leads.
  • Opportunities for rewards and recognition.

  • Must be available to work a schedule of 4 weekdays and 1 weekend day. Standard shift is 11:30-8 EST, 12:30-9 CST, or 8:30-5 PST.

  • All computer equipment is provided. Youmust be able to maintain department.Work at home (W@H) requirements whichinclude a professional workspace/room with adedicated desk and wired (cable, fiber of DSLservice) high-speed internet connection with aminimum 100 MBps download speed and 20MBps upload speed. Liberty Mutual does notsupport satellite and mobile internet services.
Qualifications
  • 2-3 years sales experience preferred. 2 yearsof sales/service-related work experiencerequired.
  • Strong, engaging interpersonal and persuasion skills needed to close sales
  • Ability to communicate well to both prospects and customers
  • Excellent analytical, decision-making and organizational skills
  • Strong typing capabilities and PC proficiency
  • Property and Casualty License required afterhire.

Positivity. Flexibility. Determination and a persuasive personality. Qualities like these cannot be taught. But they can be sharpened, strengthened, and appropriately compensated when you join Liberty Mutual Insurance as a part of our Contact Center Sales Organization. Bring your unique sales talent to our Fortune 100 company and receive paid-training, licensing in all 50 states, and a dynamic role that directs only warm leads your way (no cold calls) because we believe in supporting your success, not holding it back. Join our sales team and realize the rewards of a career with unlimited earning potential, generous commissions, and a portfolio of benefits that start on day one.

Job Details

As an Inside Sales Agent you will be handling inbound calls and warm leads, consulting with customers on their insurance needs and match the correct coverages, products, and benefits to convert sales leads into policyholders.

Due to state licensing restrictions, employees must remain in their resident state for at least one year before relocating.

Youd be a great fit if you are:

A Passionate Seller:When a lead comes in, you skillfully pick up the phone and use your sales expertise to turn prospects into happy, confident Liberty Mutualpolicyholders.

A Front Lines Liaison:You rise to the role of representing the Liberty brand, you believe in what youre selling, and you enjoy connecting customers to the right products for their individual needs.

A Reliable Teammate:Whether you work at the office or from home, you adapt well to different environments, schedules, and the varying needs of ourpolicyholders.

A Customer-Centric Closer:While sales is in your title, integrity is in your nature. That means you sincerely care that our customers get exactly the quality products and services they need to embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.

Position Details:

From day one you will begin paid training in a remote work environment. All insurance representatives need to hold a Property & Casualty Insurance license. If you do not have one, no worries, paid training also includes licensing!

  • Training extends over a period of 16 weeks for licensed hires and 18 weeks for unlicensed hires.
  • Comprehensive medical benefits from Day 1.
  • No cold calls, all incoming warm leads.
  • Opportunities for rewards and recognition.

  • Must be available to work a schedule of 4 weekdays and 1 weekend day. Standard shift is 11:30-8 EST, 12:30-9 CST, or 8:30-5 PST.

  • All computer equipment is provided. Youmust be able to maintain department.Work at home (W@H) requirements whichinclude a professional workspace/room with adedicated desk and wired (cable, fiber of DSLservice) high-speed internet connection with aminimum 100 MBps download speed and 20MBps upload speed. Liberty Mutual does notsupport satellite and mobile internet services.
Qualifications
  • 2-3 years sales experience preferred. 2 yearsof sales/service-related work experiencerequired.
  • Strong, engaging interpersonal and persuasion skills needed to close sales
  • Ability to communicate well to both prospects and customers
  • Excellent analytical, decision-making and organizational skills
  • Strong typing capabilities and PC proficiency
  • Property and Casualty License required afterhire.

Good fit if you have 2 years sales or service experience, strong sales skills, reliable internet, and can work 4 weekdays plus 1 weekend day in an eligible state.

Full job description


Description

Apply Today January 2027 Training Classes Are Now Open

If you hold aP&C license, this is your opportunity to join Liberty Mutuals Inside Sales team and take the next step in a rewarding, growth-focused career. We are also welcoming unlicensed candidates who are ready to begin their insurance journey with free P&C license training and paid training time.

Key Dates:

  • Licensed Class: January 11, 2027
  • Unlicensed Class: January 25, 2027

Start your journey with us and build a career where your talent and passion for helping others truly make an impact.

As an Inside Sales Representative at Liberty Mutual, youll have the tools, training and support you need to succeed from day one.

Plus, youll enjoy:

  • Generous earning potential
  • Paid licensing and training opportunities
  • Comprehensive benefits
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Strong work-life balance
  • And more!

Why Liberty Mutual?

Pay Details:

  • Starting base salary is $45K with opportunity for growth.
  • Average earnings range from $55K-$75K through a combination of base salary and generouscommission.
  • Top Performing Agents in their second year and onward, can earn up to $85k+.

We are currently hiring quality Inbound sales professionals in the following states:AR, AZ, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NE, NH, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, andWV

Licensed only candidates based in ID, MT, WY, GA, TN, AL, OK, KS and KY Applicants must reside within these specified locations to be considered for this role.

Positivity. Flexibility. Determination and a persuasive personality. Qualities like these cannot be taught. But they can be sharpened, strengthened, and appropriately compensated when you join Liberty Mutual Insurance as a part of our Contact Center Sales Organization. Bring your unique sales talent to our Fortune 100 company and receive paid-training, licensing in all 50 states, and a dynamic role that directs only warm leads your way (no cold calls) because we believe in supporting your success, not holding it back. Join our sales team and realize the rewards of a career with unlimited earning potential, generous commissions, and a portfolio of benefits that start on day one.

Job Details

As an Inside Sales Agent you will be handling inbound calls and warm leads, consulting with customers on their insurance needs and match the correct coverages, products, and benefits to convert sales leads into policyholders.

Due to state licensing restrictions, employees must remain in their resident state for at least one year before relocating.

Youd be a great fit if you are:

A Passionate Seller:When a lead comes in, you skillfully pick up the phone and use your sales expertise to turn prospects into happy, confident Liberty Mutualpolicyholders.

A Front Lines Liaison:You rise to the role of representing the Liberty brand, you believe in what youre selling, and you enjoy connecting customers to the right products for their individual needs.

A Reliable Teammate:Whether you work at the office or from home, you adapt well to different environments, schedules, and the varying needs of ourpolicyholders.

A Customer-Centric Closer:While sales is in your title, integrity is in your nature. That means you sincerely care that our customers get exactly the quality products and services they need to embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.

Position Details:

From day one you will begin paid training in a remote work environment. All insurance representatives need to hold a Property & Casualty Insurance license. If you do not have one, no worries, paid training also includes licensing!

  • Training extends over a period of 16 weeks for licensed hires and 18 weeks for unlicensed hires.
  • Comprehensive medical benefits from Day 1.
  • No cold calls, all incoming warm leads.
  • Opportunities for rewards and recognition.

  • Must be available to work a schedule of 4 weekdays and 1 weekend day. Standard shift is 11:30-8 EST, 12:30-9 CST, or 8:30-5 PST.

  • All computer equipment is provided. Youmust be able to maintain department.Work at home (W@H) requirements whichinclude a professional workspace/room with adedicated desk and wired (cable, fiber of DSLservice) high-speed internet connection with aminimum 100 MBps download speed and 20MBps upload speed. Liberty Mutual does notsupport satellite and mobile internet services.
Qualifications
  • 2-3 years sales experience preferred. 2 yearsof sales/service-related work experiencerequired.
  • Strong, engaging interpersonal and persuasion skills needed to close sales
  • Ability to communicate well to both prospects and customers
  • Excellent analytical, decision-making and organizational skills
  • Strong typing capabilities and PC proficiency
  • Property and Casualty License required afterhire.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role isdeterminedbya number offactors including skills, experience, education,certificationsand location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market andprovidesan opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factorsset forth inthe compensation plan for the role.

We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

Plus, youll enjoy:

  • Generous earning potential
  • Paid licensing and training opportunities
  • Comprehensive benefits
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Strong work-life balance
  • And more!

Why Liberty Mutual?

Pay Details:

  • Starting base salary is $45K with opportunity for growth.
  • Average earnings range from $55K-$75K through a combination of base salary and generouscommission.
  • Top Performing Agents in their second year and onward, can earn up to $85k+.

We are currently hiring quality Inbound sales professionals in the following states:AR, AZ, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NE, NH, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, andWV

Licensed only candidates based in ID, MT, WY, GA, TN, AL, OK, KS and KY Applicants must reside within these specified locations to be considered for this role.

Positivity. Flexibility. Determination and a persuasive personality. Qualities like these cannot be taught. But they can be sharpened, strengthened, and appropriately compensated when you join Liberty Mutual Insurance as a part of our Contact Center Sales Organization. Bring your unique sales talent to our Fortune 100 company and receive paid-training, licensing in all 50 states, and a dynamic role that directs only warm leads your way (no cold calls) because we believe in supporting your success, not holding it back. Join our sales team and realize the rewards of a career with unlimited earning potential, generous commissions, and a portfolio of benefits that start on day one.

Job Details

As an Inside Sales Agent you will be handling inbound calls and warm leads, consulting with customers on their insurance needs and match the correct coverages, products, and benefits to convert sales leads into policyholders.

Due to state licensing restrictions, employees must remain in their resident state for at least one year before relocating.

Youd be a great fit if you are:

A Passionate Seller:When a lead comes in, you skillfully pick up the phone and use your sales expertise to turn prospects into happy, confident Liberty Mutualpolicyholders.

A Front Lines Liaison:You rise to the role of representing the Liberty brand, you believe in what youre selling, and you enjoy connecting customers to the right products for their individual needs.

A Reliable Teammate:Whether you work at the office or from home, you adapt well to different environments, schedules, and the varying needs of ourpolicyholders.

A Customer-Centric Closer:While sales is in your title, integrity is in your nature. That means you sincerely care that our customers get exactly the quality products and services they need to embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.

Position Details:

From day one you will begin paid training in a remote work environment. All insurance representatives need to hold a Property & Casualty Insurance license. If you do not have one, no worries, paid training also includes licensing!

  • Training extends over a period of 16 weeks for licensed hires and 18 weeks for unlicensed hires.
  • Comprehensive medical benefits from Day 1.
  • No cold calls, all incoming warm leads.
  • Opportunities for rewards and recognition.

  • Must be available to work a schedule of 4 weekdays and 1 weekend day. Standard shift is 11:30-8 EST, 12:30-9 CST, or 8:30-5 PST.

  • All computer equipment is provided. Youmust be able to maintain department.Work at home (W@H) requirements whichinclude a professional workspace/room with adedicated desk and wired (cable, fiber of DSLservice) high-speed internet connection with aminimum 100 MBps download speed and 20MBps upload speed. Liberty Mutual does notsupport satellite and mobile internet services.
Qualifications
  • 2-3 years sales experience preferred. 2 yearsof sales/service-related work experiencerequired.
  • Strong, engaging interpersonal and persuasion skills needed to close sales
  • Ability to communicate well to both prospects and customers
  • Excellent analytical, decision-making and organizational skills
  • Strong typing capabilities and PC proficiency
  • Property and Casualty License required afterhire.

If you hold aP&C license, this is your opportunity to join Liberty Mutuals Inside Sales team and take the next step in a rewarding, growth-focused career. We are also welcoming unlicensed candidates who are ready to begin their insurance journey with free P&C license training and paid training time.

Key Dates:

  • Licensed Class: January 11, 2027
  • Unlicensed Class: January 25, 2027

Start your journey with us and build a career where your talent and passion for helping others truly make an impact.

As an Inside Sales Representative at Liberty Mutual, youll have the tools, training and support you need to succeed from day one.

Plus, youll enjoy:

  • Generous earning potential
  • Paid licensing and training opportunities
  • Comprehensive benefits
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Strong work-life balance
  • And more!

Why Liberty Mutual?

Pay Details:

  • Starting base salary is $45K with opportunity for growth.
  • Average earnings range from $55K-$75K through a combination of base salary and generouscommission.
  • Top Performing Agents in their second year and onward, can earn up to $85k+.

We are currently hiring quality Inbound sales professionals in the following states:AR, AZ, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NE, NH, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, andWV

Licensed only candidates based in ID, MT, WY, GA, TN, AL, OK, KS and KY Applicants must reside within these specified locations to be considered for this role.

Positivity. Flexibility. Determination and a persuasive personality. Qualities like these cannot be taught. But they can be sharpened, strengthened, and appropriately compensated when you join Liberty Mutual Insurance as a part of our Contact Center Sales Organization. Bring your unique sales talent to our Fortune 100 company and receive paid-training, licensing in all 50 states, and a dynamic role that directs only warm leads your way (no cold calls) because we believe in supporting your success, not holding it back. Join our sales team and realize the rewards of a career with unlimited earning potential, generous commissions, and a portfolio of benefits that start on day one.

Job Details

As an Inside Sales Agent you will be handling inbound calls and warm leads, consulting with customers on their insurance needs and match the correct coverages, products, and benefits to convert sales leads into policyholders.

Due to state licensing restrictions, employees must remain in their resident state for at least one year before relocating.

Youd be a great fit if you are:

A Passionate Seller:When a lead comes in, you skillfully pick up the phone and use your sales expertise to turn prospects into happy, confident Liberty Mutualpolicyholders.

A Front Lines Liaison:You rise to the role of representing the Liberty brand, you believe in what youre selling, and you enjoy connecting customers to the right products for their individual needs.

A Reliable Teammate:Whether you work at the office or from home, you adapt well to different environments, schedules, and the varying needs of ourpolicyholders.

A Customer-Centric Closer:While sales is in your title, integrity is in your nature. That means you sincerely care that our customers get exactly the quality products and services they need to embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.

Position Details:

From day one you will begin paid training in a remote work environment. All insurance representatives need to hold a Property & Casualty Insurance license. If you do not have one, no worries, paid training also includes licensing!

  • Training extends over a period of 16 weeks for licensed hires and 18 weeks for unlicensed hires.
  • Comprehensive medical benefits from Day 1.
  • No cold calls, all incoming warm leads.
  • Opportunities for rewards and recognition.

  • Must be available to work a schedule of 4 weekdays and 1 weekend day. Standard shift is 11:30-8 EST, 12:30-9 CST, or 8:30-5 PST.

  • All computer equipment is provided. Youmust be able to maintain department.Work at home (W@H) requirements whichinclude a professional workspace/room with adedicated desk and wired (cable, fiber of DSLservice) high-speed internet connection with aminimum 100 MBps download speed and 20MBps upload speed. Liberty Mutual does notsupport satellite and mobile internet services.
Qualifications
  • 2-3 years sales experience preferred. 2 yearsof sales/service-related work experiencerequired.
  • Strong, engaging interpersonal and persuasion skills needed to close sales
  • Ability to communicate well to both prospects and customers
  • Excellent analytical, decision-making and organizational skills
  • Strong typing capabilities and PC proficiency
  • Property and Casualty License required afterhire.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role isdeterminedbya number offactors including skills, experience, education,certificationsand location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market andprovidesan opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factorsset forth inthe compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

Liberty Mutualisan equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discriminationon the basis ofrace, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal,stateor local law.

Fair Chance Notices

  • California
  • Los Angeles Incorporated
  • Los Angeles Unincorporated
  • Philadelphia
  • San Francisco

If you hold aP&C license, this is your opportunity to join Liberty Mutuals Inside Sales team and take the next step in a rewarding, growth-focused career. We are also welcoming unlicensed candidates who are ready to begin their insurance journey with free P&C license training and paid training time.

Key Dates:

  • Licensed Class: January 11, 2027
  • Unlicensed Class: January 25, 2027

Start your journey with us and build a career where your talent and passion for helping others truly make an impact.

As an Inside Sales Representative at Liberty Mutual, youll have the tools, training and support you need to succeed from day one.

Plus, youll enjoy:

  • Generous earning potential
  • Paid licensing and training opportunities
  • Comprehensive benefits
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Strong work-life balance
  • And more!

Why Liberty Mutual?

Pay Details:

  • Starting base salary is $45K with opportunity for growth.
  • Average earnings range from $55K-$75K through a combination of base salary and generouscommission.
  • Top Performing Agents in their second year and onward, can earn up to $85k+.

We are currently hiring quality Inbound sales professionals in the following states:AR, AZ, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NE, NH, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, andWV

Licensed only candidates based in ID, MT, WY, GA, TN, AL, OK, KS and KY Applicants must reside within these specified locations to be considered for this role.

Positivity. Flexibility. Determination and a persuasive personality. Qualities like these cannot be taught. But they can be sharpened, strengthened, and appropriately compensated when you join Liberty Mutual Insurance as a part of our Contact Center Sales Organization. Bring your unique sales talent to our Fortune 100 company and receive paid-training, licensing in all 50 states, and a dynamic role that directs only warm leads your way (no cold calls) because we believe in supporting your success, not holding it back. Join our sales team and realize the rewards of a career with unlimited earning potential, generous commissions, and a portfolio of benefits that start on day one.

Job Details

As an Inside Sales Agent you will be handling inbound calls and warm leads, consulting with customers on their insurance needs and match the correct coverages, products, and benefits to convert sales leads into policyholders.

Due to state licensing restrictions, employees must remain in their resident state for at least one year before relocating.

Youd be a great fit if you are:

A Passionate Seller:When a lead comes in, you skillfully pick up the phone and use your sales expertise to turn prospects into happy, confident Liberty Mutualpolicyholders.

A Front Lines Liaison:You rise to the role of representing the Liberty brand, you believe in what youre selling, and you enjoy connecting customers to the right products for their individual needs.

A Reliable Teammate:Whether you work at the office or from home, you adapt well to different environments, schedules, and the varying needs of ourpolicyholders.

A Customer-Centric Closer:While sales is in your title, integrity is in your nature. That means you sincerely care that our customers get exactly the quality products and services they need to embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.

Position Details:

From day one you will begin paid training in a remote work environment. All insurance representatives need to hold a Property & Casualty Insurance license. If you do not have one, no worries, paid training also includes licensing!

  • Training extends over a period of 16 weeks for licensed hires and 18 weeks for unlicensed hires.
  • Comprehensive medical benefits from Day 1.
  • No cold calls, all incoming warm leads.
  • Opportunities for rewards and recognition.

  • Must be available to work a schedule of 4 weekdays and 1 weekend day. Standard shift is 11:30-8 EST, 12:30-9 CST, or 8:30-5 PST.

  • All computer equipment is provided. Youmust be able to maintain department.Work at home (W@H) requirements whichinclude a professional workspace/room with adedicated desk and wired (cable, fiber of DSLservice) high-speed internet connection with aminimum 100 MBps download speed and 20MBps upload speed. Liberty Mutual does notsupport satellite and mobile internet services.
Qualifications
  • 2-3 years sales experience preferred. 2 yearsof sales/service-related work experiencerequired.
  • Strong, engaging interpersonal and persuasion skills needed to close sales
  • Ability to communicate well to both prospects and customers
  • Excellent analytical, decision-making and organizational skills
  • Strong typing capabilities and PC proficiency
  • Property and Casualty License required afterhire.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role isdeterminedbya number offactors including skills, experience, education,certificationsand location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market andprovidesan opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factorsset forth inthe compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

Liberty Mutualisan equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discriminationon the basis ofrace, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal,stateor local law.

As an Inside Sales Agent you will be handling inbound calls and warm leads, consulting with customers on their insurance needs and match the correct coverages, products, and benefits to convert sales leads into policyholders.

  • Must be available to work a schedule of 4 weekdays and 1 weekend day. Standard shift is 11:30-8 EST, 12:30-9 CST, or 8:30-5 PST.

  • All computer equipment is provided. Youmust be able to maintain department.Work at home (W@H) requirements whichinclude a professional workspace/room with adedicated desk and wired (cable, fiber of DSLservice) high-speed internet connection with aminimum 100 MBps download speed and 20MBps upload speed. Liberty Mutual does notsupport satellite and mobile internet services.

  • 2-3 years sales experience preferred. 2 yearsof sales/service-related work experiencerequired.
  • Strong, engaging interpersonal and persuasion skills needed to close sales.
  • Ability to communicate well to both prospects and customers.
  • Excellent analytical, decision-making and organizational skills.
  • Strong typing capabilities and PC proficiency.

About this job

Lead Liberty Mutual's state government affairs strategy across multiple U.S. regions, managing regional officers and external lobbying resources. This role includes modernizing the function by scaling AI into legislative and regulatory tracking to expand coverage and analytical depth.

Good fit if you have 15+ years in state government affairs or related fields, deep insurance knowledge, and experience leading teams and implementing organizational change.

Full job description


Description

Role Summary:

The Head of State Government Affairs leads Liberty Mutual's state government affairs strategy and execution across multiple U.S. regions. The role manages regional government affairs officers and external lobbying resources, oversees the state team budget, and serves as a principal advisor to the Chief Government Affairs Officer, senior leaders, and business stakeholders on legislative, regulatory, political, and business developments.

The successful candidate brings deep state government affairs expertise, extensive insurance knowledge, strong strategic judgment, persuasive communication skills, disciplined execution, and the ability to align diverse internal and external stakeholders. The role independently evaluates complex and ambiguous issues and develops and leads advocacy strategies that advance Liberty Mutual's business, legal, and public policy priorities.

This is also a change management role. Beyond running a high-performing team, the successful candidate will modernize how that function works scaling AI into core processes as standard practice, starting with legislative and regulatory tracking so the team scans more jurisdictions, spots developments earlier, and advises with sharper insight than traditional approaches allow.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead the Function

  • Lead the state government affairs function, including regional officers, external lobbying and trade association resources, and the team budget setting clear goals, deploying resources effectively, and maintaining accountability for outcomes.
  • Coach and develop a geographically dispersed team of experienced professionals: set direction, delegate effectively, give direct feedback, create stretch opportunities, and build bench strength in an inclusive environment.
  • Partner with the Chief Government Affairs Officer, Government Affairs colleagues, senior leaders, and business stakeholders to identify priority state issues and develop enterprise-aligned strategies, operating plans, resource priorities, and measurable objectives.

Drive Advocacy Strategy and Execution

  • Direct state legislative and administrative advocacy coordinating internal and external resources, establishing priorities and milestones, sequencing work against legislative sessions and regulatory timelines, managing interdependencies across regions and functions, monitoring progress, addressing barriers, and adjusting strategies and tactics as circumstances change.
  • Assess the policy, political, legal, and business implications of high-risk or high-value matters and in partnership with the Head of Regulatory Policy as appropriate shape policy positions and recommend resource allocation, escalation, stakeholder engagement, and next steps.
  • Monitor and synthesize state legislative, regulatory, and political developments and advise the Chief Government Affairs Officer, senior leaders, and business partners on priorities, business implications, risks, opportunities, progress, and recommended decisions or actions.
  • Oversee high-quality advocacy and executive materials, including policy analyses, regulatory comments, testimony, briefings, presentations, legislative updates, and responses to government inquiries.
  • Build trusted relationships with key legislators, legislative staff, executive-branch officials, regulators, trade associations, coalitions, and other partners to advance priority issues and enterprise policy objectives.
  • Contribute to political affairs and related compliance activities in coordination with Legal and Government Affairs partners.

Change Management and Scaling AI

  • Lead change management for the function reassessing workflows, resourcing models, and ways of working to increase speed, reach, and analytical depth, and bringing the team along through the transition.
  • Scale and integrate AI into core processes as standard practice, with a particular focus on legislative and regulatory tracking using AI to scan and monitor notable bill activity, regulatory changes, and political developments across jurisdictions, flagging what matters earlier, more comprehensively and with trend/analysis insight than manual review allows.
  • Extend AI-enabled support to related work including policy analysis, drafting, and reporting.
  • Build team capability and confidence in new tools and methods, setting clear expectations for adoption while maintaining rigorous standards for accuracy, judgment, and compliance AI augments the team's expertise, it does not substitute for it.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree required, with Juris Doctor or other advanced relevant degree preferred, and demonstrated academic or professional excellence.
  • Typically, 15 or more years of progressively responsible experience in law, government, government affairs, public policy, or a related field, including leadership of multi-state strategies, internal teams, outside lobbying firms, coalitions, and/or trade association engagement.
  • Expert knowledge of state legislative, administrative, regulatory, and political processes including key decision makers, timing, and influence points together with strong command of insurance issues, corporate operations, and business objectives.
  • Sound judgment and strong problem-solving and execution skills, with the ability to assess complex or ambiguous issues, anticipate developments, balance business objectives and risk, prioritize competing demands, coordinate resources, and deliver results on deadline.
  • Demonstrated change management experience having shifted how a team or function operates and achieved sustained adoption of new ways of working.
  • Strong project and program management capability, with a record of delivering complex, multi-workstream initiatives to plan.
  • Clear, concise, credible, and persuasive written and verbal communication, including the ability to translate complex issues for executives, policymakers, regulators, business partners, employees, and external stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to advise senior executives, influence without authority, navigate competing interests, and build consensus among internal and external stakeholders.
  • Inclusive and effective people leadership, including setting direction, delegating effectively, holding others accountable, coaching and developing talent, and championing the use of technology and AI to improve how work gets done.
  • Ability to travel as needed.

Description

The US Retail Markets (USRM) Independent Agent Distribution Transformation Lead focuses on the most critical value drivers for the aligned SBU by quarterbacking initiatives that are highly complex, cross-functional, and cross-imperative. They will be responsible for effectively designing solutions to enable us to achieve our business goals while advancing the customer, agent, and employee experience. The Transformation Lead will effectively synthesize diverse, varying perspectives into a cohesive and aligned strategy by bringing the right voices to the table, building mutual trust / strong relationships, and allowing for vigorous debate. They will drive a unified vision across senior leaders and key stakeholders inside and outside of the SBU, while ensuring initiatives are in alignment with strategic business priorities. Ultimately, the Transformation Lead needs to leverage varying resources to build the aligned team that will turn strategy into reality, ensuring robust execution and outcome achievement.

**This role may have in-office requirements dependent upon candidate location.**

Responsibilities

  • Creates and leads the strategic direction for large scale cross functional initiatives that balances business strategy, marketplace research, and ideation for the creation of holistic customer and user solutions within the SBU.
  • Defines the future target state and partners with the solution delivery teams to identify the path to get there. Collaborates with executives, senior leaders, and other stakeholders to scope opportunities, develop, and prioritize projects in alignment with SBU strategy.
  • Leverages analytics and data to understand how to optimize for the best outcome. Understands how to apply user research and synthesize into programs to set direction of design that accomplishes goals.
  • Proactively identifies interdependencies, efficiencies, resources needed, and any barriers that may create risk with time to market and budget constraints. Indirectly manages assigned work streams, each with varying priorities, timelines, and resource requirements for multiple initiatives.
  • Dives deep into the underlying tech architecture and supports the team in solutioning that supports future state vision and closes gaps in business and technology.
Qualifications
  • Preference for related 4 year degree with minimum requirement of 10 years` experience with demonstrated capability in managing large, complex stakeholder projects
  • Effective communication, influencing, organizational and analytical skills required
  • Ability to set expectations upward through managing scope, ability to craft narrative, and navigate across governance structures required to keep multiple sub-workstreams moving forward
  • Drives a high performing culture by modeling commitment, building trust across extended teams, curiosity about different perspectives, and challenges the status quo while providing clarity and direction for teams executing on the work

Job.JobTitle: Claims Team Manager, Workers Compensation West Region
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Liberty Mutual has an immediate opening for a Claims Team Manager to lead a Workers Compensation team.

In order to deliver an exceptional customer experience, a leader creates a culture of engagement by inspiring passion in others. A leader explores opportunities to continuously improve within a constantly changing environment. A leader challenges each team member to exceed expectations while developing professionally. A leader understands the vision of Liberty Mutual and can translate how their teams work connects to that vision. A leader confidently communicates what extraordinary claim service looks like and empowers their team to achieve superior result.

The Claims Team Manager leads a team of Claims Specialists who manage a portfolio of Workers Compensation Claims to achieve the best possible outcomes and deliver an exceptional customer experience. The Claims Team Manager contributes to the organizations success by developing talented employees, creating a work environment where employees feel appreciated, and exploring opportunities to continuously improve and adapt to a changing environment.

If you reside within 50-miles of a Commercial Claims office, you will be required to go to the office twice a month - subject to change. Due to customer needs, the selected person must be located in a West Coast state (OR, NV, CA or AZ preferred).

Responsibilities:

  • Supervises the day-to-day operations for the claims staff by establishing priorities, scheduling and assigning work, and coaching employees in reviewing, analyzing, investigating, negotiating and settling claims in compliance with Claims Quality Standards.
  • Creates a high performing, results-oriented staff through candidate selection, onboarding, ongoing development, and managing individual performance with regular coaching focused on behavior and technical skill sets.
  • Leads and actively contributes to a culture of continuous improvement and ensures utilization of tools and behaviors within the Liberty Management System to foster critical thinking and innovation around problem solving and development of standard work.
  • Responsible for building and maintaining internal and external customer relationships. Serves as a primary point of contact for agents, brokers and policyholders.
  • Hosts and facilitates in person and/or telephonic claim reviews on a continuous cycle and ensures Special Service Instructions are managed appropriately.
  • Often called upon to do presentations for existing and prospective customers.
  • Provides management oversight of claims files (non-litigated or litigated) within the unit, to include Manager Reviews on open inventory and reviews files to measure quality assurance discusses individual training and development needs.
  • Coaches to improve technical expertise within the team
  • Monitors, evaluates and approves, within assigned authority limits, claims reserves, settlements and payments that exceed staff authority thresholds.
  • Uses common reporting of data analytics to monitor claim production, inventory management, financial and quality compliance and claim volume trends and results. Data used to communicate team performance relating to production, significant achievements and areas for continuous improvement.
  • Manages compliance within internal and external parameters, including: Oversees Liberty Mutual/Helmsman state licensing compliance and adherence to fair claims practices.
  • Maintains awareness of existing and proposed legislation, court decisions and emerging trends in claims litigation to monitor team compliance with Unfair Claims Practices.
Qualifications
  • Advanced knowledge of Workers Compensation Claims investigation, loss assessment, reserving, insurance legal and regulatory environment, litigation and fraud awareness.
  • Ability to get work done through others, communicate effectively (including listening, writing clearly, giving constructive feedback, etc.), get support from above, plan/organize work, analyze/solve problems, and focus on the larger picture.
  • Knowledge and capabilities typically acquired through a BS/BA degree (or equivalent) and at least 6 years of related experience.
  • Workers Compensation claims experience required.
  • Claims management or demonstrated leadership experience desired.
  • Experience with dedicated accounts preferred.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Claims Specialist II (Construction Liability Bodily Injury and GL Property Damage)
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Description

If youre looking for a claims role where you can make a real impactnot just manage a deskthis is it. Our Construction Liability team handles moderate to high-exposure 3rd party bodily injury and general liability property damage claims for some of the largest owner/developers, general contractors, and subcontractors across the country. From NY Labor Law and OCIP/CCIP programs to auto accidents, road construction losses, underground utility strikes, and major liability exposures tied to active job sites across the Country, the work is challenging, fast-moving, and meaningful.

The Senior Claims Specialist works within a Claims Team navigating some of the most challenging construction claims in the industry. You will work in a team of claims professionals who may work in office or remote depending on their location. You will partner with a strong leadership team that values accountability, collaboration, and growth. If you enjoy working along top talent, making tough decisions, and being part of a team that takes pride in doing the right thing at the right time, this is a place where you can build something bigger than just your next role.

This includes making decisions about liability/compensability, evaluating losses, negotiating settlements and managing an inventory of commercial property/casualty claims involving bodily injury or property loss. The Senior Claims Specialist may also assist the Claims Team Manager with assigning new claims to team members, providing technical direction, and monitoring caseloads.

This is a remote position. You will be required to go into the office twice a month if you reside within 50 miles of one of the following offices: Boston, MA; Portland, Oregon; Plano, TX or Hoffman Estates, IL and Lake Mary, Florida. Please note this policy is subject to change.

Responsibilities:

  • Plans and conducts investigations of multi-party construction bodily injury and property damage liability claims across jurisdictions. Independently manage moderate to high exposure claims involving Commercial General Liability policies including OCP, OCIP, CCIP and Self-Insured Retention programs. Conduct timely liability investigations, evaluate risk transfer opportunities, and develop defense strategies in coordination with counsel to drive efficient, outcome-focused resolutions.
  • Drive proactive claim outcomes through early investigations and strategic decision making. Own the full claim lifecycle from coverage analysis and reserving to negotiation and resolution by making timely, well-supported decisions. Actively manage litigation, set clear expectations with clients and counsel, and pursue early resolution strategies to reduce cycle time, legal spend, and overall claim severity.
  • Acts as senior technical professional on team, mentor and elevate team performance through coaching. Serve as a resource for less experienced adjusters by providing real-time guidance on coverage, liability, and investigation strategy. Reinforce best practices in documentation, reserving and communication, contributing to improved QA outcomes and consistent execution across the team.
  • Participates in conducting Suit Committees, Roundtables, Arbitrations, Mediations, field investigations and may assist in conducting closed file reviews.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
  • Moderate technical expertise handling commercial auto and general liability bodily injury and property damage claims preferred. Demonstrated ability to handle multi-part litigation, contract interpretation, and risk transfer (additional insured and indemnity) preferred. interpersonal skills to communicate and negotiate with customers and conduct investigations required.
  • 4-6 years experience in managing 3rd party bodily injury and property damage litigated claims for both insured and self-insured clients, including directing defense counsel, evaluating exposure, and negotiating settlements.
  • Demonstrated leadership ability and time management skills to delegate work appropriately and organize resources effectively.
  • Licensing required in some states
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. This is a remote position. You will be required to go into the office twice a month if you reside within 50 miles of one of the following offices: Boston, MA; Portland, Oregon; Plano, TX or Hoffman Estates, IL and Lake Mary, Florida. Please note this policy is subject to change.

Responsibilities:

  • Plans and conducts investigations of multi-party construction bodily injury and property damage liability claims across jurisdictions. Independently manage moderate to high exposure claims involving Commercial General Liability policies including OCP, OCIP, CCIP and Self-Insured Retention programs. Conduct timely liability investigations, evaluate risk transfer opportunities, and develop defense strategies in coordination with counsel to drive efficient, outcome-focused resolutions.
  • Drive proactive claim outcomes through early investigations and strategic decision making. Own the full claim lifecycle from coverage analysis and reserving to negotiation and resolution by making timely, well-supported decisions. Actively manage litigation, set clear expectations with clients and counsel, and pursue early resolution strategies to reduce cycle time, legal spend, and overall claim severity.
  • Acts as senior technical professional on team, mentor and elevate team performance through coaching. Serve as a resource for less experienced adjusters by providing real-time guidance on coverage, liability, and investigation strategy. Reinforce best practices in documentation, reserving and communication, contributing to improved QA outcomes and consistent execution across the team.
  • Participates in conducting Suit Committees, Roundtables, Arbitrations, Mediations, field investigations and may assist in conducting closed file reviews.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
  • Moderate technical expertise handling commercial auto and general liability bodily injury and property damage claims preferred. Demonstrated ability to handle multi-part litigation, contract interpretation, and risk transfer (additional insured and indemnity) preferred. interpersonal skills to communicate and negotiate with customers and conduct investigations required.
  • 4-6 years experience in managing 3rd party bodily injury and property damage litigated claims for both insured and self-insured clients, including directing defense counsel, evaluating exposure, and negotiating settlements.
  • Demonstrated leadership ability and time management skills to delegate work appropriately and organize resources effectively.
  • Licensing required in some states

Description

Join us as a Field Property Claims Adjuster where youll be responsible for helping our customers navigate the claims process and get back on their feet following damage to the homeowners property. This is a role where people who love every day to be new, different and exciting, can thrive youll be traveling on the road to meet customers in person, providing hands-on assessment of damage and empathetic support.

The Field Property Claims Adjuster will be traveling locally to insured homes within Kansas City, KS (66111) and surrounding areas. To be successful within the role, candidates should live within or near this area.

Sign-On Bonus Available! Were offering a sign-on bonus for experienced and actively licensed new hires.

What youll do

  • Investigate and evaluate onsite to resolve complex coverage and damage issues to include preparing complete estimates of repair for the covered damages. This may include accessing roofs by ladder, inspecting attics, crawl spaces and basements in search of damage.
  • Handle moderate to complex claims independently while managing your workload, from first notice of loss to final closure.
  • Be expected to work in a vehicle in the field daily while occasionally handling assignments from the desk.
  • Explain coverage of loss, assist policyholders with itemization of damages, emergency repairs and additional living arrangements.
  • Work with and coordinate a few vendor services such as contractors, emergency repair, cleaning services and various replacement services.
  • May be called upon for catastrophe duty.

  • Territory-based work:Most workdays will be spent in the field within your assigned local territory, giving you the opportunity to work directly with customers and gain hands-on experience.

    • Primarily virtual and on-the-job learning.

Description

Apply Today Training Classes Begin in January 2027!

Looking for a career in insurance? Join our Inside Sales team and get free P&C license training with paid training time. Start your rewarding career today!

Key Date:

  • Licensed Class: January 11, 2027
  • Unlicensed Class: January 25, 2027

Start your journey with us and build a career where your talent and passion for helping others truly make an impact.

As an Inside Sales Representative at Liberty Mutual, youll have the tools, training and support you need to succeed from day one.

Plus, youll enjoy:

  • Generous earning potential
  • Paid licensing and training opportunities
  • Comprehensive benefits
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Strong work-life balance
  • And more!

Why Liberty Mutual?

Pay Details:

  • Starting base salary is $45K with opportunity for growth.
  • Average earnings range from $55K-$75K through a combination of base salary and generouscommission.
  • Top Performing Agents in their second year and onward, can earn up to $85k+.

We are currently hiring quality Inbound sales professionals in the following states:AR, AZ, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NE, NH, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, andWV

Licensed only candidates based in ID, MT, WY, GA, TN, AL, OK, KS and KY. Applicants must reside within these specified locations to be considered for this role.

Positivity. Flexibility. Determination and a persuasive personality. Qualities like these cannot be taught. But they can be sharpened, strengthened, and appropriately compensated when you join Liberty Mutual Insurance as a part of our Contact Center Sales Organization. Bring your unique sales talent to our Fortune 100 company and receive paid-training, licensing in all 50 states, and a dynamic role that directs only warm leads your way (no cold calls) because we believe in supporting your success, not holding it back. Join our sales team and realize the rewards of a career with unlimited earning potential, generous commissions, and a portfolio of benefits that start on day one.

Job Details

As an Inside Sales Agent, you will be handling inbound calls and warm leads, consulting with customers on their insurance needs and match the correct coverages, products, and benefits to convert sales leads into policyholders.

Due to state licensing restrictions, employees must remain in their resident state for at least one year before relocating.

Youd be a great fit if you are:

A Passionate Seller:When a lead comes in, you skillfully pick up the phone and use your sales expertise to turn prospects into happy, confident Liberty Mutualpolicyholders.

A Front Lines Liaison:You rise to the role of representing the Liberty brand, you believe in what youre selling, and you enjoy connecting customers to the right products for their individual needs.

A Reliable Teammate:Whether you work at the office or from home, you adapt well to different environments, schedules, and the varying needs of ourpolicyholders.

A Customer-Centric Closer:While sales is in your title, integrity is in your nature. That means you sincerely care that our customers get exactly the quality products and services they need to embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.

Position Details:

From day one you will begin paid training in a remote work environment. All insurance representatives need to hold a Property & Casualty Insurance license. If you do not have one, no worries, paid training also includes licensing!

  • Training extends over a period of 16 weeks for licensed hires and 18 weeks for unlicensed hires.
  • Comprehensive medical benefits from Day 1.
  • No cold calls, all incoming warm leads.
  • Opportunities for rewards and recognition.

  • Must be available to work a schedule of 4 weekdays and 1 weekend day. Standard shift is 11:30-8 EST, 12:30-9 CST, or 8:30-5 PST.

  • All computer equipment is provided. Youmust be able to maintain department.Work at home (W@H) requirements whichinclude a professional workspace/room with adedicated desk and wired (cable, fiber of DSLservice) high-speed internet connection with aminimum 100 MBps download speed and 20MBps upload speed. Description

The Details

Join Solaria Labs as a Data Science Co-op and become an integral part of our innovation-driven team tackling diverse and complex challenges in the insurance domain. We leverage both Liberty Mutual and partner data, applying the latest AI and Machine Learning techniques to create solutions that redefine whats possible. As a co-op, youll collaborate with data scientists and engineering teams to explore and experiment with new concepts and approaches that could shape the future of insurance.

What Youll Do

  • Collaborate within an innovative lab environmentbalancing focused coding sessions with active participation in ideation and product design.
  • Explore and experiment with emerging AI technologies such as large language models, natural language processing (NLP), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic AI, information retrieval,and computer vision, applying these technologiesto prototype solutions for insurance challenges.
  • Develop and iterate on prototypes using Python, thriving in a fast-paced R&D setting with a start-up mentality.
  • Build custom algorithms, uncover data-driven insights, and share findings with the team and stakeholders.
  • Continuously sharpen your skills by embracing new technologies and participating in hackathons, meetups, and other learning opportunities.
Qualifications

Who Youll Bring

  • You must be able to work full-time from January June 2027.
  • Working towards a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD Degree in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or another related technical field, with a strong academic record with a cumulative 3.0 GPA preferred.
  • Relevant Internship or industry experience is strongly preferred.
  • Fully authorized to work in the U.S. without restrictions.
  • Strong technical, analytical, communication and organizational skills.
  • Passionate about technology, innovation, and collaborative problem-solving.
  • Curious and proactive in exploring new trends and tools in AI/ML.
  • Excited to work in an environment where your ideas and contributions may shape real products.
  • Eager to make an impact through hands-on prototyping, algorithm development, and data analysis.

About this job

Underwrite middle market commercial property and casualty risks, making independent pricing and risk selection decisions within delegated authority. Manage broker relationships, develop sourcing strategies, and mentor junior underwriters.

Good fit if you have 2.5+ years of underwriting experience, a business degree or equivalent, and can work in-person in New York.

Full job description


Description

We are seeking an experienced Middle Market Senior Underwriter to underwrite commercial property & casualty risks in the middle market segment. As an individual contributor, you will make analytical, data-driven underwriting decisions within delegated authority, with limited guidance from leadership. You will evaluate and price moderately complex to complex accounts, manage broker and client relationships, and help shape product and portfolio strategy for your book of business.

To be considered for this role, candidates must reside within the specified geographic location. This position requires regular in-person visits with local brokers and agents, so remote hires outside the designated territory cannot be accommodated.

Key Responsibilities

  • Underwrite middle market commercial accounts within assigned authority by assessing submissions, reviewing coverage terms, exposures, loss history, financials, and supporting information to determine accept/decline, terms, and pricing.
  • Make independent, data-driven decisions on risk selection and pricing consistent with underwriting appetite and profitability objectives.
  • Coordinate referrals for accounts above individual authority or that require specialized support.
  • Manage a portfolio of brokers, agents, and insureds:
  • Maintain and grow relationships with producing brokers and agents; act as a visible Liberty representative in the market.
  • Develop targeted broker strategies to source profitable middle market business and expand market share.
  • Provide timely, clear responses to brokers and clients; negotiate coverage and terms while protecting portfolio profitability.
  • Underwrite higher-limit, complex, or unusual submissions typical to middle market clients (specialty exposures, large single-location risks, multi-location schedules, or industry-specific hazards).
  • Engage internal partners (Claims, Actuarial, Risk Control, Legal) to structure appropriate terms and risk mitigation plans.
  • Mentor and coach junior underwriters and new hires on middle market underwriting practices, decision-making, and Liberty processes
Qualifications
  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 2.5 years, typically 3 or more years, of progressive underwriting experience and/or other related experience
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate and judge underwriting risks within scope of responsibility that includes competence with all phases and aspects of the underwriting process, and proficiency in the use of qualitative and quantitative tools and techniques
  • Must demonstrate comprehension of complex technical underwriting issues and be capable of defining and implementing necessary underwriting and administrative processes/workflows to properly manage or administer those issues
  • Proven track record of developing and underwriting profitable business

Quick facts

  • Location: Uniondale, NY

About this job

Liberty Mutual seeks a Senior Underwriter to evaluate and price commercial property and casualty risks in the middle market segment in Uniondale, New York. You will make independent underwriting decisions, manage broker relationships, and mentor junior underwriters.

Good fit if you have 2.5+ years of underwriting experience, a business degree or equivalent, and can work in-person in the Uniondale area regularly.

Full job description


Description

We are seeking an experienced Middle Market Senior Underwriter to underwrite commercial property & casualty risks in the middle market segment. As an individual contributor, you will make analytical, data-driven underwriting decisions within delegated authority, with limited guidance from leadership. You will evaluate and price moderately complex to complex accounts, manage broker and client relationships, and help shape product and portfolio strategy for your book of business.

To be considered for this role, candidates must reside within the specified geographic location. This position requires regular in-person visits with local brokers and agents, so remote hires outside the designated territory cannot be accommodated.

Key Responsibilities

  • Underwrite middle market commercial accounts within assigned authority by assessing submissions, reviewing coverage terms, exposures, loss history, financials, and supporting information to determine accept/decline, terms, and pricing.
  • Make independent, data-driven decisions on risk selection and pricing consistent with underwriting appetite and profitability objectives.
  • Coordinate referrals for accounts above individual authority or that require specialized support.
  • Manage a portfolio of brokers, agents, and insureds:
  • Maintain and grow relationships with producing brokers and agents; act as a visible Liberty representative in the market.
  • Develop targeted broker strategies to source profitable middle market business and expand market share.
  • Provide timely, clear responses to brokers and clients; negotiate coverage and terms while protecting portfolio profitability.
  • Underwrite higher-limit, complex, or unusual submissions typical to middle market clients (specialty exposures, large single-location risks, multi-location schedules, or industry-specific hazards).
  • Engage internal partners (Claims, Actuarial, Risk Control, Legal) to structure appropriate terms and risk mitigation plans.
  • Mentor and coach junior underwriters and new hires on middle market underwriting practices, decision-making, and Liberty processes
Qualifications
  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 2.5 years, typically 3 or more years, of progressive underwriting experience and/or other related experience
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate and judge underwriting risks within scope of responsibility that includes competence with all phases and aspects of the underwriting process, and proficiency in the use of qualitative and quantitative tools and techniques
  • Must demonstrate comprehension of complex technical underwriting issues and be capable of defining and implementing necessary underwriting and administrative processes/workflows to properly manage or administer those issues
  • Proven track record of developing and underwriting profitable business

Job.JobTitle: Workers' Compensation Claims Adjuster - West Region
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Workers' Compensation Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
Description

The Claims Specialist works within a Claims Team, using the latest technology to manage an assigned caseload of routine to moderately complex claims from the investigation of the claim through resolution. This includes making decisions about liability/compensability, evaluating losses, and negotiating settlements. The role interacts with claimants, policyholders, appraisers, attorneys, and other third parties throughout the claims management process. The position offers training developed with an emphasis on enhancing skills needed to help provide exceptional service to our customers.

Responsibilities:

  • Manages an inventory of claims to evaluate compensability/liability.
  • Establishes action plan based on case facts, best practices, protocols, regulatory issues and available resources.
  • Plans and conducts investigations of claims to confirm coverage and to determine liability, compensability and damages.
  • Assesses policy coverage for submitted claims and notifies the insured of any issues; determines and establishes reserve requirements, adjusting reserves, as necessary, during the processing of the claim, refers claims to the subrogation group or Special Investigations Unit as appropriate.
  • Assesses actual damages associated with claims and conducts negotiations, within assigned authority limits, to settle claims.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
  • Proven interpersonal, analytical and negotiation abilities required.
  • Ability to provide information in a clear, concise manner, ability to build effective relationships.
  • Bachelor`s degree or equivalent in addition to 1-year claims handling experience. Knowledge of legal liability, insurance coverage and medical terminology preferred.
  • Licensing may be required in some states.

Job.JobDescription:
Description

The Claims Specialist works within a Claims Team, using the latest technology to manage an assigned caseload of routine to moderately complex claims from the investigation of the claim through resolution. This includes making decisions about liability/compensability, evaluating losses, and negotiating settlements. The role interacts with claimants, policyholders, appraisers, attorneys, and other third parties throughout the claims management process. The position offers training developed with an emphasis on enhancing skills needed to help provide exceptional service to our customers.

Responsibilities:

  • Manages an inventory of claims to evaluate compensability/liability.
  • Establishes action plan based on case facts, best practices, protocols, regulatory issues and available resources.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Actuarial Analyst, Personal Lines Auto State Internal Indications
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Experience: 3 to 5 years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Senior Actuarial Analyst or Actuary role producing quarterly rate indications for personal auto insurance. You will develop state-level pricing strategies, build analytical tools, and partner with Risk Analytics and State Management teams.

Good fit if you have 3-7+ years actuarial experience, passed at least 5 CAS exams, strong Excel and SQL skills, and can communicate technical analysis to non-technical stakeholders.

Full job description


Description

The US Retail Markets (USRM) Personal Lines (PL) Auto State indications team is looking for a Senior Actuarial Analyst / Actuary to join our team. In this highly impactful role, you will play a pivotal role in producing quarterly rate indications to support rate decisions. This is a unique opportunity to help drive enhancements and sophistication to our processes and methodology. This position will work in a collaborative environment with partners and stakeholders in Risk Analytics and State Management.

**This is a ranged posting for a Senior Actuarial Analyst or an Actuary. Level offered is based on candidate experience at manager discretion.**

This role may have in-office requirements depending on candidate location.

As an Actuary, you will:

  • Lead work on state indications that serve as a foundation for rate guidance, ensuring that our rate actions and underwriting levers improve each states profit position.
  • Play a pivotal role in shaping state indication strategy, leveraging a robust suite of actuarial methods.
  • Help identify and propose enhancements to our existing processes and methodologies to drive for operational excellence.
  • Be an influential partner with other Risk Analytics subject matter experts to ensure a comprehensive understanding of unique state features, and collaborate with Directors of State Operations to develop customized state levers.
  • Share your insights and recommendations which will greatly influence state-level decision-making and contribute to our goal of achieving top-quartile profitability.
  • Build trust, credibility, and strong relationships will enable you to influence decisions and execution beyond the Auto Analytics team.
  • Be a senior member of the team and also contribute to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and high-performing culture.
  • Coach and mentor junior team members, sharing your expertise and supporting their development.

In this role, you can expect to:

  • Deliver state level indications to internal stakeholders to drive actions and influence decisions to achieve top quartile profitability.
  • Build indications tools and processes to increase our organizational understanding of our methodology and inform state level profitability position.
  • Proactively identify opportunities, drive analysis, and make recommendations for appropriate strategies to develop, evaluate and enhance state level profitability.
  • Act as a trusted partner to State Management to help inform and influence state-specific strategy and tactics, including pricing and underwriting levers.
  • Collaborate with Country Wide (CW) Indications, CW State Analytics, Actuarial, Finance, Claims and Data Science to gain better understanding and assess and improve profitability with a state focus.
  • Support cross-team initiatives to enrich the deliverables with state-specific insights.
  • Building trust and credibility with teams beyond State Analytics to drive decisions and execution.
  • Support an inclusive, equitable and high performing culture.
  • Coach and mentor junior team members.

Ideal candidate will have:

  • Strong technical proficiency in Excel (e.g., pivot tables, advanced formulas, data modeling) and SQL, with demonstrated experience querying and manipulating large datasets.
  • Ability to design and build scalable, repeatable processes for data extraction, transformation, and reporting.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to translate technical or analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for non-technical audiences.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to gather and interpret stakeholder requirements, ask clarifying questions, and respond to follow-up questions with confidence and clarity.
  • Comfort working cross-functionally and managing multiple stakeholder relationships simultaneously.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with strong organizational and prioritization skills.
Qualifications

This is a ranged posting. Qualifications are as follows for each level of consideration:

Senior Actuarial Analyst

  • Proven math and analytical skills, as normally acquired through the pursuit of a Bachelors degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Actuarial Science, or related field.
  • Commitment to achieving Associateship or Fellowship in the Casualty Actuarial Society.
  • Passing grades on a minimum of 5 Casualty Actuarial Exams is required.
  • Minimum 3-5 years relevant experience required.
  • Prior experience and solid knowledge of actuarial techniques and standards, as well as other business operations including financial, underwriting, legal, statistics, claims, sales, etc.
  • Solid oral and written and presentation communication skills and ability to interact effectively within and outside the organization.
  • Solid interpersonal skills and the ability to work in a team environment as well as independently.
  • Ability to motivate and mentor peers and motivate and train subordinates.
  • Ability to exercise discretion, and apply independent judgment and well-developed critical thinking skills in execution of assignments and projects.
  • Ability to balance multiple projects with minimal direction.
  • Advanced computing skills (MS Office Excel, SAS, etc.); Ability to build models of moderate complexity.

Actuary

  • Bachelor's degree required; Masters degree preferred.
  • Associateship or Fellowship in the Casualty Actuarial Society (ACAS/FCAS) designation preferred or comparable education/designation with relevant experience.
  • Minimum 5-7 years relevant experience required.
  • Sound knowledge of actuarial techniques and standards, as well as other business operations including financial, underwriting, legal, statistics, claims, sales, etc.
  • Advanced communication and interpersonal skills and ability to build relationships and interact effectively with others within and outside the organization.
  • Ability to motivate and mentor peers and motivate and train subordinates.
  • Advanced computing skills (MS Office Excel, SAS, etc.) with ability to build complex models.
