This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

Senior Underwriter – Ocean Marine Cargo
New York or Chicago


The Senior Underwriter, Ocean Marine Cargo will act within established guidelines to analyze, evaluate, price, and manage new and renewal business in support of the growth of the U.S. Ocean Marine Cargo portfolio. The initial focus will include Small and Middle Market, Large Complex Transit, Stock Throughput, and Excess Stock Exposure risks


The role will also support AXIS's broader Marine Logistics capabilities, which complement traditional Cargo coverage by addressing liability exposures throughout the movement, handling, and storage of goods. Relevant experience may include Cargo Legal Liability, Warehouse Legal Liability, Errors & Omissions, Shipper's Interest, and packaged logistics solutions.


Candidate Profile

The Senior Underwriter, Ocean Marine Cargo will be a hands-on technical underwriting professional with a demonstrated history of success within a leading commercial insurance carrier, building and managing a complex Ocean Marine Cargo portfolio.


Candidates should have strong relationships across Ocean Marine Cargo wholesale and retail broker channels and full lifecycle underwriting experience, including solicitation and evaluation of submissions, risk analysis, structuring terms and conditions, pricing, preparing and issuing indications, quotations and binders, and portfolio management.


Candidates with Marine Logistics or related supply-chain liability underwriting experience are especially attractive, including exposure to freight forwarders, logistics providers, warehouse operators, and transportation intermediaries. Experience with Cargo Legal Liability, Warehouse Legal Liability, Errors & Omissions, Shipper's Interest, or packaged Marine Logistics solutions is highly desirable.


The successful candidate should understand how traditional Cargo exposures interact with transportation, warehousing, contractual liability, and logistics-related risks across the broader supply chain, allowing them to evaluate opportunities from both a cargo/property and logistics liability perspective

Key Duties and Responsibilities

  • Underwrite and manage complex Ocean Marine Cargo business, including Small and Middle Market, Large Complex Transit, Stock Throughput, and Excess Stock Exposure risks.
  • Evaluate Marine Logistics opportunities that complement the Ocean Cargo portfolio, including Cargo Legal Liability, Warehouse Legal Liability, Errors & Omissions, Shipper's Interest, and packaged logistics solutions.
  • Assess supply-chain exposures involving freight forwarders, logistics providers, warehouse operators, transportation intermediaries, and other businesses involved in the movement, handling, and storage of goods.
  • Review contractual and operational exposures to determine appropriate coverage structure, limits, retentions, pricing, terms, conditions, and endorsements.
  • Work with brokers to identify cross-sell opportunities across Ocean Cargo and Logistics, and develop broader solutions for clients with complex supply-chain exposures.
  • Prospect for new business and develop strategies targeting Small to Middle Market and Large Complex Corporate risks.
  • Develop and maintain strong wholesale and retail broker relationships, using those relationships to generate submissions and expand the portfolio.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of direct Ocean Marine Cargo underwriting experience.
  • Demonstrated experience building and managing complex Ocean Cargo business.
  • Experience with Logistics, Cargo Legal Liability, Warehouse Legal Liability, Errors & Omissions, Shipper's Interest, or related transportation/logistics liability products strongly preferred.
  • Understanding of supply-chain exposures and the contractual relationships among cargo owners, freight forwarders, logistics providers, warehouse operators, and transportation intermediaries.
  • Ability to build and expand retail and wholesale broker relationships.
  • Strong technical underwriting, portfolio management, negotiation, and presentation skills.

Job Description: Technology and AI Strategy Lead


How does this role contribute to our collective success?

AXIS is undertaking a multi-year transformation to strengthen how we operate,

serve customers, and create competitive advantage. Technology and AI are important enablers of this transformation, creating opportunities to improve operational effectiveness, support business growth, and enhance customer outcomes.


The Technology & AI Strategy Lead is responsible for shaping, maintaining, and driving execution of the enterprise technology and AI agenda in partnership with business, technology, data, risk, and functional leaders. The role owns the integrated strategic agenda, enterprise-level recommendations, strategic coherence, value framework, and executive decision support. It does not own delivery of individual products or programs; delivery remains with the relevant business and technology owners, and business leaders remain accountable for outcomes, adoption, and benefit realization.


The role provides independent analysis, subject matter expertise, and strategic recommendations that help leadership evaluate technology and AI opportunities, risks, and trade-offs. Success requires strong business acumen, strategic thinking, stakeholder engagement, and the ability to translate complex technology concepts into practical business implications and measurable outcomes.
________________________________________

Key Responsibilities


Technology & AI Strategy


  • Support the development and refinement of the technology and AI strategy aligned with enterprise and business objectives.
  • Partner with business and functional leaders to identify opportunities where technology and AI can improve business performance, operational effectiveness, and customer outcomes.
  • Analyze emerging technology and AI trends, market developments, and vendor capabilities to inform strategic recommendations.
  • Assess opportunities to improve engineering effectiveness, delivery consistency, automation, and modernization efforts.
  • Consider responsible AI, data governance, cybersecurity, privacy, operational resilience, and regulatory requirements when developing recommendations and strategic assessments.

Portfolio Prioritization & Strategic Coherence

  • Support the development and maintenance of technology and AI roadmaps aligned to business objectives and transformation priorities.
  • Evaluate proposed initiatives and business cases against strategic goals, resource capacity, risk considerations, and organizational readiness.
  • Identify dependencies, opportunities for alignment, and potential conflicts across initiatives and programs.
  • Develop analysis and recommendations to support planning, prioritization, and investment discussions.
  • Contribute strategic insights that help leaders evaluate business needs, risks, costs, and expected value.

Execution Discipline & Value Realization

  • Develop and challenge value frameworks to evaluate expected business value and measure outcomes from technology and AI initiatives.
  • Analyze initiative progress, adoption trends, risks, and dependencies and provide insights to stakeholders, included any needed course corrections.
  • Identify lessons learned and opportunities to scale successful practices and capabilities.
  • Refresh the enterprise roadmap and investment recommendations based on delivery evidence, realized outcomes, emerging risks, and organizational learning.
  • Prepare strategic analyses, presentations, and recommendations for executive team.

Stakeholder Engagement & Change Enablement

  • Develop strategies to drive adoption of technology and AI-enabled capabilities across the enterprise.
  • Build collaborative relationships across business, technology, data, finance, risk, and transformation teams.
  • Facilitate workshops, planning sessions, and stakeholder discussions related to technology and AI priorities.
  • Develop clear, business-focused communications and presentations that help leaders understand strategic opportunities and implications.
  • Support initiatives that improve organizational understanding and adoption of technology and AI capabilities.
  • Identify barriers to adoption and recommend actions that support successful organizational change.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Support cross-functional strategic initiatives through influence, coordination, and collaboration.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on technology and AI strategy-related matters.
  • Contribute subject matter expertise and analysis to governance and planning discussions.
  • Help stakeholders evaluate opportunities, risks, implementation considerations, and long-term implications of strategic initiatives.
    _______________________________________

About You

  • Significant experience in technology strategy, digital transformation, AI enablement, business transformation, management consulting, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of technology, data, and AI concepts and their application to business problems.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex issues and develop practical, value-focused recommendations.
  • Experience evaluating business cases and connecting technology investments to business outcomes.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.
    Proven success influencing stakeholders and building alignment across matrixed organizations.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, storytelling, and presentation skills, with experience engaging senior leaders.
  • Working knowledge of responsible AI, data governance, cybersecurity, privacy, operational resilience, and regulatory considerations.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with practical execution.
    Insurance, reinsurance, financial services, or other regulated-industry experience preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; advanced degree preferred.
    ________________________________________

Role Factors

  • Requires close partnership with business, technology, transformation, risk, and functional teams.
  • Success depends on expertise, influence, relationship building, strategic judgment, and the ability to navigate complex business challenges.
  • Regular participation in planning sessions, strategy reviews, governance forums, and leadership communications.
  • Operates within established enterprise governance frameworks and provides recommendations and guidance to support decision making.
  • Works independently on complex assignments requiring assessment of multiple business, technology, operational, and risk considerations.
  • Planning horizon is primarily annual and aligned with strategic planning and investment cycles.

Senior Analyst, Operational Readiness - Claims Shared Services, Axis Global Claims

AXIS is seeking a Senior Analyst, Operational Readiness, to join the Global Claims Shared Services (GCSS) team. Reporting to the Head of Optimization, Claims Shared Services, this role ensures approved technology, process, vendor and operating model changes are ready for implementation, adopted by AXIS Global Claims, and stabilized into business-as-usual operations.

The role is responsible for business readiness, cutover, adoption, operational handoff, hypercare and BAU transition, but does not own requirements, solution design, product roadmaps, project delivery or portfolio prioritization.

Working with Product Owners, business sponsors, project managers, technology teams, vendors and operational leaders, the role confirms Claims is prepared to receive, use and sustain new processes and technology.

The Successful Candidate Will Be Responsible For:

Operational Readiness & Cutover

  • Operational readiness assessments and readiness sign-off processes for approved technology, process, vendor and operating model changes, ensuring assessments are completed on time and aligned to defined go-live criteria.
  • Develop and maintain readiness frameworks, checklists and go-live criteria that establish clear expectations for operational capability, resource readiness and support model readiness.
  • Lead business cutover planning and execution activities against approved readiness, handoff and service acceptance plans.
  • Coordinate business operational handoffs and service acceptance activities, with clear ownership, success criteria and support model handoff.
  • Identify, document and escalate readiness gaps to accountable owners before implementation.
  • Establish transition-to-BAU plans, stabilization criteria and measurable success indicators for each implementation.

Training & Business Adoption

  • Implementation communications and stakeholder readiness plans, ensuring impacted users understand what is changing, when it is changing and what action is required.
  • Coordinate business training delivery and completion tracking, with the goal of meeting training completion and stakeholder preparedness targets before go-live.
  • Measure user adoption, operational utilization and preparedness to adopt new capabilities before and after implementation.
  • Identify adoption and readiness gaps before implementation and coordinate remediation with accountable owners.
  • Support post-deployment adoption reviews and feedback loops to improve future readiness execution.

Process Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Support development of functional process maps, SOPs, workflow documentation and operational playbooks required for successful go-live and BAU transition.
  • Ensure functional process documentation remains current following operational or system changes.
  • Support establishment of centralized knowledge repositories and documentation standards that enable consistent sustainment after implementation.
  • Coordinate documentation, SOP, job aid and knowledge repository updates as part of implementation closure.

Hypercare & Stabilization

  • Lead business hypercare activities following go-live, with clear issue intake, escalation and closure disciplines.
  • Monitor adoption, operational performance and issue trends during stabilization, with focus on reducing unresolved issues and supporting faster stabilization.
  • Coordinate business inputs to issue triage, escalation and closure during the transition period.
  • Track vendor and service readiness issues, knowledge transfer actions and adherence to agreed operating procedures.
  • Coordinate lessons learned and transition closure activities, ensuring insights are captured and applied to improve future readiness, cutover and stabilization execution.

Reporting & Value Realization

  • Partner with Global MI & Insights to support adoption, utilization and benefits reporting.
  • Track readiness, stabilization, adoption and implementation outcome metrics to confirm approved changes are landing effectively.
  • Support development of implementation scorecards and executive reporting materials that highlight readiness status, adoption trends, stabilization issues and transition-to-BAU progress.
  • Assist with post-implementation reviews and outcome measurement, including lessons learned, realized benefits and continuous improvement actions.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Claims Operations, Claims Optimization, Compliance & QA, Third Party Management, Product Owners, Technology, Data & Analytics and Claims Business Leadership to support successful readiness outcomes.
  • Clarify readiness, cutovers, adoption and BAU handoff ownership across impacted teams.
  • Provide visibility to readiness gaps, operational dependencies and transition risks for accountable business owners to resolve.
  • Foster strong working relationships across GCSS and partner teams to ensure change lands effectively and is sustained in BAU.

Skills, Experience & Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in business operations, operational readiness, project coordination, business analysis, change management, claims operations or process improvement; claims project or optimization experience preferred.
  • Experience supporting implementation, technology deployment, operational change, business transformation, vendor transition or BAU handoff activities.
  • Strong organization, communication, analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to develop and maintain documentation, SOPs, job aids, training materials and knowledge resources.
  • Experience with claims systems, operational workflows, insurance operations, AI, automation or systems modernization preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Copilot, SharePoint, Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Teams.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience required; familiarity with project management, change management or process improvement methodologies preferred.
  • Some Travel is associated with this role.

Locations

  • New Jersey
  • New York

Role Summary
The Reinsurance Technical Accountant will be responsible for supporting assumed reinsurance technical accounting activities across global portfolios, based on business need. This role requires strong technical accounting knowledge, attention to detail, analytical judgment, and the ability to work across multiple regions, systems, and stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate processing, reporting, and resolution of reinsurance accounting activity.

The role will support close and reporting deliverables, review and process reinsurance statements of account, analyze premiums, losses, commissions, and related balances, and help ensure accounting activity is recorded accurately in accordance with contract terms and internal procedures. The position will also support issue resolution, aged balance review, account analysis, and coordination with internal stakeholders including Underwriting, Claims, Finance, Cash Accounting, offshore processing teams, and Reporting.

This role is critical to maintaining continuity, control integrity, and service quality across the global assumed reinsurance portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform assumed reinsurance technical accounting activities across global portfolios, regions, and business needs.
  • Review, analyze, and process reinsurance statements of account, ensuring activity is complete, accurate, and aligned with contract terms and internal procedures.
  • Analyze and record reinsurance activity, including premiums, losses, commissions, fees, adjustments, and other contract-related balances.
  • Support monthly and quarterly close processes, ensuring assigned deliverables are completed timely and accurately.
  • Monitor, research, and resolve open items, exceptions, and aged balances related to assigned accounts and portfolios.
  • Work closely with Cash Accounting to support timely clearing of aged balances, investigate receipt or payment-related questions, and resolve cash application or statement of account processing inquiries.
  • Partner with offshore processing teams to provide guidance, answer questions, review outputs, and support quality and consistency of processing.
  • Coordinate with Underwriting, Claims, Finance, Reporting, Cash Accounting, and other internal stakeholders to resolve account questions and ensure accurate financial reporting.
  • Support account reconciliations, variance analysis, and investigation of unusual or unexpected movements.
  • Identify and escalate complex issues, control concerns, processing delays, or aged balance risks in a timely manner.
  • Maintain clear documentation of accounting conclusions, open items, follow-ups, and resolution steps.
  • Support audit, internal control, and compliance-related requests, including preparation of supporting documentation and explanations.
  • Contribute to process improvements, reporting enhancements, automation readiness, and opportunities to improve efficiency, visibility, and control across the Technical Accounting function.
  • Assist with training, knowledge transfer, and documentation of account-specific or region-specific procedures as needed.
  • Provide flexible support across regions, portfolios, and deliverables as priorities shift within the global Technical Accounting function.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in reinsurance accounting, insurance accounting, technical accounting, finance, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of assumed reinsurance concepts, including premiums, losses, commissions, statements of account, treaty activity, and related accounting flows.
  • Ability to interpret reinsurance activity, identify exceptions, and apply judgment when reviewing account activity.
  • Strong analytical, reconciliation, and problem-solving skills.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple deliverables, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with onshore, offshore, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Ability to escalate issues appropriately and support timely resolution of complex accounting matters.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and ability to work with accounting systems, reporting tools, and large data sets.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience with assumed reinsurance technical accounting.
  • Experience supporting global, multi-region, or complex reinsurance portfolios.
  • Familiarity with reinsurance administration systems and reporting platforms.
  • Experience working with offshore processing teams or shared service models.
  • Experience supporting month-end or quarter-end close, audit requests, and control documentation.
  • Experience with aged balance analysis, account reconciliations, and statement of account review.


Key Skills and Competencies

  • Technical accounting knowledge
  • Assumed reinsurance accounting
  • Statement of account processing
  • Analytical judgment
  • Account reconciliation
  • Aged balance review and resolution
  • Issue identification and escalation
  • Stakeholder management
  • Control awareness
  • Documentation and follow-through
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Ability to work in a complex, deadline-driven, global environment

For this position, the anticipated base salary range is $75,000 - $85,000 USD (Stamford, CT). Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. 

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.  

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

The Head of Insights & Analytics leads a multidisciplinary team that transforms data into actionable insights and measurable business value. You will be accountable for enterprise reporting, business intelligence, performance analytics, insight generation, analytics strategy, and business adoption of analytical solutions.

The role identifies and prioritizes opportunities where advanced analytics and AI can drive business value and partners with Data Science & AI Delivery leadership to ensure successful execution.

The role's purpose is to ensure the business gets the right solutions for the right needs, whether that's a dashboard, a predictive model, an AI-driven tool or an agentic solution, always focused on delivering optimal business outcomes rather than analytics for its own sake. This is a high-impact leadership role, requiring a blend of strategic vision, technical acumen, and exceptional people leadership to drive a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and business partnership.

What will you do in this role?

  • Lead a High-Performing Analytics Function: Build, inspire, and manage a multidisciplinary team (spanning BI/reporting analysts, and data analysts) to deliver insights and analytics to AXIS in support of the business' goals. Strategically lead the Data Science & AI Delivery team to leverage with Data Science & AI Delivery leadership to leverage specialized AI and data science capability. Cultivate a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.

  • Drive Outcome-Focused Delivery: Work with business leaders across underwriting, claims, finance, operations, and other functions to understand how analytics and AI can support and enable their goals. Own prioritization, funding alignment, value realization, and adoption of analytical capabilities across the business. Act as the executive sponsor for analytics and AI initiatives. Ensure the team delivers practical solutions that drive decision-making and measurable improvements – prioritizing business outcomes over output volume.

  • Advanced Analytics, Data Science & AI Delivery: Define business priorities, success metrics, governance requirements, and expected outcomes for advanced analytics and AI initiatives. Execute with the Data Science & AI Delivery team, who are accountable for technical design, model development, deployment, and operationalization. Ensure business value realization and organizational adoption following implementation. Champion the selection of the right analytical approach (e.g., diagnostic analysis, predictive modelling, machine learning, AI automation) to solve each business problem, ensuring solutions are fit-for-purpose and add tangible value (e.g., improved loss ratio, enhanced customer experience, operational efficiency).

  • Traditional Insights & Management Information: Oversee development and enhancement of dashboards, reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs) that provide a single source of truth. Ensure reporting is accurate, timely, and clearly communicates insights to business stakeholders for areas like underwriting performance, claims trends, customer insights, and financial metrics.

  • Strategic Planning & Vision: Define and communicate a clear vision and roadmap for the Insights & Analytics function, aligned with the company's strategy. Identify opportunities to leverage emerging tools and methods to continuously advance analytical capabilities in a pragmatic way.

  • Stakeholder Engagement & Consulting: Act as a trusted partner to business leaders. Translate complex data science and analytics concepts into clear, actionable business insights. Build strong relationships with key stakeholders (including underwriters, claims managers, actuarial teams, product leaders, and senior executives) to ensure analytical initiatives meet real business needs and are fully adopted.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner closely with other Data & Analytics functions, working as one team to ensure the best possible end-to-end outcomes are delivered for the business.

  • Governance & Best Practices: In partnership with the Data and AI Governance team, establish standards and best practices for analytics and reporting, including data quality control, model governance, and ethical AI use. Ensure adherence to regulatory and compliance requirements relevant to insurance data and models. Promote data-driven decision-making and champion data literacy across the organization.

  • Analytics Operating Model & Governance: Establish and maintain enterprise standards for reporting, KPI definition, insight generation, business performance measurement, and analytics prioritization. Ensure AI and advanced analytics initiatives align with business strategy and governance requirements.

  • Performance Management: Define and track key performance indicators for the Insights & Analytics function. Ensure work is prioritized for maximum impact, resources are allocated effectively, and projects are delivered on time and within budget.

  • Technology & Innovation: Stay abreast of industry trends in insurance analytics, data science, and AI. Evaluate and adopt new technologies and analytical techniques that can drive better outcomes (e.g., new predictive modelling techniques, generative AI, advanced data visualization tools). Foster a test-and-learn environment, encouraging the team to pilot innovative solutions in a controlled, value-focused manner.

Success Measures / Key Outcomes

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Business Impact of Insights: Demonstrable improvements in business outcomes fueled by analytics (e.g., improved underwriting decisions, reduced claims leakage, increased revenue) due to insights and models delivered by the team.

  • Stakeholder Trust & Adoption: High stakeholder satisfaction and trust, evidenced by strong demand for the team's services and the embedding of analytics outputs into day-to-day decision processes across the business. Analytics and AI solutions are actively used and drive decisions, not just delivered and shelved.

  • Right Solution for the Right Problem: A track record of delivering fit-for-purpose solutions by correctly matching business needs with appropriate analytics techniques.

  • Team Growth & Performance: A highly engaged and skilled team. Team members develop new skills and perform at a high level.

  • Continuous Improvement: Establishment of improved processes and practices that increase the speed, quality, and reliability of analytics delivery.

  • Innovation & Modernization: Successful introduction of new analytical capabilities or technologies that enhance the function's effectiveness, accompanied by clear value and appropriate governance.

You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.

About You:

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.

What you need to have:

  • Proven experience within the Insurance sector

  • Leadership & Team Management: Proven leadership experience in analytics, business intelligence, data science, or related fields, ideally including insurance exposure. Ability to build and inspire a diverse team, set direction, and create a high-performance culture.

  • Analytics & Data Science Expertise: Deep understanding of a broad range of analytics approaches. Ability to evaluate and sponsor AI and advanced analytics initiatives, rather than personally designing or delivering technical solutions. Experience leading enterprise analytics organizations and aligning analytical investment with business priorities.

  • Business Acumen: Strong knowledge of insurance industry dynamics and core processes. Able to quickly grasp business problems and industry-specific challenges, then lead the design of analytics/AI solutions that address them

  • Strategic & Outcome Orientation: Strategic thinker who can define a vision for analytics in line with business strategy. Relentlessly outcome-focused, ensuring projects have clear objectives and deliver tangible business value.

  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Excellent communication skills, especially in bridging the gap between technical teams and business stakeholders. Adept at translating complex analytical and AI concepts into clear, compelling business stories and actionable recommendations.

  • Change & Innovation Driver: Demonstrated ability to introduce new tools, methods, or technologies and drive adoption. Passion for continuous learning and keeping up-to-date with the latest advancements in data, analytics, and AI. Comfortable leading a team through change, fostering innovation while managing risk appropriately.

What we prefer you to have:

  • Education: An advanced degree in a relevant field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or similar) is highly desirable, or equivalent professional experience.


Role Factors:

  • Be in the office 3 days per week

  • Travel internationally quarterly

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.

1

What Is the Opportunity?

The Account Executive Officer (AEO), Construction Loss Sensitive will partner with agents and brokers to provide coverage for new and renewal business based on customers' needs. This role is seen as a technical resource.

As an AEO, you are decisive, detail-oriented, and know how to build relationships internally and externally to drive results. Your ability to independently assess complex risk and sell our products in challenging markets will contribute to the profitability and success of Travelers.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage the profitability, growth, and retention of an assigned book of business.
  • Underwrite and skillfully negotiate complex customer accounts to minimize risk and maximize profitability.
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with internal partners within the business unit and across the enterprise to create sales plans and identify cross-selling opportunities.
  • Foster and maintain relationships with external partners by regularly meeting in person with agents and brokers to market and sell Travelers products with a goal of writing and retaining accounts consistent with our risk appetite. Must be able to travel to such meetings.
  • Identify and capture new business opportunities using consultative marketing and sales skills.
  • Independently develop and execute agency sales plans and frequently partner with your Managing Director (MD) to develop region/group sales plans.
  • May assist in the training and mentoring of less experienced Account Executives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Six to eight years of relevant underwriting experience with experience in construction loss sensitive.
  • Deep knowledge of construction loss sensitive products, the regulatory environment, and the local insurance market.
  • Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to proactively identify underwriting, marketing, or financial challenges and analyze available information to make timely decisions in alignment with our risk appetite.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to successfully negotiate in difficult situations with agents and brokers.
  • CPCU designation.

What is a Must Have?

  • Four years of underwriting, claim, operations, risk assessment, actuarial, sales, product, or finance experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

What Is the Opportunity?

Bond & Specialty Insurance (BSI) provides management and professional liability, cyber, crime insurance, and surety bonds to or on behalf of businesses of all sizes. The BSI Design Professional Claim Counsel team conducts thorough investigation, analysis, evaluation, and disposition of claims and claim litigation to achieve superior customer service and to optimize claim results. As a valued member of our team, in addition to claim, you also will provide legal advice to our underwriting colleagues and non-attorney claim colleagues, and participate in BSI claim strategic initiatives. Travelers' Professional Liability Team offers errors and omissions liability products to various market segments including accountants, design professionals, lawyers, real estate agents, property managers, and miscellaneous professional liability. The focus of this position is professional liability for design professionals such as architects or engineers.

As of the date of this posting, Travelers anticipates that the posting will remain open until November 16, 2026.

What Will You Do?

  • Follow operational policies to analyze, investigate, and resolve BSI claims of varying levels of severity with moderate supervision from claims management.
  • Prepare and present reports for management that accurately reflect loss development, potential/actual financial exposure, reserve adjustments, coverage issues, and claim and recovery strategies.
  • Retain, monitor, and manage outside counsel actively utilizing litigation management plans and budgets.
  • Communicate with underwriting on significant claim exposures.
  • Continue to develop the ability to identify all recovery opportunities and coordinate recovery efforts with the Recovery Management Unit and Claim management.
  • Travel to and attend mediations, settlement conferences, claim conferences, field office visits, trials and depositions.
  • Refine policy interpretation/coverage analysis skills including drafting coverage opinions with case law included.
  • Strengthen the ability to negotiate settlements/resolutions, review releases and settlement agreements, including confidentiality and non-disclosure provisions.
  • Support underwriting marketing efforts, including participation in broker and account visits and risk mitigation seminars and authoring customer-focused white papers and articles.
  • Monitor marketplace conditions, conduct research, and draft reference materials to inform claim and underwriting colleagues on law impacting Travelers' underwriting and claim decisions.
  • Obtain and maintain required adjusters' licenses.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

What Is the Opportunity?

As a Northland Claim Litigation Specialist, you will be responsible for managing and investigating moderate complexity injury and/or property damage claims including customer contact, determining coverage, evaluating liability, assessing damages, establishing timely reserves, and issue timely and accurate payments within appropriate authority and oversight.

In this technical role, you will leverage your expertise in claims management, investigative techniques, coverage evaluation, and settlement negotiation to ensure timely and fair resolution.

You will foster positive, professional relationships with customers and stakeholders on claims that may involve significant litigation or span extended periods.

You will provide guidance and mentorship to Claim Reps and Associate Claim Reps, sharing knowledge and best practices to support their development.

What Will You Do?

  • Independently manage an active caseload of injury and/or property damage claims and litigation from first notice of loss through resolution within level of authority. Typically, handles personal and/or business insurance high complexity liability claims which may include coverage disputes and contractual indemnity issues.
  • Gather and thoroughly investigate information by contacting all relevant parties to determine coverage, evaluate liability exposure, assess bodily injury and/or property damage, and establish appropriate reserves in accordance with policy terms and management guidance.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, representatives, opposing counsel, third-party vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Leverage resolution strategies and coordinate internal and external resources to conduct comprehensive claim investigations and evaluations.
  • Actively negotiate with multiple constituents (e.g., claimants, attorneys, contractors, representatives) and convey claim settlements within authority and issue payments timely and accurately.
  • Assist in coordinating with Counsel to support litigation management strategies.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Identify areas in which we can improve or enhance current best practices and offer creative solutions.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.

  • Two years of litigation claim experience.
  • Active adjuster license, where required by state law.
  • Experience with claims management systems, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to comprehend, synthesize, and clearly articulate complex information to multiple stakeholders.

What is a Must Have?

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.

In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

We are seeking a strategic and results‑oriented leader to head our Automotive Line of Business. This role leads a complex, fast‑evolving portfolio within the vehicle industry and is accountable for driving performance, profitable growth, and product strategy. Success in this role requires strong commercial acumen, deep market and network awareness, and the ability to translate industry trends into sustainable business results.

This is a high‑impact opportunity to shape the future of our automotive services while leading a growing business with significant revenue and profitability goals.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, and execute the AUTO LOB vision, growth strategy, product roadmap, operating plans, and financial plans.
  • Analyze vehicle market trends to forecast objectives and identify and size growth opportunities.
  • Own P&L accountability for the AUTO LOB, partnering with other countries, centers of excellence, and shared services to deliver results across local and enterprise targets.
  • Recommend and manage enterprise investments, operating expenses, and advertising and promotional spend for the LOB.
  • Provide direct oversight of AUTO business performance in Puerto Rico, including client results tracked through StoneEagle metrics.

  • Apply strong risk management expertise, monitoring trends and recommending changes as needed.
  • Build and develop a high‑performing team, strengthening people capabilities to deliver both short‑ and long‑term objectives.
  • Lead cross‑functional collaboration to scale the business.
  • Coordinate efforts at regional and corporate levels to ensure strategic alignment and effective product deployment.

​ Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in general management, business development, and services support.
  • Demonstrated P&L ownership, with accountability for revenue growth and profitability.
  • Strong capability to transfer business knowledge and best practices across teams, geographies, and functions.
  • Proven ability to build, develop, and lead high‑performing leadership teams.
  • Track record of fostering a culture of engagement, growth, accountability, and outperformance.
  • Candidate must reside in or relocate to Puerto Rico.

Other requirements :

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, preferably with a concentration in Finance, Accounting, or Marketing.
  • 10+ years of experience within the automotive ecosystem, including one or more of the following: Automotive OEM, Captive Finance Company, Automotive Third‑Party Administrator, Automotive Retail, Auto Lending, or Insurance.
  • Proven general management and negotiation experience in multi‑country or regional environments.
  • Deep knowledge of the Puerto Rico automotive market, including key players, dynamics, and regulatory considerations.
  • Basic working knowledge of Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance.
  • Fully bilingual (English and Spanish).

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Human Resources Manager / Director, Human Resources & Training
Job.JobDescription:
Alliant Insurance Services is one of the nation's largest and fastest-growing insurance brokerage and consulting firms. We operate through a network of specialized national platforms and local offices to offer our clients a comprehensive portfolio of solutions built on innovative thinking and personal service. Alliant is changing the way our clients approach risk management and benefits, so they can capitalize on new opportunities to grow and protect their organizations.

More information is available on the company's website at: >.

SUMMARY

Responsible for leading the workplace accommodations process, partnering with employees, HR Business Partners, Legal, and business leaders to deliver thoughtful, compliant, and employee-centric solutions. This role will also help drive scalable programs, policies, and resources that support an inclusive workplace while ensuring compliance with applicable employment laws.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Serve as the primary point of contact for employees and candidates regarding workplace accommodation requests.

Lead interactive discussions by conducting thorough and respectful accommodation intakes with employees, including gathering information about job limitations, essential job functions, and potential workplace solutions.

Manage a high volume of confidential accommodation cases from intake through implementation, documentation, and follow-up.

Evaluate accommodation requests in accordance with applicable ADA requirements and company policies.

Obtain, review, and appropriately manage supporting medical documentation when necessary and permitted.

Identify potential reasonable accommodations and assess their effectiveness, feasibility, and impact on business operations.

Partner with HR and management to evaluate job functions, including assessing the “essential functions" of a role.

Coordinate accommodation-related leave requests with the internal Leave of Absence (LOA) administrator.

Research and recommend appropriate workplace accommodations, assistive technologies, and workplace modifications in partnership with Facilities, vendors, and other cross-functional teams, as needed.

Consult with HR leadership, Legal, and other appropriate partners on complex, high-risk, or potentially disputed accommodation matters.

Draft and send written correspondence regarding accommodation decisions, including approval, denial, requests for additional information, temporary arrangements, and changes to existing accommodations.

Maintain accurate and confidential records of all accommodation requests, communications, decisions, and follow-up activities, including periodic check-ins with employees to assess effectiveness and determine whether adjustments are needed.

Track accommodation cases, deadlines, expiration dates, review periods, and required follow-up actions.

Partner with the broader Employee Relations team on cases involving performance management, investigations, behavioral concerns, or other workplace matters.

Provide guidance and education to managers and HRBPs on the accommodation process, confidentiality, documentation, and appropriate workplace communication.

Help develop and maintain accommodation procedures, templates, tracking tools, training materials, and reporting to develop consistent employee experience.

Support audits and provide reporting on accommodation activity while protecting confidential employee information.

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

Five (5) or more years of Employee Relations experience with significant responsibility for workplace accommodations.

Experience partnering with HR, Legal, managers, and leave administrators throughout the interactive process.

Experience with ADA accommodations in a multi-state or multi-location organization.

Experience partnering with HR Business Partners, Leave, Legal, Employee Relations, and business leaders.

Experience with accommodation or leave-management platforms.

Experience creating manager guidance, training, and process documentation.


HR certification such as SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR.

SKILLS

Strong knowledge of U.S. and state specific accommodation and leave laws (e.g., ADA, FMLA, CFRA)

Knowledge of state and local disability accommodation requirements

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex or sensitive decisions clearly and professionally

Strong organization and case-management skills with the ability to manage multiple cases, deadlines, and competing priorities

Proficiency with HRIS, case-management, document-management, and Microsoft Office tools

Ability to exercise sound judgment and discretion and maintain appropriate confidentiality

Ability to manage high-volume accommodation cases in a fast-paced environment

Ability to manage confidential employee information and sensitive workplace matters

#LI-AQ1

#LI-REMOTE

About this job

Manage and oversee a $17 billion commercial mortgage loan portfolio, monitoring loan performance and mitigating risk. In-office role in Charlotte or Greensboro, Monday-Thursday in office with flexible Fridays.

Good fit if you have 3-5+ years in commercial real estate finance or investment analysis and a Bachelor's degree in Finance or related field

The Role at a Glance

We are looking to add a Portfolio Management Associate Director to the Commercial Mortgage and Real Estate Investments team.


As a senior member of the Portfolio Management team, you will play a meaningful role in managing and overseeing the performance of a $17 billion commercial mortgage loan portfolio. Your primary focus is monitoring loan performance and mitigating risk and limiting loss across the portfolio. The ideal candidate is looking to grow their responsibilities in commercial real estate underwriting and credit analysis.


Primary Location: Charlotte, NC, US – In office Monday-Thursday; Fridays Flexible

What you'll be doing

Portfolio Monitoring and Risk Management
•Performs in-depth reviews of property operating statements and identifies positive and/or negative trends.
•Monitors complex loan structures and Borrower business plans reporting to senior management on a quarterly and/or ad hoc basis.
•Manages loan covenants and triggers working with internal and external partners ensuring compliance with loan documents
•Supports active management of troubled, watch, and surveillance loans on a monthly or quarterly basis.


Stakeholder Collaboration and Reporting
•Ensures data integrity at property and loan level for portfolio level analytics and reporting.
•Identifies and communicates process improvements to senior management.
•Serves as liaison partnering with the servicing and production teams to analyze underwriting related servicing requests, including but not limited to special servicing requests, lease approvals, collateral releases, substitutions, and sale and assumptions, and makes written and verbal approval recommendations to senior management.


Additional Responsibilities
•Maintains a high level of knowledge on market fundamentals such as rental rates, occupancy, capital market trends, and transaction activity for assigned geographic areas.
•Stays apprised of market related headlines affecting commercial real estate for reporting and analytics.
•Travels domestically for property inspections and conference events, as needed.
•May provide portfolio management support to real estate private equity team.
•Opportunities to collaborate across departments within the commercial real estate and overall investment team.

What we're looking for

Must-have experience:
•4 Year/Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of Bachelor's) – minimum required in Finance, Business Administration, or similar field.
•3-5+ years' experience required in commercial real estate finance and /or commercial real estate investment and analysis that aligns with the specific responsibilities for this position. Prior commercial real estate asset/portfolio management preferred.
•Knowledge of commercial real estate principles and valuation methods.
•Knowledge of national commercial real estate markets and macro-economic trends that affect those markets.
•Ability to understand and evaluate real estate financial statements including operating statements, balance sheets, and rent rolls.
•Knowledge of real estate legal concepts and strong understanding of loan documents.
•Ability to understand and apply financial concepts including but not limited to discounting cash flows, capitalization rates, internal rate of returns, and return on investment.
•Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
•Experience with CoStar and Argus preferred.
•Strong attention to detail and ability to clearly and effectively communicate, in writing and verbally, complex loan and property operational concepts to senior management
•Travel 10% (intermittent)

The Role at a Glance

We are excited to be seeking a highly motivated Nurse Disability Consultant to our clinical organization. This position will be responsible for reviewing, analyzing, and interpreting medical information available for disability claims.

Background Details

As a Nurse Disability Consultant, you will act as a clinical resource for Group Protection benefit specialists and claim professionals. You will evaluate medical information to clarify diagnoses, evaluate the severity of medical conditions, validate medical restrictions and limitations, and estimate duration of recovery. You will provide coaching and guidance to claims regarding medical management. If this sounds like a role for you, please read on!

What you'll be doing

  • You will maintain knowledge on current and emerging developments/trends, assess the impact, and collaborate with management to incorporate new trends and developments in current and future solutions.
  • You will evaluate medical information to clarify diagnoses, evaluate the severity of medical conditions, validating medical restrictions and limitations, and estimating duration of recovery.
  • You will clarify, interpret and/or evaluate medical information to assess appropriateness of current and ongoing restrictions / limitations and level of impairment
  • You will identify pertinent clinical facts and answers questions in collaboration with benefits specialists and physician consultants
  • You will act as a clinical resource to Group Protection claim professionals during claim meetings and as needed.
  • You will recommend specific medical information needed to evaluate ongoing levels of impairment and to facilitate optimal claim management.
  • You will make appropriate referrals to external clinical resources (i.e. IME, FCE, Peer Reviews).
  • You will discuss complex medical issues with health care providers as needed and documents outcomes of discussion.
  • You will coordinate and partner with Vocational Rehabilitation Coordinators (VRC) and others to support with return-to-work services.
  • You will effectively manage assigned caseload within department productivity goals.

What we're looking for

Must-have experience (Required):

  • 4 Year/Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of Bachelor's) in Nursing.
  • Registered Nurse – Current, unrestricted license in the state where the position is located (upon hire certificates/licensures).
  • Ability to read, analyze and interpret both internal and external documents such as general media/publications, professional journals, technical procedures, governmental regulations, policies, proposals, and standard operating procedures.
  • Confident, comfortable communicator with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrates clear, concise communication skills when interpreting medical information, documenting rationales for clinical opinions, clarifying restrictions/limitations, assisting with return to work and communicating with staff, mgmt. & other stakeholders

Nice-to have experience (Preferred):

  • Associates or bachelor's degree in Nursing.
  • 3-5 years of nursing experience with preferred clinical nursing expertise in Emergency Room, Critical Care, Orthopedics, Coronary Care, or trauma.
  • Previous insurance industry experience preferred.
  • Experience and/or proficiency with Disability Management (STD/LTD), Workers Compensation, Utilization Review and/or nurse case management preferred skills

Application Deadline

Applications will be accepted through September 25th, 2026, and posting may be taken down early due to applicant volume.

Job.JobDescription:
Job Description

Pharmacy Analytics, AVP/VP

Are you passionate about healthcare and energized the healthcare consulting industry? If so, this is the role for you!

Aon's leading Health Solutions industry team is growing and continues to be a differentiator as we attempt to redefine and transform the industry. Now is the time to join this inclusive team of passionate healthcare professionals!

This is a remote role with the flexibility to work virtually from home anywhere within the United States.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

The AVP/VP of Pharmacy Analytics will lead the design and implementation of pharmacy analytics solutions. These offerings support clients in comprehending pharmacy benefit performance, pinpointing cost and utilization possibilities, reviewing pharmacy benefit manager effectiveness, and transforming complex data into clear, actionable guidance. This role will function as a senior analytics leader and subject-matter expert across pharmacy claims, PBM contracting, formulary strategy, specialty pharmacy, payment integrity, and pharmacy trend management.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Lead the pharmacy analytics strategy, roadmap, and delivery model in alignment with broader health, benefits, and client priorities.
  • Oversee analytics related to pharmacy claims, utilization, pricing, rebates, formulary management, specialty pharmacy, clinical programs, and PBM performance.
  • Translate complex pharmacy and financial analyses into executive-ready insights, recommendations, and client-facing narratives.
  • Partner with clinical, actuarial, consulting, data science, product, and technology teams to develop scalable analytic solutions and reporting capabilities.
  • Support PBM evaluations, market checks, audits, vendor performance reviews, and pharmacy strategy engagements with data-driven insights.
  • Identify cost-efficiency opportunities, trend drivers, outliers, program gaps, and member-level patterns that inform pharmacy benefit design and intervention strategies.
  • Ensure analytic methodologies are sound, repeatable, well-documented, and aligned with client objectives and industry standards.
  • Serve as a senior point of contact for internal stakeholders and clients on pharmacy analytics methodology, findings, interpretation, and implications.
  • Provide leadership, coaching, and direction to analytics team members, including prioritization, quality control, and professional development.
  • Monitor pharmacy industry trends, regulatory changes, emerging therapies, specialty drug pipeline developments, and PBM market dynamics.
  • Data Management, Meeting Facilitation, Project Management, Risk Management, Solutions Design, Benefits Administration, Consulting, Customer Engagement, Data Analysis

Education

  • 10+ years of experience in healthcare analytics, pharmacy analytics, pharmacy benefit management, consulting, health plans, or related healthcare data environments.
  • Deep understanding of pharmacy benefits, PBM operations, claims adjudication, pricing methodologies, rebate structures, utilization management, formulary design, and specialty pharmacy.
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing pharmacy claims data and translating findings into strategic recommendations for clients or senior leadership.
  • Strong leadership experience managing analytics teams, cross-functional initiatives, or complex client-facing deliverables.
  • Proficiency working with large healthcare datasets and analytic tools such as SQL, Python, R, SAS, Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical and clinical concepts clearly to executive, technical, and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage competing priorities, timelines, stakeholder expectations, and quality standards.
  • Bachelor's degree in analytics, data science, statistics, economics, pharmacy, public health, healthcare administration, actuarial science, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree such as PharmD, MPH, MBA, MS, or PhD in a relevant field.
  • Experience supporting employer-sponsored health benefits, PBM procurement, pharmacy audits, vendor evaluations, or payment integrity initiatives.
  • Experience integrating pharmacy claims with medical claims, eligibility, clinical, lab, vendor, or financial datasets.
  • Knowledge of advanced analytics, predictive modeling, machine learning, or AI-enabled healthcare analytics.
  • Experience presenting to senior executives, clients, consultants, clinical leaders, or vendor partners.

Pay Transparency Laws:

The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $160,000 - $180,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant's education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant's geographic location.

This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon's annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan.

A summary of all the benefits offered for this position:

Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon's discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies.

Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate.

Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

About the role


The Wireless Network Engineer is a technical leader in wireless networking, responsible for designing and implementing global wireless network architectures that align with industry best practices, organizational needs, ensuring high performance, scalability and security. We are seeking a highly skilled Wireless Network Engineer with expertise in wireless network infrastructures to define and enforce wireless standards, including RF design principles, authentication frameworks, encryption protocols, security, compliance and robust performance. This is a key role in defining enterprise-wide wireless standards, ensuring high performance and seamless user experience.


Responsibilities


  • Lead engineer responsible for designing and developing scalable and highly available wireless network architectures that align with enterprise goals, industry standards and best practices.
  • Define and enforce wireless standards, including RF planning principles, authentication frameworks, encryption protocols, compliance, and performance optimization.
  • Develop and maintain standardized wireless configurations that ensure consistent operation and interoperability in multi-vendor environments.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in Wi-Fi technologies, particularly IEEE 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6/6E) and 802.11ac standards.
  • Coordinate and conduct predictive modeling and site surveys to ensure optimal RF coverage, signal integrity, and client density planning.
  • Implement AI-driven insights and machine learning-based analytics to proactively monitor user experiences, identify anomalies, and accelerate issue resolution.
  • Integrate self-healing capabilities into the wireless network to enable automatic remediation of common performance and connectivity issues.
  • Utilize intent-based networking principles to align wireless configurations with user needs and business intent, reducing manual intervention.
  • Drive the use of automation platforms for configuration management, policy enforcement, and streamlined operational workflows.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, security, and application teams to ensure wireless solutions support current and future business initiatives.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and provide strategic guidance on adoption and integration to support innovation and efficiency.
  • Evaluate emerging wireless technologies and trends, providing guidance to stakeholders on adoption strategies and their potential impact.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align wireless strategies with enterprise network architecture, security, and digital initiatives.
  • Ensure network security through robust wireless encryption protocols, authentication mechanisms, and compliance with regulatory standards.
  • Articulate design rationale, flexibly adapt solutions, and iterate designs when required.
  • Work closely with senior management, network engineering and operations teams.
  • Act as an escalation engineer for high severity network related production issues, work with engineers and various vendors to identify tactical and strategic solutions.

Requirements


  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, or related field, such as Computer Science or Information Technology or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of proven experience designing, deploying, and managing large-scale wireless enterprise networks, project delivery with focus on user experience, performance optimization and scalability.
  • Extensive experience in wireless network engineering, design, and optimization in enterprise environments.
  • Deep understanding of RF engineering principles and WLAN technologies, including Wi-Fi 6/6E and 802.11ac standards.
  • Strong background in wireless network security, including authentication, encryption, and compliance frameworks.
  • Proficient in the use of site survey and RF planning tools for predictive and real-time analysis.
  • Experience with multi-vendor wireless ecosystems and interoperability planning.
  • Familiarity with automation frameworks and proactive network management practices.
  • Hands-on experience in large-scale wireless deployments across campus, retail, or high-density environments.
  • Knowledge of location-based services, BLE technologies, and mobile engagement strategies.
  • Experience analyzing, gathering, and auditing large-scale and complex data sets to uncover new trends and patterns that influence architecture direction.
  • Proven experience recommending network improvements, including cost/benefit analysis, to meet changing business requirements.
  • Prior experience planning large-scale projects through vendor comparison and cost studies.
  • Sharp troubleshooting faculties, deductive reasoning, and careful attention to detail.
  • Independent and self-directed work ethic when participating in a collaborative environment.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Dedicated commitment to service availability and quality user experience.
  • Must be results driven with a strong sense of urgency.

Nice to Have

  • Demonstrated ability to utilize AI-driven tools for network visibility, root cause analysis, and performance metrics is nice to have
  • Industry certifications on Wireless Networking is preferred.

The base salary range for this position is $126,000-$171,000 and the position is eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan. Your actual compensation will be dependent on your skill, experience and qualifications. If your compensation expectations are above the posted range, we still encourage you to apply - your unique background matters to us. In addition, we are proud to offer a range of competitive benefits, a summary of which can be viewed here: 2026_AIG_Benefits_Overview.pdf
