Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $63,739 to $95,264 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Tampa, FL
  • License: Valid driver's license
  • Benefits: 401(k), paid time off
  • Workplace: Drug-free workplace

About this job

Registered nurse role managing workers' compensation cases in Tampa, Florida, combining office work and local travel. Involves coordinating care between injured workers, physicians, and healthcare providers while assessing treatment plans and cost effectiveness.

Good fit if you have RN licensure, a valid driver's license, and can travel locally up to 60% of the work week.

Full job description

CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Field (Medical) Case Manager position in the Tampa, FL area.

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families. Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others. This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient's progress
  • Evaluates patient's treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney's visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker's injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
  • A valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location. Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors: federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions. Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role. The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range: $63,739 – $95,264

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

ABOUT CORVEL – Medical Case Managers:

CorVel, a certified Great Place to Work® Company, is a national provider of industry-leading risk management solutions for the workers' compensation, auto, health and disability management industries. CorVel was founded in 1987 and has been publicly traded on the NASDAQ stock exchange since 1991. Our continual investment in human capital and technology enable us to deliver the most innovative and integrated solutions to our clients. We are a stable and growing company with a strong, supportive culture and plenty of career advancement opportunities. Over 4,000 people working across the United States embrace our core values of Accountability, Commitment, Excellence, Integrity and Teamwork (ACE-IT!).

A comprehensive benefits package is available for full-time regular employees and includes Medical (HDHP) w/Pharmacy, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account Options, Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Pre-paid Legal Insurance, Parking and Transit FSA accounts, 401K, ROTH 401K, and paid time off. In addition, Medical Case Managers are eligible for bonus and will be provided state-of-the-art technological devices to ensure ready access to CorVel's proprietary Case Management application, enabling staff to retrieve documents on the go and log activities as they occur.

CorVel is an Equal Opportunity Employer, drug free workplace, and complies with ADA regulations as applicable.

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days virtual for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office. Applicants beyond fifty (50) miles may still be considered.

Job Summary

As Director, Technical Underwriting - Property, you will serve as Farmers' senior technical authority for commercial property underwriting. You will establish underwriting frameworks, drive portfolio performance, oversee authority management and quality initiatives, and provide expert guidance on complex property risks. This is a rare opportunity to build a newly formed technical underwriting function as part of a significant modernization of our Business Insurance organization.

This role combines deep underwriting expertise, strategic leadership, and organizational influence. The Director will help shape underwriting appetite, governance frameworks, authority structures, quality programs, and portfolio performance while building technical capabilities across the broader underwriting organization. We are particularly interested in experienced external underwriting leaders who can bring specialized expertise and innovative thinking to help advance Farmers' underwriting capabilities.

The Director will play a pivotal role in building technical excellence, enhancing underwriting quality, improving profitability, and developing the next generation of underwriting talent.

Essential Job Functions

  • Lead authority management strategy and underwriting governance framework, including corporate authority templates, referral triggers, and decision rules.
  • Define and enforce how underwriting decisions are made to ensure consistency with underwriting strategy and risk appetite.
  • Exercise elevated underwriting authority and provide guidance on complex or high-exposure risks.
  • Own underwriting performance and profitability for assigned lines of business, including accountability for loss ratio, combined ratio, growth, and retention.
  • Monitor performance and take action to achieve financial and business objectives.
  • Own underwriting quality program and control environment, including quality standards, leakage monitoring, audits, and compliance frameworks.
  • Identify control gaps and implement corrective actions to ensure adherence to underwriting guidelines, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.
  • Translate underwriting strategy and risk appetite into technical frameworks, including guidelines, authority structures, and operational rules.
  • Ensure consistent execution across lines of business through clear standards and governance mechanisms.
  • Partner with actuarial and data and analytics to develop and deploy portfolio analytics, underwriting models, and decision-support tools.
  • Establish and lead emerging risk identification and governance processes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to assess impacts and drive updates to underwriting guidelines, authority frameworks, and control structures.
  • Provide direct technical guidance and support to underwriting centers, ensuring responsiveness, effective decision-making, and alignment with underwriting standards.
  • Lead, develop, and retain talent in either quality or loss control functions.
  • Build deep technical expertise and governance discipline within the organization.
  • Implement feedback loops to continuously improve underwriting decision quality, pricing discipline, and overall performance, including coordination and portfolio management of individual account reinsurance placements and collaboration with the reinsurance team on annual facility placements
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Experience Requirements

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $66,941 to $101,258 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Fairfax, VA
  • License: Valid driver's license
  • Benefits: 401(k), paid time off
  • Workplace: Drug-free workplace

About this job

Registered nurse position managing workers' compensation cases in Fairfax, VA. Work from home and on the road, Monday through Friday, with approximately 60% local travel. Coordinate care between injured workers, physicians, and healthcare providers.

Good fit if you are an RN with medical case management or clinical experience in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation, and can travel locally 60% of the time.

Full job description

CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Field (Medical) Case Manager position in the Fairfax, VA area.

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families. Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others. This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient's progress
  • Evaluates patient's treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney's visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker's injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

    KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

    • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
    • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
    • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
    • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
    • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
    • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

    EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

    • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
    • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
    • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
    • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
    • A valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required

      PAY RANGE:

      CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location. Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors: federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions. Our ranges may be modified at any time.

      For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role. The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

      Pay Range: $66,941 - $101,258

      A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

      In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

      ABOUT CORVEL – Medical Case Managers:

      CorVel, a certified Great Place to Work® Company, is a national provider of industry-leading risk management solutions for the workers' compensation, auto, health and disability management industries. CorVel was founded in 1987 and has been publicly traded on the NASDAQ stock exchange since 1991. Our continual investment in human capital and technology enable us to deliver the most innovative and integrated solutions to our clients. We are a stable and growing company with a strong, supportive culture and plenty of career advancement opportunities. Over 4,000 people working across the United States embrace our core values of Accountability, Commitment, Excellence, Integrity and Teamwork (ACE-IT!).

      A comprehensive benefits package is available for full-time regular employees and includes Medical (HDHP) w/Pharmacy, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account Options, Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Pre-paid Legal Insurance, Parking and Transit FSA accounts, 401K, ROTH 401K, and paid time off. In addition, Medical Case Managers are eligible for bonus and will be provided state-of-the-art technological devices to ensure ready access to CorVel's proprietary Case Management application, enabling staff to retrieve documents on the go and log activities as they occur.

      CorVel is an Equal Opportunity Employer, drug free workplace, and complies with ADA regulations as applicable.

Job Summary

As Director, Technical Underwriting - Casualty, you will serve as Farmers' senior technical authority for commercial casualty underwriting. You will lead the development of underwriting strategy, governance, referral frameworks, and portfolio management practices while providing expertise on complex casualty exposures. This newly created role offers the opportunity to shape the future of casualty underwriting within a transforming Business Insurance organization.

This role combines deep underwriting expertise, strategic leadership, and organizational influence. The Director will help shape underwriting appetite, governance frameworks, authority structures, quality programs, and portfolio performance while building technical capabilities across the broader underwriting organization. We are particularly interested in experienced external underwriting leaders who can bring specialized expertise and innovative thinking to help advance Farmers' underwriting capabilities.

The Director will play a pivotal role in building technical excellence, enhancing underwriting quality, improving profitability, and developing the next generation of underwriting talent.

Essential Job Functions

  • Lead authority management strategy and underwriting governance framework, including corporate authority templates, referral triggers, and decision rules.
  • Define and enforce how underwriting decisions are made to ensure consistency with underwriting strategy and risk appetite.
  • Exercise elevated underwriting authority and provide guidance on complex or high-exposure risks.
  • Own underwriting performance and profitability for assigned lines of business, including accountability for loss ratio, combined ratio, growth, and retention.
  • Monitor performance and take action to achieve financial and business objectives.
  • Own underwriting quality program and control environment, including quality standards, leakage monitoring, audits, and compliance frameworks.
  • Identify control gaps and implement corrective actions to ensure adherence to underwriting guidelines, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.
  • Translate underwriting strategy and risk appetite into technical frameworks, including guidelines, authority structures, and operational rules.
  • Ensure consistent execution across lines of business through clear standards and governance mechanisms.
  • Partner with actuarial and data and analytics to develop and deploy portfolio analytics, underwriting models, and decision-support tools.
  • Establish and lead emerging risk identification and governance processes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to assess impacts and drive updates to underwriting guidelines, authority frameworks, and control structures.
  • Provide direct technical guidance and support to underwriting centers, ensuring responsiveness, effective decision-making, and alignment with underwriting standards.
  • Lead, develop, and retain talent in either quality or loss control functions.
  • Build deep technical expertise and governance discipline within the organization.
  • Implement feedback loops to continuously improve underwriting decision quality, pricing discipline, and overall performance, including coordination and portfolio management of individual account reinsurance placements and collaboration with the reinsurance team on annual facility placements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Experience Requirements

  • Commercial casualty underwriting expertise including complex casualty exposures, liability trends, and technical referral authority.
  • Minimum ten years of experience in insurance underwriting or insurance compliance required.
  • Minimum five years experience leading people required.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelors degree required. Preferably in mathematics, business, or finance.
  • CPCU or CIC designation preferred.

Additional Qualifications

  • Ability to drive multiple projects to successful completion.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional work, drive decisions, and build alignment across underwriting, product, pricing/actuarial, IT, data/analytics, and operations.
  • Demonstrated change leadership, including adoption planning, training enablement, measurement, and continuous improvement. Instills commitment to organizational goals.
  • Ability to understand the vision and direction of the business to develop and execute a plan to achieve business results.

Job Summary

This position drives development and execution of state- level strategies for designated products within a business unit. The role focuses on executing state-specific rate and product strategies that align with operational and profitability goals set by leadership. The position analyzes competitor activities, market conditions, and customer insights to guide rate recommendations and product adjustments for competitive positioning. The role collaborates cross-functionally to deliver competitive, compliant, and customer-focused insurance products. It develops short- and long-term strategies that meet market demands and business objectives. The position may supervise direct reports who are individual contributors or people leaders to ensure alignment with state product management goals and successful delivery of business unit priorities.

Essential Tasks & Leadership Philosophy

  • Accountable for achieving/exceeding profit and growth targets in assigned geography.
  • Develops strategic vision and supporting roadmap that will profitably expand market share within assigned geography.
  • Conducts competitor analysis with a focus on rate trends and market entries and exits at the state level to identify opportunities for competitive rate adjustments.
  • Uses insights to recommend state-specific rate strategies that improve market position and support profitability goals.
  • Supports post-implementation monitoring to track performance of state- specific rate and product adjustments.
  • Performs data analysis to identify trends and provide insights for ongoing improvements.
  • Coordinates annual rate planning with underwriting, distribution, and other internal partners to determine rate levels and product updates.
  • Ensures rate decisions reflect state-specific considerations and strategic plans.
  • Runs dislocation tool to determine rate recommendation.
  • Communicates with Department of Insurance for moderately complex state rate filings and revisions.
  • Prepares and submits required documentation, addresses inquiries, and ensures timely responses to DOI feedback.
  • Works with internal partners to incorporate DOI-required adjustments and maintain compliance with state regulations throughout the rate revision process.
  • Escalates more complex cases to senior team members for further resolution.
  • Supervises the daily activities of direct reports to ensure task completion and alignment with business unit priorities.
  • Provides instructions, delivers regular feedback, and manages performance to support individual and team development.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

First Year Success Factors

  • Drive successful execution of rate, product, and underwriting initiatives through effective stakeholder management, data-driven decision making, and continuous post-implementation monitoring.
  • Build and communicate a clear strategic roadmap for NV, AZ & UT, aligning cross-functional teams around profit, growth, and market share objectives.

Education & Career Experience Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred.
  • Minimum five years of experience required in product management, pricing, or related, with experience in state-level product management preferred.
  • Experience in a people leader or management role preferred.
  • Insurance industry experience preferred.

Additional Qualification

  • Strong verbal communication and listening skills.
  • Demonstrated written communication skills.
  • Effective interpersonal skills.
  • Able to interact effectively with business partners and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated analytical skills.
  • Able to analyze data and trends to make informed decisions and recommendations.
  • Possesses strong product knowledge.
  • Working knowledge of insurance products including commercial lines, property & casualty (P&C) lines, specialty lines, and other relevant types.
  • Demonstrated P&L management experience.
  • Possesses strong technical aptitude.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite.
  • Familiarity with product management tools, data analysis software, and reporting systems. Working knowledge of SaaS, SQL preferred.

About this job

Field Property Claims Adjuster conducting virtual and on-site investigations of property damage for policyholders. Position involves damage assessment, liability evaluation, settlement negotiation, and fraud reporting, with hybrid work and 1-3 catastrophe deployments per year expected.

Good fit if you have high school diploma, valid driver's license, customer service experience, and are willing to climb ladders and work in confined spaces.

Full job description

We are Farmers – where ambition meets opportunity.

At Farmers, we're not just known for unforgettable jingle – we're a team with a passion for purpose and making a real difference in people's lives. We deliver peace of mind when it matters most. Our results-driven, high-performance culture thrives on creativity, accountability and bold solutions. Here, growth isn't just a goal – it's a way of life for both the organization and every individual on our team. We tackle challenges head-on, learn from every experience and measure our impact on the customers who trust us.

Join an award-winning, equal opportunity employer, where you'll find more than a job – you'll find a supportive community. Enjoy competitive benefits, take part in meaningful volunteer projects, and help shape the future alongside talented colleagues across all backgrounds. At Farmers, helping others is at the heart of what we do.

Ready to make your mark? Discover our vibrant culture and explore career opportunities at www.Farmers.com/careers/corporate. Connect with us on Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok, and let's build something incredible together!

Workplace: Remote ( #LI-Remote )

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days virtual for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office. Applicants beyond fifty (50) miles may still be considered.

If you are looking for the following in your next career...

  • Paid training through the award-winning and industry-leading University of Farmers.
  • Flexibility and independence to work outside the confines of a desk job.
  • Total Rewards Benefits Package: 401K and a competitive starting salary.
  • Rapid growth potential and management opportunities for success-oriented people through education, mentorship programs, and inspirational leadership at a company you can be proud of.

… Then Farmers Insurance is the place for you!

A Day in the Life of a Field Property Claims Adjuster

  • Conduct both virtual and on-site investigations by visiting policyholders' residences to assess propertydamage, determine liability, evaluate the extent of loss, and negotiate fair settlements.
  • Use claims handling software, a company car, and a laptop to determine claims-related damage and write estimates in a paperless environment.
  • Evaluate and report on potential subrogation opportunities.
  • Reports incidents involving theft, fraud, or arson to appropriate state and industry agencies.
  • Perform duties independently, with work directly impacting management outcomes.
  • Acts as a company representative in public interactions, maintaining a professional demeanor consistentwith management standards.
  • Engages regularly with a variety of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses,contractors, law enforcement, fraud and arson investigators, attorneys, medical professionals, and otherrelevant parties.
  • Use strong customer service skills to negotiate with policyholders to settle the claim.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomicstandards as outlined in relevant company published manuals.

Employees assigned to the Catastrophe team will be required to travel away from their residence for a specified period of time, usually consisting of 23 days.

  • Although this is not a CAT-specific role, hires will be expected to commit to 1–3 CAT deployments per year.

If You Have the Following:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required.
  • Excellent Customer service experience, preferably in a retail environment
  • Construction or Insurance experience is highly desirable and preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills – both oral and written.
  • Computer Literate: MS Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Proficiency with smartphones and applications.
  • Eagerness to learn about insurance policies and property damage from the inside out to identify how coverage applies to a particular loss.
  • Outgoing personality that would enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses, and fraud investigators.
  • Valid driver's license and Bondable. Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position may include a company vehicle.

... then this could be a great career opportunity for you!

Final candidate qualifications may be reviewed against the requirements for the associated level of this role.

Candidates Must be Willing and Able to:

  • Climb Ladders to inspect roofs, and be comfortable working on rooftops, multiple times per day,
  • Work in small, confined spaces that have been damaged; such as attics and crawlspaces.
  • Achieve a minimum passing score on all claims training exams.

Physical Actions and Environment

  • Bending, Kneeling, Pulling, Pushing, Sorting, Carrying up to 50 lbs., Climbing, Reaching, Standing, Walking, Seeing
  • Speaking (English), Reading (English), Writing (English), & Key Entering

Required job duties are performed in the field and an in-home office environment. Exposure to some or all of the following environments when in the field: Uncontrolled outside environmental conditions, Excessive noise levels, Chemicals Chemical/Biological conditions, Moving mechanical parts, Areas considered dangerous, Conditions which could affect the respiratory system or skin such as fumes, odors, dust, mists, gases, oils, smoke, soot, or poor ventilation.

Workplace: Denver, CO

Job Summary

  • This position manages an assigned territory of core Foremost Independent Agencies, including responsibilities to prospect and appoint new agencies, drive profitable premium growth, and achieve financial and operational goals. This role develops and manages agency partnerships and serves as the primary relationship between the agency and the company. The position develops and successfully promotes and supports the available suite of Foremost products and services, including a portfolio of complex accounts, within an assigned territory.
  • This role is at the forefront of building premium growth through relationships with agents to ensure market share is built successfully. This position is an individual contributor who works independently with minimal guidance and direction from management and field distribution partners while performing work with business unit and enterprise impacts.
  • It may mentor or coach less experienced team members to support peer learning but has no supervisory responsibilities. The position is remote with required weekly field travel.

Essential Job Functions

  • Owns and manages assigned territory driving profitable growth to achieve financial and operational targets. Leads, develops, and executes territory tactical plan and agency management processes (example business planning, training, compensation) to support financial and operational targets, measure results, and pivot as necessary. Independently builds and cultivates mutually beneficial agency partnerships in person with agency ownership, management, and frontline staff using a consultative sales framework.
  • Acts as a trusted advisor while delivering product, underwriting philosophy, appetite, and system training to support retention and new business development to increase depth and maximize agency revenue. Creates, maintains, and executes high quality agency strategies and plans, including holding agents accountable, to achieve written premium, profit, and new business goals.
  • Collaborates with field distribution partners to plan and align strategic and tactical components with key business strategies such as carrier consolidation (agency book consolidation), agency storefront expansion, and new product or program rollout support. Drives and ensures quality of new business flow, appropriate mix of business, and overall risk management of both individual agency books and overall assigned territory.
  • Provides appetite and target market clarity, identifies and addresses profit or quality of business concerns to ensure profitability across territory. Strategically utilizes internal reporting and tools designed to support the Independent Agent channel including all Marketing and Development programs, business development tools and internal production and profitability data and analysis. Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Serves as a subject matter specialist to assist in leading, collaborating, influencing, and supporting internal business partners (e xample underwriting, product management, claims, service ops) to identify and capitalize on opportunities, solve problems, share key competitor and industry intelligence. May mentor or coach less experienced team members in support of peer learning and developing team capabilities.

Physical Actions

  • Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. Job may include work performed at field locations. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Field work performed outdoors may include exposure to weather elements. Frequently sits or stands for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and places objects or materials weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Occasionally performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category may require regular travel between Farmers offices, alternative work locations, and/or field locations.

Education Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred. CIC, CPCU, or insurance licenses preferred upon hire.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum five years of field insurance sales and management work experience with progressing responsibility.
  • Experience achieving consistent profitable premium growth and sales success.
  • IA Distribution experience within the Denver market preferred.

Benefits

  • Farmers offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience, qualifications and location.

Job Summary

This role enables the audit function through operational leadership, systems enablement, and portfolio level visibility. It ensures audit lifecycle resourcing and executive reporting operate efficiently and consistently across the organization. The role amplifies audit impact by improving processes, transparency, and data driven decision making, including leading executive-level audit reporting (example, Audit Committee and Executive Committee) and advancing the use of data analytics, automation, and AI to enhance audit insights and delivery effectiveness.

Essential Job Functions

  • Lead the end-to-end development and continuous enhancement of management, including leveraging data analytics to generate insights, identify themes and trends, and deliver value-added reporting for audit leadership and senior stakeholders.
  • Coordinate annual audit planning activities and quarterly refresh processes, including tracking updates, dependencies, and impacts to scope, timing, resourcing, and delivery, ensuring changes are consistently reflected across plans, systems, and stakeholder communications.
  • Advance the use of data analytics, automation, and AI enabled capabilities to support audit delivery and strategic enhancements to the function.
  • Oversee data analytics resources responsible for enabling data driven audit execution.
  • Support the audit functions professional practices activities, including methodology updates, alignment with IIA standards, quality assurance and improvement program activities, and incorporation of leading practices into audit guidance, tools, and templates.
  • Own the administration and ongoing evolution of the audit management system, leveraging platform functionality and configuring the system to align with audit methodology, planning, reporting, and evolving departmental needs.
  • Oversee audit execution operations across the portfolio, including planning timelines, key milestones, and resource scheduling, ensuring appropriate capacity allocation, workload balance, and proactive management of resource constraints.
  • Provide end-to-end operational visibility, monitoring execution progress and data quality, and identifying and mitigating risks to delivery.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Bachelors degree preferred. Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), or equivalent preferred

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum seven years in internal audit or equivalent required, preferably with focus on audit operations, data analytics, methodology, quality assurance, or transformation.

Additional Qualification

  • Possesses strong product knowledge.
  • Expertise in the audit lifecycle, methodology, reporting, insights generation, and IIA standards, complemented by strong technical data analytics capabilities (example, data extraction, transformation, and analysis tools) to enable data-driven audit insights.
  • Possesses strong technical aptitude.
  • Familiarity with audit software.
  • Effective leadership skills.
  • Ability to effectively lead through change while operating in an agile and adaptable manner.
  • Strong governance and operating model design experience.
  • Demonstrated written communication skills.
  • Strong verbal communication and listening skills.
  • Demonstrated project management skills.
  • Effective interpersonal skills

And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Product Security Engineering designs, builds, and operates enterprise security controls as software products that integrate directly into cloud platforms, the SDLC, and core enterprise services. The organization applies modern software and cloud engineering practices to deliver scalable, reliable, and developer friendly security capabilities for cloud hosted workloads.

The Cloud Product Security Engineer is a hands-on security engineer responsible for building, integrating, and operating security controls within cloud environments. This role focuses on engineering preventative, detective, and responsive security capabilities across cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and application services. It includes building and operating cloud security posture management (CSPM) and data loss prevention (DLP) capabilities to continuously detect, assess, and reduce risk in cloud environments.

Engineers in this role own the full software development lifecycle from design and implementation through deployment and production support and are accountable for the reliability, adoption, and effectiveness of cloud security controls, including their role in incident detection, response, and recovery.

Senior Product Engineer supporting Allstate's Enterprise Payments organization, architecting and owning digital products built with Java and Spring Boot. Role involves designing distributed systems, establishing CI/CD pipelines, and collaborating across teams in an Agile environment.

Good fit if you have 5+ years developing REST APIs with Java Spring Boot, experience with microservices and distributed systems, and knowledge of web/API security.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Senior Product Engineer (Java/Spring Boot) architects and designs their digital products using modern tools, technologies, frameworks, and systems. They apply a systematic application of scientific and technological knowledge, methods, and experience to the design, implementation, testing, and documentation of software. They own and manage running their application in production, and ultimately becomes accountable for the success of their digital products through achieving KPIs. Product Engineers at Allstate are considered Software Engineers.

In this role, you will support the Enterprise Payments organization, which is responsible for ensuring Allstate customers can seamlessly process a wide range of payment solutions.

The internal Allstate job title used for this role is Software Engineer Lead Consultant.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in inceptions and iteration planning meetings, infusing backlogs with technical input working in close partnership with the product manager.

  • Participates in daily site, cross-site, and product team standups.

  • Participates in retrospectives, demonstrating and encouraging each participant to provide feedback with empathy.

  • Collaborate with team in high-level and low-level component and system designs

  • Collaborate in performance improvements and tech review meetings

  • Practices daily paired programming and test-driven development in writing software and building products

  • Establishes continuous integration, continuous delivery, and continuous deployment pipelines and practices

  • Support software products in user environments

  • Participates in knowledge sharing, and contributes to the overall growth of the collective knowledge of the team

Qualifications

  • 5 years or more experience and knowledge in developing REST APIs using Java Spring Boot, including tooling for documentation (Swagger, REST-docs, Open API spec), versioning, service discovery/registration, testing and management; experience using API gateways and REACT is a plus.

  • Hands on experience and accountability architecting, designing, implementing and delivering large scale distributed systems and/or applications for the cloud, including Micro Services architectures.

  • Experience and knowledge in web and API security including authentication, authorization, OAuth, OWASP, OpenID, and SAML.

  • Experience in backend development design and implementation, database (SQL, caching) and Kafka messaging.

  • Knowledge and experience using distributed version control systems (Git), artifact management systems, build and packaging systems (Maven, Gradle, NPM, Artifactory, etc.) and Jenkins or similar Continuous Integration tools.

  • Experience of working in an Agile environment or paired programming/engineering model.

  • Experience with Python is a plus.

  • Experience with the Test-Driven approach and writing unit tests for front to back coverage.

  • Experience with problem-solving and analyzing performance bottlenecks.

Experience

  • 5 or more years of experience (Preferred)

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties

About this job

Direct Sales Agent Specialist at National General/Allstate in Round Rock, Texas. Generates new business and cross-sells insurance products to local customers in person and by phone, with focus on community relationships and lead generation.

Good fit if you have 0-2 years of sales experience and can obtain P&C licensing within 90 days

Full job description

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.

This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment while making a difference, then apply to join our team today!

As a Direct Sales Agent Specialist, you will:

  • Achieve sales goals through new business, cross-sell, and retention

  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline, including local lead generation and referrals

  • Develop relationships within the community (e.g., dealerships, events, local partners) to support business growth

  • Conduct outbound prospecting and follow-ups to convert opportunities into sales

  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives

  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition

  • Deliver results aligned with performance standards, compliance requirements, and customer experience expectations

What makes Direct Auto Insurance unique?

  • Day 1 Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Tuition Reimbursement, Pension & so much more

  • 20 PTO Days per year & 6 Paid Holidays

  • Ability to sell a multitude of industry-leading products through retail stores and phone

  • Entrepreneurial, performance-based, and results-focused culture

  • Multi-tiered and comprehensive paid training program

  • Base hourly rate plus uncapped monthly incentive

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 0 2 years of experience

  • P&C licensing (Preferred) or must attain required licensure within 90 days of joining the company.

Skills

Active Learning, Active Listening, Business Rules, Communication, Cooperation, Customer Service, High Reliability, Professional Integrity, Sales, Time Management

Compensation

Base compensation: $20.00 per hour

Total Compensation:
In addition to the base hourly rate, total compensation for this role may include incentive pay, such as commissions and bonuses, based on individual and team performance.

Job Description

The Vice President, Investor Relations serves as the strategic leader responsible for developing and executing Allstate's investor relations strategy and capital markets communications. Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer, this role acts as the primary liaison between the company and the investment community, building credibility and confidence with shareholders, sell-side analysts, rating agencies, and other external stakeholders.

The Vice President provides strategic counsel to the CFO, CEO, and senior leadership team on investor sentiment, market perceptions, shareholder expectations, and competitive positioning. This executive is accountable for advancing Allstate's investment thesis, communicating financial performance and long-term strategy, and helping optimize shareholder value through transparent and effective engagement with the capital markets

Key Responsibilities

Lead Investor Relations Strategy

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive investor relations strategy aligned with Allstate's business strategy, financial objectives, and long-term value creation goals.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the CFO and executive leadership team on capital markets trends, investor expectations, shareholder concerns, and valuation drivers.
  • Drive the enterprise investment narrative and ensure consistent messaging across all investor communications.
  • Influence strategic communication related to earnings performance, capital allocation, growth initiatives, risk management, and major business transformations.

Capital Markets and Shareholder Engagement

  • Act as Allstate's principal spokesperson to the investment community.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with institutional investors, sell-side analysts, rating agencies, and other key external stakeholders.
  • Lead shareholder targeting and engagement strategies to enhance investor understanding and support of the company's strategy.
  • Represent Allstate at investor conferences, roadshows, non-deal roadshows, and industry events.

Executive and Board Advisory

  • Provide market intelligence and investor feedback to the CFO, CEO, executive leadership team, and Board of Directors.
  • Monitor trends in shareholder ownership, analyst coverage, peer performance, investor sentiment, and industry developments.
  • Advise leadership on emerging issues that may impact market perception, company valuation, or shareholder confidence.
  • Support Board and executive discussions related to capital markets, investor priorities, and shareholder engagement activities.

Financial Communications and Disclosure

  • Oversee the preparation and execution of quarterly earnings communications, including earnings releases, conference calls, investor presentations, and supporting materials.
  • Lead development of materials for Investor Day and other strategic investor events.
  • Partner closely with Finance, Treasury, Corporate Communications, Legal, and Corporate Secretary functions to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant disclosures.
  • Ensure adherence to SEC regulations, Regulation FD, and disclosure governance requirements.

Market Intelligence and Competitive Insights

  • Monitor investor sentiment, analyst perspectives, industry developments, and macroeconomic trends.
  • Conduct competitive benchmarking and valuation analyses to identify opportunities and risks.
  • Deliver actionable insights to executive leadership regarding market expectations and competitor positioning.
  • Maintain deep understanding of shareholder composition and evolving investor priorities.

Leadership

  • Build and lead a high-performing investor relations function.
  • Develop talent and create succession plans within the investor relations organization.
  • Foster strong cross-functional partnerships across Finance, Treasury, Corporate Strategy, Communications, and Legal.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This job has supervisory responsibilities and is accountable for building, developing, and leading the investor relations team.

Preferred Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Communications, or related field required.
  • MBA, CFA, or other advanced degree preferred.

Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in investor relations, finance, corporate strategy, treasury, equity research or sales, investment banking, or related fields.
  • Significant experience supporting a publicly traded company.
  • Demonstrated success interacting with institutional investors, analysts, executive leadership teams, and Boards of Directors.
  • Experience leading enterprise-level communications in a highly regulated environment.
  • Strong understanding of capital markets, valuation methodologies, SEC reporting requirements, and shareholder engagement practices.

Leadership Profile

  • Strategic enterprise thinker with strong business and financial acumen.
  • Executive presence and credible communication style with investors, analysts, executives, and Board members.
  • Ability to translate complex business and financial information into clear and compelling market narratives.
  • Strong influencing and relationship-management skills across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity and provide strategic guidance during periods of market volatility and organizational change.
  • Proven track record of leading high-performing teams and driving enterprise results.

Investor Relations

Job.JobTitle: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Milwaukee, WI
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

This is a field adjuster role in Milwaukee, Wi area.

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on all property claims types, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.

The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:

2 years' previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

Previous experience in construction estimating or as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.

Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.

Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.

Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.

This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

Required Qualifications:

Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.

Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one to two-story roof.

Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

Youre provided with comprehensive training:

The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.

Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

You will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.

If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.

Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.

Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

#LI-MMS

Skills

Customer Service, Flexibility, Negotiation, Property Insurance Claims, Time Management

Compensation offered for this role is $69,250.00 - $93,250 and is based on experience and qualifications.

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Chicago, IL

About this job

Lead consultant role providing technical leadership for enterprise network security platforms at Allstate's Chicago office. Responsibilities include engineering firewall infrastructure, developing Infrastructure as Code approaches, building CI/CD pipelines, and establishing engineering standards.

Good fit if you have strong network engineering and security fundamentals, hands-on experience with enterprise firewalls like Palo Alto Networks, and expertise in Ansible, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Position Overview


We are seeking a Vended Application Lead Consultant Engineer to join our Network Security engineering team. This role will provide technical leadership for the engineering, automation, deployment, and lifecycle management of enterprise network security platforms.


The ideal candidate will bring a strong foundation in networking and network security, combined with experience applying modern software engineering and infrastructure automation practices to infrastructure platforms. This individual should be comfortable working with technologies such as Palo Alto Networks or comparable enterprise firewall platforms, while also having hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, Ansible, APIs, and automation frameworks.


This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who can bridge traditional infrastructure engineering with a modern, automated approach to managing network security services.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a lead engineer and technical resource for enterprise network security platforms and vended applications.
  • Engineer, maintain, and improve firewall and network security infrastructure across enterprise environments.
  • Develop and promote an Infrastructure as Code approach for provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate infrastructure configuration, validation, testing, and deployment.
  • Develop automation using Ansible, APIs, scripting, and related automation technologies.
  • Design solutions that reduce manual operational activities and improve the consistency and repeatability of infrastructure changes.
  • Provide technical leadership for Palo Alto Networks firewall technologies or comparable enterprise firewall/security platforms.
  • Partner with networking, cloud, application, security, and infrastructure teams to design and implement secure connectivity solutions.
  • Troubleshoot complex network and security issues across application, network, firewall, and cloud environments.
  • Establish engineering standards, reusable automation patterns, and technical best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, resiliency, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Participate in product lifecycle activities including upgrades, platform modernization, capacity planning, vulnerability remediation, and technology refreshes.
  • Lead technical implementation efforts and provide engineering guidance to other members of the team.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and engineering standards.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong background in network engineering and network security.
  • Strong understanding of core networking concepts including:
    • TCP/IP
    • Routing
    • Subnetting
    • NAT
    • DNS
    • VPN technologies
    • Network segmentation
    • Load balancing and application connectivity
  • Experience engineering or supporting enterprise firewall platforms, preferably Palo Alto Networks or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code concepts, practices, and tooling.
  • Hands-on experience with Ansible for infrastructure configuration and automation.
  • Experience developing or supporting CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure or application deployments.
  • Experience integrating infrastructure platforms through REST APIs or other programmatic interfaces.
  • Working knowledge of scripting or programming languages used for automation, such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure problems across multiple technology domains.
  • Ability to translate technical requirements into scalable and supportable engineering solutions.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, operations, application, and security teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls, Panorama, or related Palo Alto technologies.
  • Experience managing network security infrastructure in public cloud environments such as AWS or Azure.
  • Experience with source-control platforms and development workflows such as Git.
  • Experience with CI/CD and automation platforms such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, or similar technologies.
  • Experience working with enterprise IT service management and change-management processes.
  • Experience creating reusable automation frameworks rather than one-off scripts.
  • Experience working in an environment adopting product-oriented engineering and DevOps practices.
  • Experience modernizing traditional infrastructure platforms through automation and Infrastructure as Code.

What Were Looking For

We are looking for more than someone who knows how to configure a firewall. The successful candidate will be an engineer who understands networking deeply and approaches infrastructure as an engineering product that can be automated, tested, version-controlled, and continuously improved.

They should be comfortable moving between troubleshooting a complex network connectivity issue, developing an Ansible automation workflow, reviewing a CI/CD deployment pipeline, and helping determine the future technical direction of the platform.


Core skill profile


Networking & Security: Strong networking fundamentals with enterprise firewall/security experience.

Infrastructure as Code : Experience managing infrastructure through repeatable, version-controlled automation.

Automation: Strong Ansible experience supplemented by scripting and API integration.

CI/CD: Experience applying software delivery practices to infrastructure deployment and configuration.

Firewall Platforms: Palo Alto experience is preferred, but strong experience with comparable enterprise firewall platforms is also valuable.

Technical Leadership: Ability to lead engineering efforts, establish standards, mentor others, and drive modernization of the platform.

Skills

Automation, Automation Tools, Azure Devops, Defect Resolution, ERP Applications, Functional Designs, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Integration Testing, Issue Management, Network Automation, Network Security Engineering, Palo Alto Networks Panorama, Red Hat Ansible

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 98,100.00 - 167,850.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Job Description

Senior Consultant I - Network Security Engineering

Join our Network Security Engineering team and help secure and modernize critical enterprise infrastructure. As a Senior Consultant I, you will engineer, support, automate, and maintain network security platforms that protect the organization while improving reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.

We're looking for an experienced engineer with a strong foundation in networking and network security who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and leveraging automation to drive better outcomes. You'll work with technologies such as enterprise firewall platforms, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, APIs, scripting, and automation frameworks to streamline operations and enhance platform performance.

This is a hands-on role for someone who takes ownership, works independently, and delivers high-quality engineering solutions with limited oversight. You'll troubleshoot complex network and security issues, implement infrastructure improvements, support automation initiatives, and contribute ideas that help advance the team's engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engineer, support, and maintain enterprise network security platforms, including Palo Alto Networks and related security technologies.
  • Design, implement, test, and validate network security solutions across enterprise and cloud environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex network, firewall, routing, connectivity, and application communication issues.
  • Develop and maintain automation using scripting, APIs, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and configuration management tools.
  • Build and support CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure deployment, testing, validation, and configuration management.
  • Create automated pre- and post-change validation processes to improve reliability, consistency, and operational efficiency.
  • Integrate security platforms with monitoring, deployment, and operational tooling to enhance visibility and automation.
  • Identify and automate repetitive operational tasks to reduce manual effort and improve platform scalability.
  • Support platform lifecycle initiatives, including upgrades, vulnerability remediation, technology refreshes, and modernization efforts.
  • Partner with network, cloud, security, and application teams to deliver secure, resilient, and scalable solutions.
  • Contribute to technical reviews, process improvements, and engineering best practices while operating within established architecture and security standards.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, scripts, and automation.
  • Provide technical assistance and knowledge sharing to other members of the team.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong background in network engineering and network security.
  • Strong understanding of core networking technologies and concepts, including: TCP/IP, Routing, Subnetting, NAT, DNS, and application connectivity
  • Experience engineering, implementing, or supporting enterprise firewall and network security platforms.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code concepts, practices, and version-controlled infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience developing scripts and automation for infrastructure engineering and operational use cases, including areas such as: Infrastructure change implementation, Configuration management, Pre-change and post-change validation, Infrastructure monitoring and health checks, Data collection and reporting, Operational troubleshooting, API-driven infrastructure management
  • Working knowledge of scripting or programming languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Experience working with REST APIs or other programmatic interfaces to interact with and automate infrastructure platforms.
  • Experience developing, maintaining, or working with CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure configuration and deployment.
  • Experience using source control and version-control practices, such as Git-based development workflows.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure, network connectivity, and security issues.
  • Ability to independently analyze technical requirements and implement solutions within established architecture and engineering standards.
  • Ability to take ownership of assigned technical work and drive it through implementation and validation with limited oversight.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across infrastructure, security, networking, cloud, and application teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Ansible for infrastructure configuration, deployment, orchestration, or automation.
  • Hands on experience with Palo Alto Networks Firewalls and Panorama or similar firewall platforms.
  • Experience supporting network security infrastructure within AWS, Azure, or other public cloud environments.
  • Strong understanding, VPN technologies, Network segmentation, and load balancing
  • Experience with CI/CD and automation technologies such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
  • Experience developing reusable automation frameworks, modules, or tooling for infrastructure engineering.
  • Experience working within enterprise change-management and IT service-management processes.
  • Experience working in a DevOps or product-oriented engineering environment.
  • Experience modernizing traditional infrastructure platforms through automation and Infrastructure as Code.

Skills

Automation, DevOps, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Network Security Engineering, Palo Alto Networks Panorama, Red Hat Ansible

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 75,100.00 - 126,325.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Job Description

Core Engineering & Platforms (CEP) group is seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Lead Product Engineer for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to drive the development and adoption of enterprise-scale infrastructure automation capabilities. This role is responsible for designing, building, and productizing reusable infrastructure solutions that enable engineering teams to provision, manage, and operate infrastructure through code. The ideal candidate may have successfully launched large-scale IaC initiatives and can translate strategic objectives into practical, scalable engineering solutions.

As a technical acumen and practitioner, the candidate will establish engineering standards, build reusable modules and automation frameworks, implement CI/CD pipelines, and drive self-service infrastructure capabilities across the organization. Also, the candidate will collaborate closely with platform, server, security, networking, and application teams to transform infrastructure delivery from manual processes into a resilient, automated, and software-defined operating model.
  • Accountable for the enterprise Infrastructure as Code (IaC) strategy, standards, governance, and adoption roadmap.
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable infrastructure automation solutions across omni-hosted platforms.
  • Build reusable modules, templates, blueprints, and self-service automation capabilities for infrastructure teams.
  • Develop automation usingAnsible, Terraform/OpenTofu, Puppet, Rundeck, Python,orrelated infrastructure automation technologies.
  • Apply AI-assisted engineering and Specification-Driven Design practices to improve delivery speed, consistency, and automation quality.
  • Understanding of responsible AI practices, security controls, governance, and risk management within enterprise automation platforms.
  • Design and develop APIs and integrations that enable infrastructure orchestration, provisioning, and platform services.
  • Drive CI/CD, security, compliance, testing, and deployment automation for infrastructure delivery.
  • Partner with platform product teams to accelerate IaC adoption and productize infrastructure capabilities.
  • Create documentation, reference architectures, training materials, and enablement programs for IaC tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and engineering best practices.
  • Leverage cross-domain infrastructure knowledge spanning compute, networking, storage, security, identity, cloud, andinfraservices to deliver curated consumer-facing platform products and improve operational resilience.

Job Qualifications

  • Deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code principles, patterns, and engineering practices.
  • Experience with continuous collaborative pair programming to solve technical challenges.
  • Strong experience building infrastructure automation solutions using tools such as Ansible,Terraform/OpenTofu,Env0, Puppet, or equivalent platforms.
  • Demonstrated success establishing and scaling enterprise infrastructure automation initiatives.
  • Strong software engineering mindset with emphasis on maintainability, testing, version control, and automation.
  • Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure deployments.
  • Knowledge of Git-based development workflows, branching strategies, pull requests, and code review practices.
  • Experience building reusable modules, templates, and shared automation services.
  • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, security, identity management, and platform services.
  • Proven ability to influence engineering teams and drive adoption of technical standards.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on technical execution.

Nice to have Qualifications

  • Experience integrating LLMs, MCPs, AI agents, Copilot technologies, or workflow automation platforms into infrastructure engineering solutions.
  • Experience building AI-native infrastructure platforms that incorporate intelligent code generation, automated testing, policy validation, self-healing workflows, and predictive operational insights.
  • Experience enabling self-service capabilities through platform engineering or developer platforms.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This role does not requiresupervisory duties.

Experience

5 or more years of experience (Preferred)


Skills

Ansible (Software), Application Infrastructure, Automation, Automation Technology, Data Analytics, Engineering Practices, Infrastructure Automation, IT Infrastrcuture Project Management, Python (Programming Language), Solution Engineering, Strategic Collaborations, Technical Knowledge

Full job description
