Job.CustomJobTypeName: Nurse Case Manager, Medical & Managed Care (Workers Comp)
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Lake Oswego, OR
  • Experience: 3 to 5 years

About this job

Registered nurse managing medical and disability insurance claims for injured employees. Role involves clinical case management, coordinating care with medical professionals and employers, and facilitating return-to-work outcomes.

Good fit if you have 3-5 years of clinical nursing experience, an active RN license, and strong communication and negotiation skills.

Full job description


Description

If you're a registered nurse looking for a new opportunity to work in a fast-paced, professional environment where your talent contributes to our competitive edge, Liberty Mutual Insurance has the opportunity for you. Under general technical direction, responsible for medically managing assigned caseload and by applying clinical expertise ensure individuals receive appropriate healthcare in order to return to work and normal activity in a timely and cost-effective manner. Caseload may include catastrophic/complex medical/disability cases, lost time, and/or medical only claims. Also act as a clinical resource for field claim partners.

Candidates must have a stable and reliable high-speed internet connection capable of supporting business applications, virtual meetings, and voice communications with minimal disruptions. A satellite connection is not supported.

Candidates who reside within 50 miles of the Lake Oswego, OR, Las Vegas, Nevada or Chandler, AZ office locations will be expected to commute to the office in accordance with Liberty Mutual's hybrid work guidelines and business needs.

Responsibilities:

  • Follows Liberty Mutual's established standards and protocols to effectively manage assigned caseload of medical/disability cases and by applying clinical expertise assist to achieve optimal outcome and to facilitate claim resolution and disposition.
  • Effectively communicates with injured employees, medical professionals, field claims staff, attorneys, and others to obtain information, and to negotiate medical treatment and return to work plans using critical thinking skills, clinical expertise and other resources as needed to achieve an optimal case outcome.
  • Utilizes the Nursing Process (assessment, diagnosis, planning, intervention and evaluation) to facilitate medical management to attain maximum medical improvement and return-to-work (RTW) per state jurisdictional requirements.
  • Appropriately utilizes internal and external resources and referrals i.e., Utilization Review, Peer Review, Field Claims Specialists, Regional Medical Director Consults, and Vocational Rehabilitation to achieve best possible case outcome.
  • Follows general technical direction from nurse manager, senior medical and disability case manager and/or CCMU staff to resolve highly complex medical and/or RTW issues and/or successfully manage catastrophic injuries.
  • Documents all RN activities accurately, concisely and on a timely basis. This includes documenting the medical and disability case management strategies for claim resolution, based on clinical expertise. Adheres to confidentiality policy.
  • Appropriately applies clinical expertise to claims and delivers services in an efficient and effective manner.
  • Accurately and appropriately documents time tracking for work performed. Achieves annual time tracking goal.
  • Handles special projects as assigned.
Qualifications
  • Ability to analyze and make sound nursing judgments and to accurately document activities.
  • Strong communication skills in order to build relationships with injured employees, medical professionals, employers, field claims staff and others.
  • Good negotiation skills to effectively establish target return to work dates and coordinate medical care.
  • Knowledge of state, local and federal laws related to health care delivery preferred.
  • Personal computer knowledge and proficiency in general computer applications such as Internet Explorer and Microsoft Office (including Word, Excel and Outlook).
  • Degree from an accredited nursing school required (prefer Bachelor of Science in Nursing).
  • Minimum of 3 to 5 years of clinical nursing experience; prefer previous orthopedic, emergency room, critical care, home care or rehab care experience.
  • Previous medical case management experience a plus.
  • Must also have current unrestricted registered nurse (R.N.) license in the state where the position is based and other assigned states as required by law.

About this job

Technical Consultant providing loss prevention consulting services to small commercial customers in Los Angeles. Conducts on-site evaluations, develops service plans, and mentors less experienced consultants in a specialized technical area.

Good fit if you have a bachelor's degree, at least 5 years of loss prevention consulting experience, and can travel regularly.

Full job description


Description

Provides moderately complex consultative services to an assigned group of customers within a loss prevention specialty area or territory. Conducts on-site evaluations, evaluates data, and creates/implements service plans to control customer source of risk, losses and costs. Provides risk assessment services and information to track progress and demonstrate the value of doing business with Liberty Mutual. Serves as a trainer/mentor to less experienced consultants in their specialty area at the discretion of their manager. Enhances the Company`s leadership position in the safety field through developing key relationships.

  • Provides an array of expert consultative services to an assigned group of customers within a specialized technical area or territory. Experience in Farm & Ranch is preferred.
  • Conducts on-site evaluations, evaluates data, and creates/implements service plans to control customer's source of risk, loss and/or costs.
  • Provides expert technical support to other loss prevention employees by advising them about resources available, legislation and applicable regulations, technology, industry trends and effective methods to reduce risk, improve customer satisfaction and demonstrate the value of doing business with Liberty Mutual. Monitors and evaluates the technical quality of loss prevention services provided by less experienced consultants.
  • At the discretion of their manager, provides coaching, mentoring and training to enhance their development and effectiveness.
  • Collaborates with management in developing policies, procedures, service tools, technical resources, techniques and new products in order to support and enhance the delivery of loss prevention consulting services.
  • Participates in actively acquiring and retaining profitable business.
  • Identifies new business opportunities for LP services and may design and execute programs that improve results and increase the number and quality of services customers choose to buy.
  • Enhances Liberty Mutual` s leadership position in the safety field and increases brand awareness by developing a network of contacts.
Qualifications
  • Bachelors degree with coursework in math, engineering or related areas (or equivalent) and at least 5 years of directly related consulting experience in loss prevention or progressive safety/heath field.
  • Candidates are typically working towards (or obtained) an advanced degree and/or professional certification in one or more of the following areas: CSP, ARM, CRM, CPCU, CIH, or CPE.
  • Advanced knowledge, skills and experience in a specialized field, service planning and delivery, risk assessment, risk analysis, solutions management and progress measurement.
  • Fully effective interpersonal, writing and other communication skills required to develop and maintain relationships with customers, peers, and industry contacts.
  • Demonstrated ability to retrieve and enter information using various proprietary software applications and create/modify documents and complex spreadsheets using Microsoft Office suite.
  • Position requires regular travel.

Conducts on-site evaluations, evaluates data, and creates/implements service plans to control customer source of risk, losses and costs. Provides risk assessment services and information to track progress and demonstrate the value of doing business with Liberty Mutual. Serves as a trainer/mentor to less experienced consultants in their specialty area at the discretion of their manager. Enhances the Company`s leadership position in the safety field through developing key relationships.

  • Provides an array of expert consultative services to an assigned group of customers within a specialized technical area or territory. Experience in Farm & Ranch is preferred.
  • Conducts on-site evaluations, evaluates data, and creates/implements service plans to control customer's source of risk, loss and/or costs.
  • Provides expert technical support to other loss prevention employees by advising them about resources available, legislation and applicable regulations, technology, industry trends and effective methods to reduce risk, improve customer satisfaction and demonstrate the value of doing business with Liberty Mutual. Monitors and evaluates the technical quality of loss prevention services provided by less experienced consultants.
  • At the discretion of their manager, provides coaching, mentoring and training to enhance their development and effectiveness.
  • Collaborates with management in developing policies, procedures, service tools, technical resources, techniques and new products in order to support and enhance the delivery of loss prevention consulting services.
  • Participates in actively acquiring and retaining profitable business.
  • Identifies new business opportunities for LP services and may design and execute programs that improve results and increase the number and quality of services customers choose to buy.
  • Enhances Liberty Mutual` s leadership position in the safety field and increases brand awareness by developing a network of contacts.
Qualifications
  • Bachelors degree with coursework in math, engineering or related areas (or equivalent) and at least 5 years of directly related consulting experience in loss prevention or progressive safety/heath field.
  • Candidates are typically working towards (or obtained) an advanced degree and/or professional certification in one or more of the following areas: CSP, ARM, CRM, CPCU, CIH, or CPE.
  • Advanced knowledge, skills and experience in a specialized field, service planning and delivery, risk assessment, risk analysis, solutions management and progress measurement.
  • Fully effective interpersonal, writing and other communication skills required to develop and maintain relationships with customers, peers, and industry contacts.
  • Demonstrated ability to retrieve and enter information using various proprietary software applications and create/modify documents and complex spreadsheets using Microsoft Office suite.
  • Position requires regular travel.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Underwriting Manager, Liberty Mutual Mobility Solutions
Job.JobDescription:
Description

With ride-hailing, on-demand delivery, and autonomous vehicles, options for transporting people and goods have never been so plentiful or presented so many emerging risks. Drawing on Libertys vast commercial and personal lines expertise, Liberty Mutual Mobility Solutions (LMMS) represents an underwriting model that brings a full range of tailored solutions and nuanced pricing approaches to the sharing economy and new mobility marketplace. This dedicated practice combines creative commercial underwriting with actuarial, product development, client, and claims teams to deliver a robust insurance experience. Join our expanding underwriting team to foster change and innovation and partner with brokers and sharing economy and new mobility businesses to help this segment grow and thrive.

As an LMMS Underwriting Manager, you will manage a team of underwriting professionals responsible for renewing and pursuing opportunities to achieve a balanced, profitable, and quality book while protecting company assets. In some cases, the accounts worked may be among the largest risk transfer opportunities or renewals in the company, with complex risk sharing structures and evolving coverage language.Responsibilities include risk assessment, coverage and pricing analysis, broker/partner communication and management, and industry thought leadership. This role requires strong analytical, communication, and negotiation skills in order to thrive in a dynamic and collaborative environment. You will develop and maintain effective business relationships with internal and external partners. You will apply an advanced level of expertise and judgment to evaluate scenarios, data, and recommendations prepared by underwriters, actuaries, and or cross-functional partners and provide guidance for risk selection and acceptance, coverage, and price for casualty business in select sharing economy and new mobility sectors.

Responsibilities:

  • Leadership: Responsible for the retention, acquisition, and development of senior level underwriting talent. Formally manage, guide, mentor, and coach underwriters in both technical and professional skills. Foster an environment conducive to innovation, continuous improvement and product development.
  • Risk Selection: Responsible for developing and implementing a strategy to better evaluate risk quality and further underwriters skillset in qualifying, selecting and assessing sharing economy and new mobility risks. In addition to managing staff, may also be responsible for underwriting complex accounts.
  • Agent/Broker Relationships: Establish and maintain high level of relationship management with key Agents and Brokers. Develop underwriters technical, negotiation, communication and general deal making skills.
  • Portfolio Management: Evaluate portfolio performance based on profitability metrics, evolving risk scenarios, outcome and volatility ranges, reinsurance, opportunity metrics, and industry trends. Define UW team execution strategy and oversee execution of continuously improving portfolio in alignment with team objectives. Be the lead custodial of capital for your team.
  • Quality Audit and Account Review: Collaborates with the LMMS SUO and the OOU to ensure files meet regulatory requirements and internal documentation standards. Coach underwriters to articulate thought process, decision making within both account reviews and file documentation.
Qualifications
  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 10 years progressive underwriting experience expected, including a minimum of 2 years of proven underwriting management experience, preferred
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate high impact underwriting risks within scope of responsibility
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex analyses and information
  • Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills in dealing with internal and external partners required
  • Must possess the following skills, abilities and attributes: strong leadership skills, development of people, strategic thinking, sustained effective portfolio management and profitable growth, communications skills, decision-making skills, results-oriented, industrious, innovative, problem-solving skills, coaching and mentoring skills, and negotiating skills
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Description

The North America (NA) Chief Reserving Actuary will lead the North America Reserving function. Position involves being responsible for the team performing thorough reserve analysis, maintaining reasonable and adequate reserves for this $20 Billion reserve base, clearly and transparently communicating results of reserve studies to key stakeholders, identifying elements of the reserve analysis that is particularly relevant to future business decisions by the NA business unit, effectively managing and leading a large team, and building strong relationships with business leaders and other key leaders throughout the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Provide an independent assessment of the NA reserves and associated reserve risks, ensuring the adequacy and accuracy of the NA reserves.
  • Ensure use of accurate, sound, and innovative approaches in projecting and setting reserving guidelines that are consistent with those of Global Risk Solutions (GRS).
  • Communicate the quarterly reserve analyses to the NA leadership.
  • Lead and develop a NA reserving capability that is technical and commercial-minded.
  • Be an inclusive leader committed to mentoring and developing team members to assume progressively senior actuarial and business leadership roles.
  • Provide proactive insights that are sought out by the business leaders.
  • Identify key trends, areas of uncertainty to monitor, and macroeconomic factors that are impacting the business.
  • Work in close collaboration with underwriting, pricing, claims and finance to develop a common view of the business.
  • Work in partnership with the various stakeholders to identify emerging trends that could impact results and propose corrective action in a timely manner.
  • Apply innovative approaches and leading-edge tools to analyze the business.
  • Ensure the quality of the data and its consistent application in the reserving process.
  • Foster a culture of technical rigor, transparency, and consistency.
  • Execute a governance framework that ensures that reserving guidelines are consistently applied and all processes comply with internal operational control requirements and all external regulatory and audit requirements.
  • Collaborate with the broader actuarial organization and other strategic business units to share knowledge and advance the business.
  • Seek opportunities to continuously improve and streamline processes.
  • Keep abreast of new reserving methodologies, trends and product/ tort reforms and other external issues.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree required
  • Insurance designations desirable
  • Fellowship in the Casualty Actuarial Society (FCAS) designation required, or comparable actuarial education/designation combined with relevant experience
  • Demonstrated expertise in financial management of a P&C business
  • Ability to participate effectively on the senior management team
  • Strong analytical skills with solid understanding of all casualty actuarial techniques, standards, and assumptions
  • Expert knowledge of insurance operations and P&C insurance business
  • Excellent management and communication skills
  • Strategic thinking and ability to set direction for team
  • Demonstrated ability to exchange ideas and convey complex information clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing
  • Demonstrated ability to anticipate areas of senior management concern, integrate different perspectives, and respond accordingly
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills required to establish and build effective relationships within and outside the organization
  • Ability to give effective training and presentations to senior management and other groups
  • Demonstrated ability to organize, lead, and get work done through others
  • Ability to develop staff and managers to support succession planning and address on-going talent needs
  • Ability to build and manage talent across the enterprise in conjunction with peers

Job.JobDescription:
Description

Join us as a Field Property Claims Adjuster where youll be responsible for helping our customers navigate the claims process and get back on their feet following damage to the homeowners property. This is a role where people who love every day to be new, different and exciting, can thrive youll be traveling on the road to meet customers in person, providing hands-on assessment of damage and empathetic support.

The Field Property Claims Adjuster will be traveling locally to insured homes within St. Michael, MN (55376) and surrounding areas. To be successful within the role, candidates should live within or near this area.

Sign-On Bonus Available! Were offering a sign-on bonus for experienced and actively licensed new hires.

What youll do

  • Investigate and evaluate onsite to resolve complex coverage and damage issues to include preparing complete estimates of repair for the covered damages. This may include accessing roofs by ladder, inspecting attics, crawl spaces and basements in search of damage.
  • Handle moderate to complex claims independently while managing your workload, from first notice of loss to final closure.
  • Be expected to work in a vehicle in the field daily while occasionally handling assignments from the desk.
  • Explain coverage of loss, assist policyholders with itemization of damages, emergency repairs and additional living arrangements.
  • Work with and coordinate a few vendor services such as contractors, emergency repair, cleaning services and various replacement services.
  • May be called upon for catastrophe duty.

Position details

  • Territory-based work:Most workdays will be spent in the field within your assigned local territory, giving you the opportunity to work directly with customers and gain hands-on experience.

  • Training & support:To set you up for success, youll participate in a comprehensive 5-month training program, which includes:
    • Primarily virtual and on-the-job learning.
    • Two short in-person training sessions (Weeks 4 and 7) at our Lewisville, TX office.
    • Limited overnight travel for training and team meetings (typically less than 10%).

  • Mileage Reimbursement:This role offers mileage reimbursement. You may qualify for a company-provided vehicle once mileage requirements are met. Additional details will be provided if you advance in the selection process.
Qualifications
  • Working knowledge of claims handling procedures and operations.
  • Proven ability to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Effective negotiation skills.
  • Ability to effectively and independently manage workload while exhibiting good judgment.
  • Strong written/oral communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Computer skills with the ability to work with multi-faceted systems.
  • The capabilities, skills and knowledge required through a bachelors degree or equivalent experience and at least 1 year of directly related experience.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.
  • The ability to handle multiple competing priorities and organize your day.
  • Strong time management and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated understanding of building construction principles.

About this job

Underwriter for Builder's Risk insurance at AXIS Capital, focused on underwriting new and renewal business, developing broker relationships, and supporting portfolio growth. Based in Midwest or West Coast offices with hybrid work arrangement.

Good fit if you have 3-5 years of Builder's Risk, Property, or Commercial Insurance underwriting experience and can manage commercial property analysis independently.

Full job description

This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

Underwriter – Builder's Risk

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

AXIS' U.S. Construction team is seeking an underwriter with a focus on Builder's Risk (Project and Master). This role will support the growth and profitability of our Builder's Risk portfolio by underwriting new and renewal business, building broker and customer relationships, and developing technical expertise and supporting business development within the Construction team. This position can be based out of any of our Midwest or West Coast offices.

What will you do in this role?

  • Continue developing Builder's Risk expertise while building strong relationships with brokers and customers and contributing to underwriting, retention, and growth objectives across the portfolio.
  • Analyze and qualify opportunities based upon the organization's appetite and be able to effectively communicate such.
  • Underwrite within the underwriting governance framework.
  • Evaluate, underwrite, and negotiate new and renewal business within delegated authority and underwriting guidelines while exercising sound underwriting judgment.
  • Develop and/or maintain relationships with our broker partners in support of desired business retention as well as work with our customers and brokers to identify their insurance needs and provide recommendations and possible solutions to achieve it where possible.
  • Support business development efforts through broker interactions and the identification of growth opportunities within assigned accounts and territories.
  • Manage assigned underwriting responsibilities and contribute to portfolio performance objectives in support of organizational goals.
  • Participate in industry functions and professional events to continue building market knowledge and representing AXIS professionally.
  • Participate in and help facilitate broker and customer meetings to strengthen relationships, identify opportunities, and support retention and growth objectives
  • Work collaboratively with colleagues across the organization to ensure our customer's needs are met.

About You:

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.

What you need to have:

  • 3 - 5 years of Builder's Risk, Property, or Commercial Insurance underwriting experience.
  • Curiosity and desire to learn
  • Experience analyzing and underwriting a range of commercial property or Builder's Risk exposures.
  • Solid understanding of Builder's Risk coverage, exposure analysis, pricing principles, and marketplace dynamics.
  • Able to analyze standard and moderately complex risks and communicate underwriting concepts or positions to audiences of varying experience.
  • Able to independently manage routine underwriting responsibilities while collaborating effectively in a team setting.
  • Capable of handling time constraints for quoting new and renewal business.

What we prefer you to have:

  • Understanding of both admitted (retail) and non-admitted / Excess & Surplus (wholesale) underwriting framework.
  • Experience collaborating with brokers and supporting relationship development within an assigned market or territory.
  • Creative problem-solving skills.
  • Reasonably proficient with Microsoft Office applications.

Role Factors:

In this role, you will typically be required to:

  • This will be a hybrid role with an expectation of being in an AXIS office 3 days per week (as applicable)
  • Travel roughly 25%
  • Participate on weekly team calls / meetings when operating in hybrid environments

What we offer:

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $130,000 - $165,000K. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more. 

Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is Exempt for FLSA purposes.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: New York, NY
  • Benefits: Paid time off, tuition assistance

Job Description: Head of Finance Transformation

Reporting To: Chief Financial Officer

About the Team

The Finance function at AXIS plays a central role in enabling enterprise strategy, capital stewardship, regulatory integrity, and performance insight. As AXIS continues to evolve, Finance is undertaking significant transformation to modernize its operating model, strengthen scalability and controls, and enhance its strategic contribution to the business.


This role sits within the CFO organization and operates as a senior Finance transformation leader, working alongside the CFO and Finance Leadership Team to modernize Finance processes, capabilities, systems and ways of working across a multi-year horizon.


How does this role contribute to our collective success?

The Head of Finance Transformation is accountable for shaping and delivering the Finance transformation strategy and roadmap in line with Finance priorities and AXIS business objectives. Acting as the CFO's senior adviser on Finance transformation, the role ensures Finance has the operating model, capabilities, technology and ways of working needed to support AXIS's strategic objectives over a multi-year horizon.


The role exists to improve Finance's scalability, decision support, control maturity and adoption of modernized ways of working, helping Finance operate as a more integrated and insight-driven partner to the business.


Scope

Transformation is delivered through functional leadership, not around it. The role develops and recommends Finance transformation standards, target-state designs, and prioritization approaches, while execution accountability remains with Finance functional leaders.


The role partners across Finance (e.g., FP&A, Controllership, Finance Operations, Treasury, Investor Relations, Tax, and other Finance teams) and with enterprise partners (BTS, Data, Operations, Underwriting, Actuarial, Risk, and others) to drive integrated solutions and consistent adoption of the future state.
The role owns the Finance transformation strategy, roadmap, governance and benefits framework. The Chief of Staff integrates transformation progress, dependencies and decisions into the broader CFO agenda and executive operating cadence.


What will you do in this role?

  • Define and maintain the Finance Transformation strategy, roadmap, and target operating model aligned to Finance priorities and approved investment plans.
  • Serve as the senior Finance transformation adviser to the CFO, providing recommendations on transformation investment, capability development, modernization priorities and key decisions requiring CFO or Finance Leadership Team direction.
  • Shape and coordinate the Finance technology, data and analytics roadmap in partnership with BTS, Data and Risk, embedding advanced analytics and AI-enabled capabilities into Finance workflows such as forecasting, variance analysis, controls monitoring and management reporting.
  • Establish and lead governance for the Finance transformation portfolio, including recommendations on investment trade-offs, sequencing, prioritization and resource allocation to ensure initiatives are value-driven, risk-managed and controlled.
  • Build alignment across the Finance Leadership Team and key stakeholders on the Finance target operating model, transformation roadmap, design standards and adoption of future-state processes and ways of working, reinforcing accountability and addressing resistance as needed.
  • Provide oversight of major Finance transformation programs, ensuring delivery aligns to strategic intent, regulatory requirements, and enterprise risk appetite—while monitoring benefits and outcomes (efficiency, effectiveness, control strength, analytic maturity, and business value).
  • Partner with the CFO and Finance Leadership Team to evaluate Finance operating structures, resource deployment, and capability requirements needed to support future business priorities.
  • Contribute to the development and enhancement of Finance policies, operating standards, governance frameworks, and transformation practices that improve effectiveness, scalability, and organizational performance.
  • Represent Finance transformation in senior leadership forums, contributing to broader enterprise strategy and change discussions.

Outcomes and how success is measured

  • Measurable reductions in Finance cost-to-serve and improvements in cycle times (e.g., close, forecast, management reporting).
  • Finance transformation roadmap delivered against agreed milestones, with clear governance, active risk management, documented decisions, and tracked benefits realization.
  • Sustained improvement in control effectiveness, audit outcomes, and quality of regulatory engagement.
  • Improved quality, timeliness, and actionability of management and board reporting; materially better analytics supporting decision-making.
  • Increased adoption of standardized tools, processes, and data across Finance; reduced fragmentation and manual effort.
  • Clear evidence of Finance operating as a strategic business partner to underwriting, investments, and operations, with documented decision support impact.

Authority

To accelerate delivery and avoid transformation drift, the role is empowered—through the CFO and Finance Leadership Team—to:

  • Recommend transformation standards, target-state design principles and governance requirements for CFO and Finance Leadership Team approval.
  • Recommend prioritization, sequencing, acceleration, pausing, or redirection of initiatives to ensure focus on the highest-value outcomes.
  • Establish the governance, reporting and review cadence specifically required to oversee Finance transformation delivery, adoption and benefits realization.
  • Convene and chair cross-functional decision forums as needed to remove barriers and drive resolution.

About You – What we're looking for

  • In-depth expertise in Finance transformation, including operating model design, technology enablement, analytics modernization, governance, and strategic execution.
  • Proven ability to advise executive and senior Finance leaders, influencing decisions with long-term and enterprise implications.
  • Extensive experience leading large-scale, complex transformation initiatives in highly regulated, global environments.
  • Strong enterprise judgement, balancing strategic ambition with governance, risk, and control considerations.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through other leaders—aligning and influencing senior stakeholders without relying on direct execution ownership.
  • Strong strategic, systems, and data perspective—integrating Finance, technology, data, and operational considerations.

This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. How does this role contribute to our collective success?
AI solutions are becoming increasingly important to AXIS' ability to drive efficiency, improve decision making, and enhance customer and employee experiences. As AI capabilities mature and move into production, maintaining their effectiveness, reliability, fairness, and business value becomes critical.

The AI Solutions Support Lead is responsible for the ongoing support, maintenance, monitoring, and enhancement of AI solutions that have been deployed into production. Once an AI solution has been delivered and transitioned from the Data Science & AI Delivery team, ownership of day-to-day operational support and continuous improvement will transfer to this role.

Leading a team of AI engineers provided through our strategic delivery partners, the AI Solutions Support Lead will ensure production AI solutions remain stable, performant, compliant, and aligned to evolving business needs. This role acts as the central coordination point between AI engineering, Data Science & AI Delivery, Data Engineering, BTS, business stakeholders, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions continue to deliver measurable value throughout their lifecycle.

The role combines technical leadership, operational excellence, stakeholder management, and people leadership, requiring an individual who is equally comfortable discussing model performance, coordinating incident response activities, managing enhancement roadmaps, and engaging senior business stakeholders.


What will you do in this role?

Own Production AI Solutions

  • Assume operational ownership of AI solutions following successful deployment and handover from delivery teams.

  • Establish and maintain support processes, documentation, runbooks, monitoring dashboards, escalation paths, defect management and operational procedures. once a solution has met agreed production acceptance criteria, including runbooks(those will need to be created and handed over to support team), monitoring dashboards, support ownership, escalation paths, defect management, and release evidence

  • Ensure clear ownership, accountability, and service management practices are in place for all production AI solutions.

  • Maintain an accurate inventory of supported solutions, dependencies, business owners, and support requirements.


Lead AI Support & Incident Management

  • Coordinate investigation and resolution of production issues affecting AI solutions.

  • Manage defect remediation activities and oversee the delivery of code fixes through internal and partner engineering teams.

  • Act as the primary point of coordination during major incidents impacting AI services.

  • Ensure issues are identified, triaged, prioritised, communicated, and resolved effectively.

  • Support post-incident reviews and implementation of preventative actions.


Monitor Solution Performance & Effectiveness

  • Own monitoring frameworks to assess solution performance, reliability, usage, accuracy, cost, and value realization.

  • Monitor AI outputs for signs of performance degradation, model drift, bias, fairness concerns, or changing business effectiveness.

  • Ensure solutions continue to meet business objectives, operational requirements, and governance standards.

  • Identify optimisation opportunities and drive continuous improvement activities.


Drive Continuous Improvement & Enhancements

  • Own and manage enhancement backlogs for production AI solutions.

  • Coordinate development and deployment of approved enhancements.

  • Ensure solutions evolve in line with changing business processes, regulatory expectations, and technology capabilities.

  • Support release planning and production deployments.


Collaborate Across Technology & Data Teams

  • Work closely with the broader Data Science & AI Delivery team to ensure effective transition of solutions into support.

  • Partner with Data Engineering teams to maintain data pipelines, integrations, and platform dependencies.

  • Collaborate with BTS teams to align with enterprise support processes, infrastructure standards, change management, and operational controls.

  • Coordinate activities across internal and external delivery teams to ensure service excellence.


Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Ensure AI solutions operate in accordance with AXIS AI governance policies and standards.

  • Support periodic reviews of AI solutions to confirm continued appropriateness, effectiveness, transparency, and risk management.

  • Maintain appropriate operational documentation, support evidence, and audit artefacts.

  • Contribute to governance forums, operational reviews, and risk assessments where required.


What success looks like

  • Success in this role will be measured through:

  • High availability and reliability of production AI solutions.

  • Timely resolution of incidents and defects.

  • Strong stakeholder satisfaction with AI services and support.

  • Evidence that AI solutions continue to deliver expected business outcomes.

  • Effective monitoring and management of performance, fairness, bias, drift, and operational risk.

  • Delivery of enhancements and continuous improvements aligned to business priorities.

  • Smooth transition of solutions from delivery into operational support.

  • Well-managed support teams and partner resources.



About You
You are an organised, technically strong leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of technology, operations, and business value. You have experience supporting complex production systems and can confidently coordinate multidisciplinary teams to resolve issues and drive continuous improvement.

You combine strong technical understanding with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling you to translate business priorities into practical operational outcomes.

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Significant experience supporting, operating, or maintaining production AI, machine learning, analytics, or data-driven solutions.

  • Strong understanding of AI solution lifecycles, including deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancement.

  • Experience leading technical teams and coordinating third-party delivery partners.

  • Strong incident management and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Experience managing application support, service management, or operational delivery functions.

  • Strong understanding of data platforms, APIs, cloud environments, and software delivery practices.

  • Ability to prioritise effectively and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

  • Strong organisational and leadership capabilities.


Desirable

  • Experience with Azure AI, Databricks, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, Foundry, or similar AI technologies.

  • Understanding of Responsible AI principles, model monitoring, bias management, and AI governance requirements.

  • Experience within insurance, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.

  • Familiarity with ITIL, Service Management, or Site Reliability Engineering practices.



Working Arrangements

This role forms part of the operational backbone of AXIS' AI capability.

Given the critical nature of production support responsibilities, occasional out-of-hours work, including evenings and weekends, may be required to support incident resolution, production deployments, testing activities, or other business-critical operational events.

Role Factors:
In this role, you will typically be required to:

Attend your local office at least three (3) days per week to meet and build relationships with colleagues and the wider business.

Engage in company activities to grow your network and build a strong team culture.

If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.

What is a Must Have?

About this job

Account Representative for Alliant Insurance's Small Business Unit in Broken Arrow, providing customer service and support for existing accounts and new business. Responsibilities include packaging applications, managing renewals, binding coverage, and handling client accounting inquiries.

Good fit if you have an Associate's Degree or equivalent, two or more years of related experience, a valid Insurance License, and proficiency in Microsoft Office

Full job description

Alliant Insurance Services is one of the nation's largest and fastest-growing insurance brokerage and consulting firms. We operate through a network of specialized national platforms and local offices to offer our clients a comprehensive portfolio of solutions built on innovative thinking and personal service. Alliant is changing the way our clients approach risk management and benefits, so they can capitalize on new opportunities to grow and protect their organizations.

More information is available on the company's website at: >.

Hybrid work schedule: In-office requirement.


SUMMARY


Responsible for providing customer service and support in the Small Business Unit to assist Producers and service team in supporting existing accounts and soliciting new business. This position may include independent responsibility for the servicing and retention of assigned customers and/or policies.



ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Packages and markets applications to various carriers to obtain quotes;


May negotiate prices, commissions, and/or coverages with carriers for the Small Business Unit;


Reviews policies, identifies deficiencies and determines appropriate level of coverage for the Small Business Unit;


Manages renewal process for expiring policies;


Reviews client accounting history, responds to accounting inquiries, and corrects account discrepancies including assisting in collections on past due accounts;


Binds insurance coverage and prepares insurance binders;


Assists with the preparation of presentations and/or proposals for clients;


Gathers information for applications;


Researches requests for information from underwriters for the Small Business Unit;


Composes correspondence to insured and/or underwriters for the Small Business Unit;


Inputs applications and creates letters, and other forms of correspondence;


Prepares draft certificate templates for review and approval;


Analyzes certificate requests and ensures clients needs are met;


Complies with agency management system data standards and data integrity (enters and maintains complete and accurate information);


Performs all duties in accordance with all company policies and procedures, and all federal, state and local laws, wherein the Company operates.


Performs other duties as assigned.



QUALIFICATIONS
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE


Associate's Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience


Two (2) or more years related work experience


Valid Insurance License and completion of one insurance class


Must continue to meet Continuing Education requirements for license renewal



SKILLS


Excellent verbal and written communication skills


Excellent customer service skills, including telephone and listening skills


Good problem solving and time management skills


Intermediate typing skills (30-35 wpm)


Ability to work within a team and to foster teamwork


Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

This role is based at our Irving, TX location with a schedule of Friday - Sunday, 6:00 AM- 6:30 PM.

Company Overview

A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world's leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.

AI and Biometric Usage
Assurant supports the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), but we want to know the real you. Visit our AI Usage Guidelines page to understand what we expect from applicants regarding their use of AI during the application process. Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Erie, PA
  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • Physical: Lifting up to 20 lbs

About this job

Conduct actuarial studies for auto, property and commercial insurance lines under the guidance of experienced staff. Present findings and proposals to management while learning data science techniques, tools, and actuarial analyst functions.

Good fit if you have completed sophomore year in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or related field with a 3.0 GPA minimum

Full job description

At Erie Insurance, we believe in professional and personal development. With our Future Focus Internship Program, both are provided in abundance. Not only do we offer the opportunity to gain professional experience in a challenging and competitive setting, but we welcome you as part of the ERIE family. We ensure that our interns receive the best internship experience possible, which includes multiple educational, developmental, professional, social and networking opportunities. The esteem ERIE holds in its Future Focus Internship Program is evident at every level of the organization, defined even further by multiple opportunities for socializing with high level leaders, up to and including our President and CEO. Are you ready for the internship experience of a lifetime? Look no further.

2027 Future Focus Internship Program Start Dates: Monday, May 17th or Monday, May 24th, 2027

2027 Future Focus Internship Program End Date: Friday, August 6th, 2027

Position Summary

Working with experienced departmental staff conducts actuarial studies for auto, property and commercial lines of business. Presents findings and proposals to management. Supports the work of actuarial analysts while learning the actuarial analyst job function.

As a Data Science intern, you will focus on the following duties and responsibilites:

  • Works with experienced departmental staff to learn data science techniques, data sources, tools, and business applications to conduct analysis.
  • Assists in conducting detailed analysis to identify insights and opportunities to improve business performance and decision-making.
  • Assists with researching emerging trends, tools, and techniques relevant to data science and the insurance industry.
  • Communicates findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Works with experienced departmental staff to learn actuarial techniques, data sources, and spreadsheets to conduct reviews of rating factors.
  • Assists in conducting detailed analysis of The ERIE's insurance programs, profitability, rating factors, reserve studies, dynamic financial analysis, and experience exhibits. Typical projects have included: deductible studies, trend and forecasts of average paid losses and frequencies, effect of large losses on rate indications, and competitive analysis.
  • Creates exhibits, reports, and charts for actuarial and reserve studies, state insurance department filings, and rate recommendations. Determines appropriate presentation format.
  • Develops a basic knowledge of ratemaking procedures used by The ERIE, competitors, and rate bureaus. Writes programs in SAS and Visual Basic to extract data to spreadsheet format. Reviews data for reasonableness and accuracy.
  • Gathers ERIE and Industry information in response to requests. Presents rate, reserve and other analysis to management and communicates analysis impacts to other departments as required.


The first three duties listed are the functions identified as essential to the job. Essential functions are those job duties that must be performed in order for the job to be accomplished.

Regular and predictable attendance is an essential job function. For certain positions at ERIE, including leadership roles, regular and predictable onsite presence may also be an essential job function based on business and operational needs.


This position description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the incumbent. Employees are required to follow any other job-related instruction and to perform any other duties as requested by their supervisor, or as become evident.

Capabilities

  • Values Diversity
  • Nimble Learning
  • Self-Development
  • Collaborates
  • Information Management Skills
  • Customer Focus
  • Cultivates Innovation
  • Job-Specific Knowledge
  • Instills Trust
  • Optimizes Work Processes (IC)
  • Decision Quality
  • Ensures Accountability

Qualifications

Minimum Educational Requirements

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Pursuit of bachelor's degree with completion of sophomore year majoring in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics or related field required.


Additional Experience

  • Minimum 3.0 GPA required.
  • Candidates in their final year of undergraduate study, or pursuing graduate studies are also eligible.
  • Proficiency in probability and statistics as demonstrated by passing the first actuarial exam preferred.
  • Basic knowledge of word processing, spreadsheet, presentation and data base software preferred

Physical Requirements

  • Lifting/Moving 0-20 lbs; Occasional (<20%)
  • Lifting/Moving 20-50 lbs; Rarely
  • Ability to move over 50 lbs using lifting aide equipment; Rarely
  • Driving; Rarely
  • Pushing/Pulling/moving objects, equipment with wheels; Occasional (<20%)
  • Manual Keying/Data Entry/inputting information/computer use; Often (20-50%)
  • Climbing/accessing heights; Rarely

Who We Are

For over 70 years, Glatfelter Insurance Group has believed in doing the right thing for our clients, agents, communities and associates. Glatfelter provides their insureds with comprehensive insurance solutions including property, casualty, life insurance, and more. In 2018, Glatfelter joined American International Group (AIG) and is now part of the AIG family.

About the Position

The Glatfelter Agency (TGA), a division of Glatfelter Insurance Group, is seeking an experienced Commercial Lines Account Manager to join our growing team. This individual will be assigned a book of business to maintain and service.


This position is required to be onsite at our Leader Heights, York, PA office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and service an existing book of business with professionalism.
  • Ability to convey complex insurance information in a clear and understandable manner.
  • Serve as primary point of contact for Commercial client inquiries and requests.
  • Collaborate with Account Executive, where appropriate, on account activity.
  • Coordinate renewal quotes with incumbent carrier and alternative carriers if marketing, reconciling quotes to requested specifications.
  • Utilize carrier websites to quote, rate, bind, and various other functions.
  • Compiling materials for client renewal presentations, including preparation of the agency proposal document.
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation within agency management system (Epic).
  • Review all carrier issued documents for accuracy.
  • Issue Certificates of Insurance & Prepare Auto ID Cards.
  • Process mid-year client change requests.
  • Ensure compliance with company procedures and workflows.

What We're Looking For

  • College degree or equivalent combination of education and work experience sufficient to perform the essential duties of the job required.
  • Commercial Lines retail insurance agency experience required.
  • Licensed Pennsylvania Property/Casualty Agent.
  • Strong Microsoft Word Skills.
  • CISR Designation preferred.
  • Applied Epic experience preferred.
  • Must be able to communicate effectively both orally and in writing with internal and external customers including but not limited to underwriters, clients, marketing representative, and service team members.
  • Must be capable of working independently under team concept with general supervision.
  • Should possess the ability to plan & prioritize, be detail oriented and able to handle multiple tasks.
  • Must possess problem solving capabilities.
  • Must possess strong customer service skills.
  • Should have the ability to adapt to changing and improving technologies, and able to function within various on-line company rating sites.

Why Choose Glatfelter?

Glatfelter is honored to have been named a Best Place to Work in PA since 2005. We are proud to offer a range of employee benefits and resources that help you protect what matters most - your health care, savings, financial protection and wellbeing. In addition to 17 paid holidays, (which includes a personal holiday and mental health and wellness day) we provide a variety of leaves for personal, health, family, and volunteer needs.

We believe in fostering our associates' development and offer a range of learning opportunities for associates to hone their professional skills to position themselves for the next steps of their careers. This position is required to be onsite at our Leader Heights, York, PA office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactive handling of assigned claims in compliance with applicable state regulatory requirements, departmental standards, and designated financial authority.
  • Upholding the highest standards of customer satisfaction and service to insureds, agents, regional directors, and other interested parties while fulfilling obligations to protect our insured's interests and the company's assets.
  • Communicating investigation and handling status and final determinations to insureds and claimants in compliance with regulatory requirements and departmental standards. This includes verbal communications, written correspondence, internal reports, and issuance of formal denial, disclaimer, and reservation of rights letters.
  • Representing GIG through continuous countrywide contact with insureds, claimants, brokers, insurance carriers, and vendors. May include field work, trial attendance, mediation, or other travel.
  • Maintaining claim file integrity to document activity, preserve evidence in an organized fashion, capture accurate claims data, and provide an appropriate basis for all claims handling decisions.
  • All specialized tasks and duties necessary for the prompt and efficient handling of assigned claims within the handler's designated specialty/line(s) of business. May include litigation management, subject matter expertise development or other advanced technical training or industry education.
  • All other duties as assigned. May include training, mentoring or other staff development or supervisory support functions.

What We're Looking For

  • Secondary school diploma or equivalent, college degree, and Associate in Claims designation preferred.
  • Three to six (3-6) years of experience in first-party property insurance claims or appropriate transferable experience in a related field required.

Technical Qualifications:

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Efficient time management skills.
  • Proficient knowledge of insurance policy forms, pertinent coverages, and claims handling processes and procedures.
  • Proficient understanding of technical subject matter appropriate to assigned specialty/line(s) of business.
  • Must be proficient with the use of computer applications (standard Microsoft products), keyboard/typing, and telecommunication tools and technology.
  • Quality focus and attention to detail.
  • Ability to perform calculations, prepare reports, and maintain files.
  • Effective interpersonal skills and ability to work as part of a team.

Upon employment the Associate is required to:

  • Develop a working knowledge and understanding of GCM processes and procedures as well as GIG culture, products, and services within an appropriate period of time.
  • Develop functional proficiency in the use of GIG/GCM computer systems and applications.
  • Complete required training as assigned to enhance knowledge, expand technical understanding, and develop skills.
  • Obtain required adjuster licenses within an aggressive timeframe and maintain licensure renewals by obtaining required continuing education credits.
  • Demonstrate ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and complete tasks timely/accurately.

Administration:

About this job

Account Manager Lead role at Alliant Insurance supporting producers on large market accounts in the Specialty division. Responsibilities include client relationship management, new business development, policy analysis, renewal coordination, and staff mentoring.

Full job description

Alliant Insurance Services is one of the nation's largest and fastest-growing insurance brokerage and consulting firms. We operate through a network of specialized national platforms and local offices to offer our clients a comprehensive portfolio of solutions built on innovative thinking and personal service. Alliant is changing the way our clients approach risk management and benefits, so they can capitalize on new opportunities to grow and protect their organizations.

More information is available on the company's website at: >.


SUMMARY

Responsible for providing customer service and overall service of assigned customers and/or policies on large market accounts. Supports Producer in soliciting of new business and other Producer-led new business efforts. Provides mentoring to staff to support immediate supervisor.

Valid insurance license

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Ability to work within a team and to foster teamwork

Excellent customer service skills, including telephone and listening skills

Good leadership, problem solving and time management skills

Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

Job.JobDescription:
The Administrative Assistant Supervisor provides high-level administrative support to site and senior leadership while overseeing day-to-day administrative operations. This role serves as a key business partner, ensuring seamless coordination of schedules, communications, reporting, office operations, and employee engagement activities. As the primary point of contact for administrative and office-related matters, this individual drives organization, efficiency, and professionalism across the site while supporting business priorities and fostering a positive workplace experience.

This is an onsite role in our Mt Juliet TN facility.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Lead and oversee administrative support activities, including workload prioritization, task delegation, process coordination, and quality assurance
  • Manage complex calendars, meetings, and events for site and senior leadership, including scheduling, logistics, travel arrangements, visitor coordination, technology needs, and follow-up actions

  • Coordinate office supplies, workspace organization, and interactions with internal departments and external vendors
  • Support cross-functional communication and collaboration with employees, leadership, and business partners
  • Maintain confidentiality while managing sensitive information, special projects, and other administrative initiatives

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Strong calendar management, meeting coordination, and organizational skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact professionally across all levels of the organization
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt to changing business needs, and exercise sound judgment in a fast-paced environment

Are you looking to make an impactful difference in your work, yourself, and your community? Why settle for just a job when you can land a career? At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible.


Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here!


PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of this job is to serve as a litigation representative to attend hearings, depositions, and resolve disputes as it applies to aspects of workers' compensation claims. This position exists to reduce allocated loss adjustment expenses and improve results by proactively analyzing and resolving workers' compensation claims.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Manages litigation and claim disputes as they apply to workers' compensation claims.

  • Attends claim hearings representing ICW Group.

  • Appears at WCAB lien conferences and trials; may need to appear at status, priority, and mandatory settlement conferences on occasion.

  • Schedules and attends settlement walk-through hearings with claimants and/or counsel.

  • Reduces loss adjustment expenses by quickly and effectively resolving disputed claims and litigation, including liens.

  • Resolves claims fairly and equitably, acting in the best interest of the insured.

Prepares documentation necessary for assigned cases.

  • Prepares court pleadings, reports, and settlement documents in accordance with statutory and case law as well as pertinent regulations.

  • Prepares for and attends depositions; maintains notes and correspondence.

  • Prepares and submits timely Hearing Reports to claims personnel and claims management.

  • Reviews and analyzes the billed invoices and liens and compares with professional bill review analysis.

Provides subject matter expertise in the litigation aspect of workers' compensation claims.

  • Applies appropriate legal defenses and negotiates resolution or set for trial.

  • Provides guidance and expertise to other department's operations, including Underwriting and Risk Management Services.

  • Partners with Claims Examiner to determine solutions.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university in Business Administration, Management or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Minimum 2-5 years of experience in workers' compensation required, with claims examiner experience preferred.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

None required.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Working knowledge of claims and insurance industry preferred. Familiarity with and ability to effectively utilize the CA Labor Code, CA Code of Regulations, and CA Schedule for Rating Permanent Disabilities to rate disability impairment. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical journals, financial reports, and/or legal documents. Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from counsel, claimants, customers, regulatory agencies, and/or members of the business community. Ability to effectively present information to top management, public groups, and/or boards of directors. Strong ability to negotiate to resolution various legal issues before the WCAB with opposing counsel, proper claimants, and co-defendants. Strong oral skills to articulate company's position in contested legal matters to opposing side, Information Officers, and WCAB judges.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This position requires some travel – up to 20 hours per week. Works with computers and computer screens for multiple hours per day; must be able to lift and carry 25-40 pounds. Position is sedentary approximately 80% of time. Must be able to drive and be comfortable working independently.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position is a hybrid field/office position. Field environment includes appearing at various WCAB district offices, driving to and from appointments/appearances, meeting with attorneys/judges, and use of cell phone/email. Office environment includes use of a computer, telephone, copier and other standard office equipment.

Benefits That Go Beyond The Basics

We strive to be Above all in Service® to our customers—and to our employees. That's why Erie Insurance offers you an exceptional benefits package, including:

  • Premier health, prescription, dental, and vision benefits for you and your dependents. Coverage begins your first day of work.

Position Summary

Under close supervision, uses various platforms to actively listen to customers (policyholders, agents, claimants, employees) to gain an understanding of their needs, clarify information, and offer possible solutions by using knowledge of company products, services, and policies to assist customers with, inquiries, complaints, or problems.

Role Expectations:
This position is part of our inbound contact center. You will handle approximately 65–75 calls per day from agents, customers, and other stakeholders. Calls are monitored for quality, and the role requires strong patience, professionalism, and empathy.


Compensation:

Makes billing arrangements, corrects errors (accounting, underwriting and policy issues) with resolution and documents accordingly within scope of authority and guidelines provided.

About this job

Lincoln Financial Group is building an AI Native Intelligence platform that enables conversational queries over enterprise data. This role is a hands-on technical position designing and shipping Bedrock agents, retrieval pipelines, and natural-language-to-analytics capabilities that power the platform.

Good fit if you have 8+ years in data analytics, 2+ years building production LLM systems, and hands-on expertise with AWS Bedrock, Lambda, Step Functions, Athena, and prompt engineering

Full job description

Alternate Locations: Radnor, PA (Pennsylvania); Charlotte, NC (North Carolina); Fort Wayne, IN (Indiana); Greensboro, NC (North Carolina)

Work Arrangement:

Hybrid : Employee will work 3 days a week in a Lincoln office

Relocation assistance: is not available for this opportunity.

Requisition #: 76794

The Role at a Glance

Lincoln Financial Group is building an AI Native Intelligence platform that turns enterprise data into a conversational, agentic layer the business can query directly — and that continuously finds patterns, trends, and anomalies in that data on its own. The platform's architecture spans an AWS-native ingestion and extraction pipeline, a governed semantic layer and business knowledge graph, and an intelligence layer that answers questions in plain language and surfaces what's changing, instead of relying on static reports someone has to remember to check.

We're looking for a Lead, AI Native Analytics to be the hands-on builder of that conversational and analytical experience: the person who actually designs and ships the Bedrock agents, retrieval pipelines, pattern-detection logic, and natural-language-to-analytics capabilities that make the platform usable. This is an individual-contributor-heavy, deeply technical role — you'll spend most of your time in the architecture, the prompts, and the code, while partnering closely with the Senior Director on direction and with business stakeholders on what “useful” actually looks like.

What you'll be doing

  • Design and build the conversational AI experience end to end: Bedrock Agents (via AgentCore or MCP/API), retrieval-augmented generation over Bedrock Knowledge Bases / OpenSearch Serverless, natural-language-to-SQL over Athena, and relationship queries over a knowledge graph (Amazon Neptune / GraphRAG).
  • Build capabilities that continuously detect patterns, trends, and anomalies across enterprise data — surfacing what's notable proactively, rather than waiting for someone to know what question to ask.
  • Build and tune the AI extraction pipeline that turns raw unstructured data (documents, logs, notes, communications) into structured, query-ready facts — using Amazon Comprehend and/or LLM-based extraction via the Bedrock Converse API (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB for state).
  • Own prompt engineering and agent tool design: system instructions, tool/action-group definitions, structured-output schemas, and model selection/tiering to balance accuracy, latency, and cost.
  • Integrate the conversational layer with the platform's semantic layer and business ontology (KPI and metrics definitions, business rules glossary) so agent answers stay consistent with how the business already measures itself — never computing an ad hoc number that disagrees with a dashboard.
  • Build evaluation and quality processes for LLM-based systems: golden question sets, retrieval/accuracy scoring, hallucination and abstention testing, and regression checks before any change ships to users.
  • Implement guardrails in partnership with security/compliance: PII detection and redaction, Bedrock Guardrails configuration, access-controlled data zones, and audit logging for every AI-generated answer.
  • Partner directly with business stakeholders across the enterprise to translate real questions into working conversational and pattern-detection features, and iterate quickly based on usage and accuracy feedback.
  • Mentor and provide technical direction to engineers contributing to the conversational AI workstream, and represent this workstream in architecture reviews led by the Senior Director.
  • Stay current with the fast-moving AWS AI landscape — Bedrock model and AgentCore updates, new retrieval and evaluation tooling — and bring concrete recommendations back to the team.

What we're looking for

Must Haves:

  • 8+ years of experience in Data Analytics / Business Intelligence with at least 2+ years building production LLM-based Analytics systems (not just prototypes or proofs of concept).
  • Hands-on, production-level expertise with the AWS AI/data stack: Amazon Bedrock (Knowledge Bases, Agents/AgentCore), AWS Lambda, Step Functions, Amazon S3, AWS Glue, and Amazon Athena; working experience with a vector store (OpenSearch Serverless or similar).
  • Strong, practical prompt-engineering and LLM application development skills: structured extraction, tool-calling/agentic patterns, retrieval design, and iterative evaluation against real questions.
  • Solid understanding of semantic layers, business ontologies, or metrics layers, and how to ground LLM outputs in governed, consistent business definitions rather than ad hoc computation.
  • Experience building or applying pattern-, trend-, or anomaly-detection techniques over enterprise data (statistical, ML-based, or LLM-assisted), and turning what's found into something a business user can act on.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript/Node.js for building extraction pipelines, agent tools, and integration code.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and cloud analytics engines (Athena, Redshift, or similar), sufficient to design and validate natural-language-to-SQL experiences.
  • Clear communicator who can demo a working system to engineers and explain its behavior and limitations to non-technical business stakeholders with equal clarity.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with GraphRAG or other knowledge-graph-grounded retrieval patterns, and with a graph database such as Amazon Neptune.
  • Experience with a semantic-layer/metrics-layer tool (e.g., Cube.dev) used to serve consistent metrics to both BI and AI consumers.
  • Experience with NLP/document-processing pipelines (e.g., Amazon Comprehend) for extracting structure from varied unstructured enterprise data.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry, with a working understanding of PII handling and data privacy/compliance considerations.
  • Experience configuring LLM safety/evaluation tooling such as Bedrock Guardrails, or building your own evaluation harness for generative AI systems.
  • Familiarity with a range of enterprise data domains (financial, operational, customer, or workforce data) within a large organization.
