Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Customer Service Representative, Customer Service / Account Support
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Lakeland, FL
  • Experience: 2+ years
  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off, paid holidays, tuition assistance

About this job

Customer Service Representative for Summit Claims, a workers' comp insurance specialist serving over 7,000 agents. You'll be the first point of contact for callers, handling inquiries with courteous and efficient service in a structured environment.

Good fit if you have 1-2 years of customer service experience, strong communication skills, and can work on-site four days weekly in Lakeland, Florida.

Full job description

Summit provides independent insurance agents and their clients with market-leading workers' comp insurance and elite customer service. We're growing and currently serve more than 7,000 independent agents and 31,000 policyholders across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic.

Our strength comes from a single-minded focus on workers' comp and a commitment to long-term customer relationships. Summit is who you turn to when you need a specialist who not only knows workers' comp but also gets to know your business and your priorities.

Our field team members are located in every state in which we operate.

Summit is a member of the Great American Insurance Group where our highest goal is for all employees to feel included, respected, and empowered to perform at their best.

This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship.

Scope of Work

  • Performs work under close supervision, following established procedures and direction.
  • Relies on instructions and pre‑established guidelines to carry out daily responsibilities.
  • Develops a working knowledge of company products, services, and business systems used to perform job functions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serves as the first point of contact for callers, providing courteous, efficient, and accurate assistance.
  • Demonstrates our Customer Care philosophy by putting the caller first in every interaction.
  • Maintains strong dependability and accountability in daily responsibilities.
  • Supports teammates by stepping in when needed and contributing to a positive team environment.
  • Follows established workflows and procedures within a highly structured environment.
  • Upholds professional, caring communication at all times.
  • Maintains consistent and reliable attendance to ensure adequate coverage and service levels.
  • Participates in rotating support for the Receptionist function, providing coverage as scheduled to ensure seamless front‑desk operations.

Qualifications

  • High School diploma or equivalent required.
  • 1–2 years of customer service experience, preferably in a call center or high‑volume service environment.
  • Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.
  • Ability to remain calm, patient, and professional under pressure.
  • Flexibility and willingness to adapt to changing needs.
  • A positive attitude and a caring, customer‑first mindset.
  • Dependability, accountability, and a strong commitment to attendance.

#LI-Hybrid

Great American 's culture is built on connection, shared learning, and strong relationships. To support this, employees in this role are expected to be on-site four days a week, with the flexibility to work one day remotely. Core in-office days are Tuesday –Thursday, with the fourth day determined by business needs.

Company:

SCI Summit Consulting, LLC

Benefits:

We offer competitive benefits packages for full-time and part-time employees*. Full-time employees have access to medical, dental, and vision coverage, wellness plans, parental leave, adoption assistance, and tuition reimbursement. Full-time and eligible part-time employees also enjoy Paid Time Off and paid holidays, a 401(k) plan with company match, an employee stock purchase plan, and commuter benefits.

Compensation varies by role, level, and location and is influenced by skills, experience, and business needs. Your recruiter will provide details about benefits and specific compensation ranges during the hiring process. Learn more at http://www.gaig.com/careers.

*Excludes seasonal employees and interns.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Vancouver, WA
  • Experience: 1+ year

About this job

Field Property Claims Adjuster for Liberty Mutual in Vancouver, Washington. You will travel locally to assess property damage, prepare repair estimates, and guide customers through claims from start to finish. A 5-month training program includes virtual learning and two in-person sessions in Texas.

Good fit if you have 1+ year claims handling experience, live near Vancouver WA, can obtain proper licensing, and understand building construction principles.

Full job description


Description

Join us as a Field Property Claims Adjuster where youll be responsible for helping our customers navigate the claims process and get back on their feet following damage to the homeowners property. This is a role where people who love every day to be new, different and exciting, can thrive youll be traveling on the road to meet customers in person, providing hands-on assessment of damage and empathetic support.

The Field Property Claims Adjuster will be traveling locally to insured homes within Vancouver, WA (98686) and surrounding areas. To be successful within the role, candidates should live within or near this area.

Sign-On Bonus Available! Were offering a sign-on bonus for experienced and actively licensed new hires.

What youll do

  • Investigate and evaluate onsite to resolve complex coverage and damage issues to include preparing complete estimates of repair for the covered damages. This may include accessing roofs by ladder, inspecting attics, crawl spaces and basements in search of damage.
  • Handle moderate to complex claims independently while managing your workload, from first notice of loss to final closure.
  • Be expected to work in a vehicle in the field daily while occasionally handling assignments from the desk.
  • Explain coverage of loss, assist policyholders with itemization of damages, emergency repairs and additional living arrangements.
  • Work with and coordinate a few vendor services such as contractors, emergency repair, cleaning services and various replacement services.
  • May be called upon for catastrophe duty.

Position details

  • Territory-based work:Most workdays will be spent in the field within your assigned local territory, giving you the opportunity to work directly with customers and gain hands-on experience.

  • Training & support:To set you up for success, youll participate in a comprehensive 5-month training program, which includes:
    • Primarily virtual and on-the-job learning.
    • Two short in-person training sessions (Weeks 4 and 7) at our Lewisville, TX office.
    • Limited overnight travel for training and team meetings (typically less than 10%).

  • Mileage Reimbursement:This role offers mileage reimbursement. You may qualify for a company-provided vehicle once mileage requirements are met. Additional details will be provided if you advance in the selection process.
Qualifications
  • Working knowledge of claims handling procedures and operations.
  • Proven ability to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Effective negotiation skills.
  • Ability to effectively and independently manage workload while exhibiting good judgment.
  • Strong written/oral communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Computer skills with the ability to work with multi-faceted systems.
  • The capabilities, skills and knowledge required through a bachelors degree or equivalent experience and at least 1 year of directly related experience.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.
  • The ability to handle multiple competing priorities and organize your day.
  • Strong time management and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated understanding of building construction principles.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

Job.JobTitle: Senior Technical Claims Specialist, Commercial Excess and Coverage
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Claims Representative, Claims, Excess & Surplus Lines Underwriter
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Liberty Mutual has an exciting Senior Technical Claims Specialist opportunity within our Specialty Lines Excess Coverage department. In this role, under moderate direction, you will handle a book of Commercial Casualty Excess/Umbrella claims, throughout the entire claims life cycle. Excess claim types include, but are not limited to, premises liability, auto, products, mass torts, across the United States for both Coverage A and Coverage B claims on admitted and non-admitted paper. Complex Excess claims experience needed to evaluate claims with significant financial exposure. Additionally, you will be responsible for conducting investigations, recommending adequate reserves, monitoring, documenting, assessing any risk transfer potential, and settling/closing claims in an expeditious and economical manner within prescribed authority limits for the line of business.

*We are open to fill as a Senior Technical Claims Specialist I or II, depending on candidate experience.

Responsibilities

  • As the claims owner, determines coverage, investigates the claims, determines liability, sets and adjusts reserves, evaluates the claim, negotiates a settlement, authorizes and pays the claim; may deny claims.
  • Review lawsuit documentation and supporting documents, claims file, investigation, etc. Establish actions to be taken to resolve lawsuit. Includes determining loss coverage, amounts owed, discovery plans, setting reserves and negotiations.
  • Establish appropriate working team (Home Office Legal, Defense Counsel and Home Office Claims) based on allegations established in suit.
  • Responsible for managing the practices and billing activities of outside counsel. Accountable for security of financial processing of claims, as well as security information contained in claims files.
  • Trains and mentors staff as appropriate; manages relationships and acts as liaison with various business partners (e.g., Underwriting, Reinsurance, Etc.).
  • Keeps abreast of existing and proposed legislation, court decisions and trends and experience pertaining to specialty coverage issues. May analyze the impact upon claims policies and procedures and advises Claims Management so appropriate action can be taken where required.
  • Leads and participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.

You will be required to go into the office twice a month if you reside within 50 miles of one of the following offices: Boston, MA; Westborough, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL; Indianapolis, IN; Lake Oswego, OR; Chandler, AZ; Las Vegas, NV; Plano, TX; or Suwanee, GA. Please note this policy is subject to change.

Qualifications

We are focusing on candidates who have:

  • Experience with Commercial Excess and Umbrella claims averaging $1-3 million or more required.
  • Excess claims experience with premises liability, employer's liability, environmental, auto, products liability, mass torts and other Commercial Casualty Claims experience.

Qualifications

  • Advanced to expert knowledge of commercial casualty claims investigation, coverage, reserving, expense management, resolution strategy, negotiation, litigation management, claims evaluation as well as the insurance legal and regulatory environment.
  • Advanced to expert level of skill in the area of customer focus, gaining support, teamwork, and adaptability.
  • Expert ability to identify and solve problems, achieve results and execute thoroughly.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, mentor other employees, and serves as a subject matter expert as normally acquired through 7 or more years of experience.
  • Ability to adapt to work in multiple claim systems.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Job.JobTitle: Senior Technical Claims Specialist, Commercial Excess and Coverage
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Claims Representative, Claims, Excess & Surplus Lines Underwriter
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Liberty Mutual has an exciting Senior Technical Claims Specialist opportunity within our Specialty Lines Excess Coverage department. In this role, under moderate direction, you will handle a book of Commercial Casualty Excess/Umbrella claims, throughout the entire claims life cycle. Excess claim types include, but are not limited to, premises liability, auto, products, mass torts, across the United States for both Coverage A and Coverage B claims on admitted and non-admitted paper. Complex Excess claims experience needed to evaluate claims with significant financial exposure. Additionally, you will be responsible for conducting investigations, recommending adequate reserves, monitoring, documenting, assessing any risk transfer potential, and settling/closing claims in an expeditious and economical manner within prescribed authority limits for the line of business.

*We are open to fill as a Senior Technical Claims Specialist I or II, depending on candidate experience.

Responsibilities

  • As the claims owner, determines coverage, investigates the claims, determines liability, sets and adjusts reserves, evaluates the claim, negotiates a settlement, authorizes and pays the claim; may deny claims.
  • Review lawsuit documentation and supporting documents, claims file, investigation, etc. Establish actions to be taken to resolve lawsuit. Includes determining loss coverage, amounts owed, discovery plans, setting reserves and negotiations.
  • Establish appropriate working team (Home Office Legal, Defense Counsel and Home Office Claims) based on allegations established in suit.
  • Responsible for managing the practices and billing activities of outside counsel. Accountable for security of financial processing of claims, as well as security information contained in claims files.
  • Trains and mentors staff as appropriate; manages relationships and acts as liaison with various business partners (e.g., Underwriting, Reinsurance, Etc.).
  • Keeps abreast of existing and proposed legislation, court decisions and trends and experience pertaining to specialty coverage issues. May analyze the impact upon claims policies and procedures and advises Claims Management so appropriate action can be taken where required.
  • Leads and participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.

You will be required to go into the office twice a month if you reside within 50 miles of one of the following offices: Boston, MA; Westborough, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL; Indianapolis, IN; Lake Oswego, OR; Chandler, AZ; Las Vegas, NV; Plano, TX; or Suwanee, GA. Please note this policy is subject to change.

Qualifications

We are focusing on candidates who have:

  • Experience with Commercial Excess and Umbrella claims averaging $1-3 million or more required.
  • Excess claims experience with premises liability, employer's liability, environmental, auto, products liability, mass torts and other Commercial Casualty Claims experience.

Qualifications

  • Advanced to expert knowledge of commercial casualty claims investigation, coverage, reserving, expense management, resolution strategy, negotiation, litigation management, claims evaluation as well as the insurance legal and regulatory environment.
  • Advanced to expert level of skill in the area of customer focus, gaining support, teamwork, and adaptability.
  • Expert ability to identify and solve problems, achieve results and execute thoroughly.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, mentor other employees, and serves as a subject matter expert as normally acquired through 7 or more years of experience.
  • Ability to adapt to work in multiple claim systems.

Job.JobTitle: Portfolio Product Owner (Enterprise Data Management) - Liberty Mutual Investments
Job.JobDescription:
Description

The Company:

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is the investment firm for Liberty Mutual Group (Liberty) and is responsible for powering Libertys strategy amid profound change in global capital markets. With deep expertise in fixed income, equity, and alternative strategies, LMI invests $120+ billion (as of 12/31/2025) of capital globally,taking a long-term approach across its integrated platform and has a team of over 350 investment, finance, and operations professionals located in Boston, MA, and New York, NY.

LMI has a clear purpose: build enduring businesses side-by-side with our partners, drive economic growth, and generate superior risk-adjusted returns that power Libertys strategy and secure its promises. We offer the best of both worlds the look and feel of a boutique investment firm with the reputation and financial strength of a global leader. As the investment firm of a mutual with long-term capital, LMI has a single client mandate. This gives us the freedom to focus on what we do best.

Our portfolio spans a broad spectrum of public and private investments, and we are committed to expanding our capabilities and our toolkit in support of our mission. We invest across diverse asset classes, financial structures, and industries, including real estate, digital infrastructure, healthcare, renewable energy, and technologywith the aim of creating value and powering innovation. We pride ourselves on our extensive network of mutually beneficial partnerships, and we use our substantial influence, capital, and energy to drive towards a better future. #LMI #LI-LMI

The Position:

Liberty Mutual Investments is seeking aPortfolio Product Owner to own the strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes of LMI's Enterprise Data Management (EDM) product. EDM masters the security, price, issuer, FX, reference, and cash-flow data that LMI's investment, accounting, operations, risk, and regulatory processes depend on.

This is one of the portfolio product owner roles within Financial Products, part of Global Investment Solutions (GIS), and reports to the Managing Director, Head of Financial Products. The successful candidate is the single accountable owner for the EDM portfolio: its strategy, roadmap, squad delivery, and stakeholder governance working alongside the portfolio owners for Accounting, Operations, CECL, Automation & Productivity, and Finance Transformation.

The role sits between Financial Products, Operational Strategy and Delivery (OS&D), Investment Accounting, the LMI Data Office, Technology, and platform vendors. OS&D is a primary day-to-day partner: EDM's mastering, pricing, and exception workflows are executed and consumed there, so the Product Owner is expected to work in close and continuous partnership with OS&D on operational priorities, data-quality expectations, incident response, and the reduction of manual processing. The Product Owner sets priorities in collaboration with OS&D and Technology, leads cross-functional delivery,

and is accountable for EDM providing trusted, timely, accessible data. Current roadmap themes include security master performance, derivatives, Private Credit, pricing automation, NAIC and rating data, platform upgrades, regression testing, and reduction of manual processing.

This is an AI-first role. The successful candidate uses approved generative AI as a normal part of their own work and leads its responsible adoption across EDM product management, data operations, exception handling, support, and stakeholder self-service.

Responsibilities:

Product strategy and roadmap

  • Own the EDM product vision, multi-year strategy, and a transparent roadmap aligned to investment, accounting, operational, regulatory, and technology priorities.
  • Prioritize using business value, risk, regulatory importance, data quality, operational impact, cost, and complexity; make trade-offs visible to stakeholders.
  • Balance strategic transformation, platform modernization, regulatory commitments, production stability, technical debt, and run-the-business demand.
  • Develop business cases for material EDM investments and capability changes.
  • Maintain clear boundaries between EDM product ownership and the enterprise MDM mandate, and route gaps requiring broader solutions to an accountable owner.

Data domain ownership and product health

  • Own business outcomes for security master, price master, securities of interest, reference, issuer, FX, and cash-flow capabilities.
  • Set and monitor measurable expectations for data quality, completeness, timeliness, availability, and operational efficiency.
  • Lead improvements to mastering, pricing, exception management, reconciliation, workflow, and downstream distribution, with sustained reduction in manual processing.
  • Partner with data owners and stewards on critical data elements, lineage, controls, and decision rights.
  • With Technology, OS&D, and vendors, maintain EDM stability, performance, and continuity; lead business prioritization during incidents and drive root causes to permanent remediation rather than repeated manual intervention.
  • Maintain heightened readiness and documented coverage arrangements around month-end, quarter-end, investment-accounting close, and regulatory reporting.

Backlog and delivery

  • Act as the single accountable owner for portfolio intake and prioritization, coordinating the supporting product owners, business analysts, and data stewards assigned to EDM.
  • Own the prioritized product backlog; translate outcomes into epics, features, and stories with clear problem statements, scope, dependencies, controls, acceptance criteria, and success measures.
  • Lead and participate actively in PI planning, sprint planning, refinement, reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and demos; intervene early when commitments, dependencies, or capacity put outcomes at risk.
  • Manage dependencies across EDM, SimCorp Dimension, Aladdin, Snowflake, WSO, investment-accounting processes, and downstream reporting and analytics.
  • Validate that delivered capability solves the intended business need and achieves measurable adoption and value.

Stakeholder Leadership and governance

  • Serve as the Financial Products point of accountability for EDM strategy, prioritization, and business outcomes.
  • Build trusted relationships across OS&D, Investment Accounting, Public Markets, Private Assets, Finance, Risk, Compliance, the Data Office, and Technology; influence senior stakeholders without formal reporting authority.
  • Lead the EDM Product Advisory Council with decision-ready agendas covering product health, roadmap progress, risks, and trade-offs, and a transparent record of decisions, owners, and due dates.
  • Define escalation paths and decision rights across Financial Products, Technology, OS&D, the Data Office, and vendors; escalate material risks with context, options, and a recommendation.

AI-enabled ways of working

  • Use approved generative AI daily for strategy, research, prioritization, scenario analysis, story and acceptance-criteria drafting, test scenarios, and executive materials retaining personal accountability for the accuracy and quality of every output.
  • Critically evaluate AI output and validate facts, assumptions, and calculations before use; protect confidential, holdings, and restricted data by working only in approved tools and environments.
  • Own an AI enablement roadmap for EDM spanning data onboarding, mastering, data-quality monitoring, exception management, reconciliation support, natural-language data access, incident documentation, production-support query deflection, test and regression development, and downstream self-service.
  • Define measurable objectives per initiative and run controlled experiments before scaling; determine what belongs in EDM, an enterprise capability, a vendor roadmap, or improved ways of working, avoiding point solutions that add fragmentation or technical debt.
  • Ensure AI use meets LMI information security, privacy, legal, model risk, and Responsible AI requirements, with defined human review, monitoring, and traceability. AI recommendations must not become unreviewed production decisions.
  • Build reusable prompts, skills, and knowledge assets, and help team members adopt AI in ways that improve quality rather than volume.

Vendor management and modernization

  • Represent LMI's product priorities in vendor roadmap, service, architecture, and escalation discussions; hold vendors accountable for commitments, quality, transparency, and sustainable remediation.
  • Evaluate vendor advisory councils, early-access programs, and development partnerships, and ensure vendor-led innovation, including AI capability, meets LMI governance and risk requirements.
  • Lead product direction for EDM modernization and business-process redesign performance, scalability, maintainability, user workflow, data model, architectural simplification, and standardized access patterns tied to measurable business outcomes.
Qualifications
  • Bachelors degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Information Systems, Data Management, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 10+ years in investment management, investment operations, investment accounting, enterprise data management, or financial technology, including demonstrated product ownership of a complex platform, data product, or enterprise capability.
  • Gresham Opus EDM (Markit EDM and S&P Global EDM), GoldenSource, BNY Data & Analytics (Eagle), Rimes, or a comparable enterprise data-management platform.
  • Strong command of security master, price master, reference data, data quality, data lineage, exception management, and downstream data consumption.
  • Track record translating complex business needs into roadmaps, requirements, and measurable outcomes, and leading cross-functional delivery across Product, Technology, OS&D or an equivalent investment-operations function, and Data.
  • Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, written communication, and executive presentation skills; sound decision-making and judgment in a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Agile delivery, PI planning, backlog management, and cross-product dependency management.
  • Hands-on use of generative AI to improve product management, analysis, or operational workflows, with the judgment to identify unsupported conclusions and factual errors in AI output and the discipline to apply human review and data protection.
  • Experience managing vendors or strategic technology partners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SimCorp Dimension, Aladdin, Snowflake, WSO, eFront, or related investment platforms.
  • Insurance asset management or another highly regulated financial-services environment; public and private asset classes; investment-accounting and NAIC data requirements.
  • Retrieval-augmented generation, natural-language data access, prompt design, or agentic workflow concepts; experience introducing AI capability within a governed enterprise environment.

Description

At Liberty, you'll thrive in a hybrid setting that fosters in-person collaboration, innovation and growth. This approach optimizes both remote and in-person interactions, enabling you to connect and ideate with your team and deepen valuable relationships across the company, while still enjoying the flexibility of remote work for focused tasks and projects.

The Senior Accountant independently plans and monitors the completion of book, close processes and financial reports in a deadline focused environment, while ensuring that issues are escalated as needed. Uses increasing expertise to process detailed information with high levels of accuracy and to research and apply accounting policy. They communicate effectively with other units and management to plan work, gather information, and present results. Leads efforts to continuously improve processes to produce relevant financial reports in the fastest, most efficient means possible.

You will be required to go into the office twice a week if you reside within 50 miles of one of the following offices, Portsmouth, NH or Boston, MA. Please note this policy is subject to change.


Responsibilities

  • Oversee the functions of the monthly, quarterly and annual book close cycles, monitoring timely completion and escalating issues for resolution.
  • Accurately and efficiently performs accounting activities of increasing complexity.
  • Creates increasingly complex financial statement schedules, audit support schedules and other reports in a timely manner.
  • May perform detailed review of other team members schedules.
  • Research and applies accounting policy to business issues that arise.
  • Establish documents and perform internal control procedures to ensure accurate and timely financial reporting.
  • Understands how data flows through the financial systems to the accounting function to identify issues and take action to address them.
  • Continually assesses the business value and efficiency of the work performed, making suggestions for improvements and collaborating with others in implementing them.
  • Leads or actively participate in increasingly complex department projects and continuous improvement activities.
  • Fosters the development of teammates by sharing expertise and experience through training or reviewing their work.
  • May support varying levels of treasury projects.
  • Experience with Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a plus but not required.
  • Certified Treasury Professional (CTP) is a plus but not required.
  • May provide feedback on performance.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor`s degree (Accounting or Finance) and a minimum of 3 years of accounting or finance experience preferred
  • Must demonstrate attention to detail in a fast-paced work environment and the ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously to achieve results
  • Must be able to communicate effectively with teammates and others, leading meetings and interacting with increasingly higher levels of management to gather information and effectively present results/recommendations
  • Advanced knowledge of Excel and Microsoft Word is preferred

Description

Duties:

Lead development of system testing strategies, test plans, test cases and test conditions and oversee testing across multiple environments and enforce QA standards and best practices.

Design, enhance and institutionalize test engineering procedures and standards; define, implement and report on test metrics to measure application quality and delivery risk.

Champion shift-left testing practices (TDD/BDD, white-box/gray-box testing, code coverage, static analysis, service virtualization) to detect defects earlier and improve code quality.

Lead and manage complex projects and subprojects: create project plans, assign tasks, estimate effort, manage QA activities to plan and coordinate cross-functional teams in onsiteoffshore delivery models.

Drive automation strategy and implementation across Java and TypeScript stacks; integrate automated tests (unit, API, end-to-end, regression, smoke) into CI/CD pipelines and pipeline gating.

Own performance, load and scalability testing initiatives and perform holistic system-level analysis to identify bottlenecks and remediation actions.

Establish and manage test data management, environment virtualization and security testing initiatives to support reliable and repeatable testing across sprints.

Lead defect triage processes and collaborate with development and product teams to prioritize and resolve issues.

Provide expert guidance on testing systems, processes and methodologies to clients, IT management and project teams throughout the full project lifecycle.

Mentor and coach QA engineers; build team capabilities, promote knowledge sharing and improve technical depth across teams.

Communicate test progress, quality status, risks and metrics regularly to senior stakeholders and product owners; prepare stakeholder presentations and status reports.

Position requires domestic travel up to 10%.

Telecommuting permitted up to 60%.

Qualifications

Requirements:

Employer will accept a Bachelors degree (or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related field and eight (8) years of experience in the job offered or in a Principal Test Engineer-related occupation.

Alternatively, employer will accept a Masters degree (or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related field and five (5) years of experience in the job offered or in a Principal Test Engineer-related occupation.

Position requires demonstrable experience in the following:

1. Programming in Java (Java 8+) and TypeScript and experience with Node.js runtime and ecosystem.

2. Designing and implementing automated testing strategies across Java and TypeScript stacks, including unit, integration, API, end-to-end, regression and UAT.

3. Utilizing TypeScript, JavaScript, and Java test frameworks and tools.

4. Automating API and service tests.

5. Integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.

6. Experience with build and deploy automation and pipeline gating.

7. Utilizing APM tooling including Splunk and DataDog to support testdriven performance troubleshooting.

8. Testing management and collaboration tools such as JIRA, Confluence and Git-based source control including GitHub or equivalent.

9. Mentoring and coaching junior engineers through defining QA processes and metrics and communicating testing status and risk to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

10. Working effectively in Agile and DevOps teams to drive shift-left testing practices including TDD and BDD, white-box and gray-box testing, code coverage and static analysis.

Experience may be gained during graduate program. Will accept any suitable combination of education, training, and/or experience. Multiple Positions Available.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Associate Consultant, Corporate Strategy & Research
Job.JobDescription:
Description

About the Team

The Corporate Strategy & Research (CS&R) group is an award-winning 35-person enterprise strategy and internal strategy consulting team within Liberty Mutual Insurance, a Fortune 100 company with 40,000 employees operating in 28 countries and economies worldwide. The group serves as trusted strategic advisers to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team and drives transformational change by taking an enterprise-wide, customer-centric perspective.

Established in 1972, CS&R has an outstanding track record of developing future leaders and serving as a top talent feeder to the organization by creating an environment that fosters intellectual curiosity, professional development, and personal fulfillment. Alumni of the group include our current Chairman & CEO, Chief Insights & Solutions Officer, EVP & General Manager of Sales and Service, SVP & Head of BU Strategy, VP & Managing Director of Corporate Development, and Vice President of Product Strategy. This is a great opportunity for an energetic individual to join a vibrant, high performance, and tight-knit team environment that will be front and center in driving change across the enterprise.

The Details

Were in search of intellectually curious, creative, driven individuals who have a strong desire to expand their management consulting toolkit as part of an energetic and high-impact team.

As a Senior Associate Consultant, you will work within a tight-knit consulting team that will collectively advise Liberty Mutuals senior executives in making key strategic decisions. Projects are typically in the areas of strategy development, growth strategy, organizational design & operating model, innovation, or business transformation, and typically run for 2-5 months.

You will engage in a targeted training program and partner with an experienced Managing Director who will support your development, provide feedback and perspective, and serve as a mentor. Through your project work, you will develop relationships with stakeholders across the organization and have opportunities to present to senior leaders.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Understanding strategic priorities of clients and the role of your team in evaluating and advancing those priorities
  • Designing workplans, conducting targeted research, collecting data from various internal and external sources (e.g., executive interviews and workshops, customer surveys)
  • Performing high-impact analysis and aiding in both evaluating and designing business solutions
  • Crafting storylines that clearly articulate findings, insights, and recommendations
  • Communicating with senior leadership to influence and drive the organization to action
  • Contributing to CS&R initiatives such as recruiting, talent development, culture building and engagement, or alumni engagement
Qualifications

Candidates should, at a minimum, possess the following:

  • Bachelors degree required with a minimum 3.0 cumulative GPA, ideally from a top-tier university
  • 1-3 years of relevant experience, such as client-facing role within a top-tier strategy consulting firm, banking, investments / desk research, financial services, corporate strategy, or similar
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and written and oral communication skills
  • Ability to leverage analysis to gain support and influence others
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, including project work and department responsibilities
  • Ability to work independently and as member of a team
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel
  • Insurance or financial services industry experience a plus (not required)
  • The role is located in Boston, MA only; working in a hybrid model (weekly blend of 3-4 days in-office and 1-2 days working from home)

Additional qualifications include:

  • Motivated by high impact, high visibility work
  • Comfortable operating in an ambiguous environment
  • Interest in financial services and insurance and demonstrate strong leadership potential
  • Excited about contributing to a dynamic and high-performing team culture

Were Hiring Immediately!

As an Insurance Sales Associate, you will work alongside with and support a Comparion Insurance Sales Agent in profitable growth through new business sales and customer retention. Working for Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company, means working for a company thats committed to advancing an inclusive environment. Ready to find out what it means to work for an agency that is backed by Liberty Mutuala Fortune 100 company thats committed to putting people first, acting responsibly and making things better?

Description

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role has IN OFFICE requirements. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, youll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What youll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who Were Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive you follow through and do what you say youll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing youre comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy youre able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

Build a career for yourself, not by yourself. Launch a rewarding insurance sales career today.

Job.JobTitle: Comparion Commercial Insurance Specialist (base salary + uncapped commissions)
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $65,000 to $125,000 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Boston, MA
  • Experience: 2+ years

About this job

Commercial Insurance Specialist selling small business coverage (under $10M revenue) through consultative sales and multiple carriers. Role combines prospecting, quoting, policy placement, and client relationship building with base salary plus uncapped commissions.

Good fit if you have P&C license or are pursuing it, experience prospecting and selling small commercial insurance, and strong relationship-building skills

Full job description


Description

Join our team as a Commercial Insurance Specialist, helping small businesses find the right coverage through consultative sales and tailored insurance solutions. In this fast-paced role, youll prospect new opportunities, build lasting client and referral relationships, and work with multiple carriers to deliver quality coverage and service.

The typical starting salary is $65k; through a combination of base salary, bonuses and uncapped commissions, typical total first-year compensation range is from $65k to $125k.

Job Summary:

Responsible for prospecting, generating, developing, and managing a book of small commercial insurance business. Counsels and advises prospects and policyholders on matters of protection and coverage. Is responsible for a specific volume of quality new business quoted and written within company guidelines. This role combines prospecting and new-business production with consultative sales, quoting through multiple carriers, and coordinating policy placement and renewals.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Source and develop new small commercial accounts (typically business accounts with revenues under $10M) through prospecting, referrals, networking, and inbound leads.
  • Utilizes coverage knowledge to counsel and advise prospects and existing policyholders on matters of protection and coverage based on a needs and exposure assessment by obtaining data and relative information concerning their business. Recommend appropriate insurance solutions (BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds).
  • Conducts front-line underwriting risk evaluation in accordance with established rules and guidelines. Prepare and present quotes and proposals by obtaining/comparing quotes from multiple carriers using agency management systems, CRM and carrier panel rating platforms.
  • Meets goals for volume of quality new business and cross sell opportunities quoted and written within company guidelines.
  • Works collaboratively with internal and agency partners to deliver a best-in-class customer experience.
  • Build relationships and trust with referring agents within the region to build COI/lead generation streams
  • Provide timely service for endorsements, cancellations, audits, and claims liaison as needed.
  • Stay current on carrier appetite, new products, underwriting guidelines, and industry trends.
Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with common small commercial products: BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds
  • Experience with networking, prospecting for new business and driving top of funnel leads from various sources
  • Experience using agency management systems, comparative raters
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Property & Casualty license (or progress toward them. You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years experience selling small commercial lines in an independent agency or carrier distribution channel
  • Proven track record of meeting production targets; demonstrated book of business or established referral sources
  • Designations such as CLCS, CISR, CIC, or CPCU (or progress toward them)

Skills & Competencies:

  • Consultative sales approach and client-focused problem solving.
  • Demonstrated analytical skills to understand complex coverage details and underwriting guidelines clearly to small-business owners
  • Collaborative mindset and comfortable working in a high-volume agency environment.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication, persuasion and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to build a sphere of influence in the community and participate in community networking activities

Job.JobTitle: Comparion Commercial Insurance Specialist (base salary + uncapped commissions)
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Join our team as a Commercial Insurance Specialist, helping small businesses find the right coverage through consultative sales and tailored insurance solutions. In this fast-paced role, youll prospect new opportunities, build lasting client and referral relationships, and work with multiple carriers to deliver quality coverage and service.

The typical starting salary is $65k; through a combination of base salary, bonuses and uncapped commissions, typical total first-year compensation range is from $65k to $125k.

Job Summary:

Responsible for prospecting, generating, developing, and managing a book of small commercial insurance business. Counsels and advises prospects and policyholders on matters of protection and coverage. Is responsible for a specific volume of quality new business quoted and written within company guidelines. This role combines prospecting and new-business production with consultative sales, quoting through multiple carriers, and coordinating policy placement and renewals.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Source and develop new small commercial accounts (typically business accounts with revenues under $10M) through prospecting, referrals, networking, and inbound leads.
  • Utilizes coverage knowledge to counsel and advise prospects and existing policyholders on matters of protection and coverage based on a needs and exposure assessment by obtaining data and relative information concerning their business. Recommend appropriate insurance solutions (BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds).
  • Conducts front-line underwriting risk evaluation in accordance with established rules and guidelines. Prepare and present quotes and proposals by obtaining/comparing quotes from multiple carriers using agency management systems, CRM and carrier panel rating platforms.
  • Meets goals for volume of quality new business and cross sell opportunities quoted and written within company guidelines.
  • Works collaboratively with internal and agency partners to deliver a best-in-class customer experience.
  • Build relationships and trust with referring agents within the region to build COI/lead generation streams
  • Provide timely service for endorsements, cancellations, audits, and claims liaison as needed.
  • Stay current on carrier appetite, new products, underwriting guidelines, and industry trends.
Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with common small commercial products: BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds
  • Experience with networking, prospecting for new business and driving top of funnel leads from various sources
  • Experience using agency management systems, comparative raters
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Property & Casualty license (or progress toward them. You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years experience selling small commercial lines in an independent agency or carrier distribution channel
  • Proven track record of meeting production targets; demonstrated book of business or established referral sources
  • Designations such as CLCS, CISR, CIC, or CPCU (or progress toward them)

Skills & Competencies:

  • Consultative sales approach and client-focused problem solving.
  • Demonstrated analytical skills to understand complex coverage details and underwriting guidelines clearly to small-business owners
  • Collaborative mindset and comfortable working in a high-volume agency environment.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication, persuasion and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to build a sphere of influence in the community and participate in community networking activities
  • Effective time management and ability to work well independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate numerous computerized data entry systems or other relevant applications simultaneously while advising customers
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent business background plus a minimum of 1-3 years of insurance or sales/service-related work experience.

We offer customers 50 insurance companies with product breadth including auto, home, life, pet, renters, umbrella, jewelry and much more. About this job

Sell auto, home, life, and specialty insurance products to individuals and families using a consultative approach. Base salary of $55k-$65k plus uncapped commissions, with first-year total compensation typically $55k-$75k and potential for top performers to exceed $100k.

Full job description


Description

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role has IN OFFICE requirements. Must reside in the state of Illinois.This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, youll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed no prior insurance experience required.

Pay Details

  • The typical training salary is $55k - $65k
  • Through a combination of base, bonuses, and uncapped commissions, typical total first year compensation ranges from $55k - $75k
  • Potential for top performers to earn over $100k in their first year

Description

What youll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who Were Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive you follow through and do what you say youll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing youre comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy youre able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

Build a career for yourself, not by yourself. Launch a rewarding insurance sales career today.

Full job description

Put your Insurance Experience to work – FROM HOME! 

At WAHVE, we value significant insurance experience and want to revolutionize the way people think about phasing into retirement by offering qualified candidates the opportunity to continue their career working from home. As we say – retire from the office but not from work.  Our unique platform provides you with real work/life balance and allows you to choose a full or part-time work schedule while continuing to utilize your insurance expertise in a remote, long-term position which includes company benefits!  

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WAHVE 

We created a welcoming place to work with friendly and professional leadership. We are known for the great care we take with our staff and our clients. We are passionate and determined about delivering the best customer service, preserving insurance industry knowledge, and making a difference by the work that we do.  

WHAT WE ARE SEEKING 

We have assignments available to help our insurance carrier or MGA clients in Product Development positions for Personal or Commercial Lines. Responsibilities may include: 

  • Participate in the filing life cycle which may include drafting, developing, finalizing, and submitting all products (forms, rates, rules).
  • Identify and communicate industry trends; recommending products and/or changes to existing products, coverages, policies, rates and forms. 
  • Design user specifications to provide technical guidance for new products. 
  • Develop and submit formal written filings to state insurance departments for approval of proposed new or existing product forms.  
  • Create and deliver underwriting guidance, training, and updated processes to support profitable product execution.   
  • Review technical specifications, quality assurance procedures and documentation, manual pages, rates, forms and other related documents and materials to assure intended results and accuracy.  
  • Ability to work independently and interact professionally and effectively in a team environment. 
  • Knowledge of ISO or AAIS, Excel and SERFF is a plus. 

TO BECOME A WORK-AT-HOME VINTAGE EXPERT, WE REQUIRE 

  • 25 years of full-time work experience 
  • 10 recent years of Property & Casualty insurance experience 

BENEFITS OF BECOMING A WAHVE VINTAGE EXPERT 

  • Health insurance based on eligibility. 
  • 401(k) with a 4% match based on eligibility. 
  • Voluntary Dental, Vision, Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D). 
  • Retire from the office but not from work. 
  • Eliminate the office stress and the commute. 
  • Choose the work you would like to do now. 
  • Available in either full or part-time schedules.  
  • Utilize your years of insurance industry knowledge. 
  • Be part of our dynamic yet virtual team environment and connect with other experienced insurance professionals like yourself! 

HOW TO GET STARTED 

Click APPLY NOW to complete our simple preliminary profile. Be sure to include your preferred contact information as one of our Qualification Specialists will connect with you promptly.

This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

Senior Analyst, Third Party Services, NA

AXIS is seeking a Senior Analyst, Third Party Services to join the Claims Shared Services organization. Reporting to the Head of Claims Third Party Delegated Services, this role is responsible for supporting the effective management and oversight of North America Claims Third Party Administrators (TPAs) and non-legal claim vendors globally.

The role is accountable for the effective oversight of service providers and vendors across the third-party lifecycle, including sourcing, due diligence, contracting, onboarding, performance management, renewal and offboarding. The role will lead defined governance activities, provide informed analysis and challenge, and deliver meaningful management information to support business decision-making.

This is a hands-on senior role in which the successful candidate will build effective relationships with Claims Third Party Management, Claims Leadership, Underwriting Operations, Program Managers, Compliance, QA, Legal, Vendor Management and service providers. They will be responsible for driving timely decisions, achieving effective issue remediation and consistently delivering strong third party governance outcomes including supporting continuous improvement efforts for the Claims third party management framework.

The Successful Candidate Will Be Responsible For

TPA and Non-Legal Third Party Governance Administration & Coordination

  • Act as the primary Third Party Services contact for an allocated portfolio of TPAs and non-legal Claims service providers.
  • Lead scheduled governance and performance reviews, ensuring clear assessment of service delivery, risk, controls and customer outcomes.
  • Undertake onboarding, renewal and offboarding activities, coordinating stakeholder input and ensuring that governance requirements are completed to the required standard.
  • Evaluate compliance with contractual obligations, service levels, governance standards and agreed performance measures.
  • Identify material risks, control weaknesses and performance concerns, applying appropriate challenge and escalating issues where required.
  • Agree, monitor and escalate remediation plans, ensuring actions are delivered within agreed timescales.
  • Maintain accurate portfolio records, governance schedules and relationship profiles to support effective management and decision-making.

Due Diligence & Audit Support

  • Coordinate planning and execution of initial and ongoing due diligence reviews.
  • Assemble and organize documentation required for due diligence reviews.
  • Maintain audit evidence repositories and supporting documentation.
  • Track audit findings, remediation activities and implementation status.
  • Prepare materials for internal audit, compliance and regulatory reviews.
  • Maintain records of governance approvals, assessments and supporting evidence.
  • Assist with periodic governance reporting and documentation reviews.

Performance Analysis and Management Insight

  • Produce recurring TPA and vendor performance reports.
  • Maintain scorecard data, KPI reporting and service tracking metrics.
  • Assist in preparation of management reporting packages.
  • Analyse service performance trends and exception reporting.
  • Track service level performance and remediation commitments.
  • Maintain governance dashboards and reporting repositories.

Governance Framework and Process Management

  • Develop and maintain governance procedures, operating guides and process documentation for managing third party services providers.
  • Organize document repositories and version control processes.
  • Coordinate updates to governance templates, checklists and standards documentation.
  • Maintain governance evidence and records retention requirements.
  • Support preparation of presentations and leadership materials.
  • Ensure documentation remains current and audit ready.

Stakeholder Leadership and Strategic Delivery

  • Coordinate activities across Claims, Programs, Underwriting Operations, QA, Compliance, Legal and Vendor Management.
  • Maintain action logs, issue trackers and governance review records.
  • Facilitate communication between stakeholders involved in governance activities.
  • Support implementation of governance initiatives and process enhancements.
  • Assist with special projects relating to delegated claims and third-party service governance.

Skills, Experience & Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in third party management, sourcing and procurement roles.
  • 2-5 years of experience in insurance operations, claims operations and delegated authority roles preferred.
  • Strong organizational and administrative skills.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and documentation discipline.
  • Experience preparing reports, scorecards and management information.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams and SharePoint.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Experience supporting audits, compliance reviews, vendor governance or operational oversight activities preferred.
  • Knowledge of claims operations, delegated claims administration or program business preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Analyzes project outcomes, operational data, and stakeholder feedback to recommend improvements to HR service delivery and project processes.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Independently plans and executes assigned recurring and smaller-scale HR Operations projects, establishing project plans, timelines, milestones, and deliverables within agreed-upon objectives.

Manages day-to-day execution of assigned projects and workstreams, independently prioritizing activities, coordinating dependencies, and adjusting plans within established parameters to meet deliverables.

Collaborates with project leads, HR colleagues, subject matter experts, and business partners to evaluate requirements, reconcile competing needs, and recommend practical approaches for assigned projects or workstreams.

Assesses project milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, resources, and budget information; develops mitigation recommendations, resolves nonroutine issues within delegated authority, and escalates matters requiring leadership decisions.

Facilitates cross-functional collaboration to evaluate operational workflows, recommend process and procedure improvements, and develop or update standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Trains, develops and guides Agents and district sales managers (DSM) in a designated branch territory in the promotion and sale of commercial lines products, providing assistance in the areas of production, product knowledge and application, and underwriting. Establishes and maintains relationships with branch managers and Agents to improve Agent willingness and ability to pursue and place quality commercial business with the ERIE.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assists branch managers in establishing short- and long-range objectives related to commercial lines sales, with an emphasis on growth, underwriting profitability and agency development and training.
  • Provides hands-on training and guidance to Agents on ERIE's commercial lines products, resources, and services, including identifying web-based resources and training programs for Agent use.   • Serves as a company representative in maintaining favorable Policyholder relationships. Works closely with adjusters and other claims personnel on matters of mutual concern.

  • Represents the company in community relations activities as directed.
  • For branch office accounts, handles insurance agency business as a licensed, non-commission company Agent.

Full job description

At Alliant Insurance Services, we thrive on creating employee benefits solutions built on the idea that health makes growth possible. As top tier professionals dedicated to solving our clients' health and welfare insurance challenges, Alliant team members deliver an unrivaled depth of service, and our unique approach enables us to help clients stay resilient and turn change into opportunity. More information is available at >.

SUMMARY

Responsible for providing customer service and overall service of assigned customers and/or policies, soliciting of new business on existing accounts and support of Producer-led new business efforts.

Ensures team prepares claims experience and utilization reports and reviews for accuracy;

Reacts, processes, and follows up on new business;

About this job

Analyze and underwrite Corporate-Owned Life Insurance (COLI) and Bank-Owned Life Insurance (BOLI) applications for executives and institutional clients. Role involves evaluating financial and mortality risks, applying underwriting guidelines, and collaborating across sales, actuarial, legal, and operations teams.

Good fit if you have a bachelor's degree, strong analytical and communication skills, and experience in COLI/BOLI, underwriting, operations, product management, or client service.

Full job description

Alternate Locations: Work from Home

Work Arrangement:

Remote : Work at home employee residing outside of a commutable distance to an office location.

Relocation assistance: is not available for this opportunity.

Requisition #: 76812

The Role at a Glance

As the COLI BOLI Insurance Consultant for Lincoln's Executive Benefit's Underwriting Team, you will analyze and deliver on COLI BOLI ICOLI cases. The Corporate-Owned Life Insurance (COLI) Underwriter is responsible for evaluating mortality, financial, and insurable risk associated with corporate-sponsored life insurance programs. The role supports the issuance and management of COLI and BOLI cases by assessing underwriting evidence, applying carrier guidelines, and making risk-based decisions that support profitable growth while maintaining regulatory compliance. Responsibilities often include collaboration with sales, actuarial, legal, case management, and corporate clients

This is a developmental opportunity designed for someone who brings relevant experience and knowledge of the COLI, BOLI, or broader institutional life insurance marketplace and is interested in building deeper underwriting expertise. A traditional underwriting background is not required. Candidates may bring transferable experience from areas such as operations, product management, client service, implementation, relationship management, or other roles that provide meaningful exposure to COLI and BOLI programs.

What you'll be doing

  • Underwrite Corporate-Owned Life Insurance (COLI) applications, including corporate and institutionally sponsored programs.
  • Underwrite Guaranteed Issue (GI) and Simplified Issue (SI) COLI cases in accordance with approved program designs, eligibility criteria, and carrier guidelines.
  • Evaluate and assess complex financial, and corporate risks for executives, key employees, and eligible participant populations.
  • Analyze corporate financial statements, program structures, and plan designs to ensure alignment with underwriting standards, regulatory requirements, and risk tolerance.
  • Apply knowledge of Qualified Purchaser and Accredited Investor definitions in support of program eligibility, structure, and regulatory compliance.
  • Determine face amounts, and policy terms using sound underwriting judgment
  • Review and approve pre-issue and post-issue underwriting transactions, including policy changes, face amount adjustments, and other in-force underwriting requests.
  • Collaborate with Sales, New Business, Legal, Compliance, Actuarial, and Operations to support case design and execution.
  • Identify underwriting trends, emerging risks, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Maintain current knowledge of COLI regulations, underwriting philosophies, and market practices.

What we're looking for

Must-Have's

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to influence management/critical stakeholders
  • Analytical skills and close attention to detail is necessary
  • Ability to adapt quickly in a changing work environment

Nice-to Have's

  • Experience working with corporate owned life insurance (COLI) and/or bank owned life insurance (BOLI) programs
  • Strong understanding of the institutional life insurance marketplace
  • Experience in underwriting, operations, product management, client service, implementation, relationship management, or a related area

Application Deadline

Applications for this position will be accepted through December 31, 2026, subject to earlier closure due to applicant volume.

What's it like to work here?

At Lincoln Financial, we love what we do. We make meaningful contributions each and every day to empower our customers to take charge of their lives. Working alongside dedicated and talented colleagues, we build fulfilling careers and stronger communities through a company that values our unique perspectives, insights and contributions and invests in programs that empower each of us to take charge of our own future.

What's in it for you:

  • Clearly defined career tracks and job levels, along with associated behaviors for each of Lincoln's core values and leadership attributes

  • Leadership development and virtual training opportunities

  • PTO/parental leave

  • Competitive 401K and employee benefits

  • Free financial counseling, health coaching and employee assistance program

  • Tuition assistance program

  • Work arrangements that work for you

  • Effective productivity/technology tools and training

The pay range for this position is $84,375 - $135,000 with anticipated pay for new hires between the minimum and midpoint of the range and could vary above and below the listed range as permitted by applicable law. Pay is based on non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, education, location, licensure requirements, proficiency and qualifications required for the role. The base pay is just one component of Lincoln's total rewards package for employees. In addition, the role may be eligible for the Annual Incentive Program, which is discretionary and based on the performance of the company, business unit and individual. Other rewards may include long-term incentives, sales incentives and Lincoln's standard benefits package.

About The Company

Lincoln Financial (NYSE: LNC) helps people to confidently plan for their version of a successful future. We focus on identifying a clear path to financial security, with products including annuities, life insurance, group protection, and retirement plan services.

With our 120-year track record of expertise and integrity, millions of customers trust our solutions and service to help put their goals in reach.

Lincoln Financial Distributors, a broker-dealer, is the wholesale distribution organization of Lincoln Financial. Lincoln Financial is the marketing name for Lincoln Financial Corporation and its affiliates including The Lincoln National Life Insurance Company, Fort Wayne, IN, and Lincoln Life & Annuity Company of New York, Syracuse, NY. Lincoln Financial affiliates, their distributors, and their respective employees, representatives and/or insurance agents do not provide tax, accounting or legal advice.

Lincoln is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Follow us on Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube. For the latest company news, visit our newsroom.

Be Aware of Fraudulent Recruiting Activities

If you are interested in a career at Lincoln, we encourage you to review our current openings and apply on our website. Lincoln values the privacy and security of every applicant and urges all applicants to diligently protect their sensitive personal information from scams targeting job seekers. These scams can take many forms including fake employment applications, bogus interviews and falsified offer letters.

Lincoln will not ask applicants to provide their social security numbers, date of birth, bank account information or other sensitive information in job applications. Additionally, our recruiters do not communicate with applicants through free e-mail accounts (Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or conduct interviews utilizing video chat rooms. We will never ask applicants to provide payment during the hiring process or extend an offer without conducting a phone, live video or in-person interview. Please contact Lincoln's fraud team at fraudhotline@lfg.com if you encounter a recruiter or see a job opportunity that seems suspicious.

The Role at a Glance

The Actuarial Development Program (ADP) at Lincoln Financial Group is an industry-leading program that demonstrates Lincoln Financial' s commitment to creating highly qualified business leaders. As an ADP participant, you'll be able to explore your unique interests while developing the essential actuarial, technical, management, communication, and leadership skills you need to succeed. The Actuarial Development Program includes a series of rotations, typically every 18-24 months. For each rotation, roles are available in different business areas including Life and Annuities, Retirement and Group Protection. Experience gained will enable participants to become well-rounded actuaries with knowledge that may include Product Development, Pricing, Valuation, Modeling, Risk Management, Asset Liability Management, Investments, Data Analytics, and Internal Audit.

ADP participants are expected to pass the Society of Actuaries' exams at a prescribed pace. The program is designed to support you as you work towards your FSA and provide the training and resources necessary to become a well-rounded actuarial leader.
