About this job

Investigate and resolve bodily injury insurance claims by working directly with injured parties to evaluate coverage, liability, and damages. No claims experience required; training provided with a start date of February 8, 2027, and a minimum of two in-office days per month after initial training.

Good fit if you have strong communication and negotiation skills, adapt well to change, and can obtain proper licensing as required.

Full job description


Description

Advance your career with our Personal Lines Casualty Team!

No bodily injury claims experience required!

Take the next step in your development with meaningful work and clear growth path.

The Bodily Injury Claims Specialist will investigate, manage and resolve Bodily Injury claims assigned directly with injured parties, as well as assist in providing service to policyholders.

All qualified applicants will reside within a 50-mile radius of the Chandleroffice.

The start date for the role is February 8, 2027.

There may be several in-office days per month for the first few months following initial virtual training to support your learning and to build relationships with leaders and others in the department. This position requires a minimum of two days in office per month as the standard beyond the training period, with occasional additional days for special meetings a few times a year.

Training is a critical component to your success and that success starts with reliable attendance. Attendance and active engagement during training is mandatory.


In a high performing culture,WEin PL Core:

  • Strive to be better tomorrow than today; little improvements lead to big ones!
  • Embrace change.We may need to let go of what's familiar in order to embrace and try something new.
  • Understandhow our individual work contributes to our teams, our organizations and the company
  • Are adaptable and resilient. Change is imperative to being better tomorrow and resiliency allows us to handle unexpected challenges
  • Are an exporter of Talent.We maintain a focus on development and growth.
  • Contribute positively; We come to work every day with the intent to make a positive impact on our work and on everyone around us. One positive interaction with you can turn someone's day around.

Responsibilities:

  • Investigates and evaluates coverage, liability, damages, and settles Bodily Injury claims directly with injured parties, within prescribed authority levels.
  • Pursues proactive contact with injured parties through various creative means to connect, listen, empathize and make early settlement offers whenever appropriate to resolve injury claims.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Communicates with policyholders, witnesses, and claimants in order to gather information regarding claims; refers tasks to auxiliary resources as necessary and advises as to proper course of action. Sends and responds to various written, telephone and SMS text inquiries to pursue resolution of the claim.
  • Ensures adequacy of reserves.
  • Accountable for security of financial processing of claims, as well as security information contained in claims files.
  • Makes effective use of loss management tools and techniques to ensure accuracy in decision making.
  • Keeps files updated with clear documentation for ease in understanding the status of investigations, evaluations and negotiations throughout the claim life cycle.
Qualifications
  • Strong written and oral communication skills required.
  • Good interpersonal, analytical, investigative, and negotiation skills required.
  • Growth mindset; adapts well to change including new standard work and new tools
  • Basic knowledge of legal liability, general insurance policy coverage and State Tort Law preferred.
  • Liability experience or policy and claims knowledge preferred.
  • Bachelors degree preferred.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.

As part of the application process, you'll complete an assessment related to the skills needed for this role please allow approximately 35 minutes, although there is no time limit.

Product Owner for Liberty Mutual's Small Commercial Auto squad, owning the backlog for pricing updates delivered to customers and agents. You'll balance speed and quality while working with pricing, product, and technology partners to translate complex problems into clear priorities.

Full job description


Description

Help get critical pricing updates in market for Small Commercial products! As the Product Owner for one of our Commercial Auto squads, you'll own the backlog behind the pricing changes that reach our Small Commercial customers and agents, balancing speed, quality, and capacity. You'll work side by side with pricing, product, and technology partners, with real visibility across the portfolio and a direct line to business results. If you love turning complex, ambiguous problems into clear priorities and delivered value, this is your seat.

As a member of the Agile team, the Product Owner represents the voice of the customer and the organization through the delivery of business value. This Product Owner role is within our Small Commercial Risk Pricing space, delivering critical pricing updates to our Small Commercial products. This person works closely with stakeholders (business and technology), including LOB leadership, to define and prioritize features and stories, ensuring alignment with customer needs and organizational goals. This person understands customers` problems in detail and ensures the problems are clearly defined, prioritized and the squad/team is focused on the most valuable work. The Product Owner is the team member always communicating with stakeholders to ensure an aligned understanding of how the squad/team can provide the highest value to the customer through the lens of the portfolio. This person collaborates with squads/teams, technologies and architects across portfolios to develop a deep understanding of the technologies and systems they support.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborates to create product vision and alignment with strategic priorities with stakeholders. Contributes to the development of the portfolio vision. Communicates product and portfolio vision to their squad/team and other squads/teams outside their portfolio/functional area.
  • With the squad/team, collaboratively accountable for developing and achieving product level KPIs. Manages product(s) with a moderate degree of strategy, scope, and complexity.
  • Owns and maintains the product backlog and is accountable for its contents and prioritization. Accountable for clear, actionable user stories.
  • Sets priorities and actively participates in squad/team quarterly planning. Collaborates with more senior Product Owners to set priorities for portfolio quarterly planning.
  • Sets expectations with stakeholders for delivery of new capabilities, features, and functionalities. Participates in squad/team demos, retrospectives, and all other ceremonies.
  • Works daily with the agile working group, clarifying business requirements, removing roadblocks, constantly communicating, and supporting alignment around product strategy.
  • Collaborates with IT and business leadership to align development and business goals and priorities while working with stakeholders and squad/team to remove roadblocks to execution. Resolves open issues/questions quickly and efficiently.
  • Monitors and maintains the product health, supporting long-term product viability and efficiency, and balancing long and short term and costs withdesired outcomes.
  • Analyzes and reports on feasibility, cost of delay ramifications, economies, or other aspects of planned or potential changes to the product.
  • Understands regulatory, compliance, and other industry constraints on the product and prioritizes accordingly. Negotiates with internal and external squads/teams to ensure priorities are aligned across squads/teams both within and outside the portfolio.
  • Collaboratively builds the squad/team product roadmap, contributes to strategy inputs from stakeholders. May contribute to program/portfolio level planning. Influences stakeholder expectations for delivery of new capabilities, features, and functionalities.
  • Communicates expected value and any changes in value to be delivered in each iteration (sprint, monthly, quarterly, etc.) based on the squad/team-determined capacity.
  • Leads customer-driven design and usability testing for the squad/team. Collaborates on CDD and UT across the portfolio. Ensures a well-positioned product through market & industry analysis.

Ideal Candidate

  • Hands-on experience as a Product Owner (or equivalent) on an agile team, including backlog ownership, writing clear and actionable user stories, and quarterly planning.
  • Ability to translate complex business concepts into clear requirements that business and technology partners both understand.
  • Proven ability to influence and align stakeholders at multiple levels, including senior leaders, and to make quick, well-reasoned prioritization decisions.
  • Comfort working with data to size problems, evaluate trade-offs, and measure outcomes.
  • Property & casualty insurance experience, ideally in commercial lines pricing, rating, or rate filings.
  • Experience with pricing or rating platforms, or with large-scale platform migrations or modernization.
  • Familiarity with state regulatory and filing requirements and how they shape delivery timelines.

What success looks like

  • You are curious, collaborative, and resilient in ambiguity; you ask good questions, say no thoughtfully, and keep the squad focused on the most valuable work.

Qualifications

  • Knowledge of Agile development methodologies and IT project management as typically acquired through a Bachelors` degree in relevant field (business, computer science, humanities etc.) and a minimum of 3 to 5 years direct experience with agile teams as well as 7 years in business, technology, or consulting.
  • Able to depict and explain the importance of complex ideas, issues and designs to varied audiences; educate SBU/department(s) on business vision and plan and the impact of change.
  • Able to influence a diverse group of stakeholders; strong leadership skills.
  • Able to make difficult and quick decisions daily.
  • Strong problem solver with demonstrated ability to lead a team to push the solutions and progress.
  • Experience in the insurance industry preferred.
  • Knowledge of relevant products and portfolio preferred.
  • Strong experimental mindset to drive innovation amongst uncertainty.

About this job

Associate Attorney representing Liberty Mutual and policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation and workers' compensation matters involving claims for monetary damages or personal injury and property damage. Role is primarily remote in New Jersey with required in-person appearances.

Good fit if you have a New Jersey bar license, knowledge of insurance law, and can manage litigation cases from inception through resolution.

Full job description


Description

This role is primarily remote in the state of New Jersey except for required appearances.

At Liberty Mutual, were committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders rights and positively impacting our business. As an Associate Attorney at Liberty Mutual, youll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligibleperformance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If yourelooking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where youll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual Insurance offers an engaging opportunity for an Associate Attorney to represent the company and its policyholders in routine civil litigation and workers' compensation matters involving moderately complex legal issues and claims for monetary damages or compensation related to personal injury or property damage. Under moderate supervision, you will manage cases from inception through resolution, applying your legal knowledge, research skills, and client relationship capabilities in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Litigation Execution: Manage all phases of litigation, including discovery, hearings, trials, mediations, and drafting legal documents such as pleadings and motions. Support Senior Trial Counsel and Senior Litigation Counsel in all aspects of case handling through trial, including preparation, management, and assistance at every stage of the litigation process.
  • Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Provide clear and reasoned legal opinions and strategic advice to Claims Representatives and insured clients. Develop and maintain strong client relationships through transparent and effective communication.
  • Technology Utilization: Utilize e-discovery and case management technologies to streamline legal processes, improve efficiency, and reduce operational costs. Demonstrate effective coordination with remote team members and proficiency in remote work settings.
  • Risk Evaluation and Case Resolution Facilitation: Identify, evaluate, and collaborate on strategies to mitigate legal risks, working closely with clients and senior counsel to facilitate effective resolutions.
  • Documentation Accuracy and Compliance: Ensure all legal documents, pleadings, and motions are meticulously prepared, accurate, and compliant with applicable standards and client expectations.
  • Timely Client Communication: Provide clear, consistent, and timely updates and recommendations to insured clients and claims professionals to maintain alignment with case objectives.
  • Contribution to Organizational Improvement: Participate in initiatives aimed at enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and best practices within Staff Legal and Global Legal & Compliance organizations.
  • Ethical Compliance Adherence: Uphold the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance, following legal regulations and licensing requirements and promoting a culture of integrity within the legal team.
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in New Jersey and in good standing; special licenses to practice before particular boards or federal courts may be required.
  • General knowledge of insurance law, and as necessary, workers compensation and/or No Fault law.
  • Proficient in e-discovery, case management systems, and basic legal analysis tools.
  • Strong analytical, research, and legal writing skills.
  • Basic knowledge of negotiation techniques including preparation, active listening, and problem-solving.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cases from start to finish under supervision.
  • Effective communication and persuasion skills, both written and oral.
  • Ability to collaborate with clients, claims professionals, and senior attorneys.
  • Organized, process-oriented with strong time management skills.

Description

Come join the Specialty Product leadership team! Our team is focused on achieving profitable growth for USRM by building innovative products that meet evolving customer and agent needs. We are the profit and loss owners for the Specialty portfolio and strive to innovate, influence, and collaborate with every part of the business and regulators to help USRM reach its profitability and growth goals. We're seeking a Senior Director I, Product Management to oversee the P&L and long-term success of our Umbrella line of business. The Umbrella line is on a journey to overhaul our product to position us for long-term profitable growth.

Responsibilities:

Directly accountable for Umbrella profit and loss, including performance against plan.

Creates vision and strategy for Umbrella LOB including but not limited to target market, channel strategy and product features needed to attract customers.

Establishes objectives for Umbrella in terms of growth and profitability.

Develops, reviews, and implements strategies through the integration of the sales, service, underwriting, pricing and claims functions.

Collaborates within Product and other functional departments to maximize effectiveness of programs while maintaining compliance.

Monitors the market place and identifies competitor and industry changes impacting effectiveness or compliance of current programs.

Examines all relevant data and works with the appropriate teams to implement changes in pricing position, underwriting standards, sales growth, and claims handling.

Works with the various distribution channels across states to develop new business volume and quality standards and objectives, and to monitor the quality of new business sales results

Qualifications
  • Highly developed quantitative analysis and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills
  • Proven ability to influence other leaders across an organization 10+ years progressively responsible work experience in an analytically driven environment
  • Previous experience in consulting or call center / customer service analytics in insurance or financial services preferred but not required
  • MBA or advanced degree in quantitative field preferred but not required

Description

About this job

Lead a team of analysts monitoring auto insurance product performance, analyzing program launches, and identifying trends for Liberty Mutual's USRM division. The role includes responsibility for developing AI capabilities to expand monitoring across auto products.

Good fit if you have 6+ years of relevant experience, proficiency with Excel and data analysis software, and leadership experience managing teams.

Full job description


Description

We are looking for a Director I, Product Analysis to lead our Auto Product Monitoring team as part of the Auto Product Management and Execution team. This leader will partner with stakeholders to analyze and inform the latest Auto programs for USRM. This position offers the opportunity to be a key contributor to support USRM profit and growth goals and help shape current and future pricing programs. Through leading a team of analysts, you will be responsible for defining key metrics, analyzing & visualizing new product results, identifying key trends, maintaining communication & relationships with stakeholders across USRM, and informing future product rollouts. This position is also responsible for leading AI initiatives within Auto Monitoring space to expand the breadth and depth of our monitoring capabilities using AI.

Candidates that live within 50 miles of a main hub, this position is hybrid but also available to full time remote candidates who are located more than 50 miles from a main office hub.

Responsibilities:

Lead a team of analysts to provide in-depth analysis of state program launches and overall program performance

Provide coaching, feedback and development opportunities for team

Sign-off on the top-line monitoring (close ratio, premium levels, mix, et al) of a leading Personal Line Auto Product to ensure product launched with excellence and inform broader organization of initial product results.

Provides analysis & timely updates on product performance to key stakeholders including Director of State Operations, USRM Auto Leadership, Modeling, Risk Analytics, and fellow APME team members.

Builds new best-in-class processes, visuals, tools and approaches to understand preliminary market results

Utilize AI tools and capabilities to expand our breadth and depth of monitoring across our Auto products

Collaborates with Data Strategy & Reporting and the Data Office to ensure the proper monitoring datasets and reports are available Day 1.

Offers insights into the design and expectations of future product launches.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in business, economics, or other quantitative field.

Minimum 6 years, typically 8 years or more relevant work experience.

Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis software

Proficiency and understanding of AI use cases applied to the monitoring and analysis space

Must have strong planning, organization, analytical, decision-making and communication skills.

Leadership experience and directly managing others beneficial.

Prior Personal Lines Auto experience is a plus.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Workers' Compensation Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Ready to grow your career in a role that makes a meaningful impact? Liberty Mutual is hiring Workers' Compensation Claims Specialists in our Northeast Region to help injured workers navigate the claims process and return to work with confidence.

Were hiring across multiple levelsAssociate Claims Specialist, Claims Specialist I, and Claims Specialist IIdepending on your experience. The salary range posted reflects the varying pay scale across various locations.

In this role, youll manage a caseload of routine to moderately complex claims, making key decisions on compensability, evaluating losses, and negotiating fair outcomes. Youll collaborate closely with claimants, policyholders, attorneys, and partners throughout the claim lifecycle.

Training is a critical component of your success, and that success starts with reliable attendance and active engagement.Training will include 1 week of travel to our Plano, TX office in January.


This role is remote within the Northeast region. Candidates must reside in Connecticut, Delaware, Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, or Vermont.Candidates residing within 50 miles of our offices in Weatogue, Connecticut, or Westborough, Massachusetts, will be expected to work onsite up to two days per month.On-site expectations may evolve based on business needs.

Responsibilities

  • Manages an inventory of claims to evaluate compensability/liability.
  • Establishes action plans based on case facts, best practices, protocols, regulatory issues, and available resources.
  • Plans and conducts investigations of claims to confirm coverage and to determine liability, compensability, and damages.
  • Assesses policy coverage for submitted claims and notifies the insured of any issues; determines and establishes reserve requirements, adjusting reserves as necessary, during the processing of the claims, and refers claims to the subrogation group or Special Investigations Unit as appropriate.
  • Assesses actual damages associated with claims and conducts negotiations, within assigned authority limits, to settle claims.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
  • Effective interpersonal, analytical and negotiation abilities required
  • Ability to provide information in a clear, concise manner with an appropriate level of detail
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain effective relationships
  • Demonstrated success in a professional environment; success in a customer service/retail environment preferred
  • Effective analytical skills to gather information, analyze facts, and draw conclusions; as normally acquired through a bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Knowledge of legal liability, insurance coverage and medical terminology helpful, but not mandatory
  • Licensing may be required in some states

As part of the application process, you'll complete an assessment related to the skills needed for this role please allow approximately 35 minutes, although there is no time limit

About this job

Senior Technical Claims Specialist managing complex environmental, pollution, and toxic tort claims for Liberty Mutual's Commercial Specialty Lines. Role includes full claim lifecycle ownership from coverage analysis through litigation management and settlement.

Good fit if you have 5-7 years commercial casualty claims experience including environmental or pollution claims and mass litigation or toxic tort background.

Full job description


Description

Join a Growing Team and Tackle Some of the Industry's Most Complex Environmental Claims

Liberty Mutual is expanding our Environmental Claims team and seeking an experienced Environmental Claims Professional to manage high-exposure environmental, pollution, toxic tort, and mass litigation claims within our Commercial Specialty Lines portfolio! This is an excellent opportunity for a seasoned claims professional who thrives in complex coverage and liability analysis, enjoys collaborating with legal and industry experts, and is looking to make a meaningful impact at a Fortune 100 carrier known for its financial strength, innovation, and commitment to customer advocacy. In this role of Senior Technical Claims Specialist, you will exercise significant judgment and ownership throughout the entire claim lifecycle, from coverage analysis and investigation through litigation management, negotiation, and resolution. You'll partner closely with policyholders, brokers, reinsurers, underwriting, and defense counsel while helping shape outcomes on some of our most challenging and technically sophisticated claims.

Why this role

Youll own complex environmental casualty claims from first notice through resolution, with real authority to decide coverage, set reserves, negotiate, and settle. This is not a hand-off role. Youll make the calls, direct the strategy, and be recognized internally as a subject matter expert on pollution and specialty coverage issues.

What youll do

  • Own the claim end to end. Determine coverage, investigate, assess liability, set and adjust reserves, evaluate exposure, negotiate settlements, and authorize payment. Youll also have the authority to deny claims when the facts and policy language support it.
  • Drive litigation strategy. Review pleadings, claim files, and investigation materials, then set the plan to resolve each suit, including coverage positions, amounts owed, discovery plans, and negotiation approach.
  • Build the right team for each matter. Based on the allegations, assemble the working group of Home Office Legal, defense counsel, and Home Office Claims, and bring in technical resources such as environmental consultants where needed.
  • Manage outside counsel. Oversee defense counsels strategy, practices, and billing so spend stays aligned with outcomes.
  • Protect the claim and the data. Maintain the integrity of financial processing and the security of confidential information in claim files.
  • Mentor and partner. Coach colleagues and serve as the claims liaison to Underwriting, Reinsurance, and other business partners.
  • Stay ahead of the law. Track legislation, court decisions, and trends affecting pollution and other specialty coverages, and advise Claims Management on any impact to claims policies and procedures.
  • Contribute beyond your desk. Participate in special projects that shape how the team works.

What we offer

  • Meaningful settlement authority and ownership of your files
  • Complex, high-impact work with direct access to Legal, Underwriting, and Reinsurance
  • Opportunities to mentor others and grow into subject matter expert or leadership roles
  • Flexible work arrangements. Liberty Mutual follows hybrid work arrangements and team members within a 50-mile radius of one of our hub offices (Westborough, MA; Boston, MA; Weatogue, CT; Suwanee, GA; Plano, TX; Hoffman Estates, IL; Indianapolis, IN; Lake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Chandler, AZ) are expected to work from the office approximately two times per month. We will also consider highly qualified remote candidates who do not reside near a hub location.
Qualifications

What you bring

Required

  • 5-7 years of commercial casualty claims experience, including environmental or pollution claims handling
  • Proven ability to handle complex, litigated matters independently, including coverage analysis, reserving, and settlement negotiation
  • Strong command of environmental coverage issues, such as pollution legal liability, CGL pollution exclusions, and third-party bodily injury and property damage from contamination
  • Experience managing defense counsel and consultants
  • Excellent analytical, negotiation, and communication skills
  • Advanced Environmental Claims and/or Pollution Claims experience preferred
  • Experience with mass litigation and/or toxic tort required
  • Ability to obtain/maintain All-Lines Adjuster License

Nice to have

  • Experience with Superfund/CERCLA, remediation oversight, or environmental site claims
  • Background in law, environmental science, engineering, or a related field, or a professional designation (e.g., CPCU, AIC)
  • Experience handling construction defect, toxic tort, or other complex specialty lines

  • Stay ahead of the law. Track legislation, court decisions, and trends affecting pollution and other specialty coverages, and advise Claims Management on any impact to claims policies and procedures.
  • Contribute beyond your desk. Participate in special projects that shape how the team works.

What we offer

  • Meaningful settlement authority and ownership of your files
  • Complex, high-impact work with direct access to Legal, Underwriting, and Reinsurance
  • Opportunities to mentor others and grow into subject matter expert or leadership roles
  • Flexible work arrangements. Liberty Mutual follows hybrid work arrangements and team members within a 50-mile radius of one of our hub offices (Westborough, MA; Boston, MA; Weatogue, CT; Suwanee, GA; Plano, TX; Hoffman Estates, IL; Indianapolis, IN; Lake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Chandler, AZ) are expected to work from the office approximately two times per month. We will also consider highly qualified remote candidates who do not reside near a hub location.
Qualifications

What you bring

Required

  • 5-7 years of commercial casualty claims experience, including environmental or pollution claims handling
  • Proven ability to handle complex, litigated matters independently, including coverage analysis, reserving, and settlement negotiation
  • Strong command of environmental coverage issues, such as pollution legal liability, CGL pollution exclusions, and third-party bodily injury and property damage from contamination
  • Experience managing defense counsel and consultants
  • Excellent analytical, negotiation, and communication skills
  • Advanced Environmental Claims and/or Pollution Claims experience preferred
  • Experience with mass litigation and/or toxic tort required
  • Ability to obtain/maintain All-Lines Adjuster License

Nice to have

  • Experience with Superfund/CERCLA, remediation oversight, or environmental site claims
  • Background in law, environmental science, engineering, or a related field, or a professional designation (e.g., CPCU, AIC)
  • Experience handling construction defect, toxic tort, or other complex specialty lines

Job.JobTitle: Senior Underwriter, Contractors Environmental & Professional Liability
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Philadelphia, PA
  • Experience: 3 to 5 years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Senior Underwriter role in Liberty Mutual's Environmental Construction Unit underwriting contractors pollution and professional liability policies. Responsibilities include reviewing submissions, analyzing exposures, pricing risk, managing broker relationships, and developing profitable business within underwriting authority.

Good fit if you have 3-5 years of contractors pollution or professional liability underwriting or brokerage experience and strong analytical skills.

Full job description


Description

Join a dynamic, collaborative team focused on helping contractors manage some of their most complex environmental and professional liability risks. In this role, youll evaluate unique exposures, develop thoughtful insurance solutions, and work closely with brokers, clients, claims partners, and internal stakeholders to deliver meaningful value. This is an opportunity to combine technical expertise with commercial judgment. Youll review submissions, analyze operations and contracts, assess pollution and professional liability exposures, evaluate loss history, and structure terms that support both customer needs and a strong, sustainable portfolio. Because every account is different, the work is varied and requires curiosity, creativity, and a willingness to think beyond standard solutions. Youll have the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals, contribute to important decisions, build trusted relationships while maintaining a strong focus on technical excellence and customer service.

The Environmental Division of Liberty Mutual is seeking a Sr. Underwriter to produce and maintain a profitable book of Contractors Environmental Legal Liability (CELL) and Designers & Contractors Professional Liability (DCPL) business in our Environmental Construction Unit (ECU). Responsibilities would include underwriting contractor pollution and professional policies within underwriting authority with limited guidance from leadership. As well as make decisions on whether to underwrite business by making analytical, data-driven decisions based on data and information provided, including pricing the risk.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leverage market presence and knowledge to develop and underwrite profitable business.
  • Handle a substantial environmental pollution book of business.
  • Gather underwriting information, review, analyze, price and document, new and assigned renewal Contractors Pollution Liability and combined form Pollution / Professional business subject to established Underwriting Guidelines.
  • Prepare quotes and binders and review policies and endorsements for accuracy.
  • Manage portfolio of brokers/agents and clients.
  • Develop and support marketing strategies to increase submission flow (will require limited travel)
  • Provide exceptional service to brokers by following workflow procedures on new and renewal business in order to achieve production goals and service goals (policy issuance and file documentation).
  • Drive new business submission and premium growth through strategic sales and marketing efforts with our broker partners and internal cross-sell initiatives with other profit centers

Qualifications
  • Bachelors degree required; environmental science or similar degree preferred
  • 3-5 years of Contractors Pollution Liability and combined form Pollution / Professional Liability underwriting experience with an environmental insurance company, or 3-5 years of brokerage experience placing Contractors Pollution Liability and combined form Pollution / Professional Liability policies.
  • Excellent analytical and quantitative skills.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Initiative and ability to work independently.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across teams, stakeholders, and partners.
About Us

The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Description

Join a dynamic, collaborative team focused on helping contractors manage some of their most complex environmental and professional liability risks. In this role, youll evaluate unique exposures, develop thoughtful insurance solutions, and work closely with brokers, clients, claims partners, and internal stakeholders to deliver meaningful value. This is an opportunity to combine technical expertise with commercial judgment. Youll review submissions, analyze operations and contracts, assess pollution and professional liability exposures, evaluate loss history, and structure terms that support both customer needs and a strong, sustainable portfolio. Because every account is different, the work is varied and requires curiosity, creativity, and a willingness to think beyond standard solutions. Youll have the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals, contribute to important decisions, build trusted relationships while maintaining a strong focus on technical excellence and customer service.

The Environmental Division of Liberty Mutual is seeking a Sr. Underwriter to produce and maintain a profitable book of Contractors Environmental Legal Liability (CELL) and Designers & Contractors Professional Liability (DCPL) business in our Environmental Construction Unit (ECU). Responsibilities would include underwriting contractor pollution and professional policies within underwriting authority with limited guidance from leadership. As well as make decisions on whether to underwrite business by making analytical, data-driven decisions based on data and information provided, including pricing the risk.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leverage market presence and knowledge to develop and underwrite profitable business.
  • Handle a substantial environmental pollution book of business.
  • Gather underwriting information, review, analyze, price and document, new and assigned renewal Contractors Pollution Liability and combined form Pollution / Professional business subject to established Underwriting Guidelines.
  • Prepare quotes and binders and review policies and endorsements for accuracy.
  • Manage portfolio of brokers/agents and clients.
  • Develop and support marketing strategies to increase submission flow (will require limited travel)
  • Provide exceptional service to brokers by following workflow procedures on new and renewal business in order to achieve production goals and service goals (policy issuance and file documentation).
  • Drive new business submission and premium growth through strategic sales and marketing efforts with our broker partners and internal cross-sell initiatives with other profit centers

Qualifications
  • Bachelors degree required; environmental science or similar degree preferred
  • 3-5 years of Contractors Pollution Liability and combined form Pollution / Professional Liability underwriting experience with an environmental insurance company, or 3-5 years of brokerage experience placing Contractors Pollution Liability and combined form Pollution / Professional Liability policies.
  • Excellent analytical and quantitative skills.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Initiative and ability to work independently.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across teams, stakeholders, and partners.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Plano, TX
  • Benefits: 401(k), tuition assistance

About this job

Liberty Mutual's Claims Specialist Program develops entry-level professionals to investigate claims, review evidence, and resolve cases. The program includes comprehensive training, one-on-one mentoring, and a pay-for-performance structure at a Fortune 100 company.

Good fit if you have 0-2 years of professional experience, strong analytical and negotiation skills, and permanent work authorization in the US.

Full job description


Description

Claims Specialist Program


Are you looking to help people and make a difference in the world? Have you considered a position in the fast-paced, rewarding world of insurance? Yes, insurance!

Insurance brings peace of mind to almost everything we do in our livesfrom family trips to your first car to weddings and college graduations. As a valued member of our claims team, youll help our customers get back on their feet and restore their lives when catastrophe strikes.


The details

Whenyoure part of the Claims Specialist Program, youll acquire various investigative techniques and work with experts to determine what caused an accident and who is at fault.

Youll independently manage an inventory of claims, which may include conducting investigations, reviewing medical records, and evaluating damages to determine the severity of each case. Youllresolve cases by working with individuals or attorneys to settle on the value of each case.

You will have required comprehensive training, one-on-one mentoring, and a strong pay-for-performance compensation structure at a global Fortune 100 company. Make a difference in the world with Liberty Mutual.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Sterling Heights, MI
  • Experience: 1+ year

About this job

Field Property Claims Adjuster for Liberty Mutual in Sterling Heights, Michigan. You will investigate property damage claims, meet customers on-site, prepare repair estimates, and manage claims from initial report to closure. Travel locally within assigned territory. Comprehensive 5-month training program provided.

Good fit if you have at least 1 year of claims handling experience, strong customer service skills, knowledge of building construction, and can live near Sterling Heights.

Full job description


Description

Join us as a Field Property Claims Adjuster where youll be responsible for helping our customers navigate the claims process and get back on their feet following damage to the homeowners property. This is a role where people who love every day to be new, different and exciting, can thrive youll be traveling on the road to meet customers in person, providing hands-on assessment of damage and empathetic support.

The Field Property Claims Adjuster will be traveling locally to insured homes within Sterling Heights, MI (48310) and surrounding areas. To be successful within the role, candidates should live within or near this area.

Sign-On Bonus Available! Were offering a sign-on bonus for experienced and actively licensed new hires.

What youll do

  • Investigate and evaluate onsite to resolve complex coverage and damage issues to include preparing complete estimates of repair for the covered damages. This may include accessing roofs by ladder, inspecting attics, crawl spaces and basements in search of damage.
  • Handle moderate to complex claims independently while managing your workload, from first notice of loss to final closure.
  • Be expected to work in a vehicle in the field daily while occasionally handling assignments from the desk.
  • Explain coverage of loss, assist policyholders with itemization of damages, emergency repairs and additional living arrangements.
  • Work with and coordinate a few vendor services such as contractors, emergency repair, cleaning services and various replacement services.
  • May be called upon for catastrophe duty.

Position details

  • Territory-based work:Most workdays will be spent in the field within your assigned local territory, giving you the opportunity to work directly with customers and gain hands-on experience.

  • Training & support:To set you up for success, youll participate in a comprehensive 5-month training program, which includes:
    • Primarily virtual and on-the-job learning.
    • Two short in-person training sessions (Weeks 4 and 7) at our Lewisville, TX office.
    • Limited overnight travel for training and team meetings (typically less than 10%).

  • Mileage Reimbursement:This role offers mileage reimbursement. You may qualify for a company-provided vehicle once mileage requirements are met. Additional details will be provided if you advance in the selection process.
Qualifications
  • Working knowledge of claims handling procedures and operations.
  • Proven ability to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Effective negotiation skills.
  • Ability to effectively and independently manage workload while exhibiting good judgment.
  • Strong written/oral communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Computer skills with the ability to work with multi-faceted systems.
  • The capabilities, skills and knowledge required through a bachelors degree or equivalent experience and at least 1 year of directly related experience.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.
  • The ability to handle multiple competing priorities and organize your day.
  • Strong time management and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated understanding of building construction principles.

About this job

Manager who will translate the CFO's vision into Finance transformation initiatives, managing cross-functional projects that modernize reporting, analytics, and planning capabilities. Focus areas include process improvement, technology modernization with Anaplan and Power BI, and implementing automation and AI solutions.

Good fit if you have 7+ years in FP&A or finance transformation, experience leading cross-functional projects, and strong understanding of finance technology platforms.

Full job description


Description

Manager Enterprise FP&A Job Summary

This role will help advance the CFO's long-term vision for Finance by translating strategic priorities into practical, technology-enabled solutions and supporting their implementation across the broader Finance organization. Reporting to the Director of Enterprise FP&A, the individual will play an important role in coordinating and executing a multi-year transformation of how Finance plans, analyzes, and reports financial and operational performance, with a focus on building more integrated, efficient, and forward-looking capabilities.

The role requires a combination of financial acumen, strong project management skills, technology fluency, and an ability to collaborate effectively across teams. Working closely with Enterprise FP&A leadership and broader Finance stakeholders, the individual will help translate future-state objectives into actionable project plans, coordinate cross-functional initiatives, and support the delivery of solutions from initial concept through implementation and adoption.

Key areas of focus include modernizing management reporting and performance analytics, improving connectivity across strategic, capital, and financial planning, and exploring opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and emerging technologies. The individual will work closely with Finance Transformation & Enablement, SBU FP&A teams, Capital Management, and aligned data and technology teams to translate Finance business needs into clear requirements and coordinate the delivery of scalable solutions.

Success in this role will depend on the ability to bring structure to complex initiatives, build productive working relationships, proactively identify and resolve challenges, and support the adoption of new capabilities across Finance. With the guidance and sponsorship of Finance leadership, the individual will help move transformation priorities forward and deliver measurable improvements in Finance's efficiency, analytical capabilities, and decision support.

Job Responsibilities

  1. Support the translation of the CFO's vision for Finance into actionable transformation initiatives, working with Enterprise FP&A leadership and other stakeholders to understand future-state objectives, assess current capabilities, identify opportunities for improvement, and develop practical plans to advance agreed-upon priorities.
  2. Manage cross-functional transformation projects and workstreams from initial planning through implementation and adoption. Establish project plans, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and stakeholder responsibilities; coordinate execution across teams; proactively identify risks and issues; and work with leadership to resolve challenges and keep initiatives on track.
  3. Partner with Finance stakeholders to build alignment and support organizational change, engaging SBU Finance, Capital Management, Finance Transformation & Enablement, and other teams to understand business needs, incorporate diverse perspectives, facilitate discussions, and build support for agreed-upon solutions and new ways of working.
  4. Support the advancement of the Enterprise's long-term planning capabilities, collaborating with SBU FP&A, Capital Management, Planning & Analytics, Product Owners, and the Anaplan Community of Practice to improve connectivity across strategic, capital, and financial planning, expand scenario analysis, and develop more integrated and scalable planning processes.
  5. Coordinate initiatives to modernize management reporting and performance analytics, partnering with Finance and technology teams to improve the integration of financial, operational, and external data; streamline the production of management information; and strengthen Finance's ability to deliver insights that support executive decision-making.
  6. Identify and help implement opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and emerging technologies to improve Finance workflows, reduce manual and repetitive activities, strengthen analytical capabilities, and create additional capacity for forward-looking analysis and business decision support.
  7. Track and communicate transformation progress and business impact, maintaining visibility into project milestones, deliverables, risks, and outcomes. Prepare updates for Finance leadership, identify opportunities for continuous improvement, and help measure the benefits of implemented solutions.
Qualifications
  • Strong background in FP&A, finance transformation, or a related finance role, with experience across planning, forecasting, management reporting, performance analysis, and executive decision support.
  • Demonstrated process improvement mindset, with experience redesigning workflows, simplifying processes, and reducing manual or low-value work.
  • Strong understanding of finance technology and data capabilities, ideally including Anaplan, Power BI, Excel, automation, and emerging AI tools.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects from problem definition and solution design through implementation, adoption, and measurement of results.
  • Ability to translate Finance business needs into clear process, data, reporting, and technology requirements for technical partners.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build alignment across Finance, data, technology, and transformation teams without direct authority.
  • Analytical, intellectually curious, and change-oriented, with a track record of challenging existing ways of working and delivering measurable business impact.
  • Minimum of 7 years of relevant experience.

Job.JobTitle: Director, Business Transformation - Liberty Mutual Investments
Job.JobDescription:
Description

The Company

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is the investment firm for Liberty Mutual Group (Liberty) andis responsible forpowering Libertys strategy amid profoundchangein global capital markets. With deep expertise in fixed income, equity, and alternative strategies,LMI invests $120+ billion (as of 12/31/2025) of capital globally,taking a long-term approach across its integrated platform and has a team of over 350investment, finance, and operations professionals located in Boston, MA, and New York, NY.

LMI has a clear purpose: build enduring businesses side-by-side with our partners, drive economic growth, and generate superior risk-adjusted returns that power Libertys strategy and secure its promises.Weoffer the best of both worlds the look and feel of a boutique investment firm with the reputation and financial strength of a global leader. As the investment firm of a mutual with long-term capital, LMI has a single client mandate. This gives us the freedom to focus on what we do best.

Our portfolio spans a broad spectrum of public and private investments, and we are committed to expanding our capabilities and our toolkit in support of our mission. We invest across diverse asset classes, financial structures, and industries, including real estate, digital infrastructure, healthcare, renewable energy, and technologywith the aim of creating value and powering innovation. We pride ourselves on our extensive network of mutually beneficial partnerships, and we use our substantial influence, capital, and energy to drive towards a better future.#LMI #LI-LMI

The Position:

The Business Transformation team serves as LMI's operating model and process design capability. Reporting to the Head of Business Transformation, this role serves as a strategic partner to senior leaders across the enterprise, helping design the operating models, governance structures and business capabilities that enable execution of LMIs 2030 strategy. The role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, with depth in operating model and process design and a bias toward enabling near-term execution while shaping long-term direction. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable facilitating executive workshops, assessing complex investment lifecycles, designing governance frameworks, developing business capabilities and leading implementation efforts that deliver measurable business outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Lead enterprise design engagements. Lead complex, cross-functional engagements from discovery through implementation. Frame problems, align stakeholders, develop recommendations, and translate strategic objectives into operating models, roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Partner across Strategy & Execution. Operate within GIS Strategy & Execution, which brings together Business Transformation, Program Management, and Vendor Management. Lead both standalone organizational design engagements and serve as the embedded design partner on Program Management-governed programs, contributing operating model, capability, and governance design within a shared delivery model.
  • Design target operating models. Develop target operating models that define operating processes, governance frameworks, decision rights, roles and responsibilities, and accountability models across investment and operational functions, including the organizational structures that support them.
  • Drive process and business architecture. Assess and mature business capabilities and the processes that run them across the enterprise, identifying gaps, dependencies, and opportunities to improve scalability, efficiency, and operational effectiveness. Establish capability-based frameworks that support strategic planning and prioritization.
  • Assess and optimize investment operations. Conduct end-to-end assessments of investment processes and operating workflows across public and private market asset classes. Identify root causes of operational challenges and develop practical, scalable solutions.
  • Establish governance and performance frameworks. Define governance structures, success metrics, KPIs, reporting cadences, and operating routines that enable sustainable execution, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Facilitate executive alignment. Lead workshops, working sessions, and stakeholder engagements that bring together diverse perspectives, build alignment, and accelerate decision-making across teams.
  • Advance AI-enabled ways of working. Identify and scale opportunities to apply AI-enabled tools and methods across the function, improving how engagements are delivered and enabling faster, more scalable analysis and design.
  • Bring external perspective and industry insight. Monitor industry trends, emerging operating models, technology innovations, and leading practices across asset management and financial services to inform strategic recommendations and future-state design.
Qualifications
  • 10+ years in asset management, investment operations, process design, operating model design, business architecture, or management consulting, with at least 3 years owning complex engagements end-to-end through a structured methodology.
  • Direct experience working in or advising asset management, institutional investing, insurance investment management, or investment operations organizations.
  • Deep understanding of institutional asset management and investment operations, including front-, middle-, and back-office operating models.
  • Experience supporting public and private market investment businesses, including credit, structured products, private markets, limited partnerships, alternatives, or related investment strategies.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex initiatives with enterprise-wide impact.
  • Experience designing and implementing operating models, governance structures, organizational frameworks, capability models, or large-scale business process redesigns.
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI-enabled tools applied to delivery work, such as synthesizing interview readouts, drafting process maps and operating model artifacts, and generating RACIs and other structured deliverables.
  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and facilitate alignment across competing priorities.
  • Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, solve complex problems, and drive measurable results.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience within a leading asset manager, insurance investment organization, institutional investment platform, or top-tier consulting firm serving investment management clients.
  • Expertise in business architecture, capability modeling, organizational design, operating model design, or enterprise methodologies.
  • Experience supporting strategic initiatives involving operating model modernization, business capability development, data transformation, product operating models, investment platform modernization, or organizational redesign.
  • Familiarity with investment platforms and technologies such as SimCorp, Aladdin, Anaplan, eFront, EDM, Wall Street Office, Moody's, or related systems.
  • Advanced degree in Business, Finance, Organizational Effectiveness, Strategy, or a related discipline.
  • Most transformation roles stop at strategy or org charts. We design how an entire investment organization operates and then help put it into practice.
  • You will work across investment teams, operations, finance, product, data and technology to solve some of LMIs most complex strategic challenges, from defining target operating models for emerging asset classes to establishing governance frameworks for enterprise-wide initiatives.
  • The team works from a codified methodology, including a target operating model playbook, a capability evolution playbook and a 26-deliverable framework for operating model engagements, so design work is rigorous and repeatable rather than reinvented for each engagement. Your work will directly influence how LMI scales, executes and competes in the years ahead. If you are energized by solving complex organizational problems, shaping enterprise strategy and building the operating models that enable investment organizations to perform at their best, we encourage you to apply.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role.   • Experience designing and implementing operating models, governance structures, organizational frameworks, capability models, or large-scale business process redesigns.
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI-enabled tools applied to delivery work, such as synthesizing interview readouts, drafting process maps and operating model artifacts, and generating RACIs and other structured deliverables.
  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and facilitate alignment across competing priorities.
  • Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, solve complex problems, and drive measurable results.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience within a leading asset manager, insurance investment organization, institutional investment platform, or top-tier consulting firm serving investment management clients.
  • Expertise in business architecture, capability modeling, organizational design, operating model design, or enterprise methodologies.
  • Experience supporting strategic initiatives involving operating model modernization, business capability development, data transformation, product operating models, investment platform modernization, or organizational redesign.
  • Familiarity with investment platforms and technologies such as SimCorp, Aladdin, Anaplan, eFront, EDM, Wall Street Office, Moody's, or related systems.
  • Advanced degree in Business, Finance, Organizational Effectiveness, Strategy, or a related discipline.
  • Most transformation roles stop at strategy or org charts. We design how an entire investment organization operates and then help put it into practice.
  • You will work across investment teams, operations, finance, product, data and technology to solve some of LMIs most complex strategic challenges, from defining target operating models for emerging asset classes to establishing governance frameworks for enterprise-wide initiatives.
  • The team works from a codified methodology, including a target operating model playbook, a capability evolution playbook and a 26-deliverable framework for operating model engagements, so design work is rigorous and repeatable rather than reinvented for each engagement. Your work will directly influence how LMI scales, executes and competes in the years ahead. If you are energized by solving complex organizational problems, shaping enterprise strategy and building the operating models that enable investment organizations to perform at their best, we encourage you to apply.

This Role Is For Southern California

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income potential for earnings growth over time.

  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.

We are looking for an Insurance Sales Associate to join our team in our Peoria and Chandler offices. This is not a remote position.

Were Hiring Immediately!

As an Insurance Sales Associate, you will work alongside with and support a Comparion Insurance Sales Agent in profitable growth through new business sales and customer retention. Your ability to listen and empathize are key in being the initial contact for our customers. Job.CustomJobTypeName: Personal Lines Underwriter, Underwriting, Insurance Underwriter
Job.JobDescription:
We are seeking a Personal Lines Underwriter who is responsible for making decisions on the acceptability of insurance risks through the application of various underwriting and risk selection techniques. This position also assists in the management of assigned agents.

This is a hybrid role reporting to the Harrisburg, PA office.

POSITION COMPETENCIES

  • Business Acumen
  • Negotiation
  • Results Oriented
  • Time & Priority Management
  • Decision Making

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Communicate underwriting decisions, techniques, and interpretation of policy forms and coverages with agents.
  • Document the underwriting file for all referred risks, including the actions taken, reasons for exception made, and any follow-up diary needed.
  • Communicate to the Underwriting Manager and Territory Manager any underwriting quality or integrity concerns with individual agents.
  • Provide input to the Branch Management team about individual agency underwriting performance. (i.e., Agency Review meeting, Quarterly Results Management meeting, etc.).
  • Provides underwriting and marketing philosophy or practices, to agents and assist with training issues within agency, making periodic physical visits.
  • Maintains documentation on risk exceptions and large losses based on certain agency-specific or policy specific information.
  • Identify product risks and recommend solutions to mitigate those risks. Advise Underwriting Manager on recommended risk reduction actions and solutions.
  • Exercise underwriting flexibility within the scope of authority in making appropriate exceptions, as warranted, based on agency relationships, results and Company strategies.
  • Leverage exceptions to achieve additional business opportunities from agencies.
  • Apply underwriting and risk selection techniques to determine the acceptability of new and renewal insurance risk referrals.
  • Conduct re-underwriting programs for selected agencies to improve the profitability of their books of business.
  • Complete Claim referrals.
  • Communicate underwriting and marketing philosophy or practices, to agents and assist with training issues within agency, making periodic physical visits.
  • Conduct special re-underwriting programs in conjunction with Branch and/or Home Office Management team[s] for selected agencies to improve the profitability of their books of business.
  • Provide support for prospective book transfers, including the gathering of policy, product, and underwriting information about a book transfer opportunity.
  • Ensure the proper risk placement and/or classification for referrals, to obtain adequate premium for the exposure.
  • Visits agents as necessary independently or jointly with other PNAT staff members.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Applies data to solve common business problems.
  • Compiles, manipulates and analyses data of varying complexity.
  • Knowledgeable and proficient about what tools are available for data analysis and when they are appropriate to use.
  • Contribute to the training/mentoring of the Underwriter Trainee.
  • Contribute to the development of company underwriting policy, procedures and guidelines to assure they reflect current market conditions and contribute to the attainment of Division goals.
  • Work independently within established standards.
  • Respond to Insurance Department complaints and attend periodic hearings.
  • Performs other duties as may be assigned by the Personal Lines Underwriting Manager.

SPECIAL RELATIONSHIPS

  • Daily contact with agents and periodic physical visits to agency. Develop and maintain ongoing strong positive relationships with agents.
  • Maintain a strong communication with Territory Manager to keep them abreast of agency interactions. Contributes to the development of unit and agency plans, enforcement of the objectives and monitoring of results to assure they reflect attainment of goals and current market conditions.
  • Interacts with internal customers, external customers and insurance related entities, ie., Department of Insurance.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Credentials

  • 4 - year degree preferred.
  • Continuing education in specialized insurance courses such as IIA & AU preferred

Experience

  • Completion of Underwriter Trainee curriculum; or a minimum of 1 year experience in a property/casualty underwriting position such as a Personal Lines Assistant Underwriter.

Technical/Professional Knowledge

  • Good working knowledge of underwriting and pricing risks
  • Good working knowledge of company underwriting standards and philosophy
  • Good working knowledge of all insurance coverages
  • Good math aptitude
  • Excellent research, analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Good PC skills, with an emphasis on Microsoft Office Suite; along with demonstrated proficiency in all supplied desktop tools, including the automated underwriting and email systems

The compensation has been carefully determined by considering a variety of important factors, including skill sets, experience, training, and certifications. With these considerations in mind, the estimated hiring range is $60,000 - $83,000. Additionally, you may be able to participate in our annual incentive program, depending on eligibility under the plan.

JOB REQUIREMENTS (as required by ADA - Americans with Disabilities Act)

  • This position is primarily a sedentary position that requires occasional standing and walking throughout the office environment.
  • Must be able to perform computer-based tasks and access digital information necessary for job duties, including through the use of assistive technologies.
  • Must be able to complete computer-based tasks and utilize office equipment as needed to perform essential job functions.
  • Must be able to access and enter information accurately using automated systems.
  • Must be able to communicate effectively with internal and external clients using telephone, electronic, or other communication systems.
  • Must be able to present information to individuals and groups.
  • Must be able to interpret and apply concepts that may or may not be based upon established guidelines.
  • Must be able to maintain acceptable attendance and adhere to scheduled work hours.
  • Must have a valid driver's license and be able to operate a motor vehicle.
  • Must be able to travel, with overnight stays required.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Workers' Compensation Adjuster, Claims, Claims Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $75,000 to $103,000 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Harrisburg, PA
  • Experience: 5+ years
  • License: Valid driver's license

About this job

Investigates and settles workers' compensation claims while identifying subrogation and recovery opportunities. Hybrid role based in Harrisburg, Pittsburgh, or Waukesha, requiring minimum 5 years of workers' compensation experience and an adjuster's license.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in workers' compensation claims and strong negotiation and communication skills.

Full job description

The Senior Claims Representative investigates, evaluates and disposes of assigned workers' compensation claims in a timely manner in order to achieve best practices type settlements within legal statutes, policy provisions and Company and/or client guidelines.

Candidates may reside in any of the approved hiring markets, provided they can report to our Harrisburg, PA, Pittsburgh, PA or Waukesha, WI office on a hybrid basis.

POSITION COMPETENCIES

  • Business Acumen
  • Negotiation
  • Results Oriented
  • Time & Priority Management

ESSENTIAL DUTIES

  • Initiates self-development and training, in order to improve upon, maintain or acquire skills prescribed as promoting professional and personal growth in claims handling
  • Properly identifies and pursues subrogation, contribution and salvage opportunities when available, in order to reduce or recover the amount of payment.
  • Uses appropriate, tactful and complete communications, in order to ease negotiations, develop rapport and project a positive corporate and personal image.
  • The ability to handle claims involving more complex coverage and liability issues; may also require attendance at civil proceedings or workers compensation hearings.
  • Develops claims files from initial assignment to disposition.
  • Prepares claim file documentation accurately and completely in order to justify all actions taken and to provide an effective audit trail.
  • Achieves a best practices type settlement in the disposition of claims.
  • May participate as a member of a Claims Catastrophe Team
  • May act as a supervisor of a Claims Catastrophe Team
  • Completes actions on a timely basis, such as verifying coverages, setting or adjusting reserves, making appropriate contacts.
  • Collaborates with Team Leader, Manager and Home Office as necessary to develop case strategy, moving the investigation along and disposing of the claim, in order to keep management, claimants, insureds and other interested parties satisfied that effective efforts are being made toward claim settlement.
  • Performs other duties as may be assigned by the Reporting managers listed above.

SPECIAL RELATIONSHIPS

  • In Penn National Insurance, these positions report to the Team Leader; Team Leader or CSO Manager
  • Direct contact with branch underwriting and/or claims service office personnel;
  • Direct contact with Home Office claims personnel;
  • Direct contact with agents, insureds, claimants, medical and legal professionals, appraisers and independent adjusters.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Credentials

  • Continuing education in insurance-related courses such as IIA Certificate in General Insurance, Senior Claims Law Associate, and Associate in Claims courses and/or Workers' Compensation courses (PA 10, 11, 12 ,and 13) preferred
  • Associate's degree in Claims and/or Senior Claims Law Associate designations preferred
  • Adjuster's license or be willing to obtain one as required

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in workers' compensation claims handling

Technical/Professional Knowledge

  • Must have a good understanding of tort and state laws applicable to assigned claims, the Unfair Claims Settlement Act and insurance policy coverages and provisions
  • Must have a good understanding of terminology applicable to assigned claims; i.e., medical, legal, automotive and construction terminology
  • Good communication skills, both oral and written
  • Good inter-personal skills
  • Good negotiation skills
  • Good customer service skills
  • Good analysis and evaluation skills
  • Good decision-making skills
  • Must have a strong sense of urgency
  • Good PC skills, with an emphasis on Microsoft Office Products
  • Good planning and organization skills
  • Must be able to work independently as well as a member of a team

The compensation has been carefully determined by considering a variety of important factors, including skill sets, experience, training, and certifications. With these considerations in mind, the estimated hiring range is $75,000 - $103,000. Additionally, you may be able to participate in our annual incentive program, depending on eligibility under the plan.

  • Must be able to maintain acceptable attendance and adhere to scheduled work hours.
  • Must have a valid driver's license and be able to operate a motor vehicle.
  • Must be able to travel, with overnight stays required.

About this job

Liaison between Penn National Insurance and commercial lines agents in Maryland, managing agent relationships and supporting profitable growth. Responsibilities include agency prospecting, underwriting decisions, profitability analysis, and coordination with underwriting and corporate teams.

Good fit if you have three years of property/casualty commercial lines experience and strong underwriting knowledge of small to mid-market business.

Full job description

The Commercial Lines Territory Manager serves as a liaison between the company and agents and acts as a relationship manager for our agents, regional underwriting team and corporate departments. Incumbent assesses the strengths and weaknesses of agents and assists them in achieving a mutual goal of profitable growth in both premium volume and policy count. This position ensures agents are familiar with Penn National Insurance commercial lines initiatives, products, policies, procedures and services, and is responsible for commercial lines agency prospecting, planning and agency management initiatives. Incumbent provides collaboration and support to Underwriters and RVPs on small business and mid-market decisions, as well as other branch initiatives. The Commercial Lines Territory Manager utilizes assigned position authorities to favorably impact agent, team, and branch commercial lines results. At the direction of President-Partners Mutual or Regional Vice President, this may include limited direct underwriting of small commercial new business.

This territory falls under our Central Atlantic Office branch with primary assignments in Maryland.

  • Business Acumen
  • Negotiation
  • Results Oriented
  • Results Oriented
  • Time & Priority Management
  • Decision Making

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Sales/Premium Growth

  • Develop the agency force to pre-qualify, rate, and bind profitable commercial lines business.
  • Utilize authority to assist agency partners in helping them write profitable business.
  • Develop professional working relationships with agents, regional underwriting and claim teams and corporate departments.
  • Conduct thorough evaluation of all prospective agents and submit written recommendation to Regional Vice President.
  • Keeps two-way communication between agent and company continuously open and viable.
  • Monitors agency results and follows up with agent as to growth and compliance with company's initiatives, procedures and policies.
  • Stays alert for and shares industry information, new ideas, products, or changes in other carrier philosophies that could positively or adversely affect Penn National Insurance with appropriate colleagues.
  • Conduct ongoing agency prospecting within territory to create a pipeline of potential future appointments.
  • Participates in commercial lines rate reviews as requested.
  • Utilizes authority to make consistent underwriting decisions, adhere to company acceptability and pricing philosophies, and promote ease of doing business initiatives with Penn National Insurance.

Profitability

  • Profiles commercial lines book of business to assist in profitability analysis.
  • Develops and implements effective agency profitability plans when warranted.
  • Monitors agency results and follows up with agent as to profitability and compliance with company's initiatives, procedures and policies.
  • Facilitate agency reviews with other team members to review agent's performance as compared to established goals and implement corrective actions as needed.
  • Develop and implement agency action plans to achieve profitability.

  • Develop annual agency/company marketing plans.

  • Effective oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate information of a highly technical nature
  • Proven sales, negotiations, and solution-selling skills
