Full job description

Job Description

Health Analytics Advisory Leader

Are you ready to shape how sophisticated health analytics advise executive decision-making? Join Aon and help bring our analytics capabilities together to deliver clearer insights and greater impact for clients!

This role may be based in Atlanta, Chicago, New York, or near another Aon office. Proximity to an Aon location is preferred; however, strong candidates who require greater virtual flexibility may also be considered.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

As Lead for our Health Analytics Advisory team, you will serve as the senior client advisor and advance our impact delivering, packaging and scaling leading analytics insights content across a growing range of analytic domains. Your role sits at the intersection of client advisory, analytics content strategy, financial measurement, and health economics. It also involves total-cost-of-care optimization and advancing Aon's data-driven, AI-enabled client delivery model.

You will be the trusted voice clients and consultants rely on to interpret sophisticated analytics across many domains. You will also connect our financial, predictive modeling, health economics, clinical, pharmacy, network, and care delivery analytics into one clear set of client content and solutions.

You will:

  • Advise clients and prospects on sophisticated, cross-domain analytics, translating financial, predictive, clinical, pharmacy, network, and cost-of-care analyses into actionable guidance for HR, Finance, and C-suite audiences.
  • Lead sophisticated client engagements that bring together multiple Aon capabilities, including Cost Efficiency Measurement, Health Risk Analyzer, data warehouse and informatics content, Financial Experience Monitoring, and emerging analytics solutions.
  • Develop unified client-facing analytics content that integrates different areas of expertise while balancing consultant-led, subject-matter expert-led, automated, and AI-enabled delivery.
  • Partner with leaders across data platforms, clinical, and pharmacy analytics, actuarial and financial analytics, networks, care delivery, data science, AI enablement, analytics engineering, and Centers of Excellence.
  • Develop measurement approaches that quantify the financial, utilization, engagement, and clinical impact of benefit programs, point solutions, and other interventions.
  • Create data-driven thought leadership, including white papers, trend studies, market analyses, vendor category assessments, and regulatory impact analyses.
  • Provide senior technical and methodological review across analytics domains, ensuring client content is consistent, accurate, and ready for delivery.
  • Mentor colleagues and support special projects requiring alignment across clinical, actuarial, financial, and network analytics.

How this opportunity is different

You'll partner closely with analytics domain leaders, consultants, and client leaders to bring together repeatable, scalable analytics with deep-dive domain expertise — building a shared content capability that raises the quality, consistency, and client impact of everything Aon delivers.

You'll shape how we progressively deliver insight across the full client spectrum: from early-stage prospects with limited available data, to established clients with rich, longitudinal data ecosystems — and across employer segments of every size.

Success in this role depends on deep credibility in health and benefits analytics. It also requires a genuine passion for client advisory, positive relationship skills, and rigor to turn sophisticated analysis into scalable content.

The right candidate will have a track record of advising clients directly on sophisticated analytics decisions including evaluating health carriers, vendors, and point solutions, and bridging technical domains to produce unified, scalable models and deliverables.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Extensive experience with U.S. healthcare data, employer benefits, and insurance.
  • Demonstrable experience as a client-facing analytics advisor, with excellent writing and presentation skills — able to guide senior partners (C-suite, HR, Finance) through sophisticated, multi-domain analytics with clarity and confidence.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across various analytics fields by building consensus among actuaries, analytics leaders, and clinical/pharmacy experts. You also unify content across groups with different methods and priorities.
  • Experience in measurement and validation of healthcare programs, including financial, utilization, engagement, clinical outcomes, and metrics related to return on investment.
  • Experience serving large/complex Fortune 500 organizations as well as developing scaled solutions for smaller and mid-market self-insured groups.
  • Experience with the broader vendor ecosystem serving the self-insured employer — Health Plans, PBMs, emerging point solutions, chronic condition management programs, and data warehouses/analytics platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience with statistical measurement, causal inference, and data science/predictive modeling techniques, including work with large health claims datasets (HIPAA, de-identification, data cleaning, exploratory analysis).
  • Solid understanding of medical and pharmacy claims reporting and billing — including ICD-10, CPT, DRG, ICD-10 PCS, National Drug Codes, and CMS codes — sufficient to engage credibly with clinical and pharmacy domain leaders.
  • Ability to review technical work product across domains and mentor junior technical staff, including analysts, data scientists, statisticians, and actuaries.
  • Well-developed project management and planning skills, particularly coordinating content and work across multiple partner groups.
  • Advanced degree or bachelor's with equivalent certification in Health Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Actuarial Science, Epidemiology, or a related field is required. Candidates with equivalent experience are encouraged to apply. Ability to travel 10–20% is needed.
  • Experience with recent AI transformation projects is a plus.
  • Project Management, Python (Programming Language), R Programming, Statistical Analysis, Statistical Models, Structured Query Language (SQL), Business Planning, Conflict Resolution, Organizational Leadership, Organizational Strategy, Performance Management (PM), Stakeholder Management, Strategic Planning, Talent Management, Team Development, Team Management, Training and Development, Advanced Analytics, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Data Analysis, Data Integration, Data Management, Data Mining, Data Modeling, Data Science, Data Visualization, Deep Learning, Language Models, Machine Learning (ML), Predictive Modeling

  • Drive digital transformation and innovation across paid media through the responsible adoption of AI, automation, advanced audience strategies, emerging channels and evolving measurement approaches, improving media effectiveness, operational efficiency and decision-making while keeping Aon aligned with industry best practice and evolving customer expectations.
  • Provide team leadership and direction by setting priorities, building capability, coaching team members and creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, learning and performance.

Key Behavioral Competencies

  • Strategic Leadership: Demonstrates vision in building a global paid media capability that supports business priorities, improves campaign effectiveness and strengthens Aon's digital marketing maturity.

Leadership Impact

  • Improve the effectiveness and efficiency of marketing investment through consistent governance, measurement and optimization.
  • Strengthen Aon's digital marketing maturity through scalable operating models, innovation and capability development.

Success Measures

  • Strong team performance, engagement and capability growth, with clear ownership, high standards and a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

Atlanta, Georgia

Launch Your Career in Health Solutions

Our professionals include consultants, data engineers, data scientists, reporting analysts, statisticians, and actuaries who bring unique skills and perspectives to our work. As a core analytics hub, we partner with many high‑visibility Aon business units to bring data‑driven insight into client decisions. Within Health Analytics, you'll work alongside colleagues across key solution areas — Reporting & Analytics, Data Science and Measurement, New Solution Development, Network Analytics, Data Warehouse, Strategic Initiatives, and Data Management & Engineering — all operating as one integrated team. Your Impact as a Health Analytics Data Intern

Health and Benefits Consulting

Employer-sponsored health and welfare benefit programs form the foundation of the U.S. health care system. These programs have evolved over time as employers have attempted to manage the changing needs of employees, rising program costs and the impact of new legislation while supporting their human resource and business strategies.

What You Will Do:

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of assignments during your internship. As a Health Analytics intern, you will partner with consultants to shape short- and long-term health and benefits strategies for employers, translating complex data and market insights into clear, compelling presentations and reports.

You will contribute to strategic assessments of the health care market, analyze key trends and help identify innovative solutions for employers' health and benefits challenges. This role is well-suited for someone who enjoys team interaction, can balance multiple priorities and is interested in working with large data sets and using data-driven insights to inform health and benefits strategy. Typical job responsibilities include:

  • Knowledge of benefits administration, Health Care Reform, industry trends, carrier products and services
  • Ability to work independently and anticipate client and team needs
  • Effective time management and decision making skills
  • Diligent follow-up skills
  • Ability to express ideas clearly in both written and oral communications
  • Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills
  • Commanding presentation and public speaking abilities

Education and/or Experience:

  • Associates degree (or equivalent experience), with BA/BS preferred
  • More than 3 years' client service and/or industry and product line experience

Certificates, Licenses, Registration:

  • Life, Accident and Health Insurance License required.

Job Description

As part of an industry-leading team, you will help empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective Clinical Trial solutions for our clients as part of our Life Science Practice Group.

This position will be based in Philadelphia, PA. We are open to considering candidates located in Philadelphia as well as other East Coast states, including but not limited to New York, Charlotte, Boston, and Connecticut (Hartford). This role offers flexibility for hybrid work, with a combination of in-office and remote work options.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

  • Responsible for broking/placing primarily Clinical Trials Liability as well Products Liability, Errors & Omissions Liability, and Excess Liability
  • Market new and renewal business, handling all aspects of the placements from initial market selection through the long-term servicing until the clinical trials these policies are covering are over.
  • Demonstrate effective negotiation skills on behalf of clients and prospects.
  • Ensure that placements are handled timely and correctly
  • Develop productive business relationships with key insurance underwriters and Aon local office teams
  • Identify and analyze prospect and client exposures.
  • Coordinate activities with other internal units as required to meet customer needs.
  • Create presentations such as Renewal Strategies and Coverage Proposals.
  • Responsible for planning, scheduling, resourcing and executing complex projects/programs.
  • Frequently interacts with senior level colleagues and clients, normally involving matters between functional areas, other company divisions or units, or clients and the company.

How this opportunity is different

Join Aon's industry-leading team in the Life Sciences sector, where you'll provide innovative Clinical Trial Liability solutions to clients in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries. This role offers flexibility for hybrid work, with opportunities to work from Philadelphia or other East Coast locations. You'll manage complex insurance placements, build key relationships with underwriters, and contribute to vital clinical trials that support the approval of life-saving drugs and devices. With a focus on collaboration, trust, and professional growth, this is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact in healthcare.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

Unlike most insurance programs, the primary purpose of Clinical Trial Liability insurance is to support Pharma and Biotech companies through regulatory approvals and contractual compliance while simultaneously protecting these trial sponsors and their research partners from financial liability in case of injury or harm.

Clinical trials are essential for the approval of new drugs and medical devices, as they provide the data needed to assess safety and efficacy in humans, a requirement for regulatory approval by agencies like the FDA. To generate this volume of data, clinical trials must take place in many countries who closely regulate the activity including the clinical trial liability insurance. Our team of specialized brokers, through global and local insurance partners, provides the necessary local insurance ensuring no trial is ever delayed due to insurance reasons thus supporting our clients in their mission of saving and improving lives.

  • Attention to detail, ability to multi-task, exceptional organizational skills, ability to present complex insurance programs.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of insurance brokerage and/or underwriting experience (preferred Life Sciences in Clinical Trials Liability and/or Casualty Line experience)
  • Effective working knowledge of carrier underwriting practices & processes.
  • Proven client facing skills including effective presentations & communications.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively at various levels in the organization.
  • Ability to independently manage a dynamic book of clients
  • Successfully operates in a fast-paced driven environment that requires the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Must maintain appropriate broker's and Surplus Lines licenses.

Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of industry experience.

  • A Property and Casualty Brokers License is required or must be obtained within 90 days of hire if not already active.

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well.

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

NFP's Private Equity Group is seeking an Assistant Vice President, Mergers & Acquisition (M&A) Project Manager to support and enhance our growing due diligence practice. This role offers the opportunity to work on sophisticated transactions, serve as a trusted advisor to private equity investors, and influence how risk and insurance considerations are evaluated throughout the deal process. The AVP will be responsible for managing complex diligence engagements, delivering high-quality client advisory services, and contributing to the continued evolution of NFP's due diligence capabilities. This position is ideal for an experienced insurance professional who enjoys solving complex transactional challenges, leading internal client teams, working directly with clients, and providing expert risk guidance in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead complex risk and insurance due diligence engagements for private equity transactions across a broad range of industries.

  • Serve as a key client contact throughout the transaction lifecycle, providing consultative guidance and strategic recommendations.

  • Contribute to enhancements to due diligence methodologies, reporting standards, and workflow efficiency to improve client outcomes and consistency of deliverables.

  • Evaluate insurance programs, claims history, collateral arrangements, captive structures, and insurance-related financial exposures.

  • Identify transaction-related risks and collaborate with internal and external advisors to develop effective solutions.

  • Partner with brokers, coverage specialists, producers, client service teams, and M&A professionals to assess findings and craft risk management strategies.

  • Deliver accurate, comprehensive, and actionable due diligence reports and executive-level presentations.

  • Occasional travel as required

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Finance, Accounting, Business, Insurance, or a related field.

  • 7+ years of experience in the insurance industry, with significant experience supporting private equity, M&A, transactional risk, or due diligence engagements.

  • Expertise in Property & Casualty insurance and specialty lines, including Cyber, Professional Liability, Financial Lines, Environmental, and Captive programs.

  • Understanding of financial statements, accounting concepts, insurance-related financial analysis, and transaction structures.

  • Strong ability to manage multiple complex engagements and deliver high-quality work within tight deadlines.

  • Client-facing presence and ability to build credibility with senior stakeholders.

  • Outstanding written, verbal, and presentation skills.

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, financial analysis, and report preparation.

  • P&C preferred or ability to obtain within six months of hire

Posting Description

The Assistant Vice President – Commercial General Liability Claims is responsible for providing claims advocacy and account management services to clients involving moderate, complex and catastrophic claims. The Assistant Vice President is the contact/liaison/advocate between the client, carrier and NFP. The primary purpose is to assure clients receive exceptional service, maximization of policy coverage, in-depth advice and claims advocacy in a timely and effective manner. This will be accomplished by adhering to claims procedures, implementation of effective and consistent claims service programs and direct participation in and oversight of collaborative claims resolution strategies. This position requires significant commercial general liability claims experience, expertise in written and verbal communications, a high level of organization and the ability to work in an independent setting.

Principal Roles and Responsibilities

  • Senior technical specialist role involving complex and catastrophic claims, heavy litigation, in numerous State and Federal jurisdictions.
  • Serve as a trusted advocate for clients and key partners by delivering strategic guidance and expert oversight in the management of general liability claims.
  • Engage collaboratively with clients, their representatives, insurers, technical experts, consultants, producers, and account managers to effectively advocate for client interests and ensure alignment across all partners.
  • Take ownership of resolving client claim issues in a timely manner, ensuring clear and proactive communication of outcomes to all relevant partners.
  • Prompt notification to Claims Leaders, Sale and Service team, and others of large reserve changes in excess of $100,000.
  • Maintain thorough and timely documentation within the EPIC claim file system, including detailed updates on claim activity, client and carrier interactions, and supporting documentation. Ensure all correspondence and materials are accurately filed using established naming conventions to preserve a comprehensive and auditable claim history.
  • Conduct thorough coverage analysis and research to address claim-related issues and collaborate closely with clients and their representatives to develop and present well-reasoned coverage rebuttals when appropriate (on occasion may assist other lines of business, including but not limited to Commercial Transportation/Automobile, Private Client Group, Personal Risk Teams, etc.).
  • Attend (virtually or in-person) client meetings, including claim reviews, pre-renewals, renewal, etc.
  • Support the General Liability Claim Leader and Sales Team in resolving client claim issues by providing responsive assistance and collaborative problem-solving to ensure timely and effective outcomes.
  • Provide support to Claim Leadership on a variety of initiatives, including the development and refinement of procedures, enhancement of claim service programs, and execution of ad-hoc projects.
  • Occasionally author white papers and/or give presentations on topics clients are facings.

Education, Experience and Skills Requirements

Education: Bachelor's degree required. Additional insurance certifications and/or legal background are a plus.

Experience: A minimum of 15 years of experience in the commercial general liability claims industry is required. Candidates must have held a Senior Claims Analyst role or higher. Additional experience in commercial insurance sales, marketing, or other lines of business is considered a strong asset.

Skills:

  • Proficiency with general liability insurance products, contractual risk transfer, claims handling and management, and processes. Strong solid understanding of transportation/automobile liability, management liability (E&O, D&O, Cyber, Crime), property and workers compensation coverages a plus.
  • Proven background of working effectively with clients and partners in Claims Analyst, Service or Management capacity involving complex coverage, litigation, large and catastrophic general liability claims in jurisdictions across the United States.
  • High level of organizational skills with proven successful experience in managing multiple tasks and internal /external clients concurrently in a claims setting.
  • Demonstrated expertise in written and verbal communications.
  • Customer Service – Manages difficult or emotional client situations; Responds promptly to client needs.
  • Proficiency with using broker based and carrier claims software applications. Knowledge of the EPIC system is a plus.
  • Proficiency with all Microsoft Suite of products including excel, outlook, word and power point.
  • Proficiency in performing web-based meetings and with performing in person audio / visual presentations to small and large size groups.
  • Proficiency in coordinating and performing technical claims discussions with internal and external clients.
  • Proficiency in coordinating claims audits and reviews.
  • Collaboration - Balances team and individual responsibilities
  • Ethics - Treats people with respect; Keeps commitments; Inspires the trust of others; Works with integrity and ethically; Upholds organizational values.
  • Organizational Support - Follows policies and procedures; Completes administrative tasks correctly and on time; Supports organization's goals and values.
  • Judgment - Exhibits sound and accurate judgment; Includes appropriate people in decision-making process.
  • Motivation - Demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles.
  • Planning/Organizing - Prioritizes and plans work activities; Uses time efficiently; Sets goals and objectives; Can assist with organization and schedules of other people and their tasks.

As an Account Executive, you will handle predominantly strategic risk and healthcare clients, including health systems, hospitals, physician groups, and other health care organizations.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like:

  • Retains and grows Aon's business, cultivating relationships with senior-most client decision-makers in the client organization as well as with day-to-day client contacts.
  • Drives the renewal process, assembling the appropriate team to develop and implement the client-specific renewal strategy.

Full job description

Job Description

Posting Description

Who We Are

Lenox Advisors brings together sophisticated solutions in wealth management and insurance services to high-net-worth individuals and their families. As a wholly owned subsidiary of NFP Corp., an Aon Company, we combine the culture of a boutique firm with the stability and backing of a large corporation to create an environment that's truly unique. NFP is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We're a recognized Elite Agency award winner and a leading property and casualty broker, benefits consultant, wealth manager, and retirement plan advisor. NFP provides solutions enabling client success through the expertise of over 8,000 global employees, investments in innovative technologies, and enduring relationships with highly rated insurers, vendors and financial institutions. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com.

Position Summary

Supports the Relationship Manager by scheduling and coordinating activities and initiatives that facilitate the new policy and client service processes. The Client Services Associate must provide superior client service by identifying the client's wants and needs, acting on, and/or delegating items and following through to completion while keeping all parties informed throughout the process.

Responsibilities

Pre-Sale and New Business

  • Assembles meeting preparation documents pertaining to the client/prospect prior to sales meetings, including but not limited to, illustrations, policy and product summaries, reports, presentations, and marketing packets
  • Performs all insurance underwriting duties, including preparation and completion of multi-life and individual disability, life, and long term care applications
  • Schedules medical insurance exams and orders all Attending Physician Statements based on insurance underwriting guidelines
  • Follows up with the client and Relationship Manager during the underwriting process, keeps notes on the process and conversations in MOSAIC
  • Collaborates with the New Business Team to manage all new business arguments using MOSAIC as the system of record for status, notes, and tasks. Communicates with RM and client as necessary.
  • Participates in Relationship Manager/New Business case management calls
  • Reviews insurance policies and prepares them for delivery; follows up on delivery requirements when needed
  • Ensures Relationship Manager has appropriate Licensing and Appointments and works with internal contracting and licensing contact to obtain and renew licenses
  • Partners with Advanced Sales to acquire and/or generate the appropriate illustrations/one-pagers
  • Processes all policy changes including reinstatement of lapsed cases, smoker rating changes, addition or removal of policy riders, and face amount reductions
  • Partners with Private Wealth Management Team to process individual asset management applications, service requests, and performance summaries
  • Coordinates tasks and responsibilities for all joint work

Client Service

  • Processes all insurance policy service requests, including address, beneficiary/ownership changes, premium mode changes, and dividend option changes
  • Provides outstanding client service through recognizing client's wants and needs, acting on, and/or delegating items and following through to completion, keeping all parties informed throughout the process
  • Coordinates all collateral assignments, death or disability claims, and fund allocation changes with the assistance of the Relationship Manager
  • Interacts with insurance carriers and vendors daily to ensure accurate and timely execution of client service requests
  • Takes a proactive lead on conserving the Relationship Manager's existing block of business by advising clients of overdue insurance premiums and coverage in danger of lapsing, tracking all attempts and progress, and keeping the Relationship Manager informed of problematic cases
  • Ability to follow through on a variety of requests and ability to resolve client and/or service related matters.
  • Crafts client correspondence as needed according to the Lenox Style Guide

Business Operations

  • Responsible for greeting clients, fielding phone calls, reviewing incoming mail, managing office supplies, ordering client gifts, and maintaining client files
  • Manages the Relationship Manager's calendar, scheduling and confirming client meetings, registering visitors with security, and booking conference rooms
  • Ensures data accuracy by regularly and routinely updating information in MOSAIC and maintaining client files. This includes, but is not limited to, fact find information and notes, case management (individual and MultiLife), task management, and client and policy information
  • Participates in occasional training and development sessions as directed by department(s) and Regional Manager
  • Builds feeder lists as requested
  • Partners with the Relationship Manager when participating in Lenox marketing campaigns, including MOSAIC list updates as well as updating client email addresses

Job Competencies

Required Knowledge

  • Knowledge of office equipment operations (copier, scanner, printers) and electronic calendaring programs (Microsoft Outlook)
  • Familiarity with business principles and practices
  • Familiarity working with Client Database Management systems
  • Knowledge of customer support principles

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written (email, written memos, telephone, voicemail, etc.)
  • Ability to interact with clients diplomatically and professionally
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast paced sales environment
  • Ability to work independently and also to collaborate with teams
  • Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word and PowerPoint
  • Organizational, planning and critical thinking skills
  • Ability to multitask

Required Behaviors/Attitudes

  • Demonstrates initiative, dependability, confidences and assertiveness
  • Team oriented; demonstrates a service attitude
  • Cares about delivering quality
  • Excels in planning & organizing
  • Take personal ownership for delivery of superior results; conscientious
  • Demonstrate strong dedication to meeting the needs of internal and external clients

Education/experience/license requirements

Education

  • High School Diploma Required
  • College Degree Preferred

Experience

  • 1-3 Years of Customer Service Experience
  • 3-5 Years of Industry Experience Preferred

What We Offer

We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. Job Description

Data Science Lead

The Data Science Lead will be a lead member of the AGRC North America Data & Analytics (D&A) team, driving the evolution of our advanced analytics and AI capabilities. This role is focused on designing, operationalizing, and scaling analytics, machine learning, and AI solutions that power Risk Consulting engagements.

The Data Science Lead will build robust data pipelines and models, create reusable analytics assets, and enable consultants and analysts with tools and frameworks that elevate the quality, speed, and consistency of analytics across the business. This role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, strong business understanding, and a passion for innovation, automation, and continuous improvement.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

  • Lead Advanced Analytics & AI DevelopmentCoordinate and contribute to the design and execution of advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI solutions using claims, exposure, operational, and external data to generate high-value insights for use across Risk Consulting.
  • Operationalize Scalable Data & Analytics FoundationsBuild, maintain, and optimize scalable data pipelines, feature stores, and reporting frameworks using tools such as SQL, Python, Alteryx, Databricks, and Power BI/Tableau to support repeatable, production-grade analytics.
  • Develop Reusable Analytics AssetsDesign and productionize reusable analytics components (e.g., models, data products, templates, and automated workflows) that can be embedded into multiple client engagements and solutions.
  • Data Quality, Governance, and AutomationDrive innovation in data management by profiling, cleansing, and integrating disparate data sources; define and automate data quality rules; and contribute to proactive data governance and stewardship practices.
  • Continuous Improvement & Technology AdoptionEvaluate and introduce emerging analytics, AI, and automation tools and techniques to continuously enhance the team's capabilities and efficiency.
  • Mentorship & Best Practice DevelopmentMentor junior analysts and data professionals, promote coding and analytics best practices, and help shape standards for model development, documentation, testing, and deployment.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Analytical & Technical Skills
    • Advanced analytical capabilities with a proven ability to interpret complex datasets, identify trends, and develop robust statistical, ML, and AI-driven solutions.
    • Expertise in data profiling, cleansing, and transformation, including scripting and automation of data quality rules.
    • Strong proficiency in managing relational databases, cloud-based data environments, and ETL/ELT processes.
  • Tooling & Platforms
    • Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, Alteryx, Power BI/Tableau, and Excel/VBA.
    • Familiarity with Databricks and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
    • Experience working with Access and other legacy systems is a plus.
  • Communication & Collaboration
    • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, business-relevant explanations for non-technical stakeholders.
    • Strong collaboration skills, working effectively with consultants, product owners, and other technical teams.
  • Work Environment & Mindset
    • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
    • Demonstrates a growth mindset, curiosity about new tools and methods, and a passion for innovation and continuous learning.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Data Science, or Information Management
  • 5–7 years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or data science, ideally within insurance, risk management, or consulting environments.
  • Demonstrated expertise in data modeling, statistical analysis, and predictive analytics, with hands-on experience using tools such as SQL, Python, R, and Alteryx.
  • Proficiency in data visualization platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and experience designing client-facing dashboards and reports.
  • Strong understanding of ETL frameworks, data warehousing concepts, and cloud-based data ecosystems (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks).
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets, including structured and unstructured data from multiple sources

Job Description

Aon Is Looking for A Manager of Claims Operations - Professional Liability

The Manager of Claims Operations with Aon Business Services – Integrated Services and will support our Professional Liability & License Protection Claims function, leads the end-to-end management of professional liability, malpractice, regulatory, and licensing board claims. The role oversees claims administration, Escalation service team support, email customer service, legal coordination, quality, compliance, and team performance. This position serves as a subject matter expert and escalation point for insured professionals facing allegations, investigations, disciplinary actions, or civil liability matters, with a focus on protecting professional licenses, reputations, and financial interests. This position is for a hybrid schedule, in office and remote throughout the week in Fort Washington, PA

***Must have people management experience, preferred in the insurance industry***

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Direct the handling of professional liability and license protection claims from initial notification through resolution
  • Manage Escalation service team support and email customer service, responding to inquiries, resolving issues, providing coverage guidance, and delivering exceptional service in a timely and professional manner
  • Oversee matters involving licensing board complaints, administrative hearings, professional misconduct allegations, malpractice claims, and disciplinary actions
  • Ensure timely claim investigations, coverage reviews, documentation, reserving, and resolution strategies
  • Serve as the escalation point for high-exposure, sensitive, urgent, or complex claims
  • Monitor claim inventory, aging, workloads, service levels, and closure activity
  • Interact with key business stakeholders up to executive level
  • Act as key liaison with carrier partner including complex claim resolution and audit administration
  • Evaluate need for system improvements based on feedback from process owners and operations teams
  • Work with advanced reporting and metrics, provide analysis and report out

Required Experience:

  • 5+ years of business experience preferably in the insurance industry
  • Experience in Team Management, Project Management and Resource Planning
  • Self-starter with operational improvement / mentality
  • Has technical expertise to accomplish complex processes/tasks
  • Experience analyzing complex issues and coming up with creative solutions
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Suite
  • Strong organizational skills. Attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent communication; both written and verbal
  • Proactive Management Style and consistent follow-through

Job Description

As part of an industry-leading team, you will help empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective Clinical Trial solutions for our clients as part of our Life Science Practice Group.

This position will be based in Philadelphia, PA. We are open to considering candidates located in Philadelphia as well as other East Coast states, including but not limited to New York, Charlotte, Boston, and Connecticut (Hartford). This role offers flexibility for hybrid work, with a combination of in-office and remote work options.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

  • Responsible for broking/placing primarily Clinical Trials Liability as well Products Liability, Errors & Omissions Liability, and Excess Liability
  • Market new and renewal business, handling all aspects of the placements from initial market selection through the long-term servicing until the clinical trials these policies are covering are over.
  • Demonstrate effective negotiation skills on behalf of clients and prospects.
  • Ensure that placements are handled timely and correctly
  • Develop productive business relationships with key insurance underwriters and Aon local office teams
  • Identify and analyze prospect and client exposures.
  • Coordinate activities with other internal units as required to meet customer needs.
  • Create presentations such as Renewal Strategies and Coverage Proposals.
  • Responsible for planning, scheduling, resourcing and executing complex projects/programs.
  • Frequently interacts with senior level colleagues and clients, normally involving matters between functional areas, other company divisions or units, or clients and the company.

How this opportunity is different

Join Aon's industry-leading team in the Life Sciences sector, where you'll provide innovative Clinical Trial Liability solutions to clients in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries. This role offers flexibility for hybrid work, with opportunities to work from Philadelphia or other East Coast locations. You'll manage complex insurance placements, build key relationships with underwriters, and contribute to vital clinical trials that support the approval of life-saving drugs and devices. With a focus on collaboration, trust, and professional growth, this is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact in healthcare.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

Unlike most insurance programs, the primary purpose of Clinical Trial Liability insurance is to support Pharma and Biotech companies through regulatory approvals and contractual compliance while simultaneously protecting these trial sponsors and their research partners from financial liability in case of injury or harm.

Clinical trials are essential for the approval of new drugs and medical devices, as they provide the data needed to assess safety and efficacy in humans, a requirement for regulatory approval by agencies like the FDA. To generate this volume of data, clinical trials must take place in many countries who closely regulate the activity including the clinical trial liability insurance. Our team of specialized brokers, through global and local insurance partners, provides the necessary local insurance ensuring no trial is ever delayed due to insurance reasons thus supporting our clients in their mission of saving and improving lives.

  • Attention to detail, ability to multi-task, exceptional organizational skills, ability to present complex insurance programs.
  • Minimum of 7+ years of insurance brokerage and/or underwriting experience (preferred Life Sciences in Clinical Trials Liability and/or Casualty Line experience)
  • Effective working knowledge of carrier underwriting practices & processes.
  • Proven client facing skills including effective presentations & communications.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively at various levels in the organization.
  • Ability to independently manage a dynamic book of clients
  • Successfully operates in a fast-paced driven environment that requires the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Must maintain appropriate broker's and Surplus Lines licenses.

Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of industry experience.

  • A Property and Casualty Brokers License is required or must be obtained within 90 days of hire if not already active.

How we support our colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well.

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

Who We Are:

Our sister company, Argo Capital Group, was founded in 1996 to facilitate risk sharing for Excess Reinsurance's partners and clients.

About Excess Reinsurance

Founded in 1988, Excess Reinsurance was one of the first managing general underwriters in the nation to specialize in stop-loss insurance. Stop-loss insurance helps protect self-funded employers from the financial impact of large and unexpected healthcare claims, placing our actuarial team at the intersection of healthcare, insurance, data analytics, and risk management.

What began as a team of three underwriters has grown into a diverse organization spanning actuarial, underwriting, sales, claims, legal, and operations. Today, Excess Reinsurance underwrites stop-loss coverage for more than 1,000 employer groups annually while remaining guided by four core principles: integrity, stability, innovation, and quality service.

About this job

Lead Aon's North America Rewards business with full P&L accountability for revenue growth and profitability across mid-market and enterprise segments. Shape strategy, drive market leadership, and oversee large-scale rewards transformations while building and developing a high-performing consulting team.

Good fit if you have extensive total rewards consulting experience, have led a business with P&L accountability, and have established relationships with executive leadership teams.

Full job description

Job Description

Partner, Head of Rewards Advisory, North America

Role Overview

As the Head of Rewards Advisory, North America, you will lead Aon's Rewards business across the region, shaping strategy, driving growth and delivering market-leading rewards solutions to Aon's clients across enterprise and mid-market segments! This role combines deep rewards expertise with strategic business leadership, commercial acumen, and a strong understanding of how total rewards can create measurable value for clients.

In addition to serving as a trusted advisor to executive leadership teams, you will be accountable for the growth, profitability, talent strategy, and market leadership of the North America Rewards practice, while partnering closely with Rewards & Workforce Analytics colleagues to connect rewards, workforce transformation, and talent advisory opportunities across the market!

Key Responsibilities

Practice Leadership & P&L Accountability

  • Lead the North America Rewards business with full accountability for revenue growth, profitability, forecasting, budgeting, resource deployment, and overall business performance across mid-market and enterprise rewards offerings.
  • Develop and implement the strategic vision and growth agenda for the practice, making sure it aligns with broader Human Capital objectives and Aon's business strategy. Coordinate this with the priorities of the North American Talent group.
  • Provide leadership for the continued evolution, positioning, and operational execution of both the mid-market rewards and enterprise rewards solutions, ensuring each offering is clearly differentiated, scalable, and connected to broader client needs.
  • Monitor market trends, client demand, competitive dynamics, and emerging workforce challenges to find opportunities for innovation, expansion, and investment across compensation, total rewards, organizational change, and talent consulting solutions.
  • Drive disciplined business management, operational excellence, and performance accountability across the practice, including active collaboration with the Head of Rewards & Workforce Analytics, NA Talent Solutions on shared growth priorities, integrated offerings, and cross-practice execution.

Business Development & Market Leadership

  • Act as the senior market leader for Rewards in North America, driving the growth of existing client relationships and originating new opportunities with large multinational organizations, middle-market companies, and other priority client segments.
  • Establish trusted advisor relationships with CHROs, CFOs, Boards of Directors, Compensation Committees, and Executive Leadership Teams.
  • Develop and enact go-to-market strategies, drive market visibility, and shape Aon's Rewards value proposition across both mid-market and enterprise client needs.
  • Identify and advance total rewards opportunities with clients, including compensation strategy, benefits integration, wellbeing, recognition, pay transparency, career frameworks, workforce analytics, and broader talent transformation needs.
  • Champion Aon's United model by partnering across Human Capital, Health, Wealth, Risk Capital, and Talent Solutions to deliver integrated client solutions that connect rewards, workforce transformation, and broader talent advisory capabilities.
  • Represent Aon externally through thought leadership, speaking engagements, industry forums, research initiatives, and client events to strengthen the firm's market position in rewards and total rewards advisory.

Client Leadership & Advisory

  • Lead large-scale, enterprise rewards transformations spanning multiple geographies and business units, while also supporting scalable mid-market rewards solutions that meet evolving client needs.

Aon plc (NYSE: AON) exists to shape decisions for the better — to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As a member of this team and Aon's broader Reward & Workforce Advisory business, you will help empower results for our clients, some of the world's most innovative organizations, by detecting and fixing compensation gaps potentially attributable to gender, race/ethnicity, and other protected characteristics.  Core Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with the team to deliver and/or project-manage pay equity engagements

  • Leverage data visualization techniques and tools to effectively identify insights in the data and articulate key findings to clients and colleagues
  • Run multivariate regression models to detect potential compensation discrimination based on gender, race/ethnicity, and other protected characteristics
  • Communicate complex quantitative analyses in a clear, precise, and actionable manner to executive stakeholders
  • Contribute to proposal writing and support sales conversations with current and prospective clients
  • Support the development of Aon intellectual capital and client-specific solutions

  • Creative problem-solving ability, working in ambiguous situations

  • Experience using Python, R, or other scripting languages for data manipulation and analysis

  • Graduate degree in Economics, Business, Data Science, Statistics, I/O Psychology, or a related field
  • A flair for data visualization and design in Tableau, Power BI, or PowerPoint

  • Entrepreneurial attitude with a natural ability to take ownership of the overall success of client relationships.

  • Dedication to working in a collaborative, team-oriented environment with a commitment to operating with respect and integrity.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office products (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Preferred qualifications:

  • 15+ years of progressively responsible experience in construction claims or complex commercial casualty, including leadership responsibility.
  • Strong ability to lead cross-functional teams, communicate with senior stakeholders, and manage complex client and carrier relationships.
  • Extensive experience in construction claims, casualty claims, or complex commercial claims management, with progressive leadership responsibility.
  • Deep working knowledge of construction-related insurance programs, coverage interpretation, claims advocacy, reserving, litigation management, and risk transfer concepts.
  • Deep expertise in Commercial General Liability (CGL) construction claims, including catastrophic bodily injury, property damage, and completed operations.
  • Extensive experience with OCIP/CCIP wrap‑up programs and large, complex construction placements, including multi‑line, multi‑jurisdictional programs.
  • Broad knowledge of all major construction insurance lines (GL, excess/umbrella, WC, auto, builders risk, property, inland marine, professional, pollution, wrap‑up, surety, subcontract default, cyber as applicable).
  • Extensive litigation management experience, including oversight of high‑severity and nuclear‑verdict‑potential claims, and collaboration with senior defense counsel.

  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex claim facts, legal issues, and coverage considerations and clearly articulate analyses in internal reports and high‑stakes presentations.
  • Experience leading cross‑functional initiatives and special projects across regions, practices, or product lines.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple teams and accounts, while maintaining a long‑term, proactive view of business goals and client objectives.
  • Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, drive decisions with incomplete information, and bring structure to complex operational and claim challenges.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and comfort with dashboards, reporting tools, and other business technologies.
  • Strong change‑management skills and a track record of adapting to and leading through evolving market, legal, and organizational environments.
  • Bachelor's degree required; JD preferred, particularly for roles involving complex coverage analysis, contract interpretation, and litigation management. Professional insurance designations, such as CPCU, AIC, ARM, and/or CRIS are advantageous.

Job Description

Posting Description

Who We Are:

NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the world address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com.

Summary of Role:

The Account Executive/Sr. AE works with Brokers to strategically handle and service client accounts and may have direct account responsibilities. This role will involve day-to-day client interactions while building and maintaining relationships with clients and carrier representatives. The Account Executive helps ensure client needs are addressed promptly and accurately, goals are met, and service standards are achieved. At the direction of the Broker, the Account Executive prepares applications, specifications, strategic analyses, and marketing strategies for new business and assigned client renewals, with appropriate supervision and approval from their supervisor! Title and salary will be commensurate with experience.

What's in it for you? In Complex Risk, you'll have lower volume, highly customized, strategic advisory work for large, sophisticated and national/international clients. You'll be seen as a strategic commercial insurance professional who can partner with brokers, advise clients, solve complex risk challenges, and deliver a high-touch consultative client experience!

This is a full-time remote position with a hybrid option from our Plainview, Long Island office. We will consider remote options for experienced candidates, ideally in the NY tri-state or East Coast, for the ability and feasibility to occasionally travel to client meetings or our designated offices if required.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Implement NFP's renewal strategy and service model by proactively handling renewal timelines, key milestones, stakeholder responsibilities, and client deliverables to support a consistent, disciplined, and proactive renewal experience.
  • Support pre-renewal planning by coordinating renewal strategy discussions, gathering updated exposure information, reviewing loss experience, confirming client objectives, and documenting agreed renewal goals, service priorities, and next steps.
  • Partner with Brokers, Placement, Service, Claims, Accounting, and GCC (Global Capabilities Centers) teams to coordinate renewal workflow, maintain visibility around open items, and ensure timely completion of applications, submissions, proposals, binding instructions, policies, endorsements, certificates, billing items, and post-renewal services.
  • Assist Brokers in developing go-to-market strategies by identifying renewal objectives, target markets, submission requirements, negotiation priorities, coverage improvement opportunities, and strategies to improve pricing, terms, conditions, limits, and overall program outcomes.
  • Support the stewardship process by helping identify year-over-year program changes, service accomplishments, open issues, risk management opportunities, coverage recommendations, and renewal considerations that strengthen client relationships and retention.
  • Maintain accurate and current client, policy, exposure, activity, and follow-up information in Epic and other designated workflow tools to support service model accountability, reporting, renewal planning, and E&O prevention.
  • Coordinate quality control for renewal and post-binding outputs, including binder and policy review, coverage checklists, certificates of insurance, endorsements, subjectivities, surplus lines documentation, affidavits, due diligence forms, invoicing, finance agreements, and other required deliverables.
  • Participate in client visits and/or meetings, as appropriate, to support relationship management, understand client needs, reinforce service priorities, and assist with renewal, stewardship, and ongoing service discussions.
  • Mentor colleagues in Account Manager positions and other teammates by providing guidance, sharing technical and service model knowledge, supporting professional development, and reinforcing consistent renewal and client service standards.
  • Apply NFP's Service Model as a source for current renewal processes, tools, resources, templates, timelines, and service standards to support consistent execution for clients, carrier partners, Brokers, GCC, and internal service teams.

Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities:

  • Excellent written communication skills – writes clearly; edits work for spelling and grammar; varies writing style to meet needs; presents numeric data effectively; able to read and interpret written information.
  • Self-confident to make sound independent decisions along with strong mentorship/leadership skills.
  • Ability to successfully interact with a variety of people/personalities. Can collaborate with clients at an executive level.
  • Be heavily involved in client-facing discussions throughout the policy lifecycle. Be comfortable presenting findings and recommendations.
  • Possess technical expertise plus good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to evaluate client program data, identify trends and risk considerations, and translate analysis into practical recommendations.
  • Collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with the internal service teams, brokers, carriers, and clients to support consistent execution and service delivery.
  • Ability to handle situations in a calm, friendly and professional manner.
  • Strong attention to detail, decision-making skills and problem resolution.
  • Minimal travel, but should be able to accommodate travel when required.
  • Familiarity with EPIC or other agency management system required.

Education and/or Experience:

  • Property & Casualty Broker's License required upon hire; CPCU or similar designation preferred
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred; High School Diploma or equivalent required
  • 7+ years of industry experience with a strong background in commercial insurance is ideal. Prior retail brokerage experience required
  • Advanced MS Office skills including Excel, Word, Powerpoint. Use tools such as AI, data, graphs, and analytics to support recommendations

What We Offer:

We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Are you a client leader who turns strong relationships into long‑term strategic value?

This role must be based in Vermont. Candidates will need to already reside in the state or be willing to relocate.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

This role exists to strengthen client outcomes through consultative captive leadership. As a Captive Client Services Director, you will act as the principal interface between captive clients and Aon, ensuring clients receive high‑quality service, strategic insight, and access to the right expertise across the business. You will help clients make better decisions about captive performance, risk financing strategy, and long‑term value creation.

Typical activities include:

  • Leading strategic client engagement for a portfolio of captive clients, acting as the primary relationship lead for senior executives
  • Running annual account planning discussions aligned to client priorities, service requirements, and commercial objectives
  • Coordinating strategy check‑ins with subject matter experts to provide external perspectives, market insight, and forward‑looking recommendations
  • Reviewing stewardship reports, performance data, and service metrics to find opportunities for improvement and additional value creation
  • Orchestrating internal teams across domiciles, Global Capability Centres, and wider Aon businesses to deliver integrated client outcomes
  • Finding opportunities to strengthen client relationships, improve account profitability, and expand relevant Aon services
  • Translating technical, financial, and performance information into clear client narratives and actionable recommendations
  • Coaching and supporting more junior colleagues to strengthen client leadership capability and consistency of service delivery
  • Maintaining delivery discipline across service schedules, governance commitments, and regulatory requirements

This role is differentiated by the level of client influence, strategic ownership, and cross‑functional coordination involved. You will operate as the central connector between captive clients and Aon, bringing together expertise from across the organization to support better client decisions and stronger long‑term partnerships.

The role is shifting from transactional service delivery toward consultative client leadership. Success depends on your ability to deeply understand client priorities, proactively find opportunities, and build value through strategic conversations, insight‑led communication, and effective orchestration of Aon capabilities.

You will help shape the future‑state client leadership model within ACIM, supporting a more proactive, data-driven, and commercially focused approach to client engagement.

  • Demonstrated advisory client engagement, building deep understanding of client priorities, challenges, and risk financing objectives and operating as a trusted advisor
  • Strong strategic and commercial thinking, connecting client strategies, commercial opportunities, and Aon capabilities to create measurable value and support profitable growth
  • Confirmed ability to orchestrate expertise across a matrixed organization, influencing without formal authority and aligning teams around shared client objectives
  • Track record of owning client service delivery, managing service schedules and stewardship activity, and maintaining high standards of execution and governance
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn technical information, market insight, and performance data into compelling narratives for senior collaborators
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous or evolving situations, with sound judgment, learning agility, and the ability to draw on specialist expertise when needed
  • Experience leading, coaching, or mentoring colleagues to build capability and consistent client leadership standards across teams
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in business, finance, risk management, or a related field.

Plan Administration & Compliance

  • Be responsible for the full administration cycle for a block of defined contribution retirement plans
  • Perform non-discrimination and compliance testing, including ADP/ACP, 410(b) coverage, top-heavy, 415 annual addition limit, 401(a)(4) cross-testing and other necessary measurements

Analysis & Communication

Professional Development

  • Participate in professional organizations and independent study to stay current on ERISA and industry developments
  • Integrate new knowledge and skills into daily work, sharing insights with colleagues as appropriate

High school diploma required.

Experience

Three to five years of directly related experience in retirement plan administration and consulting.

Credentialing (one or more preferred):

  • ASPPA: Qualified 401(k) Administrator (QKA), Qualified Plan Specialist (QKS), Qualified 401(k) Consultant (QKC), and/or Qualified Pension Administrator (QPA)

Experience with Stax.ai, FT William, and PensionPro strongly preferred; familiarity with ASC a plus. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Teams. Job Description

Captive Client Leader | Aon Captive & Insurance Management (ACIM)

Are you a client leader who turns strong relationships into long‑term strategic value?

Do you thrive in complex client environments where success depends on judgment, influence, and cross‑functional collaboration?

Join us to help clients make better captive and risk financing decisions!

This is a virtual role with the flexibility to work virtually across the U.S.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

This role exists to strengthen client outcomes through consultative captive leadership. As a Captive Client Services Director, you will act as the principal interface between captive clients and Aon, ensuring clients receive high‑quality service, strategic insight, and access to the right expertise across the business. You will help clients make better decisions about captive performance, risk financing strategy, and long‑term value creation.

Typical activities include:

  • Leading strategic client engagement for a portfolio of captive clients, acting as the primary relationship lead for senior executives
  • Running annual account planning discussions aligned to client priorities, service requirements, and commercial objectives
  • Coordinating strategy check‑ins with subject matter experts to provide external perspectives, market insight, and forward‑looking recommendations
  • Reviewing stewardship reports, performance data, and service metrics to find opportunities for improvement and additional value creation
  • Orchestrating internal teams across domiciles, Global Capability Centres, and wider Aon businesses to deliver integrated client outcomes
  • Finding opportunities to strengthen client relationships, improve account profitability, and expand relevant Aon services
  • Translating technical, financial, and performance information into clear client narratives and actionable recommendations
  • Coaching and supporting more junior colleagues to strengthen client leadership capability and consistency of service delivery
  • Maintaining delivery discipline across service schedules, governance commitments, and regulatory requirements

How this opportunity is different

This role is differentiated by the level of client influence, strategic ownership, and cross‑functional coordination involved. You will operate as the central connector between captive clients and Aon, bringing together expertise from across the organization to support better client decisions and stronger long‑term partnerships.

The role is shifting from transactional service delivery toward consultative client leadership. Success depends on your ability to deeply understand client priorities, proactively find opportunities, and build value through strategic conversations, insight‑led communication, and effective orchestration of Aon capabilities.

You will help shape the future‑state client leadership model within ACIM, supporting a more proactive, data-driven, and commercially focused approach to client engagement.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Demonstrated advisory client engagement, building deep understanding of client priorities, challenges, and risk financing objectives and operating as a trusted advisor
  • Strong strategic and commercial thinking, connecting client strategies, commercial opportunities, and Aon capabilities to create measurable value and support profitable growth
  • Confirmed ability to orchestrate expertise across a matrixed organization, influencing without formal authority and aligning teams around shared client objectives
  • Track record of owning client service delivery, managing service schedules and stewardship activity, and maintaining high standards of execution and governance
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn technical information, market insight, and performance data into compelling narratives for senior collaborators
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous or evolving situations, with sound judgment, learning agility, and the ability to draw on specialist expertise when needed
  • Experience leading, coaching, or mentoring colleagues to build capability and consistent client leadership standards across teams
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in business, finance, risk management, or a related field.

How we support our colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well.

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share, and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

Job Description

Wildfire Scientist – Wildfire Spread Modeler

This is a hybrid role with the opportunity to work virtually and from our Boston office

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

  • Operate, maintain, and enhance Aon's current wildfire spread modeling workflows, including:
    • Running large catalogs of simulated events for model development, testing, and calibration.
    • Working directly with our current wildfire spread engine and associated tooling to ensure reliable, repeatable runs
    • Diagnosing performance bottlenecks and improving stability and throughput of spread simulations.
  • Work on improving how our models represent spread in and through the WUI, including:
    • Representing transitions from wildland fuels to urban and suburban areas.
    • Incorporating ember generation, spotting, and structure‑to‑structure fire spread behaviors.
    • Evaluating how different fuels, topography, and exposures influence spread into built environments.
    • Helping to shape new modeling approaches that better capture fire behavior in the WUI.
  • Develop, test, and maintain modeling and data‑processing pipelines in R and/or Python, including:
    • Automation and orchestration of large batches of spread simulations on HPC / cloud resources.
    • Efficient handling of large geospatial datasets (fuels, topography, exposure grids, fire perimeters).
  • Evaluate and integrate traditional wildfire spread science into our modeling framework:
    • Work with established fire behavior models (e.g., Rothermel‑based approaches and related methods).
    • Assess model behavior against historical wildfire perimeters, growth patterns, and impact footprints.
  • Perform model validation and verification:
    • Compare modeled spread and burned area to observed historical events across different fuel types and regions.
    • Document and communicate findings and recommended improvements back into the modeling workflow.
  • Collaborate closely with an international, interdisciplinary team of:
    • Catastrophe model developers, wildfire scientists, meteorologists, engineers, and exposure/vulnerability specialists.
    • Software developers and client‑facing colleagues who bring the models to market.
  • Prepare technical documentation, presentations, and summaries of modeling work for both internal and external audiences.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • M.S. or Ph.D. in wildfire science, fire behavior, environmental science, applied geoscience, atmospheric science, a closely related field (required) or equivalent years of industry experience
  • Direct experience with wildfire spread modeling (required), which may include:
    • Operational or research use of tools such as FARSITE, FlamMap, BehavePlus, or similar fire behavior models, and/or
    • Experience developing or working with custom spread models (cellular automata, level‑set methods, or other numerical approaches).
  • Demonstrated understanding of wildland–urban interface (WUI) fire behavior, including:
    • How fires transition from wildland fuels into communities.
    • The role of embers/spotting and structure‑to‑structure spread (preferred).
  • Strong programming / scripting skills, preferably in R and/or Python (required).
  • Experience working with geospatial data and tools (e.g., raster/vector data, GDAL, ArcGIS, QGIS, sf/terra in R, or equivalent) (required).
  • Experience with numerical or environmental models in an HPC or cloud environment (preferred).
  • Solid analytical and statistical skills, including working with large datasets and time series (required).
  • Experience with SQL or other database tools (preferred).
  • Excellent technical writing and presentation skills (required).
  • Experience with catastrophe modeling or risk modeling (preferred).

This is a hands‑on modeling role in a small, focused team, with a clear mandate to both operate our current spread modeling capabilities at scale and to help shape the next generation of wildfire spread modeling within Aon.
