Job.JobDescription:
Job Description

Aon is looking for a Senior Accountant - Captive and Insurance Management

Aon's Captive & Insurance Management team is an integral part of Aon's global operations. Our 500 + captive insurance professionals manage over 1,000 captive insurance companies across 39 locations around the globe, representing more than 15% of the captive insurance market. Our clients span every sector and Industry and are primarily made up of Fortune 500 companies.

This is a remote role or flexibility for a hybrid role if you are near our Honolulu, HI office.

Aon is in the business of better decisions!

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

  • Lead all aspects of the financial reporting for client accounts and serving as the primary contact for individuals from various departments, such as risk management, corporate controllership, tax, legal, etc.
  • Drive communication & processes for client service teams to ensure quality and timeliness of financial reporting and regulatory filings.
  • Mentor and develop accounting team members.
  • Coordinate efforts with outside service providers, including actuaries, auditors, investment managers, brokers, claims adjusters, and outside counsel to proactively meet client needs.
  • Communicate and implement business plan changes with State regulators.
  • Prepare and present materials during client board meetings.

How this opportunity is different

As a Senior Accountant, you will lead client service teams with diverse skillsets and areas of knowledge: financial reporting, compliance, and insurance, while being supported and guided by leadership team members. You will have direct contact with client contacts within the corporate controllership, risk management, tax, legal and other departments, as well as auditors, actuaries, investment managers, etc. At Aon, you are provided the opportunity to drive your career development.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Effective communicator, with strong interpersonal and communication skills, both verbally and written.
  • Accounting degree, CPA is a plus.
  • Insurance Accounting experience welcomed.
  • Organized and able to multi-task with ability to effectively prioritize tasks as needed.
  • Consistent track record of increasing efficiency and improving methods and approaches.
  • Proficiency working with Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Demonstrated effectiveness in presentations to clients.
  • Detail oriented and ability to understand and drive big picture recommendations.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, innovative and forward-thinking office environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in business related major or equivalent years of industry experience is essential.

How we support our colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well.

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

Aon values an innovative and inclusive workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

Aon provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran, marital, domestic partner status, or other legally protected status. People with criminal histories are encouraged to apply.

We welcome applications from all and provide individuals with disabilities with reasonable adjustments to participate in the job application, interview process and to perform essential job functions once onboard. If you would like to learn more about the reasonable accommodations we provide, email ReasonableAccommodations@Aon.com

For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances.

Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate.

Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

Pay Transparency Laws:

The salary range for this position intended for U.S. applicants is $90,000 to $120,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant's education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant's geographic location. The actual salary may vary for applicants in a different geographic location.

This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon's annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan.

Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon's discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies.

Full job description

Farmers– where ambition meets opportunity.

Farmers is known for more than its unforgettable jingle – it's a team with a passion for purpose and making a real difference in people's lives. Farmers employees deliver peace of mind when it matters most. The organization's results-driven, high-performance culture thrives on creativity, accountability and bold solutions. Ready to make your mark? Discover Farmers' vibrant culture and explore career opportunities at www.Farmers.com/careers/corporate.

Job Summary

This role will lead a team of Integration Engineers, Data Engineers, and Test Engineers in LATAM, partnering closely with the India team to provide continuity of IT delivery and support across locations. The role will serve as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams, developing a strong understanding of business capabilities, priorities, processes, and outcomes and translating them into effective technology solutions. The individual will have end-to-end ownership of technology solutions supporting assigned business capabilities, including solutions delivered through vendor platforms, and will be accountable for ensuring they meet business needs, architectural direction, quality expectations, and operational requirements.

This leader is expected to operate independently, lead technical teams through influence, constructively challenge proposed solutions when appropriate, and drive decisions toward the best business and technology outcome. The role will also partner with technical leadership and functional Centers of Excellence (COEs) to ensure delivery teams consistently follow established engineering, architecture, integration, data, testing, security, and operational standards.

Essential Job Functions

Business & Solution Ownership

  • Develop a strong understanding of assigned business capabilities, processes, priorities, and outcomes, working closely with business stakeholders to translate business needs into effective technology solutions.
  • Act as the end-to-end technology owner for assigned business capabilities, maintaining accountability across solution design, integration, data, testing, implementation, production support, and ongoing evolution.
  • Ensure technology solutions address the underlying business need, rather than simply implementing individual requirements or vendor capabilities.
  • Maintain a holistic view of the solution across internal systems, integrations, data flows, vendor platforms, and operational processes.

Technical Leadership & Challenge

  • Provide technical leadership across delivery teams, ensuring proposed solutions are fit for purpose, scalable, supportable, secure, and aligned with enterprise technology direction.
  • Review and constructively challenge technical designs, estimates, vendor recommendations, implementation approaches, and delivery decisions when they do not sufficiently address business needs or established technical standards.
  • Lead technical teams through influence rather than organizational authority, creating alignment across engineering, data, integration, testing, architecture, operations, and vendor teams.
  • Drive technical decisions and facilitate resolution when multiple teams, technologies, or vendors are involved in delivering a business capability.

Vendor Solution Ownership

  • Own the overall solution outcome even when significant components are delivered by third-party vendors, ensuring accountability does not stop at the vendor or platform boundary.
  • Evaluate vendor solutions in the context of the broader business capability, including integration, data, security, supportability, resiliency, and operational impact.
  • Hold vendors and internal delivery teams accountable for meeting agreed technical standards, solution requirements, quality expectations, and delivery commitments.
  • Ensure vendor capabilities are appropriately integrated into the enterprise technology landscape rather than treated as standalone solutions.

COE & Engineering Standards

  • Partner with technical leadership and relevant Centers of Excellence (COEs) to understand established architecture, engineering, integration, data, testing, security, and operational standards.
  • Ensure delivery teams consistently apply COE standards, approved patterns, reusable components, and engineering practices.
  • Identify and escalate deviations from established standards, working with technical leadership to determine when exceptions are justified.
  • Provide feedback to COEs based on delivery experience to help evolve standards and practices where appropriate.

Delivery & Operational Accountability

  • Maintain end-to-end accountability from business need through design, build, testing, implementation, stabilization, and production support.
  • Proactively identify dependencies, technical risks, delivery constraints, and cross-team impacts and drive them to resolution.
  • Balance business priorities, technical quality, delivery timelines, cost, and operational risk when making or influencing solution decisions.
  • Ensure solutions transition effectively into production with appropriate documentation, controls, monitoring, support processes, and knowledge transfer.

Physical Actions

Physical Environment

Education Requirements

High school diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent, relevant experience.

Experience Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience working as a Solution Engineer
  • Strong understanding of Mulesoft
  • Experience working with cloud environments like AWS
  • Experience working with Vendors managing integrations
  • Strong integration and data experience

Special Skill Requirement

Additional Qualification

  • Experience working with Dremio & CDGC

Benefits

This position offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and work–life balance. While specific benefits may vary by country and employee level, offerings generally include competitive salary opportunities, performance-based bonuses, comprehensive benefits, and ongoing training and development resources.

Important Hiring Conditions and Disclosures

By applying for this position, candidates acknowledge and agree that:

• Personal Data Processing: The personal data provided during the recruitment and selection process will be collected, processed, and retained for legitimate recruitment and compliance purposes, in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy laws and FBS internal policies.

• Legal Authorization to Work: Employment with FBS is conditional upon the candidate having valid, local legal authorization to work in the country where the role is based at the time of hire. FBS does not sponsor or obtain work authorization unless explicitly stated.

• Exclusivity of Employment and Conflict of Interest: Upon acceptance of an offer and during employment with FBS, employees will not be permitted to engage in parallel employment, professional activities, or paid work for other entities. Any ownership, partnership, directorship, or participation in other businesses or companies must be fully disclosed and formally reviewed in accordance with FBS internal conflict‑of‑interest and external engagement policies prior to the start date or as soon as such circumstances arise.

Failure to comply with these conditions may impact the hiring decision or employment continuation.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Caledonia, MI
  • Experience: 1 to 3 years
  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • Physical: Lifting up to 50 lbs
  • Benefits: 401(k), paid time off, tuition assistance

About this job

Maintains landscaping, snow removal, and outdoor grounds at Farmers Insurance locations in Caledonia, MI. Performs tasks including mowing, trimming, chemical application, irrigation system maintenance, and winter snow removal with potential weekend and overtime work.

Good fit if you have a high school diploma, state certification or willingness to obtain it for pesticide application, and preferably 1-3 years landscaping or equipment operation experience.

Full job description

Workplace: On-site ( #LI-Onsite )

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days virtual for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office. Applicants beyond fifty (50) miles may still be considered.

Job Summary

This role supports and maintains a sustainable, landscaping, snow removal and outdoor maintenance program. Performs day-to-day landscaping and maintenance activities at one or all of three or more separate locations or a campus environment.

Shift Hours & Location

  • This role is an essential onsite role in Caledonia, MI.
  • Shift hours generally will be 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM; Monday - Friday.
  • Pls note: shift hours will have to adjust during the Winter season, depending on when snow accumulations takes place.
    • This could include working weekends and the opportunity for overtime.

Essential Job Functions

  • Performs tasks common to the care of grounds and landscapes by seeding, watering, mulching, fertilizing, and applying chemicals to outside plantings, lawns and turf, transplanting; inspecting plant materials for insects, disease, physical and mechanical damage to irrigation systems and identifying replacements; transplanting, pruning, trimming, and cultivating trees, shrubs, ground cover, and flowers; pest management; storing and caring for bulbs and cuttings in the winter season.
  • Performs regular and directed grounds and landscape maintenance by mowing lawns with riding or push mowers; trimming and edging around trees, shrubs, ground cover, flowers, sidewalks and buildings; weeding, thinning, and cleaning flower beds and other grounds by hand or utilizing proper tools and equipment; and setting up, adjusting, repairing, and cleaning irrigation systems.
  • Operates light and medium equipment in the winter months to clear snow from parking lots, sidewalks, and other traversed areas. As part of the snow removal program, candidate must be available to work differing shifts depending on when snow accumulations take place.
  • Applies chemicals used in grounds keeping (horticulture, turf management, and floriculture) properly and safely by wearing prescribed protective clothing, masks, and/or rubber gloves and boots, following either written or verbal directions for mixing chemical compounds according to specifications, applying the chemicals properly on grounds and landscapes designated for their use, and disposing of residual chemical products as directed or storing and labeling them for future use.
  • Documents a record of grounds and landscape watering and chemical spraying by keeping daily logs of areas watered and duration of watering and the application of chemicals, including areas sprayed, amount and type of chemicals used, substances sprayed and reason, and the wind speed and direction at time of spraying.
  • Safely operates light and medium duty vehicles such as pick-up trucks, tractors, loaders, skid steers, street sweepers or riding mowers.
  • Operates portable power tools and equipment such as saws, grass trimmers, snow/leaf blowers, sprayers, paint machines and other grounds keeping equipment.
  • Obeys applicable traffic laws, follows operator instructions, and wears appropriate safety items such as goggles, gloves, or other appropriate protective clothing.
  • Ensures grounds maintenance equipment and building maintenance equipment are operational by performing routine and preventative maintenance and cleaning of tools, equipment and machines within reasonable capabilities.
  • Maintains record of mechanical equipment operations, building/landscape maintenance, and vendor service visits.
  • Initiates or advises needs for purchases requisitions, verifies receipt of services or product or service.
  • Responsible for the inspection, maintenance, and repair of the campus grounds and out buildings.
  • Responsible for recommending modifications of the grounds systems including electrical, lighting, plumbing, painting and remodeling and irrigation systems, pumps, ponds, drainage and grading of terrain.
  • As needed, consults and reports any security related matters to leadership as well as Corporate Security.

Education & Career Experience Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Licensed by state Department of Agriculture as a certified applicator or handler of insecticides, herbicides, and fungicides where required or a willingness to obtain such certifications within the first year.
  • 1-3 years experience in the landscaping or irrigation industry preferred.
  • Medium/heavy equipment operation will be preferred. This will involve operating a large tractor for snow removal in the wintertime, skid steers, mowers, etc, throughout the rest of the year.

Additional Qualifications

  • Strong verbal communication and listening skills including written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated customer service skills.
  • Excellent collaboration and team building skills.
  • Friendly and service-oriented; maintains professionalism at all times.
  • Possesses strong technical aptitude; proficient in Microsoft applications.
  • Strong mechanical skills; knowledgeable and skilled in the safe use and maintenance of hand tools, power tools, user-moved aids, mechanical equipment and measuring devices.

Physical Actions

Requires ability to perform physical actions, primarily outdoors, such as frequent walking and standing on feet for long periods of time, maneuvering different terrain, bending, stooping, pushing, pulling, climbing, and using a ladder. Ability to lift up to 50lbs.

Physical Environment

Exposure to noise and extreme temperatures, exposure to hazards such as chemicals and paint.

Benefits

  • Farmers offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience, qualifications and location.

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Job Summary

  • This is for a person with expertise in product execution. This role supports the rate setting process which is the most important driver of our business results.
  • The role leads large scale processes and drives process improvement.
  • You will be leading a team working on specific markets or countrywide efforts that is responsible for supporting profitable growth of the business; assignments are generally larger and more complex than Product Managers.
  • This position requires strong organizational and time management skills, working in a cross-collaborative environment and solving structured and unstructured business problems.
  • Performs work independently with limited guidance. May manage a team of Product Managers and Analysts.

Essential Job Functions

  • Demonstrates an expertise in the principles of product management, filing process, quoting platforms and systems, knowledge management, underwriting guidelines and defining data requirements in support of the profit and growth of the business.
  • Demonstrates understanding of how the rate order of calculation works.
  • Able to guide their team's ability to navigate the organization's processes (filing, IT programming/delivery/testing, compliance, underwriting, regulatory) to influence the timeline and sequencing of both rate and non-rate initiatives that drive and influence business results. Demonstrates ability to proactively guide team's management of complex rate and non-rate initiatives.
  • Proactively works with key business partners to drive complex process improvements across the organization. Provides guidance to Product Managers and analysts on ways to optimize product changes, project implementation, and underwriting guideline updates.
  • Provides guidance for scheduling and deployment of rate revisions, multi-state product initiatives, and non-rate projects, ensuring alignment across impacted states and teams. Owns scheduling and deployment of complex rate revisions, multi-state product initiatives, and non-rate initiatives, ensuring alignment across impacted states.
  • Provides direction and guidance for all stages of the rate execution, filing process, compliance and regulatory, rate and non-rate initiatives, and timeline and sequencing.
  • Regulatory expert for assigned market or product.
  • Influences key business partners and leadership on complex rate and non-rate timeline and sequencing.
  • Demonstrates expertise of competitor product structure, underwriting rules, systems and quoting platforms. Provides direction and guidance on competitor research into compliance and regulatory changes.
  • Develops training and onboarding plan and responsible for consistent development of team members related to key processes and progression. Responsible for leading the hiring and onboarding process of new team members.
  • Escalation owner for complex or high-impact product issues.
  • Review team recommendations and facilitate presentations with leaders and business partners regarding proposed product or underwriting rule changes.
  • Business owner of complex interactions and negotiation for proposed product or underwriting rule changes with departments of insurance and other regulatory entities.
  • Able to drive and coach team prioritization.
  • Able to leverage extensive network with key internal business partners.
  • Responsible for escalation resolution and leadership communication of complex structured and unstructured problems impacting the Product team.

Physical Actions

  • Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Frequently sits for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including, navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and/or places objects or materials weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Rarely performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category require rare, if any, travel.

Education Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent is required.
  • Bachelor's degree with focus in Business, or Research such as Economics, Business Administration, Marketing, Risk Management preferred.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 13 years US property & casualty experience in product or underwriting preferred; or related experience preferred.
  • People leadership experience preferred.

Additional Qualification

  • Demonstrated analytical and research skills.
  • Possesses strong organizational skills with technical aptitude.
  • Experience in Excel required. Effective interpersonal skills: has the ability to work in teams, embraces collaboration and networking.
  • Embraces continuous learning. Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Process improvement, lean thinking. Demonstrated mentorship and coaching skills.
  • Experience with AI and Automation Tools preferred

Benefits

  • Farmers offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience, qualifications and location.

  • Coordinate with District Managers, Sales Director, Territory Office and agents to set goals, define marketing/sales objectives, achieve profitability, influence business processes, and follow through to defined goals.
  • Work with assigned agents to influence sales and marketing behaviors and drive top-line business results.

  • Achievement of top line and bottom-line sales results within assigned territory. Accomplishes rotating territory field travel schedule as outlined in the plan for meeting one-on-one with agents or in groups to present methods, ideas and support for the specific purpose of increasing sales in the assigned territory. Develop business plans for defined territory, districts and agents to focus activity on achieving all sales goals, including specific marketing and sales activities, as well as presentations and sales training that will be used within the assigned territory to drive sales results to the specified goals.
  • Reviews territory performance and prepares estimated run rates and reports of operations that include corrective actions where necessary. Assist agencies in the identification of prospective customers through recommendations of effective lead developing methods. Follows through on identified quotes with underwriting to assure achievement of desired hit ratios, evaluating results monthly, recommending actions to either correct deficiencies or to exploit a developing market opportunity.
  • Establish methods to gain knowledge and understanding of market conditions, product innovations and competitor's products, prices and sales, as well as new regulatory and statutory requirements that may affect marketplace and distribution system. Performs other duties as assigned.

  • Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. Job may include work performed at field locations.   • Python experience is required.
  • CLTV experience is required.
  • ML Ops experience preferred.
  • Lead routing experience highly preferred.

Additional Qualification

Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Strong storytelling skills with ability to communicate complex data insights clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Demonstrated written communication skills. Demonstrated problem solving skills. Effective interpersonal skills. Ability to influence internal and/or external constituents. Demonstrated analytical skills. Possesses strong technical aptitude. Seeks to acquire knowledge in area of specialty. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite. Demonstrated time management and priority setting skills. Able to handle shifting priorities. Strong proficiency working on large-scale structured and unstructured multidimensional data using in-depth knowledge of open-source cloud-enabled analytical programming languages. Strong ability to consult on data extraction, data manipulation and data design for statistical, modeling and monitoring needs. In-depth knowledge of data analysis, manipulation tools (SQL, Python, SAS, R, and/or Snowflake) and cloud computing services (AWS). In-depth knowledge of data visualization tools (example, Tableau, Power BI). Strong proficiency in using explanatory, diagnostic, and inferential techniques such as experimental design, hypothesis testing, clustering analysis, time series and other statistical modeling algorithms with the ability to decide the appropriate methodology for the purpose. Strong proficiency in predictive and prescriptive modeling using advanced machine learning and deep learning techniques. In-depth knowledge of ML/AI model deployment best practices. Able to adapt quickly to new technologies. In-depth knowledge of coding standards and version control (Git). Working knowledge of data ethics and data privacy.

Job.JobTitle: Managing Engineer - Risk Data & AI (Remote, US)
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Risk Management / Loss Control, Technology / Insurtech
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Chicago, IL

About this job

Managing Engineer leading teams that build data products, AI-enabled applications, and enterprise data platforms for risk and compliance decision-making. Role combines technical leadership with hands-on engineering, requiring 5+ years in data/AI engineering and 2+ years leading engineers.

Good fit if you have 5+ years data or AI engineering experience, 2+ years leading engineers, and hands-on development in Python or Java.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Risk Data & AI designs, builds, and operates governed data products, analytics solutions, and AI-enabled capabilities that support risk and compliance decision-making. The team applies modern data, software, and AI engineering practices to deliver scalable data pipelines, trusted analytical products, intelligent automation, and responsible AI solutions that enable TORC to identify emerging risks, generate actionable insights, and make timely, evidence-based decisions.

The Managing Engineer is a hands-on engineering leader responsible for leading teams that build, deliver, and operate these data and AI products in production. This role blends strong technical leadership, people leadership, and delivery ownership, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, secure, and responsibly implemented, with measurable business and engineering impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team delivering data products, AI-enabled applications, intelligent automation capabilities, and enterprise data platforms.
  • Set technical direction across data engineering, AI engineering, application development, deployment, and operational support.
  • Act as a hands-on leader contributing to architecture, design decisions, AI solution patterns, and critical-path development.
  • Own production outcomes including system reliability, data quality, application performance, model effectiveness, and operational health.
  • Partner with Digital Product Managers, data teams, AI teams, and engineering organizations to align roadmaps, priorities, and delivery outcomes.
  • Drive modern engineering practices including TDD, CI/CD, observability, MLOps, automated testing, and responsible AI implementation.
  • Translate business, risk, and compliance requirements into scalable data, analytics, and AI-powered solutions and reusable engineering patterns.
  • Influence adoption of enterprise data standards, AI engineering best practices, and platform-integrated capabilities.
  • Lead agile execution with a strong focus on measurable business outcomes, engineering excellence, and continuous delivery.

Required Skills:

  • 5+ years of data, analytics, or AI engineering experience with hands-on development in Python and/or Java, and delivery of production-grade AI solutions.
  • 2+ years leading engineers with technical guidance across architecture, design, code reviews, engineering standards, and delivery coaching.
  • Experience with APIs, backend services, data pipelines, and analytical/reporting systems.
  • Experience delivering AI-enabled applications, Generative AI solutions, or intelligent automation capabilities.
  • Knowledge of modern engineering practices including DevSecOps, CI/CD pipelines, testing, monitoring, and observability.
  • Experience with Generative AI frameworks, large language models, prompt engineering, and AI orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using enterprise data and vector databases.
  • Experience working in agile environments delivering data, analytics, or AI solutions.

Desirable Skills:

  • Experience in risk, compliance, security, governance, or technology operations domains.
  • Experience with MLOps, AI model deployment, evaluation, monitoring, and operationalization.
  • Exposure to agentic AI, multi-agent systems, AI copilots, or intelligent workflow automation.
  • Ability to influence adoption of standards, reusable patterns, and scalable engineering solutions across teams.
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and developing technical leaders.
  • Strong stakeholder management and ability to navigate cross-team dependencies.
  • Commitment to building scalable, reliable, responsible, and low-friction data and AI solutions that improve organizational outcomes.

Compensation offered for this role is 120,000.00 - 193,725.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. Job Description

The Inside Auto Claims Adjuster is responsible for investigating basic and occasionally moderately complex auto insurance claims. This role may handle non-represented claims and requires evaluating coverage, determining liability, and negotiating settlements. The adjuster works directly with claimants, insureds, and other involved parties to ensure timely, accurate, and customer-focused claim resolution.

Work Location & Schedule


Projected Start Date: January 11, 2027


During Training: IN OFFICE

  • Monday through Friday, 8am-4:45pm

After Training: HYBRID (IN OFFICE & REMOTE)

  • Hours: MondayFriday between 8:00 AM 5:30 PM, with occasional Saturday
  • Work Arrangement: Hybrid schedule 3 days in office (Tuesday-Thursday), 2 days remote (Monday, Friday)

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and company standards throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Investigate minor to moderately complex auto accidents and prepare clear, concise claim summaries.
  • Conduct recorded statements with claimants, insureds, and witnesses.
  • Evaluate auto claims to determine coverage, liability, and damages.
  • Negotiate and settle claims in alignment with established guidelines and best practices.
  • Maintain detailed and well-documented claim files, including notes, summaries, and decision rationale.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to support efficient and customer-centric claim handling.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of prior claim handling experience preferred.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a demonstrated commitment to excellent customer service.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and operate in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail with solid critical-thinking and decision-making skills.
  • Comfortable using technology and learning claims-related software and tools.
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Washington, and Hawaii residents.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, you may be expected to obtain an adjusters license in multiple markets.
  • All required licenses must be obtained within 60 days of hire.
  • You must maintain all licensing required for your role. This includes any continuing education and/or other state-affiliated requirements for licensing renewal.
  • This role offers a $1,000 sign on bonus if you have an active adjuster license in TX, FL, or your resident state.
  • Current employees and former employees seeking rehire at Allstate or its affiliated companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

What You Need:

  • A dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.
  • Appropriate work surface and seating.

What Allstate Provides:

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitor, headset, keyboard, mouse).
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset a portion of your internet costs.

Allstate Benefits:

Allstate cares about you and your wellbeing. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that includes pay, benefits, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. You can choose whatever benefits are most important you. Here are some of our benefits:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Paid parental leave
  • Adoption reimbursement
  • Paid time off
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Wellness incentives
  • Allstate Foundation donation match and grant opportunities

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Chicago, IL
  • Experience: 4+ years

About this job

Digital Product Manager role at Allstate leading strategy and lifecycle management for billing and payments platform capabilities. Requires partnering across engineering, design, and business teams to drive customer-centric financial experiences and measurable outcomes.

Good fit if you have 4+ years managing technical products with strong billing or payments platform experience and ability to partner closely with engineering teams.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Technical Product Manager is responsible for defining product strategy, shaping vision, and driving measurable customer and business outcomes for one or more technical products within Allstates Billing and Payments ecosystem. This role owns the direction, prioritization, and lifecycle of complex platform capabilities that enable accurate, reliable, scalable, and customer-centric financial experiences.

This leader partners closely with engineering, design, architecture, data, finance, and business stakeholders to identify problems worth solving, validate opportunities through discovery, and translate strategy into a clear roadmap and prioritized backlog. Success in this role requires strong product judgment, systems thinking, and the ability to balance long-term platform health with near-term delivery and business value.

The ideal candidate is a strong product strategist with deep technical fluency, a data-driven mindset, and experience managing enterprise-scale billing, payments, or financial platforms.

Key responsibilities:

  • Define and evolve the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a technical product or platform within Billing and Payments.

  • Own product outcomes byestablishingsuccess measures, tracking performance, and using data to inform prioritization and strategic tradeoffs.

  • Lead discovery, framing, and test-and-learn activities tovalidatecustomer, business, and operational assumptions before scaling solutions.

  • Partner deeply with engineering to shape platform direction, evaluate architectural and operational tradeoffs, and prioritize work across features, defects, resiliency, and technical debt.

  • Translate complex business and customer problems into well-sequenced product investments with clear value, dependencies, and measurable outcomes.

  • Represent the voice of the customer, user, and enterprise by combining customer insight, market context, operational signals, and internal stakeholder needs.

  • Drive alignment across business, technology, design, and operational partners to deliver high-impact solutions and ensure successful adoption.

  • Manage and prioritize the backlog to support iterative delivery while preserving focus on strategic outcomes rather than output alone.

  • Author, refine, test, and accept stories as needed to enable effective execution by the product team.

  • Communicate product direction, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders and leadership.

Essential Skills:

  • A minimum of4 years of product management experience leading technical products, platforms, APIs, services, data products, or developer experiences.

  • Strong experience in billing, payments, or adjacent financial platforms, preferably within insurance or another highly regulated financial environment.

  • Demonstrated ability to partner closely with engineering and architecture teams on systems thinking, service design, integration patterns, data flows, reliability, and scalability.

  • Proventrack recordof defining strategy and using metrics to drive prioritization, decision-making, and measurable outcomes.

  • Experience leading discovery and experimentation tovalidateassumptions and improve product direction.

Desirable Skills:

  • Experience withcustomerfacing financial flows where accuracy, auditability, resiliency, and operational excellence are critical.

  • Experience using analytics, automation, or AI/ML in pragmatic product use cases such as anomaly detection, operational efficiency, explainability, or decision support.

  • Experience working across multiple teams or products in a complex enterprise platform environment.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • This role does not have direct people-managementresponsibilities butenjoys the highest level of ownership and autonomy.

Skills

Business Case Analyses, Business Outcomes, Customer Insights, Digital Products, Product Development, Product Direction, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Management, Product Roadmapping, Product Vision, Software Product Management, Systems Thinking, Waterfall Model

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 110,000.00 - 181,025.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Workplace: Hybrid ( #LI-Hybrid ), Remote ( #LI-Remote )

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days virtual for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office. Applicants beyond fifty (50) miles may still be considered.

Job Summary

Sales Trailblazer Wanted! | P&C licensed Sales Consultant | Uncapped Earnings + Career Growth

We're looking for sales-driven, enthusiastic experienced sales professionals to join our next classes of Sales Consultants beginning in November 2026.

In this role, you will respond to calls coming into our call center by positively promoting Farmers insurance products to prospective customers, consulting with customers to understand their needs, and selling those products which best fit the customer's needs. You may also make outbound calls to optimize sales potential. You will earn a competitive base salary in addition to monthly incentive earnings based upon your performance.

We provide a comprehensive paid training program, combining virtual classroom and hands-on learning with mentoring to ensure that you have the skills you need to succeed at Farmers. Ongoing coaching and training will remain a focus throughout your career to help you grow in your role and advance to new opportunities.

Join a team where your performance drives your paycheck! Our compensation package is designed to reward your success.

  • Our model includes guaranteed annual base pay of $40,000+ based on your experience.
  • A competitive benefits package PLUS an uncapped performance-based incentive, giving you the opportunity to increase your earnings on average up to an additional $27,300+ on top of the guaranteed base pay annually.

  • Tech-savvy & adaptable – You navigate systems with ease and embrace change.
  • Coachable & curious – You welcome feedback and seek growth.
  • Accountable & reliable – You own your outcomes and show up ready.

If you're driven, competitive and ready to grow, this is the place to do it! Check out a Day in the Life of a Sales Representative!

You'll thrive in this position if you have:

  • Proven ability to meet quotas, metrics and goals
  • A drive to work in a fast-paced, high energy environment
  • Desire for a long-term career within the insurance industry
  • Proven ability to take initiative, solve problems, and prioritize tasks
  • Direct sales skills, and the aptitude to influence customers and close the sale
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; the ability to adapt communication style to each phone call, and explain complex policy and coverage information in understandable terms
  • Must be eligible to obtain resident/non-resident property and casualty license in all required states

Job.JobTitle: Java Development Lead Identity Systems Engineer
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Chicago, IL

About this job

Lead Consultant role designing and implementing workforce identity and access management solutions for Allstate's enterprise systems. Requires Java developer experience and expertise with Active Directory, CI/CD pipelines, and security controls.

Good fit if you have 5+ years of developer experience, Java skills, and background with Active Directory and CI/CD security implementation.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Lead Consultant typically provides expertise across all major functions in their area(s) of the business and delivers product features utilizing in-house and vended software, particularly web services and applications, by applying knowledge of the application functionality and client business processes. The person in the role creates technical and process designs and configures vendor and in-house software for new or existing complex enterprise-wide and business-unit applications and maintenance efforts. The Lead Consultant is also aware of roadmaps and understands how to navigate support processes and developer groups to gain insight and influence future direction.

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Workforce Identity Lead Consultant to join our team. This role is ideal for professionals with developer experience who want to be at the forefront of designing and rolling out new automated access provisioning methods and tools. The candidate will be expected to work closely both with internal team members and other Identity teams to help provide a seamless experience for our customers. You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting IAM solutions that align with Allstates security policies and business objectives.

***ALL CANDIDATES MUST BE IN THE CST OR EST TIMEZONES. NO EXCEPTIONS.***

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop overall product planning by contributing to stories for complex features in areas of responsibility, including guiding the story development for other team members who may be learning.
  • Organize, lead and finalize feature review sessions for complex business issues/requirements and document resulting decisions; provide coaching to less experienced team members on their features and delivery.
  • Create the functional design, using technical skills, to address complex business processes or issues or to address the requirements of a set of product features.
  • Configure or develop within vendor and in-house software; review and verify operation of new vendor or in-house release features. Use vendor and in-house defect resolution procedures and support tools to resolve issues.
  • Use knowledge of integrated requirements to evaluate proposed software products in line with strategic corporate and vendor direction.
  • Support the planning, conduct, and review of module and integration testing for all but the most complex projects.
  • Manage the issues and blockers for assigned features and stories.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve access related issues including reported problems to our applications, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
  • In partnership with the business groups and technical teams, provide knowledge and support for resolving technology issues in multiple areas of the business; acknowledged as a subject matter expert in multiple processes and applications.
  • Collaborate with various Product and Service teams to gather requirements and provide Identity solutions that meet performance, availability, capacity and resiliency targets for moderately complex systems.
  • Participate in the development and maintenance of Workforce Identity Roadmaps, bringing together business direction and infrastructure direction. Participate in review sessions with leadership.
  • Participate in audits and compliance activities by providing documentation and evidence of controls.
  • Provide visibility into current state performance and capacity through dashboards, reporting and review sessions with leadership.
  • Initiate tracks of work (ranked in priority) and ensure agreed timelines are met.
  • Provide projections of future capacity demand and identify potential recommendations for meeting projected demands, based on business and technology directions.
  • Participate in a rolling on-call rotation within the team.

Experience:

  • 5 or more years of developer experience (preferred).
  • Practical experience designing or operating security controls embedded into CI/CD pipelines, developer workflows, or shared platform services.
  • Java experience (preferred).
  • Python experience (desirable).
  • Experience of formulating and executing AD PowerShell Scripts.
  • Effective communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex situations and provide actionable solutions.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

***ALL CANDIDATES MUST BE IN THE CST OR EST TIMEZONES. NO EXCEPTIONS.***

Skills

Active Directory (AD), Agile Methodology, CI/CD, Java Software Development, Microsoft PowerShell, Python (Programming Language), Python Software Development, Software Engineering

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 98,100.00 - 167,850.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $20.00 an hour
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Saint Petersburg, FL
  • Experience: 2+ years
  • Benefits: Health insurance, retirement plan, paid time off, paid holidays, tuition assistance

About this job

Direct Sales Agent Specialist for National General Insurance selling auto, home, and specialty insurance products in Saint Petersburg. Role involves generating new business and cross-selling to customers through in-person and phone sales, with community relationship building.

Good fit if you have 0-2 years of experience and are willing to obtain P&C licensing within 90 days if needed

Full job description

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.

This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment while making adifference, then apply to join our team today!

As a Direct Sales Agent Specialist, you will:

  • Achieve sales goals through new business, cross-sell, and retention
  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline, including local lead generation and referrals
  • Develop relationships within the community (e.g., dealerships, events, local partners) to support business growth
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and follow-ups to convert opportunities into sales
  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives
  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition
  • Deliver results aligned with performance standards, compliance requirements, and customer experience expectations

What makes Direct Auto Insurance unique?

  • Day 1 Benefits
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Tuition Reimbursement, Pension & so much more
  • 20 PTO Days per year &6Paid Holidays
  • Ability to sell a multitude of industry-leading products through retail stores andphone
  • Entrepreneurial, performance-based, and results-focused culture
  • Multi-tiered and comprehensive paid training program
  • Base hourly rate plus uncapped monthly incentive

MinimumQualifications:

  • 0 2years of experience
  • P&C licensing (Preferred) or mustattainrequired licensure within90 daysof joining thecompany.

Compensation

Base compensation: $20.00 per hour

Job.JobTitle: Field Auto Damage Appraiser - Nassau County
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: New York, NY
  • Experience: 3 to 5 years
  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • License: Valid driver's license
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off, tuition assistance

About this job

Field-based auto damage appraiser for Allstate Insurance in Nassau County. You'll meet customers on-site to assess vehicle damage, write estimates, and guide them through the repair or total loss process using in-person visits, virtual inspections, and written communication.

Good fit if you have 3-5 years of auto collision estimating experience with CCC or Mitchell software and a valid driver's license.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Are you someone who enjoys being on the move, solving problems, and making a real impact for customers? As a Field Auto Appraiser, you'll be at the forefront of our claims processmeeting customers where they are, whether it's at their home, a repair shop, or a tow yard.

You'll take the lead in writing estimates and guiding customers through the repair or total loss process, using a mix of in-person visits, virtual inspections, and written communication. No two days are the samewhether you're evaluating damage on-site or collaborating with body shops and service providers, you'll enjoy a fast-paced, hands-on role that keeps you engaged and on your toes.

If you're looking for a career that blends technical know-how, customer service, and the freedom of field work, this is your chance to thrive in a role where your expertise truly matters.


Sign-On Bonus: A $5,000 sign-on bonus may be offered to qualified candidates who receive and accept an employment offer. Eligibility, payment timing, and conditions will be outlined in the official offer letter.


Preferred Qualifications

  • You have 3-5 years' experience in auto collision estimating using CCC or Mitchell
  • You have a High School Diploma or a GED
  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with customers
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to write precise and comprehensive estimates
  • Comfortable with utilizing technology and various platforms for claims processing
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills to manage multiple assignments effectively
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements

A day in the life of the Field Auto Damage Appraiser, and what it takes to do the job!

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder Your Eye for Detail Keeps Everything on Track- In this role, youll ensure claims are documented accurately and in line with policy agreements. As you handle each case, youll maintain clear, timely records in our claims system (which well train you on). Your attention to detail helps keep the process smooth, organized, and transparent from start to finish.

Work Location

  • This position is a field-based role.To be eligible for this role, you must be located in the following locations: Nassau County - Long Island, NY

Company Car
Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.


Training:

The first approximately eight weeks of employment are dedicated to onboarding, licensing (if applicable), and role-specific training designed to prepare you for success in the role. Successful candidates must be able to attend required training sessions, actively participate in virtual learning activities, and successfully complete the training program.


Notice of Licensing Requirement

  • As a condition of employment, you may be expected to obtain an adjusters' and/or appraisers' license in multiple markets
  • All required licenses will need to be obtained within 60 days of hire
  • You must maintain all licensing required for your role. This includes any continuing education and/or other state-affiliated requirements for licensing renewal
  • This role offers a sign on bonus of $1,000 if you have an active appraiser license or active adjuster license in TX, FL, or your resident state (current employees and candidates who have previously worked for and are seeking to be rehired at Allstate and its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus)

Benefits

Allstate cares about you and your wellbeing. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that includes pay, benefits, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. You can choose whatever benefits are most important you. Here are some of our offerings:

  • Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Allstate pension plan and 401(k) savings plan
  • Ayco financial coaching
  • Spring Health mental and emotional wellbeing resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Adoption reimbursement
  • Paid time off
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Wellness incentives

#LI-BH3

Skills

Auto Body Repair, Auto Body Shop Management, Auto Body Work, Automotive Body Repair, Automotive Body Structure, Automotive Maintenance, Automotive Repair, Body Mechanics, Car Maintenance, CCC ONE, Negotiation, Repair Estimating, Vehicle Appraisals, Vehicle Valuation, Written Communication

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 60,000.00 - 117,700.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Allstate Technology Solutions is dedicated to creating a new type of insurance platform. By leveraging cutting edge technologies, innovative product design and true integration of artificial intelligence functions with emphasis on Generative AI, Agentic AI and other AI capabilities, we will revolutionize what is means to be a protection provider.

Our goal is to create a truly transformational customer experience, while also enabling significant opportunities for operational efficiencies and contextual personalization.

Become a part of our story.

At Allstate Technology Solutions, youll find a collaborative and dynamic team focused on exploring new capabilities and pushing the boundaries of what is possible. The team works in a continuous innovation cycle of ideas, research, testing, analysis, and delivery

The Role

As a talented Digital Product Manager, you love to execute on strategic vision and turning it into something tangible whether that be a story, a design or even code. We need you to get your hands dirty with raw data and derive meaningful and actionable insights that you can use to influence direction of product team and those that surround it. Youre an innovative thinker, an independent mover, an expert communicator, and an agile problem solver looking to join an exciting team.


As an ideal candidate, you can learn and adapt quickly and are able to use every tool at your disposalsoftware, data, analytics and beyondto understand and effectively tackle hard problems. You appreciate the importance working through problem statements and defining success before the team writes code. You can hop into architecture, UX, and business discussions and ensure that the team is always driving towards collective success.


Youre also an individual who.

  • Embraces a continuously evolving breadth of projects and goals.
  • Dedicates time and interest to learning and continuously improving.
  • Desires to contribute concretely to design sessions, analytical discussions, and retrospectives.
  • Innovates and problem-solves by using new modeling techniques or tools.
  • Takes initiative and works efficiently while maintaining a focus on the bigger picture.
  • Partners closely with technical and non-technical teammates to define product goals.
  • Works collaboratively with other team members in pursuit of a common goal and execution of shared strategy

Responsibilities:

Product Roadmap Execution: Craft and execute a comprehensive product roadmap, prioritizing features and enhancements. Ensure that portfolio of products are aligned horizontally and meeting product goals.

Problem/success understanding: Collaborate with stakeholders to define what needs to be true to meet intended outcomes, ensuring a deep understanding of user needs.


User Experience Design: Advocate and design for seamless user experiences, from concept to execution.


Qualifications:

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience building products
  • Extensive track record of execution 1+ years working in Google AI, Azure Cognitive Services, AWS Machine Learning, hands-on experience
  • Experience integrating Generative AI into a products, experience executing and scaling products with Generative AI/Agentic AI is a plus
  • Agile Processes: Proficiency in Agile methodologies (e.g., iterations, point systems, refinements).
  • Adaptability: Comfort operating in an agile environment with ambiguity.
  • Data Literacy: Navigate complex data landscapes, leveraging insights to inform product decisions
  • Analytical skills: Ability to independently analyze and query data to find insights and understand patterns. Working knowledge of SQL and some coding skills (Python) would be a plus.

Skills

Agile Methodology, Amazon Web Services (AWS), API Integration, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Business Case Analyses, Critical Thinking, Digital Product Management, Microsoft Azure, Product Management, Product Roadmapping, Product Strategies, Python (Programming Language), Systems Thinking, User Experience (UX)

Compensation offered for this role is 120,000.00 - 193,725.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

About this job

Licensed Customer Engagement Specialist supporting customers with Accident & Health insurance questions and enrollment through outbound and inbound outreach. Remote position requiring active state insurance license and bilingual Spanish/English fluency.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Help Customers Navigate Their Health Coverage with Confidence

Are you passionate about helping people, building relationships, and making a difference in customers' lives? Join our team as a Licensed Customer Engagement Specialist, where you'll serve as a trusted guide for customers, agents, and prospective members seeking support with their Accident & Health insurance needs.

In this role, you'll combine your customer service expertise, communication skills, and insurance knowledge to educate customers, answer questions, support enrollment and retention efforts, and connect individuals with solutions that fit their unique situations. If you're a motivated professional who enjoys helping others, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and values meaningful customer interactions, we'd love to hear from you.

Why You'll Love This Role
Make a direct impact by helping customers understand and access important health insurance products and services.
Work from home in a supportive, team-oriented environment.
Expand your skills through continuous training, coaching, and cross-functional learning opportunities.
Be part of a collaborative team that values flexibility, customer advocacy, and professional growth.
Utilize your Accident & Health insurance license to make a meaningful difference in every customer interaction.

What You'll Do


As a Licensed Customer Engagement Specialist, you'll proactively engage customers through outbound outreach while delivering exceptional service and support. You'll help customers navigate their insurance options, answer questions, and ensure they have access to the resources they need.


Key responsibilities include:

  • Conduct high-volume outbound outreach using approved dialing systems and customer lists.
  • Build rapport quickly and create positive customer experiences through professional, empathetic communication.
  • Educate customers about available programs, services, benefits, and next steps.
  • Follow approved scripts and compliance requirements while maintaining an authentic and conversational approach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and follow-up activities within company systems.
  • Address questions, identify customer needs, and escalate complex issues when appropriate.
  • Protect sensitive customer information and comply with all privacy, regulatory, and company requirements.
  • Support inbound customer calls and other service initiatives as business needs evolve.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and development activities to continuously strengthen your skills.
  • Collaborate with teammates and cross-functional partners to deliver a seamless customer experience.

What We're Looking For


Required Qualifications

  • Active Accident & Health Insurance License in your state of residence (required).
  • Bilingual Requirement: Fluency in Spanish and English (required)
  • Strong customer service background with a passion for helping others.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to build trust, demonstrate empathy, and navigate sensitive conversations professionally.
  • Comfortable working in a structured environment with established processes and scripts.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately document customer interactions.
  • Ability to work independently while remaining highly engaged with a team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous call center, healthcare, health insurance, Medicare, sales support, or customer engagement experience.
  • Experience working remotely and maintaining productivity in a home-office environment.
  • Prior experience in high-volume outbound calling environments.

Success in This Role


The ideal candidate is:

  • Customer-focused and passionate about helping others.
  • Adaptable and comfortable shifting between outbound and inbound support as business needs change.
  • Open to cross-training and learning new responsibilities.
  • Coachable and receptive to feedback for continuous improvement.
  • Confident following required scripts and compliance guidelines while delivering a personalized customer experience.
  • Self-motivated, dependable, and able to stay productive in a remote work environment.
  • Resilient and professional when managing challenging conversations or customer concerns.

Work Environment


This position may be performed remotely, in a hybrid setting, or in an office environment based on business needs. Team members use company-provided technology and must maintain a secure, professional workspace that supports confidential customer conversations.


Join Us


If you're a licensed insurance professional who enjoys connecting with people, solving problems, and delivering exceptional service, this is an opportunity to build a rewarding career while making a meaningful impact on customers every day. We welcome motivated, customer-focused professionals who are eager to learn, grow, and contribute to a high-performing team.


Apply today and help customers navigate their health insurance journey with confidence.

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As a Senior Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to use your legal expertise and litigation skills to independently handle a caseload of higher exposure cases and more complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim matters depending on line of business. You will deliver optimal results for Travelers' insured customers and will mentor less experienced attorneys.

What Will You Do?

  • In the independent handling of a caseload of higher exposure cases and most complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim depending on line of business, your responsibilities will include:
  • Leverage trial experience to apply effective use of litigation skills and techniques to try cases to verdict or negotiate resolution.
  • Conduct advanced legal research and demonstrate strong and persuasive legal writing and presentation skills.
  • Draft substantive pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery and other legal documents.
  • Attend court events, depositions, and other appointments independently.
  • Provide in-depth, substantive case analysis and recommendations to insured clients and Claim partners on file handling strategies.
  • Collaborates with expert witnesses and consultants to develop case strategies, evaluate technical matters, and prepare compelling testimony for litigation.
  • Build and maintain strong internal and external client and business partner relationships, including independent responsibility for managing client and business partner relationships.
  • Provide internal and external training, seminars and legal updates to insured clients and Claim partners.
  • Provide leadership through mentoring other attorneys and legal support staff.
  • Initiate special projects and identifies other opportunities to support office goals/business needs.
  • Fully and effectively utilize available technology, case management system and automation.
  • Travel as required to meet business needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 7+ years of insurance defense litigation experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Strong aptitude for trying cases to a jury; proven track record of litigating jury trials, with a history of successful courtroom outcomes
  • Demonstrates strong technical knowledge in the practice area(s) and the ability to effectively communicate complex information on litigated matters to diverse audiences.
  • Advanced oral and written advocacy skills, with a demonstrated track record of summary judgment and/or appellate successs.
  • Possesses in-depth knowledge of the bench, bar, local jurisdictional practices, adversaries.
  • Excels in fostering collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners to deliver exceptional customer service
  • Demonstrates strong leadership through mentoring and influencing skills.
  • Exercises sound decision making and possesses advanced negotiation skills.
  • Effectively manages multiple priorities with an attention to detail, sense of urgency & responsiveness.
  • Possesses a flexible and agile mindset with a willingness to take on new challenges as needs evolve.

What is a Must Have?

  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent International legal degree; graduate of an accredited law school.
  • 7 years experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Active license in good standing to practice law in the state(s) in which representation is required.
  • Regularly handles hearings, trials, dispositive motion arguments, depositions, or other court proceedings and has the ability to transport to those meetings. Valid driver's license required depending on the location.

Finance Support and Analytics (primary focus)

Marketing Operations and AI-Enabled Ways of Working

  • Use Workfront and AI-enabled tools to improve project intake and workflow efficiency

  • Assist with quality review and maintenance of operational records and project data

What you'll learn: How projects move from request to delivery, how operational and financial data connect, and how to apply AI as a thought partner to analyze information, strengthen deliverables, and streamline routine tasks, with the judgment to check results for accuracy and quality.

Engagement & Integration Initiatives

  • Support planning and coordination of team events, workshops, and recognition programs
  • Assist with internal communications and employee engagement activities
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of employee intranet content
