What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As an Associate Senior Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to use your legal expertise and litigation skills to independently handle a caseload of predominatly moderate to higher complexity matters, which may include Major Case matters depending on line of business. You will deliver optimal results for Travelers' insured customers, and will mentor less experienced attorneys.

What Will You Do?

  • In the handling of a caseload of predominantly moderate and higher exposure cases, including Major Case litigation matters depending on line of business, your responsibilities will include:
  • Leverage pre-trial and trial experience to apply effective use of litigation skills and techniques to try cases to verdict or negotiate resolution.
  • Conduct proficient to advanced legal research and demonstrate strong and persuasive legal writing and presentation skills.
  • Draft substantive pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery and other legal documents.
  • Attend court events, depositions, and other appointments independently.
  • Provide in-depth, substantive case analysis and recommendations to insured clients and Claim partners on file handling strategies.
  • Collaborates with expert witnesses and consultants to develop case strategies, evaluate technical matters, and prepare compelling testimony for litigation.
  • Build and maintain strong internal and external client and business partner relationships, including accountability for managing client and business partner relationships.
  • Provide internal and external training, seminars and legal updates to insured clients and Claim partners.
  • Provide leadership through mentoring other attorneys and legal support staff.
  • Contributes to special projects and identifies other opportunities to support office goals/business needs.
  • Fully and effectively utilize available technology, case management system and automation.
  • Travel as required to meet business needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 5+ years of insurance defense litigation experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Demonstrates an aptitude for trying cases to a jury; proven track record of preparing and/or litigating jury trials, with a history of successful courtroom outcomes.
  • Demonstrates strong technical knowledge in the practice area(s) and the ability to effectively communicate complex information on litigated matters to diverse audiences.
  • Proficient oral and written advocacy skills, with a demonstrated track record of summary judgment and/or appellate successs.
  • Possesses in-depth knowledge of the bench, bar, local jurisdictional practices, adversaries.
  • Capably fosters collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners to deliver exceptional customer service.
  • Demonstrates leadership through mentoring and influencing skills.
  • Exercises sound decision making and possesses advanced negotiation skills.
  • Effectively manages multiple priorities with an attention to detail, sense of urgency and responsiveness.
  • Possesses a flexible and agile mindset with a willingness to take on new challenges as needs evolve.

What is a Must Have?

  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent International legal degree; graduate of an accredited law school.
  • 4 years experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Active license in good standing to practice law in the state(s) in which representation is required.
  • Regularly handles hearings, trials, dispositive motion arguments, depositions, or other court proceedings and has the ability to transport to those meetings. Valid driver's license required depending on the location.

If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Good fit if you have four years of property claims experience, an active adjuster license, and can climb ladders and travel to multiple locations.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. Salary Range

$81,500.00 - $134,500.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

LOCATION REQUIREMENT: This field position services Insureds/Agents in the Maryland area. The selected candidate must reside in or around the assigned territories.
*You will be issued a company vehicle for this position.*

As a Technical Specialist, Outside Property, you are responsible for handling complex, high exposure and higher severity 1st party property claims in a timely and accurate manner which includes performing in-person inspections at customers' residences and properties to accurately assess damages. In this technical role, you will leverage your skillset in claims management, investigative techniques, coverage evaluation, and settlement negotiation to ensure timely, and fair resolution of claims across complex personal and business insurance claims. You will foster positive, professional relationships with customers and stakeholders especially with claims that may span months or years to resolve. Provide guidance and mentorship to Claim Reps and Associate Claim Reps sharing knowledge and best practices to foster their development. This position is based remotely with work at residential and/or commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office. This position services a territory in <add location> areas of <add state(s)>. You must either reside in or be willing to relocate at your own expense to assigned territory.

What Will You Do?

  • Independently manage, investigate, and document highly complex 1st party property claims with minimal oversight. Will fully manage personal insurance and business insurance claims.
  • Gather information from policyholders, claimants, and third-party vendors.
  • Investigate and evaluate all relevant facts and information (including but not limited to analyzing leases, contracts, by-laws and other relevant documents which may have an impact). Determine and apply coverage for property damages per policy terms.
  • Establish accurate scope of damages for building and contents losses and utilize as a basis for written estimates and/or computer assisted estimates.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, representatives, third-party vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Actively negotiate with multiple constituents, i.e., contractors or insured's representatives and conveys claim settlements within authority.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems. May train Claim Professionals on claim systems.
  • Leverage advanced resolution strategies and coordinate internal and external resources to conduct comprehensive claim investigations and evaluations.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) and/or a UAS Remote Pilot Certification to comply with federal, state, and Travelers requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • Assess and inspect all areas of a dwelling or structure, including roofs, attics, crawl spaces, and other confined areas. Ability to carry, set up, and climb ladders weighing approximately 38-49 pounds.
  • May require extensive travel, including overnight stays, to support customers across multiple locations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Four years of property claim experience in both personal and business insurance lines.
  • Active adjuster license, where applicable.
  • Experience with claims management and estimating software, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to comprehend, synthesize, and clearly articulate complex information to multiple stakeholders.
  • Ability to analyze complex situations, exercise sound judgement, and make effective decisions independently.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers; ability to manage difficult conversations with empathy and professionalism.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills with the ability to manage a high-volume workload and prioritize effectively.
  • Proven conflict resolution and negotiation skills; ability to handle complex or disputed claims, negotiate settlements, and manage litigation.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Thorough understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations, fair claims practices, and legal requirements applicable to claim handling. Demonstrated ability to interpret, apply, and clearly articulate complex policy language, endorsements, exclusions to assess coverage and claim eligibility.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Three years of property or comparable claim related experience.
  • Valid driver's license.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Unit Manager for General Liability claims at Travelers Insurance in Hartford. Manages a team of claim professionals, overseeing product quality, file reviews, staff development, and claim handling while serving as field representative for the Home Office.

Good fit if you have 3 years of claim work experience, a bachelor's degree, and experience leading and developing staff.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$109,300.00 - $180,200.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Under general direction and as a member of local line of business General Liability management team, responsible for product quality and performance for a specific team of claim professionals. Provide guidance and direction to direct reports through a continuous process of management involvement and frequent claim file review. Serve as a field representative for the Home Office General Liability product, as requested. Reinforce General Liability Vision, Strategies, and Objectives through word and action. Select, lead, mentor, performance manage and develop staff. This job manages staff.

What Will You Do?

  • Attract, Retain and Develop World Class Talent:
  • Proactive recruitment of talent; work with management establishing and implementing a strategic staffing strategy.
  • Effective orientation and on-boarding.
  • Manage staff performance; implement strategies and plans to address staff development; identify and address training needs on an ongoing basis; provide frequent performance feedback.
  • Work with management to develop and implement effective training, performance development and succession planning.
  • Effective retention planning; proactively manage and respond to turnover.
  • Effectively utilize reward system to distinguish top performers and significant achievements.
  • Provide Compelling Claim Services:
  • Employ proper claim handling techniques to protect the integrity of our brand and providing consistent service quality and streamlined processes to add value for our customers.
  • Develop and execute a strategic file management plan that achieves optimal file resolution and business results.
  • Provide face-to-face and written guidance to ensure effectiveness, engagement, accuracy and efficiency.
  • Review new notices, ensuring claims are assigned to staff with appropriate skill sets.
  • Conduct quality file reviews per office/best practices guidelines.
  • Establish/follow up on file reviews per diary instructions, conducting additional reviews.
  • (i.e. 180, 360 day reviews), as necessary.
  • Implement strategies and initiatives to improve file quality, customer service and manage costs.
  • Drive the Information Advantage:
  • Successfully leverage data, management information and technology to identify and make the most of opportunities to support business strategies and improve results.
  • Achieve Optimal Solutions:
  • Focus on resolution and process improvement, fulfilling all obligations while maximizing cost effectiveness, helping the business understand drivers, trends and product stress points and helping our partners attract and retain business.
  • Operate within agreed upon expense budget to achieve optimal business results through productivity, appropriate resource allocation, inventory management and loss adjustment expense.
  • Partner for Mutual Success:
  • Develop and maintain effective relationships with colleagues, business partners, customers, agents, regulatory agencies and others to achieve organizational goals and create better outcomes.
  • Participate in business meetings and agency visits as required.
  • In order to perform the essential functions of this job, acquisition and maintenance of Insurance License(s) may be required to comply with state and Travelers requirements. Generally, license(s) must be obtained within three months of starting the job and obtain ongoing continuing education credits as mandated.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Claim management experience.
  • Leading the Business:
  • Drive Results.
  • Leads Change.
  • Executes Business Strategy.
  • Leading Others:
  • Attract Top Talent.
  • Maximize Individual Performance.
  • Holds Others Accountable.
  • Aligns Rewards .
  • Creates and Sustains a Dynamic Workplace.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • 3 years claim work experience in at least one line of business.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

The Materials Manager is responsible for ensuring the smooth flow of materials and products necessary for production and operational success within the depots. This is accomplished through the development of lean processes and procedures that meet internal and external customer requirements and the effective leadership of Inventory Control resources through clear and precise communications of responsibilities and goals.

This is an onsite role at our Irving, TX facility with a schedule of Monday - Thursday from 6 AM to 4:30 PM.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Effective operation by working with the supervisors to complete customer priorities based on demand schedules, assigning tasks/projects as needed, coordinating the flow of work, oversee completion of work, monitor key performance metrics (KPI), managing labor efficiency across the area of responsibility, mentor/coach leaders and manage headcount
  • Ensure adherence to company policies and process standards, while maintaining employee morale and overseeing the training of new and existing staff for the department
  • Establish, track, and analyze departmental reports/measurements and present findings as appropriate
  • Work with senior management to establish department and company goals, and rely on experience, judgment and innovation to achieve them
  • Identify process improvements for the department along with the design of KPIs and coordinate new model introductions
  • Create and utilize reports to accurately represent product flow and task completion rates and percentages
  • Develop and utilize reporting to ensure SLAs are achieved
  • Manage cycle counts and inventory control processes to ensure inventory accuracy maintained
  • Liaison between teams, shifts, and departments, and partners with vendor/customer/client representatives while fostering true partner relationships that allow us to manage change and growth within the individual business
  • Monitor inventory of stock and ensure adequate levels are maintained
  • Provides technical and operational support during the business development process and new customer acquisition
  • Maintain a clean, organized and safe work environment for personnel to work in while ensuring all safety and environmental regulations are followed
  • Develop and establish document controls to ensure accuracy of inventory
  • Hires, develops, evaluates, and (when necessary) disciplines and discharges subordinates' personnel or makes authoritative recommendations in such matters
  • Develops function-specific orientation and training programs for area personnel
  • Establishes standards for effective job performance and evaluates subordinates according to such standards

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in any business or related discipline
  • Minimum seven (7) years' experience required in a logistics/distribution, fast paced, high volume manufacturing environment with at least five (5) years of data interpretation/analysis and logistics experience and 2 of inventory management experience
  • Minimum of five (5) years leadership experience with at least five (5) years' experience managing supervisory personnel

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • APICS CPIM designation
  • Working knowledge and understanding of MRP/ERP systems, WIP & Planning, Preferred knowledge with Oracle
  • Experience with Microsoft Great Plains
  • Highly skilled inventory control leader with extensive strategic and tactical experience, results-oriented, high energy, high urgency, and embraces effective change
  • High level of customer interaction; frequent interruptions and re-prioritization of projects based upon customer needs, working under deadlines, creative thinking, working on multiple projects simultaneously, and ability making decisions based on various levels of information
  • Working knowledge of Visio
  • Ability to interact and understand IT issues related to business processes and systems changes
  • Knowledge of inventory and warehousing processing procedures
  • Experience in, manufacturing, automation, electronics, systems integration, life cycle modeling, new product introduction, process development and deployment, leveraging Lean/6 Sigma tools, project and resource planning, and systems implementation

Full job description

Are you looking to make an impactful difference in your work, yourself, and your community? Why settle for just a job when you can land a career? At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible.


Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here!


The Director, Group Product Manager is a senior technology product leadership role accountable for end-to-end product delivery outcomes for the Specialty Business Unit, encompassing Excess Casualty and other specialty product builds, and shared function delivery (Billing, Claims, Portals, Distribution) as they serve the Specialty lines. This role leads a team of Technical Product Managers and oversees technology product strategy, vendor governance, and cross-functional delivery spanning policy administration, underwriting, billing, claims, portals, and distribution for their Business Unit.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Owns the product roadmap and delivery outcomes for the Specialty Business Unit, ensuring alignment with enterprise strategy and business objectives.
  • Accountable for Business Unit delivery outcomes across shared insurance functions (Billing, Claims, Portals, Distribution, Marketing etc.)
  • Develops and articulates a clear technology product roadmap for the Specialty Business Unit, aligning product goals with the Company's overall goals, and customer needs.
  • Oversees the product planning process by collaborating with cross-functional teams, prioritizing features, defining requirements, and creating a product roadmap for the entire product development lifecycle.
  • Leads and inspires a team of technical product managers (TPMs) and coordinates their activities to ensure that they meet key performance indicators (KPIs) while fostering collaboration with engineering, business stakeholders, marketing, and other departments.
  • Partners with LPM and Business Owners on market intelligence and industry trends; translates into technology product roadmap priorities for the Specialty Business Unit
  • Represents the product roadmap to executive leadership, internal stakeholders, and customers to ensure alignment and transparency.
  • Ensures product roadmap reflects customer needs as defined by business stakeholders and LPM
  • Ensures consistent delivery of value by validating that all products meet customer needs and maintain high-quality standards.
  • Manages vendor delivery execution at the Business Unit level — ensures vendor teams deliver against SOW commitments
  • Sets Business Unit roadmap priorities for shared function TPMs
  • Develops and leads a team of technical product professionals.
  • Provides strategic and tactical direction to the team, communicating the organizational mission and values, and setting standards for performance excellence in technology product delivery.
  • Establishes a collaborative team culture ensuring high engagement, recognition, and retention of team members. Ensures leadership practices promote continuous development and high performance.
  • Manages hiring, onboarding, and training for incoming staff, setting clear expectations and developing career paths to build a resilient, skilled team capable of driving innovative solutions.

SUPERVISORY RESPONISBILITIES

Directly supervises employees within the Product Management teams and carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws. These responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; conducting performance and salary reviews; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems; coaching, mentoring, and developing team members to further their skills and knowledge; creating and monitoring development plans; setting performance expectations/goals; forecasting staffing needs and planning for peak times and absences; enforcing department policies and procedures.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree required in business administration, marketing, computer science, software development, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • Minimum 8-10 years of experience in IT product management with at least 3-4 years in senior leadership roles, with a track record of successfully managing and launching insurance technology products.
  • Experience in P&C insurance technology delivery required.
  • Demonstrated experience in vendor governance, SOW negotiation, and investment proposals for enterprise technology platforms.
  • Experience with insurance SaaS platforms (Guidewire, Majesco) and vendor delivery models required.
  • Track record of delivering cross-functional outcomes across multiple concurrent initiatives.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Working knowledge of underwriting workflows, policy administration, billing, and claims processes for Specialty lines.
  • Comfort with ambiguity in a scaling organization — this role requires someone who can build structure while delivering outcomes simultaneously.
  • A solid understanding of product management tools and processes, including proficiency in agile methodologies, product lifecycle management, market research techniques, and data analysis.
  • Strong strategic thinking skills and a solid understanding of business dynamics to align product initiatives with overall business objectives.
  • Strong leadership skills to inspire and motivate a team, set a clear vision, and guide them toward successful product outcomes.
  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, are important for conveying product vision to key team members and stakeholders and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work with diverse teams, including engineering, architecture, business teams, etc.
  • Strategic thinking and ability to make informed decisions about product direction, market opportunities, and competitive positioning while analyzing complex situations and leveraging your problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to embrace new technologies, methodologies, and agile strategies.

PHYSICAL ENVIRONMENT

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk and hear.

About this job

Associate Actuary role in Lincoln Financial's Actuarial Development Program supporting pricing execution reporting across Group Protection products. Responsibilities include data transformation, renewal and new business forecasting, and building dashboards for cross-functional stakeholders.

Good fit if you have 3-6+ years actuarial experience, proficiency in SQL and Dataiku, and are pursuing ASA credentials.

Full job description

Alternate Locations: Omaha, NE (Nebraska); Charlotte, NC (North Carolina); Fort Wayne, IN (Indiana); Greensboro, NC (North Carolina); Hartford, CT (Connecticut); Radnor, PA (Pennsylvania)

Hybrid : Employee will work 3 days a week in a Lincoln office

The Role at a Glance

The Actuarial Development Program (ADP) at Lincoln Financial is an industry-leading program that demonstrates Lincoln Financial' s commitment to creating highly qualified business leaders. As an ADP participant, you'll be able to explore your unique interests while developing the essential actuarial, technical, management, communication, and leadership skills you need to succeed. The Actuarial Development Program includes a series of rotations, typically every 18-24 months. For each rotation, roles are available in different business areas including Life and Annuities, Retirement and Group Protection. Experience gained will enable participants to become well-rounded actuaries with knowledge that may include Product Development, Pricing, Valuation, Modeling, Risk Management, Asset Liability Management, Investments, Data Analytics, and Internal Audit.

ADP participants are expected to pass the Society of Actuaries' exams at a prescribed pace. The program is designed to support you as you work towards your FSA and provide the training and resources necessary to become a well-rounded actuarial leader.

Additional Program Highlights:
•Highly competitive compensation package with salary increases and bonuses upon successful exam completion
•Social and training opportunities to enhance skills, network with ADP participants and build long-lasting industry relationships
•Dedicated leaders and mentors to assist with career development
Work with actuarial and data science software and technologies including MG-ALFA, Axis, Prophet, Dataiku, R, and Tableau
•Generous study time allowances for each exam session
•Payment and/or reimbursement of actuarial exam fees, materials, review courses, and seminars taken during the program

The Associate Actuary, Pricing Analytics & Reporting role will support the highly visible pricing execution reporting across Lincoln's Group Protection product suite – Life/AD&D, LTD, STD, Leave, Dental, and Supplemental Health. This role will be responsible for producing critical metrics & forecasts that drive business decisions across pricing, underwriting, and sales/distribution. You will be an end-to-end owner of the reporting process including data transformation, pricing strategy implementation, and data visualization.

What you'll be doing

•Data Transformation: Maintain data pipeline (i.e. Dataiku) that produces the team's renewal and new business execution reports, proactively identifying and implementing improvements to accuracy, functionality, and business impact.
•Renewal Execution Reporting/Forecasting: Produce reporting on key renewal metrics such as persistency, rate action, and profitability. Track & forecast metric development throughout operational year and influence intra-year strategy decisions.
•New Business Execution Reporting/Forecasting: Produce reporting on new business sales & profitability relative to targets. Integrate region, segment, or product-specific strategies into target benchmarks. Act as a technical liaison to sales leadership.
•Cross-Functional Collaboration: Closely partner with leaders from pricing, underwriting, data engineering, sales, and account management to drive business decisions through accurate and relevant reporting.
•Data Visualization: Build and maintain dashboards and reporting tools that are used by a variety of stakeholders. Develop creative solutions to display insights in new and meaningful ways.

What we're looking for

•3-6+ years of actuarial experience
•Pursuing actuarial credentials (ASA designation preferred)
•Proficiency in SQL, experience with Dataiku & Oracle databases
•Experience with data visualization or other reporting tools (Ex: Tableau)
•Demonstrated ability to maintain data accuracy, cleanliness, and functionality
•Motivated and collaborative approach to the role
•4 Year/Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) (Minimum Required)

About this job

Lead Software Engineer providing technical leadership for an Agile team building cloud-native applications on AWS. The role involves hands-on development in Java, Node.js, or Python, designing serverless architectures, and modernizing the technology landscape through cloud migration and DevOps practices.

Good fit if you have 5+ years developing enterprise applications, 2+ years leading distributed Agile teams, and strong hands-on experience with AWS serverless services and infrastructure as code.

Full job description

Alternate Locations: Greensboro, NC (North Carolina); Fort Wayne, IN (Indiana); Radnor, PA (Pennsylvania)

Work Arrangement:

Hybrid : Employee will work 3 days a week in a Lincoln office

Relocation assistance: is not available for this opportunity.

Requisition #: 76826

The Role at a Glance

The Lead Software Engineer / Technical Lead provides hands-on technical leadership for an Agile delivery team responsible for building industry-leading capabilities while modernizing the technology landscape through cloud migration, DevOps, artificial intelligence and architectural advancement. This role guides solution design and application delivery from initial proposal and estimation through development, testing, deployment, and production support.

The position partners with business stakeholders, Enterprise Architecture, federated architecture teams, Security, and other technology groups to deliver scalable, secure, cost-effective solutions. The role also champions engineering practices such as CI/CD, independent architecture, secure coding, automated testing, and a “you build it, you own it” operating model.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead the design, development, and delivery of AWS cloud-native and serverless applications using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, EventBridge, SQS, SNS, and Step Functions.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures supporting enterprise integrations.
  • Provide hands-on development using Java, Node.js, and Python, including code reviews, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and production support.
  • Design and manage infrastructure as code using AWS CDK and CloudFormation.
  • Build and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, including automated testing, security scanning, and deployment automation.
  • Implement asynchronous processing, retry mechanisms, dead-letter queues, idempotency, and resilient integration patterns.
  • Collaborate with Security and Identity teams on OAuth 2.0, mutual TLS (mTLS), IAM, Secrets Manager, and secure API integrations.
  • Drive application observability and production troubleshooting using CloudWatch, Splunk, and New Relic.
  • Lead technical design discussions, architecture reviews, estimation, and implementation planning across distributed Agile teams.
  • Identify opportunities to modernize legacy applications, reduce technical debt, improve system reliability, and optimize AWS costs.
  • Promote engineering excellence through secure coding, automated testing, peer reviews, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development tools.
  • Assess emerging technology trends and advise senior management on their potential impact, particularly in AWS, microservices, cloud architecture, and artificial intelligence.
  • Identify and lead process improvements that reduce defects, shorten code turnaround time, strengthen pipelines, improve cost and performance, and enhance application security.
  • Provide business and technical subject matter expertise to team members and internal and external stakeholders on complex assignments and initiatives.
  • Lead technical response and solution coordination for production issues; support resolution estimation, root-cause analysis, remediation, and service restoration.
  • Direct and enhance organizational initiatives by positively influencing and supporting change management and/or departmental/enterprise initiatives within assigned area(s) of responsibility including but not limited to transition to AIDLC, enterprise cloud migration, etc. that support IT partners in delivering applications that increase adoption of self-service capabilities.

What we're looking for

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years of experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise applications.
  • 2+ years of experience providing technical leadership to distributed Agile development teams.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS serverless services, including Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Event Bridge, and SQS.
  • Proficiency in one or more backend technologies, including Java, Node.js, or Python.
  • Experience designing RESTful APIs, microservices, event-driven integrations, and distributed systems.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code, preferably AWS CDK or CloudFormation.
  • Experience developing and maintaining GitLab CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and secure deployment processes.
  • Understanding of cloud security, IAM, OAuth 2.0, API authentication, and secure integration patterns.
  • Experience with application monitoring, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and production support.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply generative AI responsibly within the software development lifecycle, including validating AI-generated outputs, protecting confidential information, following secure coding practices, and complying with enterprise AI governance and intellectual property requirements.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, or comparable generative AI tools to accelerate code development, technical analysis, documentation, testing, debugging, and modernization activities.
  • Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, security teams, and engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical assignments, communicate architectural decisions, and collaborate effectively with business and technology stakeholders.

TECHNOLOGY EXPERIENCE

Cloud Platform & Serverless

  • AWS Lambda, Amazon API Gateway, Amazon EventBridge, Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS, AWS Step Functions
  • Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon S3, Amazon RDS, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, AWS IAM, AWS Secrets Manager, AWS KMS, Amazon VPC, Amazon CloudWatch, AWS CloudTrail

Programming Languages & Frameworks

  • Java, Node.js, Python
  • Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices

Infrastructure as Code & DevOps

  • AWS CDK, AWS CloudFormation
  • GitLab CI/CD, Git, automated deployment pipelines
  • Automated testing, code quality analysis, vulnerability scanning

Architecture & Integration

  • Serverless architecture, event-driven architecture, microservices
  • REST APIs, asynchronous messaging, distributed systems
  • OAuth 2.0, mutual TLS (mTLS), secure API integrations
  • Retry handling, dead-letter queues, idempotency, and fault tolerance

Monitoring & Observability

  • Amazon CloudWatch, Splunk, New Relic
  • Application logging, monitoring, performance analysis, production troubleshooting
  • Databases
  • DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle, DB2, SQL

AI-Assisted Engineering

  • Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or comparable AI-assisted development tools
  • Responsible use of generative AI for development, code reviews, testing, documentation, and modernization

Job.JobDescription:
Are you looking to make an impactful difference in your work, yourself, and your community? Why settle for just a job when you can land a career? At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible.


Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here!


PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The Claims Specialist position is responsible for handling complex claims with a focus on providing exceptional service for stakeholders in order to drive claims to an equitable resolution within Company standards. The Claims Specialist works with a sense of urgency, understands insurance coverage concepts, and navigates the legal system with the support of counsel to drive strategic outcomes.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Manages complex claims inventories requiring advanced technical expertise and strategic claim handling

  • Effectively communicates with policyholders, agents, attorneys, and witnesses to gather information and provide the highest possible level of customer service.
  • Promptly investigates claims to determine exposure, works with appropriate experts and makes strategic recommendations.
  • Utilizes appropriate resolution tactics (e.g., mediation, negotiation, denial, litigation or offer) to proactively drive outstanding results.
  • Operates within the requirements of related state and/or the governing entity rules and regulations as well as internal claims handling policies and procedures.
  • Directs defense counsel throughout the litigation process in line with ICW litigation guidelines while monitoring legal fees and costs.

All Claims Specialists:

  • Consistently provides exceptional customer service
  • Effectively collaborates with cross-functional Team Members for project and process discussions
  • Makes recommendations for streamlining processes and adopting the industry's best practices
  • Ensures accuracy of data in claims system for compliance with applicable regulatory reporting
  • Provides knowledge transfer across the organization
  • Continuously seeks to improve technical skills by attending job related training and tracking current case law.
  • As a SME (subject matter expert), serves as a technical resource and mentors/trains less experienced Team Members

Workers' Compensation Claims (Specific Responsibilities):

  • Prepares and presents claims status reports for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Administers timely and appropriate benefits to injured workers; manages and approves payment of benefits within designated authority level. Works within applicable state rules, regulations as well as ICW Group's internal claims handling policies and procedures.
  • Creates and adjusts reserves in a timely manner to ensure reserving activities are consistent with company policies.
  • Resolves claims fairly and equitably, acting in the best interest of the insured while providing timely benefits to injured workers as required by law.
  • Supports specialty claim handling programs and strategic initiatives involving complex litigation, medical exposure, catastrophic injuries, fatality, PTD, or long-duration claims
  • Provides technical guidance and collaborates with leadership on complex claim resolution strategies and specialty handling initiative
  • Identifies and drives resolution opportunities on complex or long-duration claims through proactive settlement, reserving, and medical management strategies.


SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This position has no supervisory responsibility


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree (or equivalent combination of education and experience) required along with a minimum of 8 – 10+ years' related claims handling experience involving complex litigation, reserving, settlement strategy, and high exposure claims.


CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Workers' Compensation: Certification that meets the minimum standards of training, experience, and skill required. WCCA and WCCP preferred. State Workers Compensation License is required in some branches.



KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Excellent understanding of laws and jurisdictional restraints to manage claims
  • Excellent verbal communication skills, time management, attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Must be adept at learning new technology
  • Flexibility to adapt to changes in a fast-paced environment

Must have the ability to:

  • Read, analyze, and interpret technical and legal documents
  • Write reports and business correspondence
  • Respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers (insured), claimants and regulatory agencies
  • Present information at meetings, to management and clients
  • Solve practical problems and deal with a variety of variables in situations where limited standardization exists

Workers' Compensation: Advanced knowledge of workers' compensation claims handling, reserving, litigation management, and resolution strategies



PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, and other standard office equipment.


This description is a general statement of essential job functions and responsibilities. The position may include other duties as assigned.

WHY JOIN ICW GROUP?

Good fit if you have 5+ years of executive assistant experience, strong organizational skills, and proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Microsoft Teams.

The Role at a Glance

An exciting Executive Assistant position has recently opened in the Chief Actuarial Risk Office (CRAO) supporting Chief Actuary and Risk functions. The Executive Assistant will report to Chief Actuary, Senior Vice President (SVP) and will also provide support to other senior leaders in the CRAO organization. In this collaborative setting, you will work closely with fellow team members to ensure the smooth operation of the executives' offices and contribute to the overall efficiency and effectiveness of the department.

As part of the administrative support team, you will have the opportunity to collaborate and exchange ideas with colleagues who share a commitment to excellence. You will collectively manage calendars, coordinate meetings, and support various projects and initiatives. Together, you will coordinate complex travel arrangements, streamline communication channels, and maintain efficient document management systems. By pooling your collective skills and expertise, you will provide comprehensive support to the executives, enabling them to focus on their strategic responsibilities. This team-oriented environment fosters a sense of camaraderie, encourages knowledge sharing, and provides opportunities for professional growth and development.

While reporting to the Chief Actuary, Senior Vice President you will also be a part of the broader team of EA professionals, not only contributing to the success of the executives you support but also play a vital role in the broader objectives of the organization. Your dedication, teamwork, and attention to detail will be instrumental in helping the department operate seamlessly and achieve its goals.

What you'll be doing

•Calendar Management: Effectively manage the executives' calendars, including scheduling and prioritizing meetings, appointments, and events. Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure optimal use of their time.
•Meeting Coordination: Prepare meeting agendas, collate relevant materials, and provide logistical support for meetings, conferences, and presentations. Take minutes, follow up on action items, and ensure timely completion of tasks.
•Committee Support: Provide administrative support to committees and working groups, including scheduling meetings, preparing agendas, and distributing relevant materials. Assist with minutes and action item tracking, ensuring effective committee operations.
•Travel Arrangements: Coordinate complex domestic travel arrangements, including flights, accommodations, and itineraries. Ensure travel plans align with the executives' schedules and preferences.
•Document Preparation: Create, format, and proofread various documents, including reports, presentations, and spreadsheets. Ensure accuracy, consistency, and adherence to company guidelines.
•Relationship Management: Establish and maintain positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including clients, colleagues, and vendors. Act as a liaison between the executives and various teams, departments, and external partners. Additionally, provide support for employee onboarding activities, including coordinating new hire paperwork, and assisting with the integration process.
•Expense Management: Process and track expense reports, ensuring compliance with company policies. Maintain accurate records of expenses and receipts and assist with budget monitoring and financial reporting.
•License Management: Maintain accurate records of software and professional license assignments across the team, including actuarial modeling platforms and other specialized tools.
•Project Support: Assist with special projects and initiatives by conducting research, gathering data, and preparing presentations. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to facilitate project milestones and deliverables.
•Confidentiality and Data Security: Handle sensitive and confidential information with the utmost discretion. Maintain strict confidentiality protocols and ensure data security measures are followed.
•Office Organization: Organize and maintain electronic and physical files, ensuring easy retrieval of information. Manage office supplies, equipment, and facilities to ensure a well-functioning work environment.

What we're looking for

•5+ Years of executive assistant experience (minimum required)
•Exceptional organizational skills, demonstratable abilities to effectively manage calendars, coordinate meetings, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
•Excellent communication (written and verbal) abilities. Experience interacting with individuals at all levels of the organization.
•Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive information with utmost discretion and maintain a high level of confidentiality.
•Tech savviness with productivity tools such as Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and Microsoft Teams.
•Strong attention to detail ensure accuracy in document preparation, scheduling, and managing information.
•Proactive problem-solving skills
•Flexibility and adaptability, work well under pressure, and multi-task. Strong professional presence, and interpersonal skills.
•Ability to work overtime if needed.
•Advanced Analytics: In certain situations, use advanced analytics tools or techniques to analyze data, generate insights, or prepare reports. This could involve using spreadsheet software, data visualization tools, or statistical analysis software to support decision-making or provide relevant information to executives.
•Simple Code Writing: Depending on the specific projects, ability to write scripts to automate repetitive tasks using programming languages like Python or using macros in software applications to streamline processes.
•AI Tool Proficiency: Familiarity with AI productivity tools (Copilot, Claude) to support document drafting, summarization, and workflow automation. Comfortable experimenting with and adopting new AI capabilities as they evolve.

About this job

Hands-on network engineer role managing enterprise LAN, WAN, and cloud infrastructure across on-premises data centers and Microsoft Azure. Operates Palo Alto firewalls, Cisco switching fabric, and NetApp storage networking with responsibilities spanning security, routing, VPN, and incident response.

Good fit if you have 5+ years hands-on experience with Cisco switching, Palo Alto firewalls, Azure networking, and NetApp storage, plus strong TCP/IP and troubleshooting skills.

Full job description

Position Summary:

We are seeking a strong, hands-on Network Engineer to join our IT infrastructure team. Reporting to the Senior Network Engineer, this role owns the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and improvement of the company's network, firewall, and connectivity infrastructure across on-premises data centers and a growing Microsoft Azure environment, including the Cisco compute fabric, NetApp storage networking, and Palo Alto security platforms that support it. The ideal candidate is a deeply technical engineer with strong fundamentals, disciplined troubleshooting, and excellent documentation.

Work Location:
This is a full-time, in-person position based at our Boca Raton, Florida office. Remote and hybrid work arrangements are not available for this role.

Technical Environment:

  • Security: Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls (PAN-OS) across on-premises data centers and Azure, GlobalProtect VPN, Cloudflare, and Zero Trust / network access control.
  • Switching and compute fabric: Cisco Catalyst campus switching and Cisco Nexus (NX-OS) data-center switching; Cisco UCS X-Series (chassis, Fabric Interconnects, Intersight).
  • Routing and WAN: BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP across a multi-site WAN (MPLS / DIA circuits) with site-to-site IPSec VPN.
  • Storage networking: NetApp ONTAP (FAS / AFF) with SnapMirror replication; Tintri.
  • Cloud: a substantial and growing Microsoft Azure networking footprint (hub-and-spoke VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, Azure Firewall, NSGs, and user-defined routes).
  • Wireless and monitoring: UniFi wireless; Site24x7 monitoring.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate, maintain, and monitor enterprise LAN, WAN, and UniFi wireless infrastructure across multiple sites.
  • Administer Palo Alto Networks firewalls (PAN-OS), including security policy, NAT, threat prevention, URL filtering, and GlobalProtect VPN; tune App-ID and SSL / TLS decryption.
  • Design, implement, and support Microsoft Azure networking, including hub-and-spoke VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, Azure Firewall, NSGs, and user-defined routes.
  • Configure and troubleshoot routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP) across Cisco Catalyst and Cisco Nexus (NX-OS) switches and the Cisco UCS X-Series Fabric Interconnect environment in a multi-site network.
  • Build and maintain site-to-site IPSec VPN connectivity with business partners and vendors.
  • Support NetApp ONTAP storage networking and replication.
  • Administer network monitoring platforms; maintain alerting, dashboards, NetFlow, and device-health visibility.
  • Administer and support network security applications and Zero Trust / network access control.
  • Respond to network alerts and incidents; perform root-cause analysis and permanent remediation.
  • Participate in planned maintenance windows, including change preparation, verification, and rollback procedures.
  • Create and maintain network documentation, diagrams, IP address management (IPAM), and runbooks.
  • Install, rack, and cable network hardware; support equipment lifecycle and refresh projects.
  • Assist with network security tasks, including certificate management, vulnerability remediation, and access reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune's 2026 Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting
  • Long-term and short-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support
  • Collaborative and growth focused culture

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of hands-on network engineering or network administration experience.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP fundamentals, including subnetting, routing, NAT, DNS, and DHCP.
  • Production experience with enterprise-class routers and switches, including Cisco Catalyst, Cisco Nexus (NX-OS), and Cisco UCS X-Series Fabric Interconnects.
  • Hands-on production experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls (PAN-OS), including security policy, NAT, and VPN.
  • Working knowledge of at least one dynamic routing protocol (OSPF, EIGRP, or BGP).
  • Demonstrated experience with Microsoft Azure networking (VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, NSGs, and routing).
  • Experience with NetApp (or comparable enterprise) storage and its supporting network connectivity.
  • Experience with network monitoring tools and alerting platforms.
  • Experience supporting network security applications.
  • Methodical troubleshooting skills using packet captures, logs, and device diagnostics.
  • Strong written documentation skills.
  • Works well in a collaborative team environment, with strong self-motivation to drive projects through to completion.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Palo Alto Networks Network Security Professional, the entry-level certification in the current role-based program. The legacy PCNSA also applies.
  • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA).
  • Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700) and / or Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104).
  • NetApp Certified Technology Associate (NCTA).
  • Experience with Cisco UCS X-Series and Intersight data-center compute fabric.
  • IPSec VPN design and troubleshooting experience.
  • Familiarity with server, virtualization, or storage environments.

Work Environment:

  • Reports to: Senior Network Engineer.
  • Scope: owns day-to-day network operations and project execution; partners with the Senior Network Engineer, who leads network architecture and standards.
  • Full-time position with participation in an on-call rotation.
  • Occasional travel between company sites may be required.

At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as a Senior Trade Finance Underwriter to play your part in that transformation. It's an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.


Make your mark in Underwriting


AIG Underwriting teams help to find insurance solutions in areas including Financial Lines, Property, Casualty, Specialty Lines, Cyber, and Multinational Clients. We are reimagining how we help customers to manage risk, transforming our operating model and reshaping our role responsibilities and career pathways. The goal is to unlock the full potential in each colleague – empowering our people to grow as insurance professionals and add more value to our customers and AIG.


How you will create an impact

  • Perform credit analysis, and recommending and/or approving appropriate credit limits and terms
  • Analyze trade life cycle/ working capital needs in relation to buyers and seller risks in trade transactions
  • Complete insurance quotations and transaction summaries/ credit memoranda for internal stakeholders
  • Liaise closely with other insurance risk and credit underwriters and credit committees to obtain appropriate approvals and validate structures
  • Take ownership of transactional due diligence, structuring and commercial underwriting of trade transactions from origination to execution including analyzing structural risks and mitigants, eligibility criteria, sizing credit reserves/deductibles, modelling and premium setting
  • Escalate key issues or concerns in succinct clear manner to managers
  • Assist with negotiations of policy, trade and funding documentation to protect AIG's interests and meet client requirements and liaise with legal on same
  • Liaise with relevant AIG business departments (tax, accounting, compliance, onboarding, legal, new product development, vendor/ business partner onboarding, operations) on transactions
  • Take ownership of the monitoring of live trade transactions including structural changes, endorsements and renewals particularly on credit analysis and changes
  • Ensure policies and risks remain compliant with AIG underwriting guidelines, processes and procedures
  • Liaise closely with onboarding teams where corporates or funders are onboarded into AIG structures

Strategic product development and communications:

  • Support to identify and develop client-focused products and strategies for variety of clients (banks, alternative funders and other financiers) including cross-sell opportunities
  • Support origination strategies and engage with prospects & brokers including managing certain client relationships
  • Engage with and support sales initiatives and development of communications for brokers, banks, and other distribution stakeholders
  • Engage in Broker / Client meetings as often as possible to ensure local market presence
  • Prepare succinct summaries, business plans, models and high level data on financials and business growth for onwards distribution to manager and AIG senior management and investors (including presentations to key stakeholders)

Training and processes:

  • Assist to enhance trade transaction related processes
  • Attend and where relevant deliver training to local and global colleagues on trade products


What you'll need to succeed

  • Bachelor's or higher degree in finance or accounting
  • Mid-level experience in trade credit or risk team or related experience in the banking and finance industry
  • Proven ability to distil accounts, financial and written information
  • Transactional experience in trade finance deals including broad spectrum of trade products (receivables, confirmed payables, supply chain finance, guarantees, letters of credit, trade loans etc.)
  • Experience with new business generation
  • Strong communication skills, written and oral, presentations
  • Organizational skills and project management
  • Ability to manage time pressure, deadlines and competing tasks/ prioritize
  • Ability to handle a varied workload in a diverse and growing portfolio.
  • Proven decision making skills
  • Interpersonal skills - team player with internal and external stakeholders/ clients
  • Languages helpful, ability to engage with diverse, global teams

About this job

Handle complex Directors & Officers Liability claims and related management liability matters at AIG in New York. Responsibilities include coverage determination, investigation, litigation strategy, and negotiating multi-million dollar settlements with authority to manage outcomes independently.

Good fit if you have 6+ years handling complex insurance claims or litigation, strong communication and negotiation skills, and experience managing litigated cases through settlement.

Full job description

At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as a Complex Claims Director – Management Liability to play your part in that transformation. It's an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.

Make your mark in Claims

Our Claims teams are the proven problem solvers of choice for clients, delivering consistent technical excellence and showcasing our service differentiation to create an unparalleled global claims handling experience. Through a robust stakeholder feedback loop and supported by consistent processes and leadership, we take pride in delivering responsive, fair and professional service with empathy and efficiency.

How you will create an impact

As Complex Claims Director for Management Liability, you will be responsible for handling all aspects of our highest severity D&O claims with opportunity to handle high exposure Employment Practices Liability and Fiduciary Liability claims and you will have the unique opportunity to work with some of the industry's top talent in Financial Lines Claims. You are respected for your deep technical expertise and/or ability to oversee programs and processes. You have balanced the needs of multiple stakeholders, making sound decisions using data, analysis, experience and judgment, along with the appropriate risk mindset. Ultimately, you take ownership for key outcomes. This position requires:

  • Determining the scope and extent of available coverage.
  • The investigation, evaluation and disposition of new and existing Directors & Officers Liability claims including possibly Employment Practices Liability and Fiduciary Liability claims.
  • Preparation and execution of investigation strategies which identify critical issues effecting liability, causation and damages and assessment of risk transfer and contribution opportunities.
  • Clear and concise communication and contact with internal and external customers, including insureds, brokers and underwriters, to provide guidance and manage expectations.
  • Proper documentation of exposure evaluation and resolution strategy.
  • Frequently present to senior management of claim disposition recommendations.
  • Obtain the appropriate authority to independently negotiate multi-million dollar claims with the top plaintiff attorneys nationwide. Document evaluation, thought process, and strategy. Utilize ADR as appropriate and necessary.
  • Effectively strategize and budget litigation of each claim through discussions with counsel, vendors and insureds. Establish with defense and coverage counsel clear ground rules in order to maintain financial control of budget and expenses.
  • 10% travel.

What you will need to succeed

  • 6+ years of experience handling complex insurance claims, litigation or other related experience; management liability claims experience highly preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal/written) and strong negotiation skills.
  • Advanced experience and capabilities in litigation claims management including ADR and mediation process.
  • Experience attending and controlling cases: pre-suit, litigated, post-trial, at mediations, settlement conferences, etc.
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent required. JD highly preferred. Multi-state adjuster licenses preferred.
  • Motivation and interest in the potential for an upwardly mobile career path.

Ready to make a bigger impact? We look forward to reviewing your application.

Job Description

As a part of Taiwan/Greater China Global Solutions in U.S., you will manage and coordinate accounts and prospects, building and maintaining strong relationships with key client stakeholders and internal account service teams.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

Aon is in the business of better decisions. At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the Day Will Look Like

The role involves production and strategic account coordination of key U.S. Taiwan/Greater China clients & prospects, frequently interacting with client leadership externally and Aon's Account Service Teams.

  • Proactively identify and develop new business opportunities, expanding the book of business and strengthening overall client relationships.
  • Act as the lead Account Executive within Aon U.S. for Taiwan clients' U.S. risks, serving as the primary point of contact for Taiwan-headquartered clients on their U.S. exposures.
  • Serve U.S. local client entities directly, answering questions and resolving issues during U.S. business hours to ensure timely responses and issue resolution
  • Collaborate with practice & geographical offices to advance opportunities, support account plans, and contribute to pipeline development and revenue growth initiatives.
  • Facilitate client-facing discussions and internal alignment to ensure opportunities are effectively positioned and progressed.
  • Act as a bilingual bridge between clients and Aon teams, working closely with Commercial Risk and other solution groups to coordinate tailored solutions and address client needs.
  • Work closely with Aon Taiwan and client headquarters in Taiwan on strategy, program design, placement approach, and key account decisions to ensure alignment with the overall client relationship and client expectations from Taiwan.
  • Coordinate with Aon U.S. local offices and specialty practices on placement execution, renewals, servicing, and complex risk solutions.
  • Support Mexico-related client needs and coordinate with relevant Aon teams, recognizing the growing expansion of Taiwan clients into Mexico as part of their North American operations strategy.

How this opportunity is different

This role is specifically designed to support Taiwan/Greater China multinational clients and requires a unique combination of bilingual communication skills and cultural fluency. You will play a key role in identifying opportunities, building relationships, and advancing business initiatives in close partnership with internal stakeholders. Success in this role comes from the ability to bridge cultural and organizational gaps, communicate effectively across languages, and translate client needs into actionable strategies. By aligning internal resources and coordinating across stakeholders, you will help strengthen client relationships, advance business opportunities, and deliver consistent, high-quality solutions.

In particular, success will depend on deeply understanding Taiwan clients' business models, culture, and expectations, and ensuring that U.S. servicing is tightly aligned with strategies and decisions driven from Taiwan HQ.

Skills and Experience That Will Lead to Success

  • Bilingual in business-level Mandarin Chinese and English, both spoken and written.
  • 10+ years of sales, consulting, account management, marketing, or client advisory experience (preferably in commercial risk or insurance).
  • Taiwanese background preferred. Ability to communicate in Taiwanese dialect would be an advantage.
  • Client-facing experience at a brokerage, insurance company, financial institution, or professional services firm serving Taiwan/Greater China clients.
  • Complex project management experience.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, influence cross-functional teams across multiple locations and time zones.
  • Deep understanding of Taiwan business culture, decision-making processes, and the expectations of Taiwan-headquartered multinational clients.
  • Experience managing strategic or multinational accounts and navigating complex organizational structures.
  • Willingness to acquire a Property & Casualty license within 90 days of employment (Aon pays for training materials and exam).

Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
